title: Black Emperor Pathway
summary: Black Emperor Pathway: The Black Emperor Pathway manipulates existing rules to serve its user, specializing in loophole exploitation, physicality, bribery,
searchText: Black Emperor Pathway Anarchy · Standard Pathway Black Emperor Pathway Sequence 9: Lawyer → Sequence 0: Black Emperor The Black Emperor Pathway manipulates existing rules to serve its user, specializing in loophole exploitation, physicality, bribery, distortion, disorder, and domination. At high sequences it can exploit abstract laws, manipulate environments, magnify effects, isolate locations, and repeatedly resurrect while its order remains in place. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Black Emperor Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Lawyer Eloquence influences judgment and thinking; Law Proficiency finds loopholes and exploits rules and opponents’ weaknesses. 8 Barbarian Physical enhancement breaks normal human limits, while mental resistance protects against psychological influence. 7 Briber Bribe applies Weaken, Charm, Arrogance, or Connection effects through actual or symbolic offerings. 6 Baron of Corruption Distortion exploits Order's loopholes to alter words, actions, intent, trajectories, seals, and attacks; Corrosion darkens hearts. 5 Mentor of Disorder Disorder scrambles attacks, judgments, distances, and movement; Commanding Presence compels obedience, while Distortion is strengthened. 4 Earl of the Fallen Exploit extends or ends states; Bestowment imposes negative effects, Magnify amplifies actions, and regional rules become manipulable. 3 Frenzied Mage Superior materializes social authority as suppressive force; Frenzy randomly alters abilities, often benefiting the mage and harming opponents. 2 Duke of Entropy Entropy progressively disorders abilities, thoughts, states, environments, or rules; Exploit reaches extraordinary distances and Distortion twists authorities' rules. 1 Prince of Abolition Definition and Distortion rewrite existing Order, including what counts as substitutes, bribery, corruption, and other rules. 0 Black Emperor Autocrat governs subordinate authorities through Order's loopholes; Distortion disrupts rules, and Resurrection returns the Black Emperor from mausoleums. Pathway themes & abilities Its authority is framed as the Shadow of Order, or a Distortion of Order, with recurring abilities centered on bribery, disorder, distortion, bestowment, magnify, exploit, majesty, and resurrection. The pathway's Above the Sequence is The Anarchy, and its corresponding Sefirah is the Nation of Disorder. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Earl of the Fallen: Exploit extends or ends states; Bestowment imposes negative effects, Magnify amplifies actions, and regional rules become manipulable. Sequence 3 — Frenzied Mage: Superior materializes social authority as suppressive force; Frenzy randomly alters abilities, often benefiting the mage and harming opponents. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Duke of Entropy: Entropy progressively disorders abilities, thoughts, states, environments, or rules; Exploit reaches extraordinary distances and Distortion twists authorities' rules. Sequence 1 — Prince of Abolition: Definition and Distortion rewrite existing Order, including what counts as substitutes, bribery, corruption, and other rules. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Black Emperor: Autocrat governs subordinate authorities through Order's loopholes; Distortion disrupts rules, and Resurrection returns the Black Emperor from mausoleums. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances The pathway’s earthly history is entangled with rival empires: Solomon became its Sequence 0, founded the Solomon Empire in the Fourth Epoch, and was killed in the rebellion led by Trunsoest and Alista Tudor; after a later resurrection, he rebuilt his empire. In the Fifth Epoch, Roselle—initially a Paragon Beyonder—also became Black Emperor. Much later, Loen’s George III pursued the same apotheosis through a hidden mausoleum-and-rule-changing ritual. The Twilight Hermit Order sheltered his scheme, while the Great Smog helped conceal its human cost Story connections The Fourth-Epoch succession: Solomon’s fall enabled Trunsoest and Alista Tudor to establish a joint empire; Solomon later returned and rebuilt his own Roselle’s rise: Roselle changed pathways before becoming Black Emperor; he was later assassinated, then returned as an incomplete Black Emperor George III’s failed bid: The ritual involved nine mausoleums, human trafficking, and political changes. The Great Smog obscured the plan; Klein and other allies ultimately interrupted George’s apotheosis Figures to know Solomon Fourth-Epoch Sequence 0 and founder of the Solomon Empire Alista Tudor rebel against Solomon who later became a Sequence 0 in another pathway Trunsoest joined Alista’s rebellion and helped establish the Tudor–Trunsoest United Empire Roselle Gustav transmigrator, former Paragon Beyonder, and later Black Emperor George Augustus III Loen ruler and Sequence 1 Black Emperor Beyonder whose apotheosis attempt failed Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. Associated figures Selected figures listed in the source material: Son of Chaos Kvastir Roselle Gustav Solomon Alista Tudor Trunsoest Showing 6 of 24 names listed in the source; this is not an exhaustive roster. Pathway connections The source lists these as neighboring, compatible, or otherwise connected pathways. Some do not yet have a dedicated page in this archive. title: Blasphemy & History
summary: Explore the Blasphemy Slates and the major historical figures of the Lord of Mysteries world across the Epochs.
searchText: Blasphemy & History Lord of Mysteries · History & Mysticism Blasphemy & History The two slates and the figures who shaped the Epochs Records carved into the world The Blasphemy Slates preserve the pathway system, while history preserves the people and powers that shaped it. Switch between the two archives below. The historical section keeps major figures alongside the Epoch in which they acted, so names remain connected to the events that define them. Since the Sequence pathways are also called the ‘Blessings of The Divine’ or ‘Pathways of The Divine’, then why would the stone slate that records the completed twenty-two Sequence pathways be called the ‘ Blasphemy Slate ’. Blasphemy, what an interesting term… Just who is the one blasphemed? Roselle Gustav in his Diary On Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 93 I am not God, I am merely The Fool who is interested in the long history of this world. The Fool to Derrick Berg On Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 137 Blasphemy Slate Historical Figures Blasphemy Slate First & Second Slates First Blasphemy Slate First Blasphemy Slate in the Paths of the Divine merchandise project. Appearance An abnormally ancient stone slab, its surface was mottled with the ravages of time. The language used in the First Blasphemy Slate seems to be the source of all the languages, including but not limited to Jotun, Hermes, Ancient Feysac, and the Southern Continent's Dutanese. Even if someone has never learned the language before, they could understand the meaning at a glance. This language is also used by the Trunsoest Brass Book to write its Laws. Power As a product from the remains of the Primordial God Almighty, the First Blasphemy Slate can be used as a medium to control the power of the Chaos Sea . It can also be used to strengthen the Astral Barrier against the intervention of the Outer Deities. History The First Blasphemy Slate was originally born from the remains of the Primordial God Almighty in the Chaos Sea but was later pulled by some forces and left the ground before it was complete. When the Ancient Sun God awakened in Chernobyl, "He" gained possession of the First Blasphemy Slate , and used it as a medium to control the Chaos Sea indirectly through Sasrir to isolate its corruption from "His" main body. Near the end of the Second Epoch, the Ancient Sun God manipulated the First Blasphemy Slate to emerge, revealing the paths of the divine. However, only part of its content was leaked; the remaining formulas remained unknown. With the appearance of the First Blasphemy Slate, humans fractured under the instigation of dragons, mutants, and demons. Giants and others saw themselves as divine creatures, no longer human. The giants and elves split accusing each other of betrayal regarding Lilith's death and waging the 230-year "War of the Betrayers", with dragons and demons intervening three times. After the Ancient Sun God's death at the end of the Third Epoch, the First Blasphemy Slate was held by Sasrir's Evil Spirit, who was sleeping inside the Giant King's Court. In the year 1352 of the Fifth Epoch, the Slate was taken by Amon, after the death of Sasrir Evil Spirit in the main hall of the Giant King's Court. When Mr. Door was trying to return to the physical world, Amon used the First Blasphemy Slate to resist the descent of the Mother Goddess of Depravity . During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, Amon threw the Slate at a mountain's peak that tore out from the Fog Sea that was near the Abyss entrance and the Primitive Island in Fog Sea. This, along with the enhanced seal brought about by Amon's authority of 'Door', and the Half- Lord of the Astral World Adam's control towards the Astral Barrier, prevented any Outer Deities from being able to have "Their" power penetrated inside for a short period. This also temporarily cut off the Mother Tree of Desire 's influence over the Dark Side of the Universe and Chained God. After the Slate was used to patch the Astral Barrier, it was eventually destroyed when the barrier shattered during The Apocalypse. Second Blasphemy Slate Second Blasphemy Slate in the Paths of the Divine merchandise project. The Second Blasphemy Slate was born after the fall of the Ancient Sun God. It contains the complete pathway researched information for all twenty-two Standard Pathways, including the Potion names (some were revised compared to the First Blasphemy Slate ), Potion formulas, and Advancement Rituals. The main difference between the Second Blasphemy Slate and the First Blasphemy Slate isn't that the latter has many unique Sequence names, but that the former had many additions. It was a secret the Ancient Sun God caught a glimpse of towards "His" later years-the secrets of Above the Sequence as fruits of the Ancient Sun God's research. The knowledge on the Second Blasphemy Slate appeared in its essence and not in textual form, thus anyone who saw it needed some time to interpret it. Appearance A gray stone slab, with many mottled marks on its surface, making it look rather ancient. It was very similar to the First Blasphemy Slate , but it didn't have that abnormally ancient feeling to it. It also had words that looked like the source of all languages. Power As a product from the remains of the Ancient Sun God who was a Quasi- God Almighty and almost equivalent to the owner of the Chaos Sea , similar to the First Blasphemy Slate , the Second Blasphemy Slate can be used as a medium to control the power of the Chaos Sea . History When the Ancient Sun God perished, "He" used a portion of "His" body and will to create the Second Blasphemy Slate , to bring light for The Apocalypse by ending the chaotic battle between the deities due to anger, emotions, and other reasons, initiating the era of working towards becoming Great Old Ones. During its creation, the Primordial God Almighty interfered by altering the content of the Sequence 0: Demoness' Apotheosis Ritual to aid "His" resurrection plan. After emerging, the Second Blasphemy Slate was moving around and was seen by many people, most of them later established Angel Families in the Fourth Epoch: Bethel Abraham, Solomon, Zaratul Senior, Tudor, Trunsoest, Augustus, Einhorn, Sauron, Castiya, Zoroast, Stiano and Constantine . According to Bethel Abraham, Cheek and the Artisan had also seen the Slate with "Him". Because the Slate might leave at any moment, and because the knowledge on it needed time to be interpreted, most of them could only memorize at most one complete Pathway. Adam took the Slate in the end. The Twilight Hermit Order under Adam then controlled the Second Blasphemy Slate . As a member, Emperor Roselle had seen the Second Blasphemy Slate and through it, created the corresponding Cards of Blasphemy. However, the version that he saw is incomplete and missing some information. This missing information is later revealed to be the secret of Above the Sequence. The Fool had seen the Second Blasphemy Slate when he was captured by Adam. He managed to read the information on The Nine Great Old Ones on Earth, the demigod potion formula information of the Visionary , Darkness , and Justiciar pathways, and likely all of the remaining contents. Later, Adam arrived in the Forsaken Land of the Gods to confront the True Creator so "They" could fuse and "He" could be whole again. Adam used Arrodes to trigger the Chaos Sea, then "He" used the Second Blasphemy Slate to form a connection with the triggered area. "He" then stepped forward into the shadow curtain to confront and merge with the True Creator. During Project Vortex in 1359, Adam uses the Second Blasphemy Slate as a medium to send Chaos Sea to severely injure the Uncertain Mist through the Genie and Roselle, ensuring one less danger during The Apocalypse. Historical Figures & Epochs World history History The Beginning On the first day, the Original Creator awoke and created this world, but Reality , the Spirit World , the Astral World , and Fate were still mixed together. On the second day, the Oldest One birthed the Mother Goddess of Depravity . Reality gained a foundation, the Spirit World and Astral World were separated, and the River of Fate began to flow. Soon after, the Mother Tree of Desire was born, giving rise to life and introducing evil and desire. Then came the Son of Chaos, who established order-and with it, shadows naturally emerged. On the third day, the Oldest One and the Mother Goddess united, and the Mother of All Things gave birth to a firstborn daughter, the Goddess of Fate . From then on, the fates of all things began to intertwine, no longer in absolute chaos but instead forming relative patterns and foreseeable futures. Pre-Epoch Main article: Pre-Epoch After the Original Creator created the universe, "He" fell asleep. The slumbering Original Creator spontaneously split out multiple personalities such as the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings. They are also in a state of deep sleep, but they have begun to use their own authority and Beyonder Characteristics to indirectly and secretly interfere with and influence the real world, making many preparations for the true division after their initial awakening. The cataclysm came around the modern era and everything was destroyed. During this time, the stars and the earth all experienced great changes. The Survivors and Transmigrators came from this era. First Epoch: The Age of Chaos Main article: First Epoch Unknown when it started, unknown when it ended. The beginning was dark, chaotic, and filled with madness until Beyonder races eventually gained some rationality. The First Blasphemy Slate first appeared in this epoch. The Western Continent disappeared in the gray fog. Second Epoch: The Dark Epoch Main article: Second Epoch Due to the purification of Beyonder Characteristics, the major races have evolved their own characters and civilizations, and eight Ancient Gods have emerged one after another. "They" ruled sky, land, and oceans. "They" ruled over the Spirit World and Astral World, and various races. Humanity struggled to survive and became subordinates or even slaves of Giants, Elves, and Sanguines. Until the Ancient Sun God woke up and took back the authorities from Ancient Gods, allowing humanity to successfully rise up in revolt. Third Epoch: The Cataclysm Epoch Main article: Third Epoch After the death of all Ancient Gods, the Ancient Sun God became the absolute ruler of the world and the one and only Orthodox God. Humans walked out of the shadow of other races and became the dominant race of the land. They started to study the world of mysticism. They created the Pathways system with potion formulas and rituals based from the First Blasphemy Slate. Soon later, the Ancient Sun God found the awakening of the Primordial One in his mind and attempt fight against "Him". Under the tacit agreement, the Rose Redemption was founded. This led to the fall of the Ancient Sun God, and the Second Blasphemy Slate was created from "His" remains after "His" death. The Lord of Storms, Eternal Blazing Sun, God of Knowledge and Wisdom and True Creator were born afterward. Fourth Epoch: the Epoch of The Gods Main article: Fourth Epoch After the fall of the Ancient Sun God, the Eastern Continent where the City of Silver was located was isolated from the rest of the world, and became known as the "Forsaken Land of the Gods". The Solomon Empire established, led by the Black Emperor Solomon with support from the True Creator, as well as the Rose Redemption. Later on, Alista Tudor and Trunsoest rebelled against the Black Emperor Solomon and the Solomon Empire with the support of the six gods. They successfully killed the Black Emperor and established the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire, replacing the Solomon Empire. Eventually, the Black Emperor Solomon managed to resurrect and rebuild the Solomon Empire. This led to the great war: War of the Four Emperors. Fifth Epoch: The Iron Age Main article: Fifth Epoch After the fall of four emperors. The Northern Continent is ruled by seven Orthodox Churches and the Four Great Nations, and there are also many secret organizations operating secretly. In the early days, in the Southern Continent, due to the fall of the Underworld Emperor, the Resistance gradually appeared at the sea. The Highlands Kingdom and the Paz Kingdom were founded, before they were destroyed by the invasion from the Northern Continent nations. The Industrial Revolution started with the transmigration of Huang Tao as Roselle Gustav. The improvement of steam engine cultivated the growing number of pirates and the birth of steamship. Then started the era of Colonialism. In the Year 1350, the world war occurred embroiled all of the nations of Northern Continent. In the Year 1358, Outer Deities penetrated the barrier more and more intensely, and the number of Boon Recipients who pursued mysterious power and believed in evil gods continued to increase. The end was approaching, and the world was in a greater crisis.

title: Cattleya
summary: Cattleya character profile: aliases, pathway, sequence, affiliations, appearance, and source notes.
searchText: Cattleya Character profile Cattleya Hermit · Sequence 3: Clairvoyant ( Hermit Pathway ) Cattleya is one of the 6 Pirate Kings and is a Beyonder of the Mystery Pryer. Her codename in the Tarot Club is The Hermit. She is one of the ten Pillars of the Moses Ascetic Order. She once held the title Admiral of Stars. Her flagship is named "The Future" and she is the captain of The Stars Pirates. Her bounty originally was 37,000 pounds, after she permitted Gehrman Sparrow board the Future, her bounty raised to 45,000 pounds. By year 1352, Cattleya became the hidden Pirate Queen. After Mr. Fool had entered a deep sleep, she finally made up her mind and announced her advancement to the public and became a true Pirate Queen called Queen of Stars. This page includes major-spoiler information from the linked source article. The fact fields below are transcribed from that article’s character infobox. Its canonical progression runs from Prisoner at Sequence 9 to Chained at Sequence 0, with the overview listing mutation, curses, binding, possession, death-related spells, and object control among its abilities. Paraphrased from the Fandom pathway article .. Complete wiki information Full main-article information imported from the Chained Pathway wiki article . Existing archive pathway details above are preserved. The mind is the prisoner of the body, and the body is the prisoner of the world. This refers to the madness that is restrained and the desire that is oppressed. Mr. Sun to Mr. World On Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 314 Overview The Chained Pathway has different types of mutant abilities, but they're also cursed. They can summon zombies, jump through things with reflections, resist bullets with powerful defence, possess others, control ghosts, cast death-related spells, regenerate and heal themselves, and sacrifice rationality for more power. They have high strength, speed, and defence, but have some difficulty in controlling themselves. They also lose power or control during the full moon. At High-Sequences, they have the ability to bind their foes, control all inanimate objects within a specific radius, employ dreadful curses and curse others through all connections, and transform into terrifying, evil, distorted, chaotic Abominations that are filled by pure and extreme madness. Since the Chained Pathway symbolises Binding / Restraint and Unity , from the Mid-Second Epoch onwards, the main Ingredients of each sequence, starting from Sequence 7 , have essentially merged into one. There have been almost no more instances of them splitting. [ 1 ] The Beyonder Characteristics of this pathway originated from the Outer Deity Mother Tree of Desire . [ 2 ] The Above the Sequence of the Chained Pathway is the Father of Devils , and the corresponding Sefirah is the Tenebrous World . Therefore, the Mythical Creature Form manifested by the Chained Pathway is essentially the vessel that binds this aggregate, and is dependent on the self-awareness and choices made during "Their" advancements to Sequence 4: Puppet and Sequence 2 Ancient Bane , which bind and fixes itself into various curses, such as oil trees, dolls, mummies, etc. [ 7 ] [ 8 ] At Sequence 4 , an embalmed mummy is one type of anchor, but it's not strictly necessary to use a demigod-level mummy, as any item with a similar function and the same rank can serve the purpose. The Rose School of Thought 's Temperance Faction traditionally uses mummies for their advancement, because this practice is tied to the imagery and history of the Chained God and has even influenced the burial customs of the Highlands Kingdom . Similarly, the advancement to Ancient Bane requires finding an ancient, evil item capable of bearing angelic power. This item becomes the core of the final Mythical Creature Form . Innate Mythical Creatures like Suah and Tirié , who have not completed the corresponding Sequence advancements, exhibit forms that are essentially amplifications of "Their" Beyonder Characteristics . Pathway themes & abilities Its central symbolism is Binding and Unity: the pathway concentrates on curses, restraint or Temperance, Deviants, and Objects. The sequence abilities develop mutant transformations, berserk desire, undead and spirit forms, possession, curse-making, and increasingly broad control over restraints and objects. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Puppet: Curses can be transferred through linked puppets; users control objects, perform prior roles, and restrain madness. Sequence 3 — Disciple of Silence: Prolonged silence brews potent curses; transfiguration curses turn targets into harmless creatures and curses can possess objects. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Ancient Bane: A dwelling place anchors immortality; Bane influences minds and desires, attacks spirits, and exercises curse authority. Sequence 1 — Abomination: Curse authority transforms creatures into Deviants, spreads madness and evil, and restrains surroundings with barriers. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Chained: Symbolic authority governs curses, Deviants, Temperance-based binding, and control of sentient or nonsentient objects. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances The Chained Pathway’s novel history is bound to the Rose School of Thought: in the early Fifth Epoch, the Chained God founded it, but the Mother Tree of Desire later corrupted him and displaced its worship, turning the school toward indulgence. The ensuing ideological conflict and internal war drove the Temperance survivors—including Sharron , Maric , and Reinette Tinekerr —into flight; they eventually joined the Church of the Fool. In Backlund, Klein first encounters Maric at Bravehearts Bar and hires Sharron as a bodyguard; the pair later help him hunt Rose School members. These events frame the pathway through restraint, factional fracture, and resistance to corruption, not just its powers Story connections The school’s fall and factional split: The Chained God’s corruption shifted the Rose School from its original Temperance outlook toward the Mother Tree of Desire ; the Indulgence faction defeated and drove out Temperance members Backlund allies become part of Klein’s story: Klein meets Maric at Bravehearts Bar, then hires Sharron as a bodyguard; later he and Sharron assist Sharron and Maric against Rose School members Exiles find a new religious home: Sharron , Maric , and other Temperance survivors eventually join the Church of the Fool, maintaining their faction identity Figures to know Chained God (Tolzna) Founder of the Rose School of Thought; corrupted by the Mother Tree of Desire Mother Tree of Desire The corrupting power that supplanted the Chained God in the school’s worship and empowered the Indulgence turn Sharron Chained-pathway Temperance defector, Klein’s hired bodyguard, and later a Church of the Fool member Maric Chained-pathway Temperance defector who connects Klein with Sharron and becomes one of his Backlund allies Reinette Tinekerr A named Temperance survivor who fled the Rose School conflict and later joined the Church of the Fool Major story spoilers. Jebus Lata On Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 714 Overview The Chaos Mist Pathway is the gray between white and black, the fog between light and darkness, the bridge between order ( Justiciar ) and shadows ( Black Emperor ). [ 1 ] They represent Grayness that is the ultimate Truth of the universe, and are the manifestation of Chaos that renders all that is certain to become no longer certain. Beyonders of this Pathway can act as the "platform" that enables transactions between different parties, forming a Vortex consisting of many different forces. [ 2 ] This Pathway is one of the new Pathways introduced in Circle of Inevitability . It exists outside the 22 Standard Pathways , but is still classified into Sequence 9 to Sequence 0. [ 3 ] On Earth, the Beyonders of this Pathway do not advance through Potions, but by praying to the Outer Deity Uncertain Mist , who is the Above the Sequence of this Pathway, for a Boon . The corresponding Sefirah is the remaining part of the Son of Chaos 's Sefirah that was not attracted to Earth and became the Nation of Disorder . This Pathway is the only Pathway under the Uncertain Mist . title: Church of the Fool
summary: Learn about the Church of the Fool, its bible, sacred emblem, prayer gestures, and the Ten Commandments in Lord of the Mysteries.
searchText: Church of the Fool This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Church of the Fool ← Back 1. Church Of The Fool "Excuse me sir, do you have a moment to listen about our lord and savior, Mr. Fool?" Baldur on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1325 The Church of the Fool, was founded in the year 1352 of the Fifth Epoch after the City of Silver and Moon City residents left the Forsaken Land of the Gods. All the residents believe in The Fool. Aside from those, other believers of The Fool come from some members of the Abraham Family, members of the Tarot Club , members of the Rose School of Thought's Temperance Faction, and the believers of the Church of the Sea God. Their current main church is in New City of Silver in Rorsted Archipelago. The name of the cathedral is The Fool's Cathedral. The Holy Bible, the Order of Mass, and prayer details were written by the City of Silver. It was based on their knowledge of the miracles Mr. Fool had shown, combined with the religious scriptures left behind by the Creator. Some time before the year 1358 of the Fifth Epoch, the Church of the Fool had received acknowledgement by all other Orthodox Churches, and The Fool was officially recognized as an Orthodox God. They don't contain hostility toward other Orthodox Churches. 2. Bible Of The Fool The Fool Across past, present, and future, The Fool reigns supreme over the Spirit World. He is also the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck. A beacon for all in the pursuit of eternity. He is compassionate, benevolent, and the savior of this world. He allows people to address him as "him" instead of "Him" . He resides above both reality and the Spirit World. His benevolence extends to Heaven and the land. Beside him stand eight angels. Angels of The Fool Angels of Mercury The Angel of Mercury is the embodiment of fate, The Fool's most cherished Angel. Angels of Death The Angel of Death has followed The Fool for the longest period of time and is the consul of the Underworld. Angels of Redemption The Angel of Redemption is the Fool's bugle, once taking on the form of Gehrman Sparrow to deliver his revelations. Angels of Life The Angel of Life is the crystallization of wisdom itself, the indestructible spirituality that resides in everyone’s body. Angels of Retribution The Angel of Retribution is beside the Fool's throne. "He" is the Fool's lightning, the Fool's rage, and the Fool's palm, the judge of all the fallen and the ones who aren't chaste. Angels of Holy Spirit Next to the Angel of Retribution is the Angel of the Holy Spirit, reigning over all spirits and representing The Fool in controlling the Spirit World. Angels of Time The Angel of Time was an angel of ancient times. "He" eventually submitted to The Fool and now strikes the bell of Heaven. Angels of Stars The Angel of Stars is a witness, a recorder, the eyes and ears of The Fool. 3. Sacred Emblem The symbol of the Church of the Fool is The Fool Sacred Emblem. Its the pupil-less eye and contorted lines of mysticism in concealment and change, established during his time of founding the Tarot Club . It is a silver-white Sacred Emblem emitting a radiant glow under the sunlight. The Fool's bible is a black-and-silver patterned book. 4. Prayer Gesture "Praise The Fool!" A concluding words of The Fool believers on Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 291 High Priest Nim of the New Moon City invented the prayer gestures to express their gratitude and devotion to The Fool. They would press the right palm against the left chest, accompanied by spoken: "Praise be to Mr. Fool". As of 1358, the Church of the Fool's customary prayer is to press their hand to their chest and bow slightly. 5. Ten Commandments First commandment: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto me living human sacrifices. Second Commandment: Thou shalt not use my name in vain. Third Commandment: Thou shalt have no other gods before me. Fourth Commandment: Honor thy father, thy mother, and thy children as you love me. Fifth Commandment: Thou shalt not commit adultery. Sixth Commandment: Thou shalt not kill the innocent. Seventh Commandment: Thou shalt not bear false witness, frame, or violate contracts. Eighth Commandment: Serve me with your heart, not with your offerings. Ninth Commandment: Those who have committed lesser wrongdoings, first atone for your sins before seeking forgiveness. title: Circle of Inevitability
summary: The Circle of Inevitability is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth.
searchText: Circle of Inevitability Outer Deity Circle of Inevitability Overview The Circle of Inevitability will bring calamity but is also the universe's most powerful and genuine Angel of Redemption. The Genie, Book 2, chapter 1127 The Circle of Inevitability is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. "He" is the current owner of the Eternal Aeon Pathway. Honorific Name The Eternal Cycle; The Predestined Destiny; Embodiment of Cause, Effect, and Process; Symbol of Past, Present, and Future (永恒的轮回， 注定的命运， 原因、结果与过程的化身， 过去、现在和未来的象征) Note: During prayers and rituals, the latter two segments may be adapted in various ways. 1 Symbols, Authorities & Abilities TRANSLATION NOTE "注定" (Zhùdìng) is sometimes translated to " Destined " / " Destiny " / " Predestined ", and sometimes translated to " Inevitability " in the official Webnovel English translation. "循环" (Xúnhuán) is sometimes translated to " Cycle ", and sometimes translated to " Loop ". "He" possesses full Authority over the Eternal Aeon and the corresponding Symbols , which include but are not limited to the following: Eternal Aeon: Authorities over Inevitability and Cycle . 3 Book 2, chapter 1174 The Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities "He" possesses and displays at the Above the Sequence level include: '''Redemption ( Jiùshú)''': "He" symbolizes the possibility of salvation in apocalyptic crises brought about by the inherent chaos of destiny, and the correction of this chaotic nature, allowing the universe to continue in relative stability and development until its ultimate end. 4 Author's WeChat post coi This is "His" greatest and most fundamental symbolism and perhaps the reason "He" had been born as the child of the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity. 5 Book 2, chapter 1175 4 '''Destined / Inevitability ( Zhùdìng)''': "He" can select and anchor one tributary of the River of Fate that "He" chooses. 6 Book 2, chapter 1172 "He" could make it so that all external forces attempting to interfere with Project Vortex would Inevitably fail, except for the participants themselves. 7 Book 2, chapter 867 When a conclusion was bound to be bad, steering it toward a lesser evil was far easier than reversing it to something good. 8 Book 2, chapter 1111 The Circle of Inevitability fixed Lumian's destiny on madness, and not on complete destruction. This prevented his body from collapsing when he was forcefully merged with Alista Tudor's Mirror Person, the Primordial Demoness' Sequence 1 characteristic, and the masculine and feminine aspects of the Mirrored Original Creator. 8 When being targeted by the Calamity of Destruction Lumian's Sword of Destruction , the Future body of the Circle of Inevitability selected and anchored one tributary of the River of Fate, causing the Sword of Destruction to narrowly miss, grazing "His" body. 9 Book 2, chapter 1166 Amid the double Calamities from Lumian - a Chaos Vortex and a Black Hole - the three continuously orbiting bodies of the Circle of Inevitability resembled a small boat in a tempestuous sea, always precariously skimming the vortex and black hole's uncertain regions and weak spots- dangerously close yet never succumbing, as if Predestined to remain unaffected here. 9 "He" could not fix the tributary of fate representing "His" successful accommodation of the Key of Light (Sefirah), which is unfixable. This is because, as the embodiment of fate, the Key of Light would have absolute good fortune at critical moments, disrupting any attempts to accommodate "Him". 6 '''Cycle / Loop ( Xúnhuán)''': "He" can use "His" Circle Inhabitant's power to reset the state of a region, including other Great Old Ones. 10 Book 2, chapter 1167 "He" reverted the battlefield to the moment before Lumian created the Fog of War , before the Monarch of Decay fell into madness and chaos due to the effect of the Origins of Disaster and Mirrored Original Creator symbolisms, before the Eternal Darkness Amanises was affected by the Inextinguishable Ravings and had to put "Herself" in a Slumber . Lumian and Amanises had nearly succeeded three times to swiftly wound or eliminate the Monarch of Decay, but each time, the Circle of Inevitability had intervened-either resetting the state through Loop or exerting influence via the symbolism of Inevitability . 2 '''Present ( Xiànzài) : "His" Present Self''' can use the Sufferer's power to reenact "His" past torments and impose them upon "His" enemy. 9 "He" can reenact the massive suction force that happened to "Him" when "His" Sefirah was being forcibly pulled during the Original Creator's awakening onto the Calamity of Destruction Lumian. This caused his Sword of Destruction to divert away from the intended target and pulled it toward "Him" instead. 9 If "He" had experienced the suction force that the Original Creator's three direct children experienced, this would have caused Lumian to suffer tremors in his Sefirah, rendering him weak and incapable of using his powers for a short time-even if his Sefirah wasn't wholly extracted or partially consumed. 9 '''Past ( Guòqù) : "He" possesses the symbolism of the Past'''. What was not lost in the Past could not be destroyed in the Present . 2 Even when "His" three bodies are destroyed, "His" Past Body can reappear a second later and reunite with "His" Present Body and Future Body . 2 Only by using the kind of power associated with the Fourth Pillar- erasing the very concept of the Circle of Inevitability's existence and "His" Past history-could "He" be truly wounded or killed. 2 The Past symbolism allows "Him" to bring only "His" past self into situations such as entering Lumian' body to resolve the Termination symbolism. 12 Thus, even if "He" successfully accommodated the Monarch of Decay or vice versa, "They" would still be able to return daily to resolve the problem without triggering Termination . '''Future ( Wèilái) : "His" Future Redemption Body''' can create a new tributary within the River of Fate where no other possibilities or developments existed. When the future was already determined, and every tributary led to the same outcome where the Termination symbolism would appear, the Circle of Inevitability created a new tributary capable of preventing its appearance. "He" can combine the symbolisms of Future and Destined : The combination of these two symbolisms makes "Him" nearly impossible to hit. 2 When being put into a slumber by the Eternal Darkness' symbolism of Darkness , "He" used the symbolisms of Future and Destined to manifest countless tributaries of fate before "Him", each representing the same possibility: that "He" would soon awaken. 6 '''Eternal Aeon ( Yǒngjié zhě) : the unity of Past , Present , and Future , as well as Cause , Process , and Effect'''. 4 "He" used "His" Eternal Aeon symbolism to stop the power of Termination within Lumian's body to sublimate into the Termination symbolism, and achieve Redemption : 5 "His" three bodies simultaneously bore the ravages of the power of Termination . Then, the three bodies encircled the deep black point held in six palms, and began to spin faster and faster. The black turned into mercury, mercury became transparent redemptive light, and the light was dyed black again, repeating over and over. 5 Before long, the pitch-black Past Sinner Body morphed into the initial scene of the Termination power's formation. The mercury-colored Present Sufferer Body stabilized the current event of destruction. The holy light-formed Future Redemption Body froze the moment when the Termination symbolism was about to emerge but had not yet fully formed. Then, the Future Redemption Body , spinning rapidly, became dyed black once more, transforming into the scene corresponding to the Past Sinner Body , completing the Redemption . 5 '''Substitution ( Tìdài) : "He" holds the Substitution '''symbolism, the highest level of the Substitution Spell. The Past Sinner Body caused the figures of the Monarch of Decay within the River of Fate's Past to be replaced one by one with figures of the Circle of Inevitability and vice versa, while "His" Present Sufferer Body separated a Sequence 1 body to switch with the Monarch of Decay's body within Lumian in the Present . One returned to the outside world, and the other entered within, completing the Substitution . Now, Lumian no longer accommodated the Monarch of Decay but rather a Sequence 1 avatar of the Circle of Inevitability, slowing the formation of the Termination symbolism within Lumian's collapsing body but doesn't stop it. 5 In the River of Fate, "His" images, which originally belonged to the Monarch of Decay, had been replaced by "His" own through the influence of the Substitution symbolism. This created a profound mystical link between "Him" and the Monarch of Decay, allowing "Him" to discover the Monarch of Decay's whereabouts and pursued after "Him". 5 Countering Symbols, Authorities & Abilities Certain Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities of other Great Old Ones can counter some of "His" powers, which include but are not limited to the following: Lord of Mysteries: King of Space-Time counters Past , Present , and Future . The King of Space-Time , who held the symbolism of History , might not be able to kill the Circle of Inevitability but could certainly inflict suffering worse than death. 2 Theft, with the help of the Key of Light, counters Past . The Lord of Mysteries and the Key of Light combined can replace, supplant or use various other methods to eliminate the Circle of Inevitability and make someone ascend and take "His" place. The only problem is having to permanently resist "His" reviving consciousness. 13 Beacon of Destiny counters Cycle . 11 Error counters Destined . Key of Light: Incarnation of Fate counters Destined : The Key of Light would inevitably have absolute good fortune at critical moments, disrupting any attempts to accommodate "Them". The Circle of Inevitability did not fix the tributary of Fate representing "His" successful accommodation of the Key of Light—it was simply unfixable. 14 Eternal Darkness: Space-Time-in-One can delay and halt Destined and Cycle : Amanises unleashed deep darkness like a river from the void, pulling Time and Space into "Herself" and merging them swiftly. This managed to halt the Circle of Inevitability's spinning, suspending "Him" like an insect trapped in amber, preventing "Him" from triggering a Loop node. 2 Amanises plunged the Uniqueness of Twilight Giant into the darkness edge and into the void, causing the dense darkness to contract, and the flow of time to slow, converging toward a single point. The fate of the Circle of Inevitability's Destined awakening remained unchanged but was now delayed, pushed several seconds into the future. 6 River of Eternal Darkness counters Cycle : The River of Eternal Darkness is a river that never Loops . It always moved forward. Even death itself would dissipate within its currents. The colorless, illusory river can submerge all Loop nodes, causing them to instantaneously perish and vanish without taking effect. 6 Calamity of Destruction: Return of All Things to Chaos counters Destined and Cycle : Lumian Lee formed a Vortex of Chaos to drag the fixed tributary of the River of Fate and the pre-set Loop node into the Apocalypse , returning it to Chaos , thereby breaking the Circle of Inevitability's Destined and Cycle powers. 2 Appearance True Form : "He" was formed by three bodies arranged in a circle. The one facing left was pitch black, with a sinister, malicious visage seemingly composed of the deepest, most chaotic sins. The one facing forward was silvery, emaciated, and filled with pain. The one facing right radiated pure, redemptive holy light, emanating solemnity and compassion toward all things. The light of the three bodies intertwined into a silvery-black hue. 15 Personality Due to "His" symbolism of Redemption , "He" is one of the few Outer Deities capable of the desire to save/grant salvation to lesser races. 16 "His" Godhood Instincts would compel "Him" to perform Redemption , but only during cosmic catastrophes like the premature appearance of the Fourth Pillar before the universe reaches its natural end. 5 In other scenarios, "He" could remain either malevolent or neutral. 17 "He" can bring calamity, but is also the universe's most powerful and genuine Angel of Redemption. 18 Background According to the Seven Lights, ever since the Oldest One awakened and split apart, the most powerful Outer Deities in the entire universe, including the Circle of Inevitability, gathered around this tiny solar system. Some of "Them" wish to retrieve "Their" Sefirot and Beyonder Characteristic that had been ripped from "Them" and were attracted here. Some of "Them" have the hope of getting neighboring Sefirot and high-level Beyonder Characteristics which "They" can accommodate. 19 The Circle of Inevitability coveted the Key of Light (Sefirah) the most. However, the City of Calamity and the River of Eternal Darkness were also within "His" scope, as these pathways symbolized destined conclusions and various calamities. Additionally, similar to the High-Dimensional Overseer, if the Lord of Mysteries were defeated in a joint effort, the Circle of Inevitability would not shy away from seizing control of Sefirah Castle and accommodating the Uniquenesses of the Fool and Error Pathways. 11 Book 2, chapter 1164 History The Circle of Inevitability is the eldest son of the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity. 20 Before the First Epoch, the Circle of Inevitability and the Goddess of Fate frequently fought each other. 21 Even thought the Mother Goddess of Depravity favored the Goddess of Fate, the reason why "She" didn't help "Her" was because the universe needed the Circle of Inevitability's Redemption Symbolism. 22 When the Original Creator awoke and split up, "He" was also affected by the Law of Convergence. "He" endured great suffering to prevent "His" Sefirah from being forcibly extracted or split. 9 In the First Epoch, during the Lost Era, the Primordial God Almighty and Celestial Worthy's strong and still-perfect-and-whole power deterred the Outer Deities, who can only settle for observing Earth from afar for now. 23 In 1358 of the Fifth Epoch, the Circle of Inevitability succeeded in sending one of "His" Angels, Termiboros, to the planet via a descent ritual in Cordu Village of the Intis Republic. However, Termiboros was sealed inside Lumian Lee's body by The Fool. During Project Vortex, the Circle of Inevitability transmitted a bit of "His" power through the barrier via the Endless Cosmos. All external forces attempting to interfere with Project Vortex would inevitably fail, except for the participants themselves. 7 In the end, Project Vortex ended in failure for all Outer Deities except the Mother Goddess of Depravity and Mother Tree of Desire. "His" believers and Boon Recipients were almost completely wiped out. During The Apocalypse, "He" assisted the Monarch of Decay and fought against Lumian Lee and Amanises. During the fight, Lumian and Amanises had nearly succeeded three times to wound or eliminate the Monarch of Decay, but each time, the Circle of Inevitability had intervened by either resetting the state through Loop or exerting influence via the symbolism of Inevitability . 2 When Lumian began irresistibly merging with the Monarch of Decay and was about to cause the formation of the Fourth Pillar, the Circle of Inevitability intervened by using the Substitution symbolism to replace the Monarch of Decay within the River of Fate's past with an Angel of Redemption Characteristic. "He" then used "His" true body to replace the avatar, personally entering Lumian's body to face the encroaching power of Termination . Using "His" Eternal Aeon symbolism, the Circle of Inevitability achieved Redemption . "He" then replaced "His" external Sequence 1 avatar to replace "His" true body once again, sealing it within Lumian's body, while the true body returned to reality. From now on, the Angel of Redemption avatar would slow the transformation of Termination power within Lumian into Termination symbolism. It would also assist in balancing the consciousness and spirit of the reviving Malevolent Dragon. When the delayed transformation once again reached a critical stage, the true body of the Circle of Inevitability would replace the avatar, enter Lumian's dreamscape, and use the Symbolism of Eternal Aeon to reset the crisis to its initial state. In essence, every day, "His" true body would endure destruction alongside Lumian due to the Termination power. This cycle would repeat daily, eternally. After resolving the crisis, the Circle of Inevitability departed for the Astral World to chase after the fleeing Monarch of Decay, using the mystical connection that was established through the previous use of the Substitution symbolism. 24 Trivia Book 2 in the Mysteries series is named after this Outer Deity. title: Concerto of Light and Shadow
summary: Concerto of Light and Shadow, a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact: function, downside, and status.
searchText: Concerto of Light and Shadow Sealed Artifact · Grade 1 Concerto of Light and Shadow Grade 1 · No code recorded Overview Concerto of Light and Shadow is recorded in the archive as a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. Grade 1 artifacts sit near Saint level, roughly matching Sequence 3 to Sequence 4 Beyonders. It is described as: An iron-skinned pocket watch, half of the watch's face is filled with neatly arranged symbols, while the other half is chaotic. Function It can restrict certain actions in the area, and strip certain Beyonder powers from the target. It can also gift certain negative effects to the target, making him sluggish; eager; avaricious; or lose their fighting spirit. It could distort the target's speech, actions, intentions, and attacks, reducing a lethal blow into a serious injury, or it could repel an attack, turning progression into retrogression, escaping into leading a charge. Downside When the user enter combat state, random change that affects Beyonder abilities will uncontrollably occur within its range. Status No status is recorded in the source table. Source: the Sealed Artifacts archive , from the Lord of the Mysteries wiki . searchText: Condenser Pathway Non-Standard Pathway · Supernova Dominator Condenser Pathway Outer Deity: Supernova Dominator · Boon advancement The Condenser, also called the Tidal Scholar pathway, centers on astronomy and the manipulation of fundamental forces: gravity, electromagnetic forces, celestial bodies, cosmic voids, fusion, cosmic laws, attraction, weight, and density. It is a non-standard Boon pathway advanced through prayer to the Supernova Dominator . Non-standard pathway lore and Outer Deity corruption details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Condenser Pathway ingredient archive → Detailed description The Condenser, also called the Tidal Scholar pathway, centers on astronomy and the manipulation of fundamental forces: gravity, electromagnetic forces, celestial bodies, cosmic voids, fusion, cosmic laws, attraction, weight, and density. It is a non-standard Boon pathway advanced through prayer to the Supernova Dominator . Paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Complete wiki information Full main-article information imported from the Condenser Pathway wiki article . Existing archive pathway details above are preserved. Space is Time, Time is Space, Heaviness causes Slowness, and Starlight brings Disorder. Cuttlefish That Loves Diving On Cuttlefish's WeChat Post : "The Supernova Dominator Pathway" Overview The Condenser Pathway revolves around the usage of fundamental forces while possessing astronomical knowledge tied to the stars. It specializes in manipulating gravity, electromagnetic forces, grazing celestial bodies, and creating cosmic voids. At High-Sequences, this Pathway holds authorities over Fusion , Fundamental Forces , Gravity , Weight , and Density . [ 2 ] The power of this pathway primarily emanates from the stars and the land beneath. Only a small portion of it involves the sea. [ 3 ] This Pathway is one of the new Pathways introduced in Circle of Inevitability . It exists outside the twenty-two Standard Pathways , but is still classified into Sequence 9 to Sequence 0. [ 4 ] On Earth, the Beyonders of this Pathway do not advance through Potions, but by praying to the Outer Deity Supernova Dominator , who is the Above the Sequence of this Pathway, for a Boon . The corresponding Sefirah is the Supernova Dominator 's currently unnamed Sefirah . This Pathway is the only Pathway under the Supernova Dominator . [ 5 ] Corresponding Ingredients Browse the local Condenser Pathway ingredient archive → Unknown Mythical Creature Form Massive fusion clusters composite being, with its core also consisting of countless fusion clusters. The being is capable of taking forms such as a giant, a dragon, or even an indescribable shape. [ 2 ] Radiant Angel "They" are radiant beings of starlight with six pairs of wings. [ 6 ] Star Dragon "They" are colossal transparent dragons that's able to drive a small asteroid. [ 6 ] Neighboring and Compatible Pathways Compatible Pathways to the Condenser Pathway include, but might not be limited to, the following: Some Pathways under the God Almighty : [ 7 ] Sun Tyrant Pathways under the Calamity of Destruction : Demoness Red Priest Pathways under the Demon of Knowledge : Hermit Paragon Pathways under The Anarchy : Black Emperor Justiciar Pathways under the High-Dimensional Overseer : Sublunary Eye Pathways under the Primordial Hunger : Tail-Devourer In addition, some Pathways have a connection to the Condenser Pathway , but it's unknown if they are Compatible or not: Some Pathways under the Goddess of Origin : Moon Some Pathways under the Eternal Darkness : Darkness High-level abilities The pathway’s upper abilities are inseparable from the corruption of its Outer Deity. These powers are expressed through Boons, mystical influence, and the gradual replacement of ordinary cause-and-effect with the pathway’s domain. Creates intense gravitational fields that bend or shatter matter and can reach intangible targets such as Fate, thoughts, and Spirit Bodies. Summons or controls stars and supernovae, producing destructive eruptions capable of overwhelming layers of defense and many Avatars. Forms black holes that compress matter, capture light and heat, slow time, and crush entire stellar dominions. Controls fusion and fundamental forces to create matter, reverse black holes into white holes, and release blinding or annihilating light. Corruption from Supernova Dominator The Supernova Dominator is the pathway’s Outer Deity and primary source of Boons. Corruption can appear as physical mutation, mental contamination, altered fate, environmental collapse, or the rewriting of reality, depending on the pathway’s authority. Known corruptive effects Creates intense gravitational fields that bend or shatter matter and can reach intangible targets such as Fate, thoughts, and Spirit Bodies. Summons or controls stars and supernovae, producing destructive eruptions capable of overwhelming layers of defense and many Avatars. Forms black holes that compress matter, capture light and heat, slow time, and crush entire stellar dominions. Controls fusion and fundamental forces to create matter, reverse black holes into white holes, and release blinding or annihilating light. Advancement warning Unlike the standard pathways, Earth-side advancement is recorded as receiving a Boon through prayer to Supernova Dominator . That connection is also the main route through which the Outer Deity’s will, symbols, and corruption can enter the practitioner. Major story spoilers. summary: Darkness Pathway: The Darkness Pathway centers on night and sleep: its users grow stronger at night, can pacify or host souls, enter dreams, induce sleep,
searchText: Darkness Pathway Eternal Darkness · Standard Pathway Darkness Pathway Sequence 9: Sleepless → Sequence 0: Darkness The Darkness Pathway centers on night and sleep: its users grow stronger at night, can pacify or host souls, enter dreams, induce sleep, see in darkness, and suppress moods and desires. At higher sequences it develops darkness domains, realistic dreams, concealment, misfortune, horror, deathlike repose, and embodiment of its authorities; its Above the Sequence is Eternal Darkness and its Sefirah is the River of Eternal Darkness. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Darkness Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Sleepless Nocturnality strengthens physical ability, intuition, and mental capabilities at night; enables dark vision and danger sensing. 8 Midnight Poet Midnight Poems produce tranquilizing, sleep-inducing, pacifying, or fear effects, with stronger defenses resisting them. 7 Nightmare Nightmares separate soul during sleep, enter and shape dreams, invade targets’ dreams, and manifest nightmare limbs. 6 Soul Assurer Requiem puts spirit bodies to sleep, suppresses desires and thoughts, soothes souls, ghosts, and undead. 5 Spirit Warlock Spirit Commanding seals and controls spirits, enabling multitasking and occasional flight or earth traversal through helpers. 4 Nightwatcher Night Domain boosts the user and weakens enemies; concealment, misfortune, spirit control, and dream invasion also expand. 3 Horror Bishop Horror Bishops wield Sword of Darkness, create city-scale Nightmare Worlds, and project an aura of Horror. 2 Servant of Concealment Servants of Concealment erase targets from perception, hide secrets and areas, reverse concealment, and create concealed worlds. 1 Knight of Misfortune Knights of Misfortune wield national-scale misfortune and can return from darkness after death, though not truly immortal. 0 Darkness Darkness governs concealment, dreams, eternal rest, spirits, misfortune, catastrophe, and horror, including resurrection in darkness. Pathway themes & abilities Its recurring themes are darkness, silence, sleep and dreams, spiritual bodies, concealment, misfortune, and horror. Core expressions include Nocturnality, Midnight Poems, dream manipulation, Requiem, Spirit Commanding, Night Domain, Concealment, and Darkness authority. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Nightwatcher: Night Domain boosts the user and weakens enemies; concealment, misfortune, spirit control, and dream invasion also expand. Sequence 3 — Horror Bishop: Horror Bishops wield Sword of Darkness, create city-scale Nightmare Worlds, and project an aura of Horror. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Servant of Concealment: Servants of Concealment erase targets from perception, hide secrets and areas, reverse concealment, and create concealed worlds. Sequence 1 — Knight of Misfortune: Knights of Misfortune wield national-scale misfortune and can return from darkness after death, though not truly immortal. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Darkness: Darkness governs concealment, dreams, eternal rest, spirits, misfortune, catastrophe, and horror, including resurrection in darkness. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances The Church of the Evernight Goddess, the institutional center of the Darkness pathway, emerged in the Third Epoch and helped humanity through the Cataclysm; its Nighthawks later worked undercover as local law-enforcement or security teams. Amanises’s rise began earlier: a subsidiary goddess of the demonic-wolf deity Flegrea, she seized the Darkness Uniqueness and a Sequence 1 characteristic amid Flegrea’s fall, then vanished before ascending. In modern Loen, the Tingen Nighthawks’ struggle against a plot involving Ince Zangwill, artifact 0-08, and the True Creator’s Spawn ended with captain Dunn Smith sacrificing himself to save the city Story connections [Major spoiler] Flegrea’s downfall: Amanises began as one of Flegrea’s subsidiary gods; amid the conspiracy that killed him, she secured the Darkness Uniqueness and a Sequence 1 characteristic, setting up her later rise The Nighthawks on the ground: The Church’s mostly Darkness-pathway Nighthawks worked undercover in local law-enforcement or security roles. Their Tingen team, led by Dunn Smith, is central to the novel’s opening supernatural investigation [Major spoiler] Ince’s defection and Tingen: Former Evernight archbishop Ince Zangwill defected with Sealed Artifact 0-08. His scheme to obtain Saint Selena’s remains and advance into the Darkness pathway caused the deaths of Dunn and Klein; Dunn’s sacrifice stopped the True Creator’s Spawn and saved Tingen [Major spoiler] Church rivalry and consolidation: The Evernight and God of Combat churches were long-standing rivals. After the God of Combat fell in the Fifth Epoch conflict, Evernight’s church took over his church Figures to know Amanises / the Evernight Goddess Once the Goddess of Misfortune and a subordinate of Flegrea; later the Darkness deity and founder of her church Flegrea The ancient demonic-wolf deity whose downfall let Amanises claim the Darkness Uniqueness Dunn Smith Darkness-pathway Nighthawk captain in Tingen; he recruited Klein and sacrificed himself to protect the city Ince Zangwill Former Evernight archbishop who defected with 0-08 and later became a Darkness-pathway Nightwatcher Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. title: Death Pathway
summary: Death Pathway: The Death Pathway governs death and partly controls the spirit world. Its high-sequence authorities extend into resurrection, instant killing,
searchText: Death Pathway Eternal Darkness · Standard Pathway Death Pathway Sequence 9: Corpse Collector → Sequence 0: Death The Death Pathway governs death and partly controls the spirit world. Its high-sequence authorities extend into resurrection, instant killing, the Underworld, and the boundary between life and death. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Death Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Corpse Collector Physical enhancement, Spirit Vision, resistance to cold and decay, and knowledge of undead traits and weaknesses. 8 Gravedigger Communicates with nearby spirits, commands simple actions, and uses Eye of Death to identify creature weaknesses. 7 Spirit Medium Spirit Channeling communicates with and controls spirits, creating varied effects through supernatural phenomena. 6 Spirit Guide Language of the Dead can dislodge spirits; Resurrection raises corpses as will-less skeletons or zombies. 5 Gatekeeper Door to the Underworld drags targets toward death; Internal Underworld houses souls, spirits, and undead. 4 Undying Reincarnation restores them after periodic death; Underworld Authority enables sealing and limited Spirit World Traversal. 3 Ferryman Partial Death authority can kill by gaze, wither targets, and reverse death through touch. 2 Death Consul Absolute Death strips vitality; Nation of the Dead creates a death-filled domain and undead. 1 Pale Emperor Pallor creates a colorless world that weathers powers; Enslavement extracts spirit bodies and controls souls. 0 Death Conceptual Death ends life, memories, connections, and existence imprints; Pallor, Endpoint, Undead, and Enslavement reach ultimate authority. Pathway themes & abilities Its powers center on corpses, spirits, undead creatures, necromancy, Spirit World interaction, pallor/withering, enslavement, and death manipulation. Higher Sequences add Underworld authority, resurrection or reincarnation, spirit control, and increasingly absolute forms of death and endpoint authority. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Undying: Reincarnation restores them after periodic death; Underworld Authority enables sealing and limited Spirit World Traversal. Sequence 3 — Ferryman: Partial Death authority can kill by gaze, wither targets, and reverse death through touch. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Death Consul: Absolute Death strips vitality; Nation of the Dead creates a death-filled domain and undead. Sequence 1 — Pale Emperor: Pallor creates a colorless world that weathers powers; Enslavement extracts spirit bodies and controls souls. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Death: Conceptual Death ends life, memories, connections, and existence imprints; Pallor, Endpoint, Undead, and Enslavement reach ultimate authority. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Salinger’s rise reshaped the Death pathway’s identity: after serving the ancient rulers Flegrea and Gregrace, he became Death, built the Balam Empire in the Southern Continent, and replaced the pathway’s former phoenix mythical form with the feathered serpent. In the Fourth Epoch, his attempt to fuse Death with the Red Priest authority drove him mad; his alliance with the Primordial Demoness ended in a catastrophic war against the Seven Gods and his death. His descendants and followers continued the story: the Numinous Episcopate pursued his resurrection, while his son Azik ultimately refused to complete a revival that would have displaced his own life Story connections Empire and transformation: Salinger’s succession to Gregrace linked Death’s shift from a phoenix to a feathered serpent with the rise of his Balam Empire God-level catastrophe: Salinger’s forced convergence with Red Priest and alliance with the Primordial Demoness escalated into conflict with the Seven Gods; he was killed and the Southern and Northern Continents were further divided by the Berserk Sea Afterlife of the plan: The Numinous Episcopate organized around reviving Salinger. In the later revival attempt, Azik chose to remain himself rather than complete the process that would bring his father back through him Figures to know Salinger / Death God of the Death pathway, founder and ruler of the Balam Empire, and the central target of the later resurrection effort Azik Eggers Salinger’s son, a Death Consul and Balam emperor in the Fourth Epoch; he rejects the final soul-merger that would revive Salinger Gregrace Phoenix ancestor who preceded Salinger as the Death pathway’s god Primordial Demoness Salinger’s ally in the late Fourth-Epoch catastrophe and an actor in the revival scheme around the Blood Emperor Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. title: Demoness Pathway
summary: Demoness Pathway: The Demoness Pathway centers on disaster and catastrophe, combining assassination, seduction, ritual and curse magic, invisible-thread
searchText: Demoness Pathway Calamity of Destruction · Standard Pathway Demoness Pathway Sequence 9: Assassin → Sequence 0: Demoness The Demoness Pathway centers on disaster and catastrophe, combining assassination, seduction, ritual and curse magic, invisible-thread manipulation, instigation, disease, and mirror-related abilities. At higher Sequences it expands into petrification, plagues, resurrection, natural disasters, apocalypse, and the return of things to chaos; its Above the Sequence is Calamity of Destruction and its Sefirah is City of Calamity. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Demoness Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Assassin Physical enhancement, heightened senses, night vision, and concealment within darkness or shadows aid assassination. 8 Instigator Instigation senses emotions and malice, plants desires, and provokes fights, crimes, and escalating conflicts. 7 Witch Charm, black flames, frost, mirror substitution, curses, invisibility, divination, and anti-divination become available. 6 Demoness of Pleasure Invisible threads restrain enemies, form protective cocoons, induce pleasure, while enhanced charm, frost, flames, curses, and substitution follow. 5 Demoness of Affliction Accelerated airborne diseases, finer threads, active charm, stronger curses, frost, invisibility, and mirror mazes expand the repertoire. 4 Demoness of Despair Plagues spread broadly, threads petrify on contact, charm overwhelms, and mirror projection and traversal intensify. 3 Demoness of Unaging Mirror Self enables agelessness and resurrection through mirror persons; petrification, charm, curses, traversal, plagues, and projections strengthen. 2 Demoness of Catastrophe Catastrophe governs natural, social, mechanical, and conceptual calamities, including mirror-world collapse and curses of destiny. 1 Demoness of Apocalypse Mirror World manipulation and Apocalypse bring area-wide termination; disease authority expands beyond mystical pathogens, with archangel-grade dark magic. 0 Demoness Chaos returns things toward primordial dissolution, joined by Primordium, conceptual charm, mirror-world rule, femininity, dark magic, and disease. Pathway themes & abilities Its recurring themes are catastrophe, apocalypse, chaos, femininity, charm, Mirror World control, and dark magic. Signature tools include concealment, instigation, black flames, frost, curses, threads, disease/plague, petrification, mirror substitution and projection, with higher authorities governing calamities and final collapse. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Demoness of Despair: Plagues spread broadly, threads petrify on contact, charm overwhelms, and mirror projection and traversal intensify. Sequence 3 — Demoness of Unaging: Mirror Self enables agelessness and resurrection through mirror persons; petrification, charm, curses, traversal, plagues, and projections strengthen. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Demoness of Catastrophe: Catastrophe governs natural, social, mechanical, and conceptual calamities, including mirror-world collapse and curses of destiny. Sequence 1 — Demoness of Apocalypse: Mirror World manipulation and Apocalypse bring area-wide termination; disease authority expands beyond mystical pathogens, with archangel-grade dark magic. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Demoness: Chaos returns things toward primordial dissolution, joined by Primordium, conceptual charm, mirror-world rule, femininity, dark magic, and disease. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers for Lord of the Mysteries and Circle of Inevitability . The Demoness Pathway is framed around catastrophe and apocalypse, and the novel’s later exposition also associates it with the feminine side of the Original Creator. In the Fourth Epoch, its worshippers were organized as the Demoness Family; the group later widened recruitment into the Demoness Sect, devoted to the Primordial Demoness. During Backlund’s Great Smog, Ince Zangwill collaborated with the Sect and the royal faction, manipulating Trissy as a target. In the later plot against King George III’s apotheosis ritual, Trissy became a vessel for the Primordial Demoness and died when the goddess descended through her Sequence 4 body Story connections The Fourth-Epoch Demoness Family began as bloodline descendants of the Primordial Demoness; from the Fifth Epoch, it recruited non-relatives and became the Demoness Sect In the Great Smog of Backlund, Ince Zangwill worked with the Demoness Sect and Loen’s royal family, using Trissy as a target in a plot that nearly killed Sherlock Moriarty Trissy was treated as a possible vessel for the Primordial Demoness. During the struggle to stop King George III’s Black Emperor apotheosis, the goddess descended through her; Trissy died under the strain of hosting a god in a Sequence 4 body In the Fourth Epoch’s War of the Four Emperors, the Primordial Demoness delivered the critical blow that stopped the Blood Emperor’s final attempt to drag the world into destruction, intending to resurrect him later Figures to know Primordial Demoness (Cheek) Sequence 0 deity worshipped by the Demoness Sect; central to the pathway’s Fourth-Epoch conflict and Trissy’s vessel plot Trissy Demoness whose part in the Great Smog and the George III plot connects the Sect’s schemes to Klein’s story Ince Zangwill Former Church of Evernight member who allied with the Demoness Sect and the royal faction during the Great Smog Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. Associated figures Selected figures listed in the source material: Cheek (Primordial Demoness), the Sequence 0 God of the Demoness Pathway. title: Derrick Berg
summary: Derrick Berg character profile: aliases, pathway, sequence, affiliations, appearance, and source notes.
searchText: Derrick Berg Character profile Derrick Berg Sun · Sequence 4: Unshadowed ( Sun Pathway ) Derrick Berg is a Beyonder of the Bard Pathway. Codename The Sun in the Tarot Club. He was a teenager who lives in the City of Silver, which resides in the Forsaken Land of the Gods. He hopes he can lead the City of Silver out of the Forsaken Land of the Gods, restore sunlight, and bring normal lives back to his people. This page includes major-spoiler information from the linked source article. The fact fields below are transcribed from that article’s character infobox. Translations Language Official Translation English Derrick Berg Chinese 戴里克·伯格 Korean 데릭 베르그 Thai เดอร์ริก เบิร์ก Role & affiliations Aliases and titles The Sun Little Sun Elder Berg Affiliations Tarot Club Church of the Fool City of Silver Six-member Council Occupation(s) Pope of the Church of the Fool Archbishop of the Church of the Fool Elder of Six-member Council Member of the exploration team Religion(s) Church of the Fool Church of the Ancient Sun God Pathway & abilities Pathway: Sun Recorded progression: Sequence 4: Unshadowed ( Sun Pathway ) Pathway reference Sun Compare sequence names and pathway symbols in the Pathways reference . Quotes 6 lines Complete quote entries transcribed from the character’s dedicated wiki Quotes page. The collection includes available Book One and Book Two entries. I don’t care if you’re God or The Fool, my prayers will not change. I hope that the people of the City of Silver will be freed from the curse of their destinies. I hope that the sun and sky described in the books will appear in our skies. If possible—if possible, I wish that my parents can be revived. — Derrick Berg, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 138. So, I want to be the Sun… When there was a Sun shining over the land, we had never encountered any curse. — Derrick Berg, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 138. Yes, we believe that we will regain the Lord’s favor in the end. Perhaps, it will be on the day the sun rises again. We were once ruled by the giants’ royal family, and we worshiped the Giant King Aurmir. Later, we were saved by the Lord and we will never betray the Lord again. — Derrick answered to The Fool in an uncertain tone, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 180. Did the Lord not abandon us? It’s just that “He” had gone mad. — Derrick Berg, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 311. My faith lies only with Mr. Fool! — Derrick Berg, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1172. Mr. World, do you need to bring some food with you? There are mushrooms that can produce milk! — Derrick to Mr. World, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1176.
