title: Klein Moretti 's Identities, Aliases & Disguises
summary: All of Klein Moretti's identities in Lord of the Mysteries - The Fool, Sherlock Moriarty, Gehrman Sparrow, Dwayne Dantès, and Merlin Hermes.
searchText: Klein Moretti 's Identities, Aliases & Disguises This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Klein Moretti 's Identities, Aliases & Disguises ← Back Organizations 1. The Fool "If I wanted to give you my blessings, I wouldn't have said that. I would have said, I hope that you will still love your family and friends after seeing them as they are." , Klein to Audrey on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1228 The Fool is an old god that seeks to revive and reclaim his authority. "He" is mysterious and seems to be executing "His" will through the Tarot Club . "He" does not speak often, especially in later meetings, and only gives hints to Tarot Club members. "He" also does not allow members to offend "Him" and punished Cattleya once she let out hints about "Him" . "He" is the God of the Church of the Fool . A. Appearance After becoming The Fool : "His" facial features are a mix of Klein Moretti and Gehrman Sparrow. "He" wears an illusory mask with blank facial features (uniqueness of the Fool pathway ) and wears a black windbreaker. "He" wears a pair of black gloves (uniqueness of the Error pathway) and holds a staff inlaid with star speckles (uniqueness of the Door pathway ). 2. Sherlock Moriarty Klein did not take much effort distinguishing Sherlock from Klein, so in many ways, they are similar, except that Sherlock is good at deduction and is a great detective. A. Appearance Sherlock Moriarty has Brown eyes, slightly long black hair, average-featured face with some stubs of facial hair, thin yet with a moderately muscular build. B. Relationship Talim Dumont: Friend, Klein was involved in the case of his death. Mike Joseph: Friend, a reporter who hired Klein as a bodyguard for an investigation. Aaron Ceres: Friend, father of the Will Auceptin . Sharron and Maric : Friend, they helped each other in multiple occasions. Isengard Stanton: Friend, he was one of his connection to the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery. Old Kohler: Worked as Klein's informant in East Borough. Ian Wright: Friend, he was Klein's first client as a detective. Utravsky: Friend, Klein helped him. Emlyn White : Friend C. Reference Sherlock Moriarty. This name is a combination of names from the famous detective Sherlock Holmes and his nemesis, James Moriarty. The fictional characters in the Sherlock Holmes stories written by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. 3. Gehrman Sparrow/The World He is a crazy adventurer who began to hunt pirates on the sea before being involved in many Beyonders' incidents at the Demigod level. He doesn't talk much, stays cold and calm all the time while being very assertive with others. Gehrman is also known as The World of the Tarot Club , a mad believer and the Angel of Redemption of The Fool. A. Appearance Gehrman Sparrow is a young gentleman with gold-rimmed glasses, neat black hair and dark brown eyes. He looks colder and sharper than Sherlock or Klein. Gehrman refined demeanor and gloomy aura make him appear as an experienced, ruthless adventurer. B. Relationship Blazing Danitz: Servant/Friend/Fool's believer Reinette Tinekerr : Messenger/Ally Edwina Edwards: Ally/Friend Frank Lee: Friend Anderson Hood : Ally/Friend C. Reference Gehrman Sparrow: Gehrman is a reference to Gehrman, the First Hunter, a boss character in Bloodborne. And Captain Jack Sparrow, the protagonist of the Pirate of the Caribbean. 4. Dwayne Dantès Dwayne Dantès is a mysterious tycoon from Desi Bay and a devout believer of Evernight Goddess. He came to Backlund to seek new opportunities, and to a certain extent, tries to enter the upper hierarchy of Backlund nobles. In fact, he was an adventurer who accumulated wealth in the Southern Continent, and since the fortune was not gained in a completely legal way, he came to Backlund to clean up the fortune. If any official Beyonders wish to dig deeper than this, they would then discover that he is a cheat who disguises himself as a rich man and makes big investments for the final scam. He is known as a womanizer because of Arrodes . A. Appearance Dwayne Dantès is a middle-aged gentleman with a mature appearance, deep-blue eyes, black hair with few silver strands, and profound gaze. Someone who exhibits the aura of a person who had experienced the vicissitudes of life. B. Relationship Walter: Butler Richardson: Valet, Land Steward of Maygur Manor Taneja: Housekeeper Maury Macht: Neighbor Portland Moment: Neighbor C. Reference Dwayne Dantès: Dantès is a reference to a famous avenger, Edmond Dantès from The Count of the Monte Cristo, a French adventure novel written in 1844. 5. Merlin Hermes Merlin Hermes: A wandering magician who travels and grants people's wishes. "He" is the creator of the Fully Automatic Wishing Machine, a machine that can supposedly grant its users three wishes. However, it was actually Merlin Hermes granting the wishes. "He" calls himself the Miracle Magician and servant of "The Fool" , Lord of Mysteries, Great Ruler of the Spirit World. A. Appearance Merlin Hermes is a wandering magician, he wears a black robe and classic hat. He looked nothing special. B. Reference Merlin Hermes: Merlin refers to the legendary wizard featured in Arthurian legend. And Hermes is originated from Greek Mythology, who is the Herald of the Gods, Protector of travelers and merchants. ← Back Home

searchText: Inextinguishable Ravings Outer Deity Inextinguishable Ravings Overview The Inextinguishable Ravings seemed to share His origin with the residual psyche of the Original Creator within the Beyonder characteristics. It was the source of all ravings. Klein Moretti, Book 2, chapter 1164 The Inextinguishable Ravings is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. "He" is the current owner of the Everlasting Pathway. "He" seemed to share "His" origin with the residual psyche of the Original Creator within the Beyonder Characteristics - the source of all ravings. 1 Book 2, chapter 1164 Honorific Name The Philosophical Essence; The Inextinguishable Ravings; The Symbolism of Life's Spirit; The Eternal Consciousness (哲学的本源， 不熄的呓语， 生灵精神的象征， 永不磨灭的意识) Symbols, Authorities & Abilities "He" possesses full Authority over the Everlasting and the corresponding Symbols , which include but are not limited to the following: Everlasting: Authorities and Symbols of Philosophy , Consciousness and Spirit . This Pathway is a mix of two different Pathways: 5 6 The Pathway of Philosophy . The Pathway of Consciousness and Spirit . The Sequence 0 name is Everlasting. The Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities "He" possesses and displays at the Above the Sequence level include: Inextinguishable Ravings: "His" ravings primarily awaken the spiritual imprint of the Original Creator, which resided within all Sefirot, Uniqueness, and Beyonder characteristics. No one can escape it; no one can remain unaffected. 2 "He" is capable of ignoring the interference of Marionettes , Avatars , and Afterimages to directly project "His" voice into Sefirot and Uniquenesses, transmitting "His" madness and implanting "His" intent. 1 Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder characteristics directly derived from the Original Creator would be heavily affected by this influence. 2 Great Old Ones that were not directly born from the Original Creator but instead, from the union between the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity, can barely endure this influence. Due to the intermediary layer, the spiritual imprint within "Them" was relatively weak. "He" is capable of transforming into frenzied thoughts and formless consciousness. 3 Consciousness & Spirit : "He" is the symbol of Consciousness and Spirit , injuring "Him" would cause nearby entities to experience chaotic Consciousness and disoriented Spirits . The disturbance would gradually spread outward to other star dominions, weakening as it expanded until it eventually dissipated. 7 The Symbol of Life's Spirit : "He" can awaken and corrupt the lingering Spirits within aggregate beings that are composed of multiple Spirits , making "Him" their nemesis. 3 Book 2, chapter 1168 The Golden Buddha, and the Pitch-Black Fiend - aggregate entities composed of multiple consciousnesses and the lingering Spirits of many Dao integrators - were forced to suppress "Themselves", unable to do anything else. Eternal Consciousness : "He" is intwined with the concepts of Consciousness and Spirits , making "Him" immortal. 8 The Philosophical Essence : "He" is able to transmit the First Philosophy , causing both physical and mental anguish in all Beyonders who can hear unknown and mystical voices. The higher the Sequence, the greater the impact. 9 Countering Symbols, Authorities & Abilities Certain Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities of other Great Old Ones can counter some of "Their" powers, which include but are not limited to the following: Eternal Darkness: Darkness counters The Symbol of Life's Spirit . "They" can put "Themselves" or "Their" allies into a state of Slumber . This can let "Their" thoughts, spirit, the madness within "Their" Sefirot, and complex and chaotic spirits such as those of the Dao Integrators fall into stillness, and allow "Them" to escape the influence of the Inextinguishable Ravings. 2 3 Primordial Hunger: Devouring counters Inextinguishable Ravings . "He" can Devour the Ravings from the Inextinguishable Ravings within "His" own mind. 2 Appearance "He" doesn't have a true physical form but attaches "Himself" to certain objects, causing them to exhibit specific colors or appearances. 1 Background According to the Seven Lights, ever since the Oldest One awakened and split apart, the most powerful Outer Deities in the entire universe, including the Inextinguishable Ravings, gathered around this tiny solar system. Some of "Them" wish to retrieve "Their" Sefirot and Beyonder Characteristics that had been ripped from "Them" and were attracted here. Some of "Them" hope to get neighbouring sefirot and high-level characteristics which ‘They’ can accommodate. 10 The Inextinguishable Ravings was highly likely to covet the Knowledge Moor and aimed to control the Chaos Sea, accommodating the Uniqueness of the Hanged Man, White Tower, and Visionary Pathways. 1 The Tenebrous World was also an option for "Him", though it was not an optimal choice, one "He" would usually avoid. 3 History During Project Vortex, the Inextinguishable Ravings sent a bit of its power through the barrier via the Endless Cosmos. It transmitted the First Philosophy, allowing the Immortal Voice to penetrate the barrier in small amounts. These would be received by all who can hear unknown and mystical voices. The higher the Sequence, the greater the impact. 4 Book 2, chapter 867 This was an unprecedented event for many Beyonders of the Hermit Pathway who suddenly heard this sound. Even without carefully distinguishing the content of the sounds, they suffered severe effects. However, compared to the indoctrination of the Hidden Sage, this was more bearable and did not push them to the brink of losing control. Upon hearing these mysterious terrifying sounds, most Beyonders of the Hermit Pathway witnessed a phantom light composed of complex information writhing madly like a shedding giant snake in an unknown place. Similarly, Beyonders of the Hanged Man Pathway also heard this sound. Some Angels, Saints, and Oracles of the Aurora Order also suffered intense and painful effects as a result. 4 Some remnants of the Knowledge Moor lie in Fourth Epoch Trier. Followers of the Inextinguishable Ravings planned to approach it with the help of the Mirror People after Project Vortex concluded. 4 Trivia When the Inextinguishable Ravings transmitted its power through the barrier, Fors Wall sealed Cattleya's listening abilities in both the literal and mystical senses, with layers of dazzling starlight covering her ears. This significantly reduced the effect of the sounds. 4 The Inextinguishable Ravings and the Mother Tree of Desire can devour each other. 11 Translations Language Name Chinese 不熄的呓语 Thai เสียงพร่ำเพ้อไม่สิ้นสุด References Book 2, chapter 1164. searchText: Justiciar Pathway Anarchy · Standard Pathway Justiciar Pathway Sequence 9: Arbiter → Sequence 0: Justiciar The Justiciar Pathway centers on defending Order through laws, judgments, and punishment. Its higher Sequences can negate supernatural powers, impose mystical Rules and Verdicts, and enforce order over chaos; its characteristics are stated to originate with the Outer Deity Son of Chaos, with The Anarchy as its Above the Sequence and Nation of Disorder as its corresponding Sefirah. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Trunsoest Brass Book On Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 698 Overview The Justiciar Pathway is about defending Order . It is strong at setting laws and punishing lawbreakers. They can set up rules that will inflict punishments if broken, directly attack minds and souls, recognize people supernaturally, detect abnormalities, and use all kinds of weapons and explosives. At High-Sequences, they can negate other Beyonder powers and supernatural phenomena, and enforce order upon chaos. They can also set Verdicts and Rules and any sentence they speak in mystical language can be set as a rule for their targets to follow. The Beyonder Characteristics of this pathway originated from the Outer Deity Son of Chaos . [ 2 ] The Above the Sequence of the Justiciar Pathway is The Anarchy , and the corresponding Sefirah is the Nation of Disorder . Name Key abilities 9 Arbiter Convincing Authority charm makes others more likely to believe and obey commands. 8 Sheriff Designates a small-town Jurisdiction, recognizes people and routes supernaturally, detects abnormalities, and gains weapon proficiency. 7 Interrogator Summons contact-bound illusory torture devices and psychic attacks that damage Spirit Bodies, compel confession, and improve demolition skills. 6 Judge Uses mystical language to impose area Rules and Verdicts such as Prohibition, Imprison, Confinement, secrecy, Death, Flog, and Exile. 5 Disciplinary Paladin Selects targets for Punishment, restricting movement and enhancing influence and offense; Authority strengthens Prohibition and Death. 4 Imperative Mage Sets time-limited Imperatives, creates rule-based Contracts, and gains Verdicts including Deprivation, Exile, Execution, Confinement, and Intimidation. 3 Chaos Hunter Applies Balancing, senses and tracks Disorder, and delivers unavoidable Sword of Judgment; earlier Imperatives and Verdicts strengthen. 2 Balancer Divides battlefields to enforce Balance, equalizes opponents briefly, senses Disorder, and enacts Laws and Decrees. 1 Hand of Order Acts as an Order Proxy, creating or temporarily modifying battlefield-to-nation-scale Rules and sensing or quelling Disorder. 0 Justiciar Commands Order over Rules, Laws, and Principles; establishes permanent publicized Rules, removes non-underlying Rules, and enables complex resurrection methods. Pathway themes & abilities Its recurring toolkit combines Authority and jurisdiction with supernatural recognition and detection, mind-and-soul attacks, weapon use, rule-setting, Verdicts, Punishment, ability Deprivation, Balance, and broader Law-and-Order control. The linked abilities article distinguishes Order, Disorder, Balance, Judgment, Laws, Principles, and Rules; higher levels progressively make these effects more area-wide, binding, and able to suppress other powers. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Novel lore & story appearances In the Fourth Epoch, Trunsoest and Alista Tudor helped overthrow Solomon and jointly ruled the Northern Continent through the Tudor–Trunsoest United Empire. When Solomon’s resurrection threatened them, the Six Gods backed Trunsoest’s switch from the Black Emperor pathway to Sequence 0 Justiciar; Alista instead became the Blood Emperor, splitting their empire into rival states. Trunsoest’s empire drew support from the orthodox gods and, through his marriage to Auernia, the Sanguines, but he fell in the War of the Four Emperors. searchText: Klein Moretti Main character profile Klein Moretti The Fool · Lord of Mysteries · Founder and convener of the Tarot Club Klein Moretti is the protagonist of Lord of Mysteries and an important side character in Circle of Inevitability . A modern-era transmigrator living through the identity of Klein Moretti , he becomes The Fool, the ruler above the gray fog, and the founder of the Tarot Club. This page contains major spoilers for Lord of Mysteries and Circle of Inevitability . Profile facts were checked against the linked source articles. Overview Klein is the current owner of Sefirah Castle and holds authority connected to the Fool, Error, and Door Pathways. Through his many identities, he moves between ordinary society, secret organizations, the sea, and the highest levels of the supernatural world. His defining qualities are caution, humor, intelligence, adaptability, and a strong desire to protect the innocent. He repeatedly chooses plans that preserve his humanity even while advancing toward the status of Saint, Angel, God, and finally Lord of Mysteries. Profile snapshot Birth March 4, 1327 of the Fifth Epoch Origin Earth; Southwest China as Zhou Mingrui Current status Alive; resurrected six times according to the source Pathway status Lord of Mysteries; The Fool, Error, and Door authorities Core affiliations Tarot Club; Church of the Fool; Church of the Evernight Goddess Symbol The Pupil-less Eye and the Contorted Lines Biography & historical events The chronology below follows the Klein Moretti/History article and the main Klein Moretti profile. Before the Fifth Epoch: Zhou Mingrui Before becoming Klein Moretti , he was Zhou Mingrui, a hardware engineer from Southwest China in the modern era. He studied a little of many subjects, enjoyed games, and learned Tarot divination while trying to impress someone he liked. After finding an old book titled Quintessential Divination and Arcane Arts of the Qin and Han Dynasty , he performed its Luck Enhancement Ritual and transmigrated in the middle of the night. Tingen City and the Tarot Club The original Klein was a history graduate living in Tingen City with Benson and Melissa Moretti. After Zhou Mingrui fused with his remnants, he joined the Nighthawks as civilian staff and became a Sequence 9 Beyonder of the Fool Pathway . The gray-fog space connected to his transmigration allowed him to draw Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson into his presence, creating the first Tarot Club gathering. Volume 1 — Clown Klein investigated supernatural incidents in Tingen and advanced to Clown. Ince Zangwill's schemes and the True Creator's spawn led to a battle that killed Klein and Dunn Smith. Klein returned to life through the power linked to the gray fog and left for Backlund to become stronger. Volume 2 — Faceless As Sherlock Moriarty, Klein became a detective in Backlund. He survived Rosago's assassination attempt, killed Lanevus while stopping the True Creator's descent, advanced through Magician and Faceless, and escaped a widening conflict involving Ince Zangwill, the royal family, and the Primordial Demoness. Volume 3 — Traveler As Gehrman Sparrow, Klein became a feared adventurer and pirate bounty hunter. He confronted the cult in Bansy Harbor, killed the Sea God Kalvetua in Bayam, worked with Cattleya 's crew, advanced to Marionettist, and killed Admiral of Blood Senor. Volume 4 — Undying As Dwayne Dantès, Klein entered Backlund's upper society to pursue the Antigonus Family's Notebook and the Bizarro Sorcerer formula. He survived Foggy Town and Zaratul's trap, explored the undersea ruins with Azik Eggers , and worked with Leonard Mitchell and Daly Simone to kill Ince Zangwill. Volume 5 — Red Priest Klein investigated the Great Smog of Backlund and helped clear Amon's avatars with Arianna, Pallez Zoroast , and Will Auceptin . He opposed King George III's Black Emperor ritual, advanced to Scholar of Yore in the Berserk Sea, and discovered that the palace above the gray fog was Sefirah Castle. Volume 6 — Lightseeker Amon took Klein into the Forsaken Land of the Gods and revealed ancient secrets, including the truth that Earth was a far-future Earth. Klein digested the Scholar of Yore potion, escaped using suicide and resurrection, hunted Kotar, gained the characteristics for Miracle Invoker and Attendant of Mysteries, and led the City of Silver out of the Forsaken Land. Volume 7 — The Hanged Man As Merlin Hermes, Klein fulfilled wishes while digesting the Miracle Invoker potion. He helped seal 0-02, assisted Bernadette with Roselle's final mausoleum, created Utopia for his advancement ritual, escaped Adam's divine kingdom, and killed Zaratul to become a King of Angels. Volume 8 — Fool Klein resisted the awakening will of the Celestial Worthy, accommodated the Fool Uniqueness, and advanced to Sequence 0: The Fool. He defeated Amon inside Sefirah Castle with a supernova, then made preparations with the Evernight Goddess and the Tarot Club before entering slumber. Slumber and Circle of Inevitability Klein released the humans sealed in cocoons inside Sefirah Castle before sleeping with Arrodes . Even while asleep, his aura answered major crises, including Termiboros' descent in Cordu Village and the protection of Lumian Lee . On June 25, 1360, Klein fully awakened, fused with the Celestial Worthy, accommodated Sefirah Castle as The Fool, and later accommodated the Error and Door Uniquenesses. The current source records him as the new Lord of Mysteries and the first Great Old Dominator on Earth. Appearance Zhou Mingrui had short black hair, dark brown eyes, glasses, an unremarkable but refined face, and noticeable eye bags. Klein Moretti 's original body had black hair, brown eyes, a thin build, and a scholarly air. As a Fool Pathway Beyonder, he used shapeshifting to create distinct appearances for his identities. Sherlock Moriarty Brown eyes, slightly long black hair, average features, and a thin but moderately muscular build. Gehrman Sparrow Neat black hair, dark brown eyes, gold-rimmed glasses, and a colder, sharper adventurer's presence. Dwayne Dantès A middle-aged gentleman with deep-blue eyes, black hair with silver strands, and a profound gaze. Merlin Hermes A wandering magician in a black robe and classic hat. Personality Klein is cautious, good-natured, humorous, polite, mature, and gentlemanly. He is fundamentally a lover of justice and will act even at personal cost. Dangerous experiences make him more ruthless, confident, and mysterious, but he continues to avoid harming innocent people because he fears both moral compromise and loss of control. He is interested in history and appearance, and his talent for acting existed even before he became a Beyonder. The Acting Method strengthens his ability to imitate roles and identities while preserving a private sense of humanity beneath them. Identities and titles The Fool: ruler above the gray fog and hidden leader of the Tarot Club. The World: the Tarot Club identity used for missions and commissions. Sherlock Moriarty: detective identity in Backlund. Gehrman Sparrow: adventurer and pirate bounty hunter. Dwayne Dantès: wealthy Backlund gentleman and social infiltrator. Merlin Hermes: wandering magician who fulfills wishes. Only a Hunter knew how treacherous a Hunter could be! — Lumian Lee, Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 815. What kind of monster did my additives create? — Lumian's thought about the corrupted Gusain, Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 816. Bye-Bye! — Lumian to Julie and Wanak as he ran away, Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 817. One day, I will truly walk before you and tell you my answer. — Lumian's response to Adam, Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 884. It's not so easy to imitate an image that can make me fear and dread. No matter how frightened I am inside, I'll act like it's no big deal, and I certainly won't let my words betray any weakness. — Lumian to Franca Roland , Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 932. Wouldn't that make the Blood Emperor have to call me daddy? — Lumian joking about his possibility of giving birth to Alista Tudor, Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 1009. I understand. Is it worth it? — Lumian's question to Mr. Fool about his sacrifice, Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 1033. You're closer to teasing than stating facts with that last part... I can clearly hear that you're somewhat afraid, yet you still insist on teasing both Gehrman Sparrow and yourself — is this the nature of writers? title: Monarch of Decay
summary: Monarch of Decay, Outer Deity of the Second Law Pathway, leftover material of the Fourth Pillar.
searchText: Monarch of Decay Outer Deity · Above the Sequence Monarch of Decay Second Law Pathway · The Irreversible Entropy Overview The Monarch of Decay is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. He is the current owner of the Second Law Pathway . 1 He is the leftover material of the Fourth Pillar, 2 and together with other conditions, his symbol of Decay might cause the Fourth Pillar to be born early. 3 ...the Monarch of Decay would naturally cause the entire planet and all living beings to start decaying, eventually either rotting to death or becoming disgusting creatures loyal to him... Madam Magician to Lumian Lee, Book 2, chapter 1090. Formerly called the Malady God. 4 Honorific Name The Inevitable Decay of All Things, The Endpoint of the River of Time, The Lord of Rot and Putrescence, The Irreversible Entropy. 5 The honorific name shares several phrases with the description of his three pathways in the author's WeChat post. Some nuances are lost in the WebNovel English translation. WebNovel translation Original Chinese Literal translation Explanation The Inevitable Decay of All Things 万物终朽的象征 (Wànwù zhōng xiǔ de xiàngzhēng) Symbol of the Eventual Rotting of All Things "万物终朽" (Wànwù zhōng xiǔ, all things eventually rot) is a phrase in the description for the Pathway of Decay (衰败, Shuāibài). The Endpoint of the River of Time 时光之河的终点 (Shíguāng zhī hé de zhōngdiǎn) The Endpoint of the River of Time "时光" (Shíguāng, time) is the same word for Time used in the Pathway of Time (时光, Shíguāng). The Lord of Rot and Putrescence 腐烂与衰败的主宰 (Fǔlàn yǔ shuāibài de zhǔzǎi) The Lord of Putrefaction and Decay "腐烂" (Fǔlàn, putrefaction) appears in the description of the Pathway of Disease (疾病, Jíbìng): "腐烂的源头" (the source of putrefaction). "衰败" (Shuāibài, decay) is the same word used in the Pathway of Decay, the Monarch of Decay, and the Left Hand of Decay. A more literal translation is "weaken, decline, wane, deteriorate into ruin". The Irreversible Entropy 不可逆转之熵 (Bùkě nìzhuǎn zhī shāng) The Irreversible Entropy No further note. Symbols, Authorities and Abilities He possesses full authority over the Second Law Pathway and the corresponding symbols, which include but are not limited to the following: Second Law: authorities of Time, Senescence, Disease, Decay, and Entropy, and the symbols of Decay, Certain Death, and The Endpoint of the River of Time. 6 This Pathway is a mix of three different Pathways: 7 The Pathway of Decay (衰败, Shuāibài). The Pathway of Time (时光, Shíguāng). The Pathway of Disease (疾病, Jíbìng). Termination He is the leftover material of the Fourth Pillar. His Pathways represent the following aspects of the Fourth Pillar: The eventual Decay (衰败, Shuāibài) of all things. The merciless erosion of Time (时光, Shíguāng). Disease (疾病, Jíbìng) itself, the source of putrefaction (腐烂, Fǔlàn). When the formation of the Fourth Pillar starts from the convergence of the Calamity of Destruction and the Eternal Darkness, 8 the Monarch of Decay will be converged into and become a part of the Fourth Pillar. As a Great Existence representing Termination (终结, Zhōngjié), he has the confidence to kill another Great Old One in a short time. 9 Decay He is the symbol of The Eventual Rotting of All Things (万物终朽, Wànwù zhōng xiǔ). As long as he exists, one will experience Decay and eventually reach the end of their life unless they reach Sequence 0. 10 He can make the Decay of an afterimage equal to the Decay of the main body. His symbols include "Anything that can go wrong will go wrong". This can manifest in various ways, from destabilizing the internal balance of Great Existences 11 to inducing the early arrival of the Termination symbolism. In The Day of Many Disasters, two of his bestowed Left Hand of Decay, one male and one female, were placed as corpse statues in the side entrance of Alista Tudor's Blood Palace in Fourth Epoch Trier. Their purpose was to symbolize one thing: "making anything that can go wrong be most likely to go wrong", which manifested in the increasingly desperate situation facing those within the Astral Barrier and eventually led to the Mother Goddess of Depravity's descent through the Astral Barrier. 12 Time He is The Endpoint of the River of Time (时光之河的终点, Shíguāng zhī hé de zhōngdiǎn), being able to drag the region's Time toward its conclusion. 13 He can slow the surrounding flow of Time and hasten its approach to the terminal point. 14 He used this to defend against the Calamity of Destruction's Supernovae and Black Holes. The shock waves that erupted from the former dimmed rapidly before even nearing him, Decaying with astonishing speed, while the latter evaporated at an unimaginable pace, shrinking steadily. 15 He can manifest watery streams of time that were able to slow the flow of the River of Eternal Darkness. He can push his body into the depths of illusory ripples where it seems to be the end of Time, the final point of change. This can delay his prophesied Death until that Endpoint leaving the present unaffected. 16 Time, when combined with Decay, gave rise to Sureness (必然, Bìrán). Sure Hit (必然命中, Bìrán mìngzhòng) and Certain Death (必然死亡, Bìrán sǐwáng): he can invoke these symbols as an attack through his Left Hand. 17 He can make the Death of an Avatar equal the Death of the main body. His Left Hand can block an attack from the Eternal Darkness that combines the River of Eternal Darkness with the three Uniquenesses of Twilight Giant, Darkness, and Death. However, doing so would render him immobile for a period of time. Disease He is Disease (疾病, Jíbìng) itself, the source of putrefaction (腐烂, Fǔlàn). Virus: he holds the symbol of Virus. 18 Naturally, the symbol of Virus allows the Monarch of Decay to create Avatars, which manifests at the Doomed One Sequence. However, because he inherently bears the symbolism of Certain Death, any separated Avatars will die very quickly. As a result, he can no longer rely on Avatars to assist in combat the way he could at earlier levels. Appearance Usual form : watery streams of time emanated from the Monarch of Decay, whose body was the size of a planet, covered entirely in golden plating resembling an alien mummy. Between the gaps of the golden plates, greenish-yellow pus oozed out, capable of slowing the flow of the River of Eternal Darkness and dragging the region's time toward its conclusion. His left hand was not covered by gold. It was riddled with blue veins, rotting flesh, yellow-green blood vessels, and deeply wrinkled skin. 19 True form : after shedding the golden plating covering, his body is a heavily decayed, oozing, yellow-green pus-covered body. 20 Background According to the Seven Lights, ever since the Oldest One awakened and split apart, the most powerful Outer Deities in the entire universe, including the Monarch of Decay, gathered around this tiny solar system. Some of them wish to retrieve their Sefirot and characteristics that had been ripped from them, and were attracted here. Some of them hope to get neighboring Sefirot and high-level characteristics which they can accommodate. 21 The Monarch of Decay's goals were either the City of Calamity or the River of Eternal Darkness, though he could only choose one. 22 History The Monarch of Decay was one of the offspring of the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity. 23 Lumian Lee first encountered believers of this Outer Deity proselytizing in Trier and assaulted one of them. One of his believers would later be murdered by Lumian after he caused the death of the Ruhr. The Order of All Extinction is an organization which follows this Outer Deity. They participated in Project Vortex. 24 Higdon, a Saint follower of the Monarch of Decay, accompanied Voisin Sanson to recover Ludwig Phil on behalf of the Primordial Hunger, and Termiboros on behalf of the Circle of Inevitability. At the end of Project Vortex, both Higdon and Voisin Sanson perished. In The Day of Many Disasters, two of his bestowed Left Hand of Decay, one male and one female, were placed as corpse statues in the side entrance of Alista Tudor's Blood Palace in Fourth Epoch Trier. Their purpose was to symbolize one thing: "making anything that can go wrong be most likely to go wrong", which manifested in the increasingly desperate situation facing those within the Astral Barrier and eventually led to the Mother Goddess of Depravity's descent through the Astral Barrier. During The Apocalypse, he was assisted by the Circle of Inevitability and fought against Lumian Lee and Amanises. During the fight, Lumian and Amanises had nearly succeeded three times to wound or eliminate the Monarch of Decay, but each time, the Circle of Inevitability had intervened by either resetting the state through Loop or exerting influence via the symbolism of Inevitability. 25 When Lumian began irresistibly merging with the Monarch of Decay and was about to cause the formation of the Fourth Pillar, the Circle of Inevitability intervened by using the Substitution symbolism to replace the Monarch of Decay within the River of Fate's past with an Angel of Redemption characteristic. He then used his true body to replace the avatar, personally entering Lumian's body to face the encroaching power of Termination. Using his Eternal Aeon symbolism, the Circle of Inevitability achieved Redemption. He then replaced his external Sequence 1 avatar to replace his true body once again, sealing it within Lumian's body, while the true body returned to reality. After being saved, the Monarch of Decay was last seen fleeing through the Astral World, and was pursued by the Circle of Inevitability, who was tracking him using the mystical connection that was established through the previous use of the Substitution symbolism. 26 Trivia The Monarch of Decay and High-Dimensional Overseer can devour each other. If one of them succeeds and further accommodates the Uniqueness of Door, they can attain the King of Space-Time symbolism. 27 References Book 1, chapter 1270 (mentioned). title: Moon Pathway
summary: Moon Pathway: The Moon Pathway specializes in healing, biological enhancement, healing and buffing potions, animal taming, regeneration, and darkness spells.
searchText: Moon Pathway Goddess of Origin · Standard Pathway Moon Pathway Sequence 9: Apothecary → Sequence 0: Moon The Moon Pathway specializes in healing, biological enhancement, healing and buffing potions, animal taming, regeneration, and darkness spells. At higher sequences it develops spirituality and Moon-domain control, long-distance summoning, life/creation manipulation, and Fertility and Proliferation authority; its Above the Sequence is the Goddess of Origin and its Sefirah is the Brood Hive. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Moon Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Apothecary Creates medicinal concoctions, gains Spirit Vision for health, and tames or domesticates plants. 8 Beast Tamer Reads, uses, and communicates through animal senses; controls and tames animals, including supernatural creatures. 7 Vampire Regenerates rapidly and commands Darkness, Shadow, and Moon spells, including bat wings, corrosive claws, and Blood Servant Conversion. 6 Potions Professor Discerns spiritual materials and crafts potions and perfumes with extraordinary effects, including healing and utility preparations. 5 Scarlet Scholar Controls Moonlight through Full Moon environments, Moonlight Transformation, and Flash teleportation. 4 Shaman King Interacts with nature for ritual magic, uses substitution spells, darkness and Moon spells, and Illusory Bats. 3 High Summoner Opens a Door of Summoning to contract Spirit World creatures, with partial authority over summoning. 2 Life-Giver Wields Life and partial Spirituality authority, healing directly, regrowing bodies, extending lifespans, and opening multiple summoning doors. 1 Beauty Goddess Embodies Beauty, commands lower-sequence lifeforms, shapes favorable lunar environments, and dissolves into Crimson Light. 0 Moon Commands Summoning, Beauty, Life, Spirituality, Darkness, Bizarreness, and subordinate control of plants, animals, humans, and creatures. Pathway themes & abilities The pathway’s stated symbolism centers on spirituality, plants, beauty, parts of life, darkness, and mystery. Its main abilities include potioneering, spirituality, vampire physique, darkness magic, summoning, life manipulation, beauty, and Moonlight manipulation. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Shaman King: Interacts with nature for ritual magic, uses substitution spells, darkness and Moon spells, and Illusory Bats. Sequence 3 — High Summoner: Opens a Door of Summoning to contract Spirit World creatures, with partial authority over summoning. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Life-Giver: Wields Life and partial Spirituality authority, healing directly, regrowing bodies, extending lifespans, and opening multiple summoning doors. Sequence 1 — Beauty Goddess: Embodies Beauty, commands lower-sequence lifeforms, shapes favorable lunar environments, and dissolves into Crimson Light. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Moon: Commands Summoning, Beauty, Life, Spirituality, Darkness, Bizarreness, and subordinate control of plants, animals, humans, and creatures. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances The Moon pathway’s story is inseparable from the Sanguines: they call themselves Sanguine rather than “vampire,” and their worship of the Moon refers to ancestor Lilith, not the Primordial Moon. Spoilers: Lilith was believed to have fallen in the Second Epoch, but later survived by concealing herself as the Giant Queen Omebella, with help from the Evernight Goddess and Ancient Sun God. After Sanguine queen Auernia fell, an artifact carrying Lilith’s spiritual imprint was stolen by the Rose School of Thought and used to construct the public identity of the Primordial Moon. The school’s Primordial Moon faction began as a Moon-pathway branch of the Life School of Thought before defecting to the Rose School Story connections Lilith’s apparent death and return: Sanguine tradition remembers Lilith as the ancient ancestor, while the later revelation that she survived under Omebella’s identity reframes Earth Mother history. Lilith · Sanguines An invented god-identity: The Rose School’s Primordial Moon faction was formed from defectors of the Life School of Thought; a stolen relic associated with Lilith and Auernia helped create the Primordial Moon’s public identity. Rose School of Thought · Lilith Emlyn’s recruitment: Lilith’s apocalypse revelation reached Emlyn through Nibbs Odora, directing him toward the Fool; Emlyn subsequently joined the Tarot Club. Lilith · Nibbs Odora · Emlyn White Figures to know Lilith Sanguine Ancestor and former Moon deity; later revealed as the Earth Mother who survived by taking Omebella’s identity. Lilith Auernia Sanguine queen and wife of the Night Emperor; her fall is tied to the relic later used to stage the Primordial Moon identity. Sanguines · Lilith Emlyn White Sanguine and Moon-pathway Beyonder whose recruitment connects Sanguine politics to the Tarot Club. Emlyn White Nibbs Odora Sanguine elder who delivered Lilith’s revelation to Emlyn and set his connection to the Fool in motion. Nibbs Odora · Lilith Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. title: Moses Ascetic Order
summary: Detailed history, philosophy, pathways, members, and organizational information for the Moses Ascetic Order..
searchText: Moses Ascetic Order Lord of Mysteries · Organizations & Factions Moses Ascetic Order Detailed history, philosophy, pathways, members, and organizational information for the Moses Ascetic Order. Image Primary image from the Lord of Mysteries Wiki ↗ ← Back to Organizations & Factions archive Moses Ascetic Order Chinese 摩斯苦修会 General Information Description Members Status Destroyed. Remaining members are taken over by the Church of the Fool or Stars Pirates to reform Type Secret Founded Fourth Epoch God Worshipped Hidden Sage Founder Stiano and a few other humans who have read the Second Blasphemy Slate Leader Torriope (Chairman) Retia Austin (Vice Chairman) Notable Members Cattleya Influence Pathway(s) Hermit Paragon Headquarters Avalon, North Sea (Former) Related Group(s) Church of the Fool Stars Pirates History Lord of Mysteries The Moses Ascetic Order was first established by a few humans who had read the Blasphemy Slate. They believed in a non-anthropomorphic god, called the 'Hidden Sage'. Being morally upright pursuers of knowledge, the original Moses Ascetic Order was a very respectable organisation, and it maintained a good relationship with the other major churches. According to Old Neil, they had a very good relationship with the Church of the Evernight Goddess before their fall. Their beliefs and results on ritualistic magic have heavily influenced them. Sometime later, the Hidden Sage, the god they believe in, came to life as an evil god that corrupted the order. The Moses Ascetic Order has fallen since then, turning into an evil cult that spreads evil and corruption. Circle of Inevitability During spring 1359 of the Fifth Epoch, the Moses Ascetic Order was destroyed after being attacked by the Tarot Club, the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery, and the Church of the Evernight Goddess as a part of Hunting Hidden Sage. After the events of Hunting Hidden Sage, the Moses Ascetic Order is destroyed. Chairman Torriope is killed. Vice-Chairman, Dragon Scholar Retia Austin survives and escapes using Mystical Re-enactment. Two of the Ten Pillars, Seids and Ohayes, are killed. The surviving members of the Moses Ascetic Order 's Ten Pillars goes into hiding. Cattleya took in many members of the now destroyed Moses Ascetic Order . [?] Philosophy The Moses Ascetic Order believes in the 'Hidden Sage'. The description is that of a god, but it is more of an ideology, a natural law. For example, all objects are numeric. They held the view that the Hidden Sage is an embodiment of Spirit Numerology, or that knowledge is supreme, and the Hidden Sage is knowledge itself. The members of the organisation led ascetic lives to resist losing control and to resolve the effects of the remnant potion. They strictly kept their order’s secrets, and they upheld moral and religious precepts, determined in their pursuit of knowledge. They believe that humans continuously reincarnate after death. Anyone who entered the order would be barred from speaking for five years after becoming a Mystery Pryer . They would learn to remain silent, thereby cultivating and enhancing their focus. Their maxim is "Do as you wish, but do no harm." Headquarters Main article: Avalon Sealed Artifacts Grade 0 Destined Madness : Corresponds to a Sequence 2 Sage of the Hermit Pathway . Solomon's Mask : Corresponds to a Sequence 2 Duke of Entropy of the Black Emperor Pathway . Post-Apocalyptic Scripture : Corresponds to a Sequence 2 Soothsayer of the Wheel of Fortune Pathway . Grade 1 Face of the Arcane : Corresponds to Sequence 3 Arcane Scholar of the Paragon Pathway . Merumu's Spellbook : Corresponds to Sequence 4 Mysticologist of the Hermit Pathway . Eye of Omniscience : Corresponds to Sequence 4 Mysticologist of the Hermit Pathway . Creator's Hammer : Corresponds to Sequence 4 Alchemist of the Paragon Pathway . Two artifacts corresponding to Sequence 3 Clairvoyant of the Hermit Pathway . One artifact corresponding to Sequence 3 Pallbearer of the Mother Pathway . One artifact corresponding to Sequence 4 Mysticologist of the Hermit Pathway . One artifact corresponding to Sequence 4 Manipulator of the Visionary Pathway . Several other Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts They also had various Grade 2 and 3 Sealed Artifacts. After the operation of Hunting Hidden Sage, the Sealed Artifacts of the Moses Ascetic Order were taken and split between the Tarot Club and the Church of the Evernight Goddess.

title: Mother Goddess of Depravity
summary: The Mother Goddess of Depravity is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth.
searchText: Mother Goddess of Depravity Outer Deity Mother Goddess of Depravity Overview On the second day, the Oldest One birthed the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Reality gained a foundation, the Spirit World and Astral World were separated, and the River of Fate began to flow. The Second Day of Genesis, Book 2, chapter 1171 The Mother Goddess of Depravity is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. "She" is also known as the Primordial Moon , The Great Mother , the Sovereign of the Physical World and the Mother of All Things . "She" has been occupying the Moon since the First Epoch, terraforming it to the Crimson Moon. "She" is the first child of the Original Creator, and is one of "His" three direct children along with the Mother Tree of Desire and the Son of Chaos. 25 "She" is also the ruler of all feminine power of the Cosmos. 1 Book 1, chapter 1271 "She" was the original owner of the Mother and Moon Pathways. "She" is also the current owner of the Chaos Primogenitor. "She" is the Sovereign of the Physical World , one of the three Pillars that are the foundation for the universe's maintenance and development. 2 Book 2, chapter 1090 When the Original Creator split into pieces, "He" created a force strong enough to tear the Sefirot apart. Part of "Her" Sefirah was torn from "Her" and became the Brood Hive, which was attracted to Earth along with the Moon and Mother characteristics "She" held. Then the Mother Goddess of Depravity became not much different from the other Outer Deities, but still with the symbol of Pillar on "Her". Besides the Mother Goddess of Depravity, the Mother Tree of Desire, and the Son of Chaos who were directly born from the Original Creator, the remaining Outer Deities were all born from the union of the Mother Goddess of Depravity and the Original Creator. "They" are the first batch of beings created by "Her", thus "She" is the true Mother of All Things . 2 "She" is said to have a conflict with the Mother Tree of Desire, but "They" have also cooperated. 26 27 Honorific Name Mother Goddess of Depravity Complete Mother Goddess of Depravity; Origin of Evil; The Indestructible; Goddess of Origin; Mother of All; Brood Hive of Filth; Sovereign of the Physical World (堕落母神， 邪恶之始， 不灭者， 根源之神， 万物之母， 污秽的母巢， 现实世界的主宰) Without the Brood Hive Mother Goddess of Depravity; Origin of Evil; The Indestructible; Sovereign of the Physical World (堕落母神， 邪恶之始， 不灭者， 现实世界的主宰) Primordial Moon The one and only Crimson Moon; The Symbol of Life and Beauty; Mother of all Spiritual Forces (独一无二的红月， 生命与美丽的象征， 所有灵性力量的母亲) Symbols, Authorities & Abilities "She" possesses full Authority over the Chaos Primogenitor and partial Authority over the Mother and Moon Pathways (through accommodating the Brood Hive but without the Uniquenesses) and the corresponding Symbols , which include but are not limited to the following: Mother: Authorities over Mother , Earth , Nature , Death , and Life . Moon: Authorities over Summoning , Beauty , Spirituality , Life , Darkness , and Bizarreness with the symbol of the Moon . Chaos Primogenitor: Authorities over Reproduction , Propagation , Reality , and the Symbol of Nurturing the nascent Original Creator of the next Universe . 5 Book 2, chapter 1156 This Pathway is a mix of two different Pathways: 30 31 32 6 Author's WeChat post mgod, part 17 33 The Pathway of Original Sin , Evil and Corruption , which includes the Exploitation of Life . The Sequence 0 name is Chaos Primogenitor. The Pathway of Reality and Procreation . The Sequence 0 name is World . To match the Mother Goddess of Depravity's Honorific Names to "Her" Pathways and Authorities: 7 Author's WeChat post mgod, part 7 6 " Origin of Evil " - Chaos Primogenitor Pathway " The Indestructible " - Physical World (Reality) Authority " Sovereign of the Physical World " - World Pathway The Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities "She" possesses and displays at the Above the Sequence level include: '''Sovereign of the Physical World ( Xiànshí shìjiè de zhǔzǎi) : One of the two most vital symbols for the Mother Goddess of Depravity is "Her" symbolism as a Pillar. "She" symbolizes and is the controller of the Physical World''', one of the three layers of the world. A Pillar is slightly stronger but has no fundamental difference compared to the other Great Old Ones. In general, by relying on the unique symbolism of a Pillar , "She" has the status and power to contend with two or three other Great Old Ones at most. 8 34 However, the Mother Goddess of Depravity is invincible as a support. Furthermore, as the wielder of The Indestructible symbolism, except for scenarios where "She" faces the Fourth Pillar, the Original Creator, or overextends the Chaos Primogenitor symbolism, "She" will never perish even when facing hundreds of Great Old Ones at once, and will at most be severely injured. '''The Indestructible ( Bù miè zhě) : Reality is the foundation of the universe. Unless everything ended, reality would eternally exist. Thus, the Soul and the Body of Mother Goddess of Depravity possessed the characteristic of Indestructibility'''. 9 Book 2, chapter 1164 Reality resists and dissipates Mysticism . For the Mother Goddess of Depravity who wields the symbol of Reality , even though "She" doesn't have a size larger than the instant symbolic influence range, mechanism-wise, "She" cannot be killed by the Death symbolism of the Eternal Darkness. 10 Author's WeChat post giant_formulas, part 25 "She" could only perish under the following scenarios: 11 Book 2, chapter 1161 Encountering the Original Creator, who could make the impossible happen. The emergence of the Fourth Pillar symbolizing the end of everything. Overextending the Chaos Primogenitor's unique symbolism. As the embodiment of Reality , the Mother Goddess of Depravity getting severely injured can cause Reality to quake, or vice versa in certain scenarios. When "She" was injured by the symbolism of the Calamity of Destruction, the entire planet lost its vitality, the stars in the sky dimmed, and tremors reverberated throughout the boundless Cosmos. 11 Through the symbolism of Error , the shaking of Reality can equate with the Sovereign of Reality suffering severe damage. 12 Author's WeChat post fate_formulas, part 31 As long as "She" wishes, "She" cannot be Banished or Sealed . 9 "She" can transform into a colossal, ethereal oak tree, rooted deeply in reality, supporting the heavens, and intertwining "Herself" with the fabric of the real universe, to prevent "Herself" from being Banished or Sealed . 11 "She" can "fix" mystical connections, spirits, and consciousness, among other things, in place, disrupting interference and influences from other entities. This is symbolized as an illusory, slightly damaged oak tree. The Mother Goddess of Depravity solidified the mystical connection between the Mother Tree of Desire and Tenebrous World, disrupting Klein's Marionettes ' attempt to Graft the connection back to themselves. 13 The Mother Goddess of Depravity "fixed" the Goddess of Fate's consciousness and spirit in place, disrupting the Lord of Mysteries Klein's Theft and saving "Her" from the fate of being Sealed into the Chained materials. 35 Unlike the Lord of Mysteries, "She" can't Seal off reality to prevent unauthorized entry or expel all adversaries, however, "She" can impose a continuous weakening effect on targets within reality. 9 As the Sovereign of the Physical World, "She" can be said to possess the authority of '''Foundation ( Gēnjī) , making all Outer Deities rely on "Her" for "Their" existence, which is why "She" cannot be Destroyed or Sealed'''. 36 '''World ( Shìjiè) : The Sequence 0 of the Pathway of Reality and Procreation , and the cornerstone of the Sovereign of the Physical World''' symbolism. 7 6 This Pathway suppresses the Chained, which has the characteristic of "The body is the prisoner of the World ". 37 '''Nurturer of the Chaos Primogenitor ( Hùndùn yuán tāi) : The Chaos Primogenitor is the Original Sin''' and the nascent Original Creator of the next universe. Nurturing "It" is one of "Her" two most vital symbols, and a key reason "She" remains a Pillar even after the Brood Hive's separation. 5 14 Book 2, chapter 1157 '''Chaos ( Hùndùn) : As one of the three direct children of the Original Creator, the Mother Goddess of Depravity inherently possesses the Chaos quality of the Original Creator. The Chaos Primogenitor denotes this Chaos''' aspect. 38 '''Origin of Evil ( Xié'è zhī shǐ) : The Pathway of the Chaos Primogenitor is the Pathway of Evil and Corruption , which includes the Exploitation of Life . 6 As such, "She" possesses the corresponding Honorific Name and symbolism of the Origin of Evil'''. The Chaos Primogenitor , once born, doesn't belong to "Her" anymore. At the moment, "She" can borrow "Its" power. 39 However, "It" doesn't bring only benefits to the "Her", but also burdens the mother's body as an infant would. 40 "She" can invoke the special symbolism of the Chaos Primogenitor once every Major Month (2,160 years) . The normal heartbeats of the Chaos Primogenitor helped "Her" accelerate the accommodation of the rebelling Brood Hive, despite being disrupted by the countless Marionettes and Avatars from the Lord of Mysteries. 5 41 The extremely special heartbeat of the Chaos Primogenitor about to be born and "Its" imminent entry into reality shattered the Astral Barrier that originated from the Original Creator, as if its original master had recalled it. 14 Invoking this special symbolism would put "Her" in a state of prolonged weakness for centuries 14 that cannot be recovered using New Life . 11 If "She" borrowed this special symbolism for less than 2,160 years , the Chaos Primogenitor would truly descend into the real world - a devastating catastrophe to "Her", 14 and could cause "Her" to perish despite the symbolism of The Indestructible . 11 The Lord of Mysteries, Demon of Knowledge, and Son of Chaos joining force can extend the Chaos Primogenitor's cooldown by modifying the Major Month . However, "They" could extend it by one Major Year at most. 42 "She" has the ability to actively give birth to the Chaos Primogenitor . 43 '''Genesis ( Chuàng shēng) : The God Almighty and the Mother Goddess of Depravity both hold part of the Genesis symbolism - opposing the Termination''' symbolism of the Fourth Pillar 44 - with the God Almighty holding a larger share. 45 '''Motherhood/Maternal Instinct ( Mǔxìng) / Mother of All Things ( Wànwù zhī mǔ)''': Excluding the Mother Tree of Desire and the Son of Chaos, "Her" union with the Original Creator gave birth to all other Outer Deities. "They" are the first batch of beings created by "Her", thus "She" is the true Mother of All Things and '''The Great Mother ( Wěidà mǔqīn)'''. 2 The Goddess of Origin , Mother of All Things , and Brood Hive of Filth symbols were separated from "Her" during the Original Creator's awakening in the First Epoch and got attracted to Earth, along with the Moon and Mother Pathways. These symbols later self-completed into the Sefirah Brood Hive. 3 "She" reaccommodated the Brood Hive during The Apocalypse, but did not retrieve the the Uniqueness of Mother and the Uniqueness of Moon. In the First Epoch, the Primordial God Almighty and the Brood Hive gave birth to Omebella and Zedus, making certain arrangements. In The Day of Many Disasters, the birth of Omebella strengthened the symbolism of the Mother in mysticism, allowing the Mother Goddess of Depravity to bypass the Astral Barrier to descend on Earth. 46 Humans were created by the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity. 47 "She" is the source of every single Mother Goddess -type deity of any religion in the history of Pre-Epoch Earth. 15 Author's WeChat post mgod, part 22 "She" had once united with a planet in ancient times, birthing three divine offspring that rule over the corresponding civilization. 16 Book 2, chapter 1129 '''Goddess of Origin ( Gēnyuán zhī shén) : From the Origin it comes, to the Origin''' it returns. 17 Author's WeChat post mother_abilities If the Mother Goddess of Depravity obtains the the Uniqueness of Demoness, it will lead to the Buddhist's concept of the Cycle of Four Kalpas : Formation, Continuance, Decline, Disintegration . 48 '''New Life ( Xīnshēng) : "She" can use the symbolism of New Life''' on "Herself", Souls, consciousness, spirits, intellect, and Beyonder powers. Using New Life on "Herself": Rebirth : "She" can initiate New Life to reset "Her" form, reverting "Herself" to an embryonic state for Rebirth . This process would reset all symbols associated with "Her", except those intrinsic to "Her" being, erasing external mystical correspondences. 11 If "She" used Rebirth during the process of accommodating the Brood Hive, this would reset "Her" progress to zero. "She" is capable of accelerating the reconstruction of the Mirror World to its original stability through Rebirth . 49 Every part of the Mother Goddess of Depravity was in a state of constant New Life , including "Her" soul, consciousness, spirit, and intellect. This caused "Her" to recover "Her" intellect as soon as "She" became Foolish , rendering "Her" immune to the core symbolism of the Lord of Mysteries. 18 Book 2, chapter 1176 Using New Life on others' consciousnesses: The natural influence of "Her" symbolism let all the consciousnesses within Calamity of Destruction Lumian to gain New Life , including that of Cheek, Tudor, the Primordial God Almighty, the divided Mirrored Original Creator, and the Malevolent Dragon. 8 Book 2, chapter 1160 Grisha Adam was bathed in crimson moonlight, bringing New Life to all consciousnesses within "Him", including that of Herabergen, Leodero, and the Primordial God Almighty. 13 Book 2, chapter 1169 50 Using New Life on others' Beyonder powers: The interferences from the Eternal Blazing Sun, Evernight Goddess, Earth Mother, God of Steam and Machinery, and God of Knowledge and Wisdom in Bethel Abraham's apotheosis ritual were all given New Life , no longer able to be controlled by their original owners. 51 A portion of the billions of Marionettes under the Lord of Mysteries Klein's control gained New Life and consciousness, ceasing to be mere puppets and starting to resist his control. Many Marionettes attempted to use various abilities, but the majority of these powers betrayed their original owners, instead destroying them. 19 Book 2, chapter 1151 Each strand of the Lord of Storms' lightning form was tainted scarlet, gaining New Life as they detached and scattered, killing "Him". 52 Corruption : "Her" corruption can create a new personality, not just amplify the evil traits of the original personality. This is what happened to Bethel Abraham. 53 "Her" corruption will still remain even after a Black Emperor dies and revives through the Astral World, accompanying "Their" resurrection with corruption that has gained New Life . 20 "Her" symbolic nature would continue to influence the surrounding area even when "She" hesitates to attack due to other entities' influences, such as Charm from the Calamity of Destruction. 8 The symbolism of New Life has immensely powerful healing properties, "She" can quickly heal "Herself" and other Great Old Ones' wounds. 11 18 13 Only certain symbols and concepts would weaken the effectiveness of New Life , such as the symbol of Destruction 13 and the power of Termination . 21 Book 2, chapter 1174 The dead affected by the “new tide of Life " on the Primitive Island would be Resurrected with New Life , possessing a certain will and vitality, and even a Spirit after being repeatedly affected by it would oddly develop some sort of sentience and come “alive”. 54 '''The Feminine ( Yīnxìng) Aspect of The Universe : Unlike the Masculine Side of the Universe which is very scattered, the Mother Goddess of Depravity is the master of all Feminine Forces of the Universe'''. 55 When the Mother Goddess of Depravity lost the Brood Hive during the Original Creator's awakening in the First Epoch, it caused the birth of Life and the Feminine powers in the entire universe to undergo a certain anomaly. 3 However, thousands of years of time at astronomical scales is a very short period of time, and the corresponding influence hasn't spread. Even though the Demoness isn't neighboring to the Mother and Moon Pathways, the Oldest One's Feminine Aspect and the Universe's Feminine Aspect are, to some extent, equivalent, leading to convergence without causing excessive madness compared to other pathways, similar to to the effect of combining Beauty Goddess and Naturewalker in a 3 + 1 setup. 56 '''Spirit Body and Spirituality ( Líng tǐ língxìng) : "She" represents the destinations of Spirits''' and is "Their" master. This is an authority that overlaps with the Death and Darkness. 57 Reincarnation Cycle : The Mother Goddess of Depravity and the Eternal Darkness have overlapping authority over Spirits . Merging "Them" together would create a cycle like Reincarnation and Rebirth . 58 The emergence of the Eternal Darkness allows the previously wandering Souls on Earth in the Spirit World to finally have Eternal Rest in the River of Eternal Darkness, but without the Mother Goddess of Depravity's symbolism, the Reincarnation Cycle will not be complete. 59 The Mother Goddess of Depravity's Chaos Primogenitor is Compatible with the three Pathways under the River of Eternal Darkness since there's an inherent connection between Life and Spirit . "She" can accommodate any of the three Uniquenesses under the River of Eternal Darkness to complete the full Cycle of Reincarnation . Acquiring only one is sufficient, more would be dangerous because the Physical World would descend completely into madness. 60 A complete Mother Goddess of Depravity can no longer accommodate any Uniqueness under the River of Eternal Darkness because "She" would exceed the limitation, but "She" could still control them and use them for completion. Paramita : "Her" Divine Kingdom is a Paramita . If the parts related to Death , Spirits , and Reincarnation are completed, it would become part of Reality , altering the state of the entire universe. 61 '''Moon ( Yuèliàng) : The Moon itself is more akin to a symbolism than to an authority. Just as the Moon is Earth's companion, the Mother is the first companion of all life. This is the Moon's''' most essential aspect. 22 Author's WeChat post moon_abilities The Moon concept in the Astral World was jointly occupied by the Mother Goddess of Depravity and the Brood Hive. As a result, it was impossible to complete the Moon. 62 "She" is able to make a Blood Moon to suddenly descend into the Astral World, illuminating all the distorted concepts there, as well as preventing any Deity from escaping. 63 '''Beauty ( Měi) : Beauty is derived from the Moon and Femininity , and the Brood Hive is the most Beautiful thing in the universe. 22 By possessing the Brood Hive, the Mother Goddess of Depravity is the symbol of Beauty – a concept that equaled Beauty itself, 11 radiating an unmistakable Maternal''' brilliance. 8 Because of "Her" Beauty , "Her" enemies would hesitate to strike at "Her", making "Her" a less likely target of malice. 8 22 '''Brood Hive of Filth ( Wūhuì de mǔ cháo) : By possessing the Brood Hive, "She" holds the corresponding symbolism of Brood Hive of Filth'''. 17 Death : "She" holds the symbolism of Death , corresponding to the symbols of Goddess of Origin and Brood Hive of Filth . Returning to the Origin is Death , while the Brood Hive of Filth part of this symbolism points towards Pollution , Loss of Control , and Bodily Mutation . 17 "She" can influence other entities to wither, collapsing into Death and returning to the embrace of Mother Earth . Many of Lord of Mysteries Klein's Marionettes withered under "Her" moonlight 19 and "Her" Banshee-like scream. 11 Under "Her" Banshee-like scream, the collapse of Calamity of Destruction Lumian's consciousness and body accelerated further from the influence of Death and Desolation . 11 Reverse Corruption : As a Great Old One, those without sufficient rank who discover "Her" existence will be Corrupted —manifestations of this Corruption include sprouting genitalia, staining blood-red, or swelling as fetuses prepare to tear their way out of their body. 64 Countering Symbols, Authorities & Abilities Certain Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities of other Great Old Ones can counter some of "Her" powers, which include but are not limited to the following: Calamity of Destruction: Destruction counteracts New Life . Wounds and compound weaknesses dealt to "Her" would take longer to heal under the influence of the symbolism of Destruction . 11 13 Masculinity mutually counteracts with Femininity . 65 For example, the Calamity of Destruction cannot turn a weakened Mother Goddess of Depravity into a male, and vice versa. Lord of Mysteries: History , Fooling , and Error can inflict severe damage to the Sovereign of the Physical World . The Lord of Mysteries could use the symbolism of History to summon the History of Reality being shaken during The Apocalypse war, then employ the symbolism of Fooling to blur the lines between History and Reality , and then uses the symbolism of Error to equate the shaking of Reality with the Sovereign of the Physical World suffering severe damage, thereby inflicting heavy losses on the Mother Goddess of Depravity . However, this isn't enough to kill or Seal "Her". 12 Appearance On the Moon: "She" occupies the moon and interferes with the earth through the shared identity of Primordial Moon . It appeared that the moon had a crimson sea flowing on its surface. It appears to be drowning everything, as though it was digesting this huge natural satellite. This blood-colored sea boiled when Klein learned about the news of "Great Old Ones", "Outer Deities", and "Cosmos". 66 When Amon repelled "Her" power using the First Blasphemy Slate, the crimson moon appeared in the sky. The color quickly faded and turned pure. On it was a huge, distorted, crimson figure. 67 True Form of the Mother Goddess of Depravity : Without the Brood Hive: A colossal winged female composed of stacked reproductive organs. 15 With the Brood Hive: "She" is composed of countless birthing organs haphazardly piled together, with swirling smoke and crimson moonlight intertwining to form an accretion-disk-like extension that served as clothing. Yet, this massive figure had a head resembling that of a human woman. "Her" features - facial structure, long brown hair, and crimson eyes - were flawless, embodying the very concept of "beauty". "She" was the symbol of beauty in the universe, radiating an unmistakable maternal brilliance. 8 15 History Genesis On the first day, the Original Creator awoke and created this world, but Reality , the Spirit World , the Astral World , and Fate were still mixed together. On the second day, the Oldest One birthed the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Reality gained a foundation, the Spirit World and Astral World were separated, and the River of Fate began to flow. Soon after, the Mother Tree of Desire was born, giving rise to life and introducing evil and desire. Then came the Son of Chaos, who established order-and with it, shadows naturally emerged. 23 Book 2, chapter 1171 On the third day, the Oldest One and the Mother Goddess united, and the Mother of All Things gave birth to a firstborn daughter, the Goddess of Fate. From then on, the fates of all things began to intertwine, no longer in absolute chaos but instead forming relative patterns and foreseeable futures. 23 After the Goddess of Fate, the other Outer Deities were born one after another from the union between the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity, 2 Book 2, chapter 1090 68 with the Circle of Inevitability as "Their" eldest son. 24 Pre-Epoch In the Pre-Epoch, the Outer Deities exerted influence on Earth, but did not dare to overly influence. 69 The Mother Goddess of Depravity already had worshippers on Earth. "She" was the source of every single Mother Goddess-type deity of any religion in the history of Earth, 70 and was worshipped everywhere under the image of the Great Mother Goddess. 71 Before the First Epoch, the Circle of Inevitability and the Goddess of Fate frequently fought each other. 72 Even though the Mother Goddess of Depravity favored the Goddess of Fate, the reason why "She" didn't help "Her" was because the universe needed the Circle of Inevitability's Redemption Symbolism. 73 First Epoch As one of the direct children of the Original Creator, the Mother Goddess of Depravity was the most affected by the Law of Convergence when the Original Creator awakened in the Pre-Epoch, causing part of "Her" Sefirah (later self-completed into the Brood Hive) and the two Pathways of Moon and Mother to be separated from "Her" and were attracted to Earth. During the Lost Era, the Primordial God Almighty and Celestial Worthy's strong and still-perfect-and-whole power deterred the Outer Deities, who can only settle for observing Earth from afar for now. 74 Lord of Mysteries Mr. Door has suggested a few times that Roselle should visit the moon, and indicated that the moon has answers to many things. Roselle heeded his advice and was corrupted during his visit. 75 It is also suspected by Klein that she is responsible for corrupting Roselle. 76 This was later confirmed. 20 Book 1, chapter 1307 After the corruption, Roselle created the Cards of Blasphemy that possess high-level anti-divination and anti-prophecy abilities. Roselle told Klein to be wary of the Mother Card since it has a trap set by "Her". Roselle also warned that when all 22 Cards of Blasphemy are collected, something bad will happen which is most likely caused by "Her" influence. 20 Circle of Inevitability "She" possesses the authority of the Chaos Primogenitor and is worshipped by various factions under the name " The Great Mother ". Some believe that all creatures in the world are the children of the Great Mother. They were directly transformed from the flesh and blood of the Great Mother. 77 Since The Fool entered "His" slumber, the Outer Deities had advanced "Their" infiltration of Earth. The Mother Goddess of Depravity was the most prolific amongst "Them", managing to corrupt many members of the Sanguines and Church of the Earth Mother, including Father Montserrat. The Nightstalkers, a secret organization worshipping the Great Mother, was established in the Intis Republic. The Mother Goddess of Depravity also cooperated with the Eternal Blazing Sun on certain matters, causing Lady Moon to become pregnant with a divine child from the Eternal Blazing Sun. However, it was revealed later on that the Eternal Blazing Sun chose to instead assist Red Angel Medici's bid in becoming the Calamity of Destruction instead, refusing to bow to neither "Her" nor Adam due to "His" pride. However, "She" had already created a symbolic bond between "Him" and Omebella, which may have been "Her" goal in the first place. Anyone who attempts to take advantage of "Her" seems to be taken advantage of instead... Madam Magician, Book 2, chapter 1019 During Project Vortex, "She traded the corruption inside Roselle Gustav for the Shadow of the Beauty Goddess held by the Rose School of Thought, with the corruption being used to strip the Chained God of "His" last Abomination characteristic to give birth to Tirié. "She" was active in The Fool's Dream, running Mushoku Hospital alongside the Mother Tree of Desire. Together, "They" stored the various traumas of Klein in the basement, and "She" granted New Life to the corpse of Panatiya in cooperation with the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings. However, "She" would later betray "Him" by siding with the Primordial God Almighty instead, and withdraw from the Dream alongside the Mother Tree of Desire. According to "Her" contract with the Primordial God Almighty, "He" would help "Her" reclaim the Goddess of Origin Authorities using Omebella, and "She" would help "Him" revive. In addition, "She" entered a contract with the Mother Tree of Desire and witnessed by the Primordial God Almighty, where the Mother Tree of Desire would sacrifice the Tree of Shadow to help the Mother Goddess of Depravity descend on Earth in The Day of Many Disasters. In return, the Mother Goddess of Depravity would need to give assistance to the Mother Tree of Desire later. After The Day of Many Disasters, the Mother Goddess of Depravity had descended onto Earth and aimed for the Brood Hive in the Western Continent. The Fool exploited "Her" instinctual desire, lured "Her" to breach the Celestial Worthy's barrier sealing the Western Continent, then reinforced the seal; while the Western Continent's Celestial Master and others continued burning "Their" life forces and utilizing the powers of the Sefirot to sustain the barrier for almost a year. Eventually, the Mother Goddess of Depravity captured the Brood Hive within the gray-white fog sealing the Western Continent 2 months before the Death of Primordial Demoness. The Brood Hive yearns to see "Its" eldest daughter, Omebella, truly reborn, but "It" resists re-merging with the Mother Goddess of Depravity. The two were locked in a fierce struggle. Both the World of Ruins and the Western Continent attained a fleeting peace, with only the naturally dissipating forces and maternal symbolism still exerting their effects. 78 When The Apocalypse began, Lumian destroyed both the Gift of the Land and Lilith to symbolically killed Omebella, who is the link between the Mother Goddess of Depravity and the Brood Hive. 79 Because of this, the Brood Hive, whose dissipating consciousness had been rekindled by intense hatred and mystical stimulation, reassembled and became active once more, delaying the complete fusion between "It" and the Mother Goddess of Depravity. 80 Klein Moretti, who had become a complete Lord of Mysteries, disrupted "Her" further by sending hundreds of billions of Marionettes "Her" way. 19 The Mother Goddess of Depravity used the authority of the Chaos Primogenitor to fasten "Her" accommodation of the Brood Hive. During the critical moment, "She" utilized the special heartbeat of the Chaos Primogenitor about to be born and "Its" imminent entry into reality to instantly finish accommodating the Brood Hive, which also shattered the Astral Barrier. 14 After Lumian Lee became the Calamity of Destruction, "He" used his mystical link and similarities to the Mother Goddess of Depravity and damaged himself to deal "Her" a critical blow. Afraid that Lumian's death and loss of balance would unleash the Mirrored Original Creator, which would reflect back on "Her" through the mystical connection and might cause the birth of the Chaos Primogenitor, the Mother Goddess of Depravity healed Lumian, then temporarily retreated away from the battlefield to heal "Her" injuries. During the latter stage of the battle between Earth's Above the Sequences and the Outer Deities, the Mother Goddess of Depravity had recovered enough to influence the battlefield remotely. When the Mother Tree of Desire was heavily injured by Farbauti and the Master of the Shadow Cottage's self-curse, "She" exploited the cursed mystical connection to drag "Herself" toward the Tenebrous World battlefield. Klein attempted to Grafted back the connection, but failed due to the Mother Goddess of Depravity's intervention, making the Mother Tree of Desire successfully escape with the Tenebrous World. The Mother Goddess of Depravity also targeted Adam with New Life , which worsened "His" condition and caused the Primordial God Almighty to further awakened. After Klein incapacitated both the Supernova Dominator and the Goddess of Fate, the Mother Goddess of Depravity saved the Goddess of Fate from being Sealed . Towards the end of the battle, the Mother Goddess of Depravity descended directly again, and fought briefly against Klein before he proposed a temporary truce. Klein then created a Loophole in "Her" contract with the Primordial God Almighty, allowing "Her" to avoid fulfilling "Her" end of the bargain immediately. "She" left the solar system alongside all "Her" children apart from Supernova Dominator, who had been Sealed by Klein previously. However, the contract was still in effect, meaning "She" would have to return some time in the future to help the Primordial God Almighty revive. Trivia After hearing Fors Wall's story of wandering on a planet where the inhabitants worshiped the Mother Goddess of Depravity, Lumian Lee speculated that perhaps like the World of Ruins, the Mother Goddess of Depravity's true domain is like this—devoid of civilization but teeming with Mythical Creatures. On the other hand, planets worshiping "Her" elsewhere might still foster civilizations. 16 Translations Language Name English Mother Goddess of Depravity Primordial Moon Chinese 堕落母神 原始月亮 Thai เทพมารดาแห่งความต่ำทราม ดวงจันทร์บรรพกาล References Book 1, chapter 1271.
