title: Mother Pathway
summary: Mother Pathway: The Mother Pathway centers on life, plants, and earth, with additional emphasis on healing, genetics, and creating new lifeforms from
searchText: Mother Pathway Goddess of Origin · Standard Pathway Mother Pathway Sequence 9: Planter → Sequence 0: Mother The Mother Pathway centers on life, plants, and earth, with additional emphasis on healing, genetics, and creating new lifeforms from existing ones. At high sequences, it can accelerate growth, create chimeras, humans, and constructs, drain life to return it to earth, and support rebirth and life creation. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Mother Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Planter Physical enhancement; farming and seed care; limited weather prediction from natural signs. 8 Doctor Spirit Vision diagnoses conditions; broad physical and soul healing includes surgery, soul suturing, and restoring vigor. 7 Harvest Priest Accelerates seed and plant growth, commands nonintelligent plants and insects, casts weather rituals, and heals land. 6 Biologist Cross-breeds organisms or objects into new species, creates potent toxins, and gains deep knowledge of life. 5 Druid Uses earth spells, underground travel, swamps, nature’s wrath, golem creation, animal transformation, and stronger crossbreeding. 4 Ancient Alchemist Mutates bodies and minds, creates artificial life and humans, commands low-intelligence creatures, heals severely, and gains supernatural transformation. 3 Pallbearer Commands death and return: raises evil spirits, drains life, returns undead to earth, and seals undead angels. 2 Desolate Matriarch Exercises earth, desolation, harvest, and life over broad areas; creates constructs, toxins, evil spirits, and mythical transformations. 1 Naturewalker Reshapes environments, merges with natural elements for travel or power, and creates conceptual nature realms. 0 Mother Embodies Mother, Earth, Nature, partial Death and Life; births deities, concepts, worlds, mutates life, and enables return. Pathway themes & abilities Its documented themes include botany, healing, crossbreeding, biological mutation, chimera and construct creation, alchemy, fertility and reproduction, desolation, and life manipulation. At Sequence 0, its core authorities are Mother, Earth, Nature, parts of Death and Life, and subordinate authorities including Desolation, Healing, Transmutation, Return, and Harvest. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Ancient Alchemist: Mutates bodies and minds, creates artificial life and humans, commands low-intelligence creatures, heals severely, and gains supernatural transformation. Sequence 3 — Pallbearer: Commands death and return: raises evil spirits, drains life, returns undead to earth, and seals undead angels. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Desolate Matriarch: Exercises earth, desolation, harvest, and life over broad areas; creates constructs, toxins, evil spirits, and mythical transformations. Sequence 1 — Naturewalker: Reshapes environments, merges with natural elements for travel or power, and creates conceptual nature realms. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Mother: Embodies Mother, Earth, Nature, partial Death and Life; births deities, concepts, worlds, mutates life, and enables return. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers for both novels. The Church of the Earth Mother is an orthodox institution founded in the Third Epoch, and its clergy control the Mother and Moon pathways; its faith centers on the Earth Mother. A late revelation recasts that identity: Lilith, the Second-Epoch Sanguine Ancestor believed dead, survived by taking the fate and identity of the Giant Queen Omebella, then eventually ascended as Sequence 0 Mother. In the Third Epoch, Earth Mother joined Evernight Goddess and God of Combat in opposition to the Ancient Sun God’s faction, and later participated in Rose Redemption, a major conspiracy that led to his death Story connections The stolen identity and delayed apotheosis: Lilith faked her death, assumed Omebella’s identity with help attributed to Evernight and the Ancient Sun God, and waited for Badheil’s apotheosis before advancing to Mother A hidden role in the Third Epoch’s power struggle: Earth Mother allied with Evernight and God of Combat against the Ancient Sun God’s faction and later joined Rose Redemption The church under pressure in Circle of Inevitability : To guard against false revelations from the Mother Goddess of Depravity , the church split its Beyonders into the Favored and the Blessed; the Day of Many Disasters then devastated the Favored faction Figures to know Lilith Sanguine Ancestor, concealed Earth Mother, and Sequence 0 Mother Omebella Giant Queen whose fate and identity Lilith appropriated; the Silver City’s records preserve an important trace of her story Evernight Goddess Lilith’s ally in the concealment scheme and a partner in the Third Epoch coalition Emlyn White Sanguine and high-ranking deacon of the Church of the Earth Mother Major story spoilers. title: Mother Tree of Desire
summary: The Mother Tree of Desire is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth.
searchText: Mother Tree of Desire Outer Deity Mother Tree of Desire Overview Soon after, the Mother Tree of Desire was born, giving rise to life and introducing evil and desire. The Second Day of Genesis, Book 2, chapter 1171 The Mother Tree of Desire is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. "She" is the second child of the Original Creator, and is one of "His" three direct children along with the Mother Goddess of Depravity and the Son of Chaos. 1 Book 2, chapter 1171 2 Book 1, chapter 1271 "She" was the original owner of the Abyss and Chained Pathways. "She" is also the current owner of the Patriarch. Honorific Name Complete Mother Tree of Desire; Father of Devils; Lord of Deviants; Source of Curses; Perpetual Blatherer; Heartless God (欲望母树， 恶魔之父， 异类之主， 诅咒之源， 永世的嘶吼者， 失心之神) Without the Tenebrous World Mother Tree of Desire; Perpetual Blatherer; Heartless God (欲望母树， 永世的嘶吼者， 失心之神) TRANSLATION NOTE Even though "失心"'s literal translation is "lost heart", the term's actual meaning is "lost mind" (for example, "失心疯" means "madness" or "insanity"). Thus, a more correct translation of "失心之神" is "God of Lost Minds" instead of "Heartless God" from the official Webnovel English translation. Symbols, Authorities & Abilities "She" possesses full Authority over the Patriarch and partial Authority over the Abyss and Chained Pathways (through accommodating the Tenebrous World but without the Uniquenesses) and the corresponding Symbols , which include but are not limited to the following: Abyss: Partial authorities over Degeneration , Filth , Corruption , Desire , Curses , and Deviants , and the symbol of Abyss of the Heart/Mind . Partial via the Tenebrous World. Chained: Authorities over Curses , Deviants , Binding , and Objects , and the symbol of Binding . Partial via the Tenebrous World. Patriarch: Authorities over Love , Envy , Reason , and Sentient Beings , and Symbol of Desires . This Pathway is a mix of two different Pathways: 9 The Pathway of Desires ( Reasons ). The Pathway of Blathering , the corresponding authorities are Raving , Madness and Propagation . 10 The Sequence 0 name is Patriarch. 11 The Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities "She" possesses and displays at the Above the Sequence level include: Chaos : As one of the three Children of The Original Creator, "She" symbolizes Chaos . Even though "She" doesn't have a corresponding Sequence 0 to denote this Chaos , "She" is the Father of Devils and the Mother Tree of Desire, which makes "Her" symbolically, inherently Chaotic . 12 Father of Devils (Former): "She" was the original Father of Devils before "She" lost the Tenebrous World and the two corresponding Pathways when the Original Creator awakened. Because of "Her" connection, "She" held corruptive influence over "Her" former two pathways after the Astral Barrier had sufficiently weakened. After The Apocalypse, "She" is re-accommodating the Tenebrous World but without the the Uniqueness of Chained, the Uniqueness of Abyss, and their corresponding Beyonder Characteristics. 13 Mother Tree of Desires : "She" is the Mother Tree of Desires and carries the corresponding symbols. Perpetual Blatherer : "She" is the initiator of Reason and endless Desires . 1 4 Author's WeChat post mtod "She" can awaken the survival instincts of all sentient beings in a region, including other Great Old Ones, which can cause "Them" to flee. 5 Book 2, chapter 1169 "She" can manipulate the Desires within the heart of all creatures. 6 "She" can rely on the symbolism of Desire to locate the true body of the Lord of Mysteries. 6 Book 2, chapter 1168 With "Her" birth came the rise of Life and the introduction of Evil and Desire . 14 In comparison, the Abyss's authority over Desire lies more in inducing, catalyzing, and igniting Desires , rather than embodying Desire itself like the remnants within the Mother Tree of Desire. 15 Reason : "Her" birth symbolizes of the emergence of free will and the distinction between self and others. 16 Before "Her" birth, the Mother Goddess of Depravity was essentially still part of the Original Creator as a single entity. After "She" appeared, the Mother Goddess of Depravity and the lives that appeared with the Mother Goddess's birth were no longer considered part of the Original Creator as a single entity. Tree Supplication: "She" is able to Supplicate powers from the Mother Goddess of Depravity. However, it will depend on the mood of the Mother Goddess of Depravity whether "Her" prayer will be accepted or not. 17 Ravings : "Her" authority emphasizes the effects of Ravings , and is not Ravings itself. 18 Fear : "She" is the embodiment of the emotion of Fear . 19 This authority overlaps with the authority of the Darkness. Countering Symbols, Authorities & Abilities Certain Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities of other Great Old Ones can counter some of "Her" powers, which include but are not limited to the following: Lord of Mysteries: Marionettes and Grafting counter Desires : Marionettes were dead people, puppets devoid of Desires . 7 The Lord of Mysteries can Graft the surging Desires within "Their" true body onto Marionettes , then release them from manipulation, killing them. 6 High-Dimensional Overseer: Dimensionality partially counters Desires . Beings in higher dimensions or within the High-Dimensional Overseer's dimensional painting will not be fully consumed by the explosion of desires from the Father of Devils, "They" would only enter a brief state of stagnation. 5 Appearance True Form: "She" resembled a humanoid giant tree covered in chaotic scales. Its surface was adorned with enticing crystalline fruits, glistening, alluring flowers, various metallic emblems, black hearts, bare tumors, and coins from different civilizations. At the tree's upper reaches were two heads. The lower head was male, eyes closed, exuding bizarre desires. The upper head was female, with green hair and a face of extraordinary beauty, possessing a charm that spoke directly to affection. 7 Book 2, chapter 1165 History Genesis On the first day, the Original Creator awoke and created this world, but Reality , the Spirit World , the Astral World , and Fate were still mixed together. On the second day, the Oldest One birthed the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Reality gained a foundation, the Spirit World and Astral World were separated, and the River of Fate began to flow. Soon after, the Mother Tree of Desire was born, giving rise to life and introducing evil and desire. Then came the Son of Chaos, who established order-and with it, shadows naturally emerged. 1 First Epoch As one of the direct children of the Original Creator, the Mother Tree of Desire was most affected by the Law of Convergence when the Original Creator awoke, causing part of "Her" Sefirah (later self-completed into the Tenebrous World) and the two Pathways of Chained and Abyss to be separated from "Her" and were attracted to Earth. During the Lost Era, the Primordial God Almighty and Celestial Worthy's strong and still-perfect-and-whole power deterred the Outer Deities, who can only settle for observing Earth from afar for now. 20 Fourth Epoch In the Fourth Epoch, the Tree of Shadow was planted into the ruins of Trier by the Mother Tree of Desire. This series of event is connected to the Tenebrous World's leakage after Alista Tudor's attempt to merge with the Mirrored Original Creator, causing the powers of Sefirot in the Western Continent to leak to the outside world during the War of the Four Emperors. 21 Nobody realized the secret planting of the Tree of Shadow due to the urgency of constructing the city and countering certain underground threats. 22 Fifth Epoch "She" has a direct influence over the Pathways "She" originally owned. With the weakening of the Astral Barrier at the end of the Fourth Epoch, "She" was able to send more power through the barrier onto Earth, increasing "Her" control over Beyonders of the two Pathways, including the Chained God and the Devil Monarch Farbauti. During the beginning of the Fifth Epoch, "She" suddenly appeared and corrupted the Chained God, turning the Rose School of Thought into an evil organization that believes in releasing desires and indiscriminately commit rapes, murders, and sacrifices. 23 "She" has a conflict with the Primordial Moon within the Rose School of Thought, 24 and is believed to possess some High-Sequence Beyonder Characteristics of the Moon. 25 "She" also corrupted the Devil Monarch Farbauti but didn't manage to completely control "Him" like "She" did with the Chained God. Perhaps due to "Her" corruption, the current Abyss fell into a state where most devils were unable to live in. 26 Lord of Mysteries The Mother Tree of Desire was first introduced in Volume 3 when Klein was acting as Admiral Amyrius. Under "Her" guidance, Cynthia, Amyrius' mistress was corrupted by the forces in the Proliferation Necklace and mutated into a tree monster. 27 Klein was later reminded by Orange Light Hilarion to beware of the Mother Tree of Desire. 28 Circle of Inevitability That evil god goes by the pseudonym Mother Tree of Desire in this world. Don’t attempt to understand Her, let alone guess Her true and complete title. Madam Magician to Lumian Lee, Book 2, chapter 142 "She" possesses the authority of the Patriarch. It was revealed that beneath the depths of Trier, the Tree of Shadow had its roots buried long before the construction of present-day Trier. The ambiance in Trier gradually transformed according to the Mother Tree of Desire's desired path. 29 "Her" influence has grown significantly over the past year or two. According to Madam Magician, Mr. Poet noticed some rudimentary cooperation among these organizations which worship the Mother Tree of Desire. Some members of the Devil families also show signs of worshiping "Her". 30 According to Madam Magician, among the Great Existences , the only one who didn't preach using an alias was the Mother Tree of Desire, because " Mother Tree of Desire " was a small segment of the corresponding existence's long string of honorific names. There were two reasons why understanding and reciting it didn't directly bring corruption: First, it was only a small segment, incomplete; second, the Mother Tree of Desire indirectly controlled the one worshiped by the Rose School of Thought in the real world and the Devil Monarch in the Abyss, so when this honorific name was mentioned, under conditions of limited understanding and while the barrier still existed, the proximity-based mystical phenomenon occurred, making it not so dangerous. 31 Project Vortex The Mother Tree of Desire participated in the Vortex by giving the Shadow of the Beauty Goddess "She" possessed to the Mother Goddess of Depravity. In turn, "She" received the corruption inside Roselle Gustav, which was then transplanted into the Chained God. Though Amon managed to reduce the corruption, it was still enough for Tirié to be born, stripping the Chained God of "His" last Abomination Characteristic. The Fool's Dream "She" exerted influence inside Klein's dream by running Mushu Hospital, alongside the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Together, "They" held the various traumas of Klein stored in the hospital basement. "She" heightened the sexual urges of a morgue assistant, making him engage in intercourse with the corpse of Panatiya shortly before it came to life. Lumian theorized "She" was corrupting the security members of the Intis Group due to them being mummified, which matches "Her" aesthetics in the Rose School of Thought. "She" withdrew from the Dream following the scrutiny from the main awareness alongside the Great Mother before the final confrontation between the Celestial Worthy and Klein. The Day of Many Disasters During the event, "She" took advantage of the chaos to attempt to fully grow the Tree of Shadow and descend onto Earth. Suah and Tirié merged with the Tree of Shadow, 32 which was later destroyed by The Fool, leaving only its root. However, before he could eliminate Suah and Tirié, he had to enter the Astral Barrier to prevent it from being broken after the death of the Eternal Blazing Sun. 33 It was revealed later on that this was part of a contract between the Mother Tree of Desire and the Mother Goddess of Depravity, witnessed by the Primordial God Almighty. After accommodating the Brood Hive, the Mother Goddess of Depravity would assist the Mother Tree of Desire, in exchange for the loss of the Tree of Shadow. 34 5 The Apocalypse In the early stage of The Apocalypse, Suah and Tirié conducted a ritual to sacrifice the Chained God to forcibly open a passage in the Astral Barrier with the Mother Goddess of Depravity's aid to allow the Mother Tree of Desire to descend within the barrier. "They" merged into the Chained God, intending to return to the Mother Tree of Desire, but were Fooled and Deceived by Klein, who had become a Lord of Mysteries, to mijudge the timing. Klein then Grafted the mass of Chained materials onto an area above the gray fog. 35 During the battle between Earth's Above the Sequence and the Outer Deities, the Mother Tree of Desire was held off by the Lord of Mysteries Klein, along with the Supernova Dominator and the Goddess of Fate. In another battlefield, the Master of the Shadow Cottage and Farbauti, who had merged with each other and the Tenebrous World to become a Quasi-Father of Devils, lured the Inextinguishable Ravings into "Them" and then cursed "Themselves". Amon, with permission from Klein, used the Chained Uniqueness to establish a mystical connection between the Tenebrous World and the Mother Tree of Desire, severely wounding "Her" through the self-curses of the Tenebrous World. However, the Mother Tree of Desire in turn used the mystical connection to drag "Herself" toward the Tenebrous World's battlefield. With the help of the Mother Goddess of Depravity, "She" managed to shake off Klein's influence and took away the Tenebrous World. "She" then immediately fled into the Astral World, leaving the the Uniqueness of Chained and the Uniqueness of Abyss and corresponding Beyonder Characteristics behind. 6 5 After The Apocalypse, the Mother Tree of Desire would need a long time to fully re-accommodate the Tenebrous World. Due to the fusion and influence of various Dao integrators, the Tenebrous World had developed a new consciousness and spirit. Although both "It" and the integrators fused within "It" had been destroyed by "Their" self-curses, "Its" spirit remained indestructible, chaotic, and extreme. Moreover, the Mother Tree of Desire was still in a severely wounded state, requiring at least decades, if not longer, to fully accommodate the Tenebrous World and completely recover. Furthermore, "She" had also gone into hiding to recover and accommodate in secrecy, preventing interference or being hunted by other Outer Deities, further ruling out any possibility of receiving healing from the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Thus, "She" was unlikely to be a factor in the near term. 36 Trivia If "She" were to reclaim the Tenebrous World and its associated authorities, "She" would become the most powerful Great Old One outside of the Pillars. Furthermore, "She" would still be able to accommodate a non-Pillar Sefirah, gaining power comparable to a Pillar but lacking a corresponding Pillar symbolism. 4 If a Great Old One symbolizing Impotence existed, the Mother Tree of Desire would be able to make "Them" stand up again. 37 Translations Language Name Chinese 欲望母树 Thai พฤกษามาตาแห่งปรารถนา References Book 2, chapter 1171. title: Naturism Sect
summary: Naturism Sect — a secret organization associated with Mother Tree of Desire.
searchText: Naturism Sect Lord of Mysteries · Organizations & Factions Naturism Sect Secret organization associated with Mother Tree of Desire ← Back to Minor Factions & Deity Orders Affiliation record Naturism Sect Type Secret Organization God Worshipped Mother Tree of Desire Source coverage Listed in the Outer Deities affiliation record; no separate profile is available. Background The Naturism Sect is listed among the secret organizations associated with Mother Tree of Desire . The affiliation record states that the Outer Deities who could not establish a single world-spanning faction instead seeded organizations of varying sizes in different regions. It does not give leadership, headquarters, membership, or history for this group, so none is assigned here. Source note: Affiliation from the Outer Deities record and the secret organizations list . Some names come from author WeChat posts and some English renderings are unofficial.

title: Needle and Tube
summary: Needle and Tube, a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact: function, downside, and status.
searchText: Needle and Tube Sealed Artifact · Grade 2 Needle and Tube Grade 2 · No code recorded Overview Needle and Tube is recorded in the archive as a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact. Grade 2 artifacts cover the middle Sequences, roughly Sequence 5 to Sequence 7. It is described as: A combination of a needle, a tube, and a container with mysterious patterns. Function Can draw blood of the user, then transfuse it back later for healing and increased physical attributes. Downside Drawing blood weakens the user for 12 hours. Using it too often will weaken the user permanently. If someone carry it around for more than half an hour, he’ll become a little neurotic. Status No status is recorded in the source table. Source: the Sealed Artifacts archive , from the Lord of the Mysteries wiki . title: Novel Overview
summary: Overview of Lord of the Mysteries by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving. Summaries and guides for all 8 volumes of the novel.
searchText: Novel Overview This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Novel Overview A story of secrets, sacrifice, and impossible ascension Step above the gray fog In a world of steam engines, sealed artifacts, ancient gods, and pathways that promise power at the cost of sanity, one ordinary man wakes inside a dead stranger's life. What begins as survival becomes a journey through hidden history, secret identities, and the terrifying price of becoming more than human. “The fool that doesn't belong to this era; the mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.” Cover: The Mysteries Wiki (Fandom) Introduction Firearms, cannons, battleships, airships, potions, divination, curses, and sealed artifacts: the age of steam is brighter than it looks. Behind every church, newspaper, noble house, and fog-shrouded ritual waits a secret capable of changing the world. Follow Klein Moretti from his first frightened questions to the throne of The Fool, then explore the eight volumes that turn a mystery into a legend. Volume 01 · 213 chapters · Chapters 1–213 Clown June 28 – September 16, 1349 A dead man's identity. A gray fog no one can explain. The first seat at a table of strangers. Klein Moretti wakes in Tingen City and learns that survival means becoming a Beyonder. As a Nighthawk, he follows clues through rituals, nightmares, and church secrets while the first Tarot Club gathering takes shape above the gray fog. Read the Volume 1 guide → Volume 02 · 269 chapters · Chapters 214–482 Faceless September 16, 1349 – New Year 1350 In Backlund, a detective's face is only another kind of mask. Klein becomes Sherlock Moriarty and enters a city where every conspiracy has a respectable front. Between the True Creator, Lanevus, royal ambitions, and the secrets of the Faceless potion, he discovers that identity can be both armor and a weapon. Read the Volume 2 guide → Volume 03 · 250 chapters · Chapters 483–732 Traveler The sea route beyond Backlund The city is behind him. The ocean is full of monsters, pirates, and gods with borrowed names. As Gehrman Sparrow, Klein sails through Bansy Harbor, Bayam, and the Sonia Sea. Every port offers a new bargain: cults, pirates, mermaids, the Sea God Kalvetua, and an adventurer's reputation that becomes harder to separate from the man beneath it. Read the Volume 3 guide → Volume 04 · 214 chapters · Chapters 733–946 Undying Backlund, the Southern Continent, and the Foggy Town A gentleman enters high society carrying a detective's past and an angel's attention. Dwayne Dantès gives Klein access to noble drawing rooms, but wealth cannot hide the war beneath the city. While chasing the Antigonus Family's Notebook , he faces Zaratul, Azik's buried history, and the revenge waiting at the end of Ince Zangwill's trail. Read the Volume 4 guide → Volume 05 · 204 chapters · Chapters 947–1150 Red Priest Backlund's Great Smog and the approaching world war The fog is political, the gods are moving, and every victory reveals a larger battlefield. Klein investigates the Great Smog while Amon's avatars spread through Backlund. His path crosses King George III, Adam, the Evernight Goddess, and the buried truth of Sefirah Castle, transforming a private investigation into a struggle over the shape of history. Read the Volume 5 guide → Volume 06 · 116 chapters · Chapters 1151–1266 Lightseeker The Forsaken Land of the Gods To find a way forward, Klein must walk into a land where even history has been abandoned. Amon's game leads Klein into ancient ruins, lost civilizations, and the truth behind the world he thought he had left. Along the way he hunts Kotar, deepens his bond with Sefirah Castle, and helps the City of Silver search for a future beyond eternal darkness. Read the Volume 6 guide → Volume 07 · 87 chapters · Chapters 1267–1353 The Hanged Man Miracles, wishes, Utopia, and the last preparations A wandering magician grants wishes while quietly building a road toward godhood. As Merlin Hermes, Klein tries to digest his potion through miracles that seem small compared with the coming catastrophe. Utopia, Roselle's final secret, Adam's trap, and Zaratul's last stand pull every thread of his journey tight. Read the Volume 7 guide → Volume 08 · 41 chapters · Chapters 1354–1394 Fool The final step above the gray fog To become The Fool, Klein must gamble with the thing he has spent the whole story protecting: himself. The Celestial Worthy's will awakens as Klein accommodates the Fool Uniqueness and faces Amon inside Sefirah Castle. The final volume is a battle for power, sanity, and identity—and the quiet beginning of the legend that continues into Circle of Inevitability . Read the Volume 8 guide → Home

searchText: Organizations & Factions Lord of Mysteries · World Powers Organizations & Factions Churches, families, secret orders, and major factions across the Epochs Power, worship, and allegiance Explore the divine powers and organizations that shape the world across the Epochs. Use the tabs to explore deities, the Orthodox Churches, Angel Families, the Secret Organizations of the world, detailed major faction profiles, and the religious orders that operate behind the visible world. This is a deity! Mortals cannot fight against deities; same for angels. Those who have yet to become deities will never be able to fathom the power of deities. Roselle On Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 323 I’m already a member of a secret organization. From that moment forth, I’ve taken on a fate that requires me to constantly hide and lie to my friends... Is this the price — one out of many — to be paid? Fors Wall 's thoughts on joining the Tarot Club On Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 337 Deities Orthodox Churches Angel Families Secret Organizations Major Factions Religious Orders Minor Factions & Deity Orders Deities Gods & Outer Deities Definition Gods (神, Shén ) refer to existences that are formed from the convergence of a minimum of one Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics. Any combination of Uniqueness + three Sequence 1 will converge into a God -level existence, rather than a special King of Angels. True Gods (真神, Zhēnshén ) are when the components are from the same or adjacent Pathways. Ancient Gods (古神, Gǔ shén ) are when the components are from non-adjacent Pathways. The degree of madness does not affect the distinction between a True God and an Ancient God. For example, if someone with the four components from the same Pathway forcefully undergoes convergence without the Apotheosis Ritual, if not crazy, "They" are a True God; if crazy, "They" are a True God who lost control. As for other Sequence 2s and below, they also don't affect the definition of a True God or an Ancient God, only the degree of madness. Classification True Gods True Gods are also known as the Sequence 0 in the Pathway System. For a Beyonder to advance to a True God of a Pathway, they have to accommodate the Uniqueness and all three Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics of that Pathway. A True God of one Pathway can further accommodate the Uniquenesses and at least one Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristic of neighboring Pathways to become a Multi-Pathway True God . When a True God accommodates the Sefirah, plus the Uniquenesses and at least one Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristic of all neighboring pathways in the Above the Sequence group, "They" will become a Great Old One. Ancient Gods Main article: Ancient Gods The Ancient Gods are Gods that didn't advance according to the Pathway System, but from direct convergence of characteristics. "They" are defined by characteristic mixing from non-adjacent Pathways, but must follow the general definition of a God , i.e., at a minimum, they must have one Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 characteristics. Both of the following cases are possible: "Their" three Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics come from non-adjacent Pathways. In addition to the Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 characteristics constituting a True God , "They" have other non-adjacent Uniquenesses and Sequence 1 characteristics. For example: An Ancient God can be formed from one Uniqueness and four or five Sequence 1 Characteristics, as long as those four or five Sequence 1s are not from adjacent Pathways. If they have multiple Uniquenesses but don't have three Sequence 1 characteristics, they don't satisfy the definition of an Ancient God . Apotheosis Ritual Apotheosis Ritual (成神仪式, Chéng shén yíshì ) refers to the Sequence 0 Advancement Ritual —the ritual to become a God. Similar to other Advancement Rituals, the function of the ascension ritual is to maintain self-awareness; it is not a prerequisite to achieve a qualitative change through aggregation of Beyonder Characteristics. Even in cases where becoming mad or suffering corruption is inevitable—such as when switching to a Non-Compatible Pathway (like Alista Tudor and Roselle Gustav), or the Demoness ' Apotheosis Ritual that requires contact with the Chaos Sea—performing the Apotheosis Ritual still allows for better self-preservation than forcing the aggregation by directly consuming the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics like the Ancient Gods. If a Sequence 1 only wishes to accommodate the Uniqueness and become a King of Angels, the corresponding Sequence 0 ritual can be simplified and won't be as difficult. However, when "They" attempt to advance to Sequence 0, even if "They" have accommodated the Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics on separate occasions, "They" will still have to hold the full Apotheosis Ritual . For Ancient Gods, the absence of the Apotheosis Ritual is one aspect that led to "Their" cognitive breakdown. Even if "They" performed the Apotheosis Ritual after becoming a God, it wouldn't improve "Their" condition. Authorities and Traits of Gods Moreover, a true god is unique. Clarice On Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 801 All General Powers/Characteristics of Angels, at a higher level. Theoretically, with enough time and proper arrangement, any Sequence 0 can destroy a star. If "They" take enough time, "They" can destroy a Star System. "Their" influence and power can reach the range of a Star System. All "Their" lower abilities can contain godhood and authorities, depending on whether "They" wish them to. Authority Embodiment : Having accommodated the Uniqueness - the manifestation of the authority of a Pathway - "They" become the embodiment of the corresponding Authorities , and have complete control over "Their" Pathway. Pathway Influence : "They" can directly influence Beyonders of the same Pathway, no matter where they are in the world. This includes, but not limited to: Modifying the Sequence abilities within their pathways to some extent. However, adjustments can only be made below the level of Uniqueness. This is the case even if "They" are a Great Old One. Making lower-sequence Beyonders of the same pathway hear murmurings. Directly interfering to increase the chance of losing control when someone consumes a potion to advance. Manifesting imageries in their dreams. Mythical Creature Form Alteration : "They" can change the Mythical Creature Form of "Their" respective pathway, but it would take time. Unique Existence : As the holder of the Uniqueness, Gods and things related to "Them" are Unique . Three-Line Honorific Name : Only Gods or Angels who once accommodated an Uniqueness can use a three-line honorific name. Although their honorific name often won't be limited to three lines, when chanting or praying one could choose only three. Boon Bestowal : Gods can bestow the gift of Beyonder powers to "Their" believers without the need for a potion, however, this is a burden to "Them". It can only be used as a temporary measure. The more people who need a blessing, the greater the burden, it might even affect "Their" state. Those who are bestowed will also suffer disadvantages, such as becoming closer to the corresponding God in mind , body and spirit . Symbolic Influence : "Their" mere presence causes changes to the nearby environment. The changes that take place depend on the symbolism that "They" control. When one accommodates the Uniqueness or becomes a True God , there is a strengthening of related symbolism across at least a planet. Astral World : As the embodiment of "Their" corresponding authorities, "They" can access the Astral World, an abstract plane of authorities and symbolism. "They" can travel through it. "They" can modify and control concepts and symbolism through it. Immortality : At Sequence 0, there is no longer a concept of how many years one can live, and will not experience decay and death through the passage of time. However, a Sequence 0 will still be affected by Decay authorities and age, becoming weak, it is just that they will not die because of it. Size Manipulation : "They" can manipulate their own size. "They" can shrink down to human size and grow up to be as tall as a mountain. Depending on the Pathway, some True Gods can become as large as a star or as small as a point of light. Divine Kingdom : "They" can create "Their" own complete Divine Kingdom , a personal space separated from outside. Depending on their authorities, "They" can change the rules inside and impose them even on other Gods . The maximum size of a Divine Kingdom can cover is that of a star. If a True God is willing, "They" can create a mystical language with specific functions. "They" still need spirituality to use their authorities. Note : Multi-Pathway True Gods Multi-Pathway True God refers to a Sequence 0 that possesses authorities of more than one pathway. To become a Multi-Pathway God , a Sequence 0 of one pathway needs to accommodate the Uniqueness and at least one Sequence 1 characteristic of one or more neighboring pathways. A Dual-Pathway True God is definitely stronger than two Single-Pathway True Gods combined. Assuming no contact with the Sefirot, the number of pathways and authorities a Multi-Pathway True God has does not equate "Their" strength level. "Their" strength also depends on the importance of the authorities, their symbolic significance, and whether they restrain each other, etc. Moreover, since mixing the abilities of Sequence 1 or higher of Pathways belonging to the same Sefirah can manifest the Sefirah's symbolism or power (for example, the combined attack of Lumian Lee and 0-17, or the Demoness' advancement ritual ), if one becomes a Multi-Pathway True God of all Pathways under the Above the Sequence group, "They" will be able to manifest the symbolism and powers of "Their" Sefirah through such combinations. For example, a True God over the three Lord of Mysteries Pathways would be on the same level as a True God over the five God Almighty Pathways. A Multi-Pathway True God must retain all three Sequence 1 characteristics of "Their" own Pathway until "They" become a Great Old One. For example, Amon, after consuming the Door Uniqueness and one Door Sequence 1 characteristic, cannot spit out two Error Sequence 1 characteristic and retain Dual-Pathway Sequence 0 . "Their" degree of control over that Uniqueness is close to that of a True God, "They" just lack the necessary support of the Sequence 1 characteristics to exert full power. In a direct confrontation, "They" could hold "Their" own against a True God (albeit still weaker), and have the possibility of counter kill or successfully escaping afterwards. A Highly- Activated Uniqueness without Sequence 1 characteristics is stronger than a King of Angels who has Accommodated the Uniqueness plus three Sequence 1 characteristics (but without becoming a True God). This is because the King of Angels has to control "Their" Uniqueness and balance the Godhood, thus cannot achieve the level of Activation. Note : This distinction no longer applies at the True God level, i.e., if an Activated Uniqueness becomes a True God, "Their" strength would be no different than that of other True Gods. This is because regardless of the previous state, after the qualitative change from the convergence of the Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 characteristics, the True God's Uniqueness becomes completely Activated . Dao Integrators Main article: Dao Integrators Dao Integrators can utilize the power of "Their" corresponding Sefirah at varying degrees, depending on "Their" states: In "Their" usual state, "They" have status and power approaching that of Sequence 0, slightly weaker. When going all out, "They" are at Sequence 0's level. When burning and desperately risking "Their" life to merge with the Sefirah, "They" could briefly reach the strongest tier of Half Great Old One. Flesh and Blood Pirates Church of the Fool (Temperance Faction) History The Rose School of Thought 's origins can be traced back to before the Fourth Epoch, boasting a history stretching back over two millennia, all the way before the Cataclysm back to the time of Mutated King Kvastir in the Second Epoch. Early in the Fifth Epoch, after the perishing of Death, there was resistance stirring against the Balam Empire in places like the Star Highlands and Paz Valley. During this process, the Chained God appeared, and the Rose School of Thought was born. Before the invasion of the Northern Continent, the Rose School of Thought was an orthodox organization in the Southern Continent, alongside the Church of Death. It ruled the Paz Valley and Star Highlands, where the government and the church were one. The organization has always been focused on the Chained Pathway . The original belief was about temperance, until the Mother Tree of Desire corrupted the Chained God. The organization slowly transformed into believing in releasing and indulging in desires. In the beginning, the Indulgence Faction and the Temperance Faction barely tolerated each other. But later, the Indulgence Faction started claiming that the Chained God, whom both factions believe in, is actually the embodiment of the Mother Tree of Desire . After Suah was born in the year 428 of the Fifth Epoch, the belief in releasing desires and bloody sacrifices became dominant in the organization. When the invasion by the Northern Continent's countries occurred, they lost their country and went underground, becoming clandestine. On the one hand, they resisted the colonists and attempted to expel them from the Southern Continent. On the other hand, they frequently caused terrorist acts in the Northern Continent. This actually had no effect on their resistance to colonization. Instead, it incurred the hatred of the people of various countries. After Suah successfully advanced to become a true Abomination , an internal war began. The Indulgence Faction launched a surprise attack on the Temperance Faction and inflicted severe injuries. The remaining members of Temperance Faction , such as Reinette Tinekerr , Sharron and Maric , fled in a sorry state and were hunted down for a long time until they joined the Church of the Fool. The Indulgence Faction has fully transformed the Rose School of Thought to their belief towards the Mother Tree of Desire . If it weren't for The Fool's protection, the Temperance Faction members would have more or less been influenced by the Mother Tree of Desire in the past 1356-1358. Factions Indulgence Faction The Indulgence Faction believes in the Mother Tree of Desire . After the internal war broke out and the Temperance Faction was defeated and had to flee, they became the main faction of the Rose School of Thought , and transformed the rest of the organization towards Indulgence ideologies. Temperance Faction The Temperance Faction believed in Temperance of desires, and originally believed in the Chained God. They believe that "Temperance is not about perpetual suppression; it is about rationally understanding oneself and preparing for an explosive moment when it truly matters". After being defeated by the Indulgence Faction and were forced to flee away, they eventually became part the Church of the Fool. They introduce themselves as "the Temperance Faction of the Rose School of Thought under the Church of the Fool", and maintained that they are the true orthodox branch of the Rose School of Thought while viewing the Indulgence Faction as traitors who should change their organization's name. Primordial Moon Faction The Primordial Moon Faction were originally a branch of the Life School of Thought from the Moon Pathway . Later, guided by the Primordial Moon, they defected from the Life School of Thought and joined the Indulgence Faction , becoming the Primordial Moon Faction . The Primordial Moon Faction also includes other believers of the Primordial Moon—such as Klarman—who had received the blessings of the Primordial Moon, and later on received a revelation to join the Rose School of Thought . Klarman sometimes believed that the Mother Tree of Desire and the Primordial Moon were different sides of the same great existence, but other times, he felt that "They" were not only different, but there was also a deep conflict between "Them". This resulted in the Primordial Moon believers not getting enough attention when they later joined the Rose School of Thought . Apart from receiving some bestowments in the form of items, they were only placed in noncritical positions. Devil Faction According to Leonard Mitchell , he has observed some rudimentary cooperation among the Mother Tree of Desire 's organizations over the past year or two, with even some members of the Devil Families becoming involved with the Indulgence Faction . From the series of events involving Hisoka and the Dream Festival, Lumian Lee suspected that there was also a Devil Faction within the Rose School of Thought . Philosophy The Rose School of Thought was believes in the Chained God, and they believe that magic is a science and art that changes according to one's will to change things. This requires the establishment of a religious ritual system, including law and order. At the same time, they believe that their wills originated from various desires. Combined with Beyonder powers, they were able to accomplish all sorts of unimaginable things. Because of these ideas, they retained an ancient and bloody tradition of primitive sacrifice including the skinning of people and using the skulls of children as ritual objects, letting a large number of believers fervently release all sorts of desires. The Rose School of Thought has held different beliefs for ages. Their core principle revolves around the notion that willpower is born from diverse desires, capable of reshaping reality and achieving incredible feats. Yet, there's a divide in how they approach these desires. Some adhere to indulgence, embracing passionate cravings at all times, even resorting to bloody or primitive sacrificial rituals to bolster their willpower. On the other hand, the temperance faction, working from the potions' names, advocates for suppressing desires, keeping them pent up within their hearts, only unleashing them during critical moments to unleash formidable forces. Characteristics Their main sphere of influence is the Southern Continent. They are known for promoting unrestrained desires and bloody rituals. According to Mr. Poet's experience, while the organizations exhibit clear purpose, decisiveness, accurate foresight, and excellent planning at a high level, they often appear chaotic, disorderly, and even mad in specific events. This reflects the nature of the evil god itself. In simpler terms, these organizations don't cooperate or communicate well, often acting erratically and unpredictably. According to Klein's conjecture, the Rose School of Thought has about the same number of demigods as the Aurora Order: the number of Saints number around 5, and the number of Angels and Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts number around 2 to 3. However, compared to other secret organizations, its structure and relationships are still relatively loose. In Year 1352, after Klein became a King of Angels, he destroyed and killed The President inside their headquarter, the Garden of Eden. Klein suspected the Psychology Alchemists might appear again in the future, no longer as a shadow of the Twilight Hermit Order, but under the control of Hermes. Characteristics They believe that a person's consciousness is an island, and the subconscious is the portion of the sea beneath the island. The collective subconscious is the surrounding sea. The sky belongs to the Spirit World. Further information: Mind World Headquarters Their headquarters is at a city inside the Sea of Collective Consciousness in everyone's mind. This city is called the Garden of Eden. The city can be accessed from everywhere in human society as long as there are two people around, excluding the one who wants to enter. Members of the council can enter the city as long as they bring their persona mask with them. Notable Members Councillors There are eight members of the council at any one time. Seven of them hold a persona mask corresponding to the Seven Deadly Sins as codename, while the last one is The President overlooking everything. Every councillor is responsible for a city and the surrounding area. They do not have any councillors in the Fog Sea, the Berserk Sea, the Sonia Sea, and the Southern Continent. The Church of the Evernight Goddess is at odds with the Church of the God of Combat from the Feysac Empire. — Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 144 The enmity between Orthodox Churches is driven by the Above the Sequence in-group rivalry. As the fall of all adjacent pathways' gods is necessary for the rise of a Great Old One, every god in a group sees the other as a enemy. In the Loen Kingdom that featured polytheism, the principle of jurisdiction over Beyonder events was first to divide them according to the beliefs of the victims. If they involved the followers of multiple deities, then it would be decided according to who held jurisdiction over the area. Church Enforcement Division (Beyonder Team) Evernight Nighthawks and Red Gloves Earth Fertility Order Combat Unknown Storms Mandated Punishers Sun Inquisition Knowledge Unknown Steam Machinery Hivemind Fool Unknown Gender Roles Perspectives The Church of the Earth Mother is like the Church of the Evernight Goddess. They believe that women should have the same standing in society as men. However, they place more emphasis on reproduction, treating it as the holiest matter. The Church of the Lord of Storms and the Church of the God of Combat are the most biased towards men. The Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun is next but they have high-ranking women, and at least one female Angel. The Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom is different from the other Churches. They discriminate based on intelligence. The Church of the God of Steam and Machinery is neutral and has even worked with the Church of the Evernight Goddess to encourage women to head out for work due to the need for more labor in the development of industry. Powers The Seven Orthodox Churches formed a uniform naming convention for Sealed Artifacts. They will exchange information regarding Grade 0 and Grade 1, telling each other which ones they possess. Therefore, Grade 0 and Grade 1 code names won’t be repeated. Grade 2 and Grade 3 are arranged by their respective churches, so different churches might have the same code name. Grade 0 correspond to Angels level, Grade 1 to Saints, Grade 2 to Mid-Sequences and Grade 3 to Low-Sequences. According to Alger, the Orthodox Churches own 5 to 8 Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, and there are fewer than 4 grounded Angels in each church. When it comes to Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts and Saints (especially the latter), the orthodox Churches has no advantage in numbers when compared to the Church of the Fool in the year 1352 of the Fifth Epoch, which has the following forces: City of Silver: A Sequence 3 saint, three Sequence 4 saints, and nearly ten Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, as well as a few demigod Beyonder characteristics that can temporarily be used as Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts. Moon City: Three demigods, five Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts. All of them combined was equivalent to a quarter of the Church of Storms. In particular, after an all-out war, with the brass increasing the number of Saints by nurturing them, the Church of Storms has around 20 Saints. title: Outer Deities & Corruption

searchText: Outer Deities & Corruption Cosmic corruption index Outer Deities & Corruption The entities beyond the standard pathways—and the ways their Boons, symbols, and authorities corrupt the world. Outer Deities are entities from outside the Earth barrier who corrupt the world through Boons, prayer, contaminated knowledge, symbolic influence, and replacement of natural laws. Many established organizations worshipping them operate in secrecy. Mother Goddess of Depravity Chaos Primogenitor Pathway Represents Evil and Corruption, including exploitation of life and distortion of living systems. Can impose weakening effects and fix mystical connections, spirits, or consciousness in place. Authority over Reproduction and Propagation; can create/transmute life in corruptive ways. Manipulates blood and performs heretical magic combining floral/alchemical forces. Related Organizations: Holy Mother Order , Mother Five-Grains , Sole Spirit Society , The Great Mother , Nightstalkers, Tree God Sect , School of God's Descent, School of Existence Read the Chaos Primogenitor guide → Mother Tree of Desire Patriarch Pathway Manipulates desires in the hearts of creatures, inducing twisted impulses. Awakens survival instincts and can spread desire across regions. Associated with vines, flesh, and corruptive growth. Focuses on reproduction, indulgence, and binding through desire. Related Organizations: Bliss Society , Tree Worship Sect , Order of the Non-Self , Hall of Honor , Sole Love Society , Knowledge Seekers , Naturism Sect Read the Patriarch guide → Uncertain Mist Chaos Mist Pathway Embodies uncertainty, deception, and transformation of reality. title: Paragon Pathway
summary: Paragon Pathway: The Paragon Pathway specializes in natural-world knowledge and item-crafting, combining scientific, historical, and mechanical expertise
searchText: Paragon Pathway Demon of Knowledge · Standard Pathway Paragon Pathway Sequence 9: Savant → Sequence 0: Paragon The Paragon Pathway specializes in natural-world knowledge and item-crafting, combining scientific, historical, and mechanical expertise with the creation and safe use of powerful Beyonder weapons and sealed items. At high sequences, it can animate creations, disintegrate structures, extract environmental information, alter physical principles, perceive essences, and advance civilization through technology. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Paragon Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Savant Knowledge of mysticism and mechanics plus perfect recall, improved learning, and comprehension. 8 Archaeologist Enhanced physique, limited ritualistic magic, and strengthened knowledge of history, survival, ruins, taboos, and mysticism. 7 Appraiser Rapidly appraises most Beyonder items’ powers and problems without divination, reducing danger during use. 6 Artisan Manufactures Beyonder items, mechanical artifacts, Sealed Artifacts, and temporary enchanted weapons from characteristics and spirituality. 5 Astronomer Uses astronomical phenomena or false constellations, firing starlight curses and altering gravity through blessings. 4 Alchemist Creates soul-infused life and temporary dolls or objects; enhanced manufacturing supports mechanical bodies and devices. 3 Arcane Scholar Transforms into knowledge, extracts environmental information, manipulates surroundings, absorbs life force, and disintegrates structures. 2 Knowledge Magister Creates imagined wonders, alters physical principles, analyzes essences, teaches or tests others, and learns instantly. 1 Illuminator Wields Civilization and Education authorities to restore structures, influence targets, create cultural effects, and enlighten. 0 Paragon Holds reality-leaning authority over discovered knowledge, civilization, physical principles, education, learning, manufacturing, and analysis. Pathway themes & abilities Its core themes are knowledge, memory, craftsmanship, appraisal, ritualistic magic, manufacturing, artificial life, technology, disintegration, physics/principles, and essence analysis. The pathway emphasizes scientific learning and reasoning without the high-spirituality dangers or disaster attraction associated with some other pathways; its high-end authority centers on reality-leaning information, civilization, education, learning, manufacturing, and analysis. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Alchemist: Creates soul-infused life and temporary dolls or objects; enhanced manufacturing supports mechanical bodies and devices. Sequence 3 — Arcane Scholar: Transforms into knowledge, extracts environmental information, manipulates surroundings, absorbs life force, and disintegrates structures. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Knowledge Magister: Creates imagined wonders, alters physical principles, analyzes essences, teaches or tests others, and learns instantly. Sequence 1 — Illuminator: Wields Civilization and Education authorities to restore structures, influence targets, create cultural effects, and enlighten. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Paragon: Holds reality-leaning authority over discovered knowledge, civilization, physical principles, education, learning, manufacturing, and analysis. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Roselle Gustav began as a Savant (the Paragon pathway’s earlier name) after the Church of Craftsmanship gave him two pathway options, and he chose Savant; his inventions, including the steam engine and improved sailboats, helped launch Intis’s industrial revolution. The church’s god then ordered the church’s renaming to God of Steam and Machinery, linking Paragon’s technological role to a major institution. Their relationship later soured: Roselle suspected the god sought to control him through his son Bornova, and the church joined Roselle’s eventual assassination. Much later, Bernadette tried to save her corrupted father; during Project Vortex, Roselle intervened against the Uncertain Mist and perished, with resurrection deferred for a century Story connections A pathway reshapes a church: Roselle’s Savant inventions fueled Intis’s industrial turn, and the deity’s name changed from God of Craftsmanship to God of Steam and Machinery Innovation turns into political and religious conflict: Roselle suspected the Steam god was using Bornova to control him; later, the church joined the forces that assassinated Roselle Father and daughter amid cosmic danger (major spoiler): Bernadette searched for a way to save Roselle. In Project Vortex, he acted against the Uncertain Mist , died in the process, and was set to resurrect after a century Figures to know Roselle Gustav Paragon/Savant Beyonder, inventor and ruler of Intis; his industrial reforms, pathway switch, assassination plan, and later sacrifice connect these events God of Steam and Machinery the deity whose church controls the Paragon pathway and whose name and public standing changed after Roselle’s industrial revolution Bernadette Gustav Roselle’s daughter; she pursued answers about his fate and participated in the attempt to address his corruption Bornova Gustav Roselle’s son, whom Roselle suspected the Steam god was using to influence him Major story spoilers. title: Patriarch Pathway
summary: The Patriarch pathway, also called the Actor or Desires pathway, combines desire with blathering, madness, and propagation. It satisfies the Beyonder’s own
searchText: Patriarch Pathway Non-Standard Pathway · Mother Tree of Desire Patriarch Pathway Outer Deity: Mother Tree of Desire · Boon advancement The Patriarch pathway, also called the Actor or Desires pathway, combines desire with blathering, madness, and propagation. It satisfies the Beyonder’s own desires while imposing twisted desires on others through acting, dreams, influence, and life-draining techniques. Advancement on Earth comes through Boons granted by the Mother Tree of Desire . Non-standard pathway lore and Outer Deity corruption details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Patriarch Pathway ingredient archive → High-level abilities The pathway’s upper abilities are inseparable from the corruption of its Outer Deity. These powers are expressed through Boons, mystical influence, and the gradual replacement of ordinary cause-and-effect with the pathway’s domain. Manipulates desires in the hearts of creatures and can induce twisted impulses in other people. Awakens survival instincts across a region, even affecting powerful beings and destabilizing their judgment. Spreads corruption through dreams, acting, environmental influence, and the mutation of living bodies. Its Outer Deity corrupted the Chained God and the Dark Side of the Universe, turning desire into an engine of indiscriminate violence, sacrifice, and biological transformation. Corruption from Mother Tree of Desire The Mother Tree of Desire is the pathway’s Outer Deity and primary source of Boons. Corruption can appear as physical mutation, mental contamination, altered fate, environmental collapse, or the rewriting of reality, depending on the pathway’s authority. Known corruptive effects Manipulates desires in the hearts of creatures and can induce twisted impulses in other people. title: Primordial Hunger
summary: The Primordial Hunger is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth.
searchText: Primordial Hunger Outer Deity Primordial Hunger Overview The Primordial Hunger symbolized the instinct of Convergence. Klein Moretti, Book 2, chapter 1164 The Primordial Hunger is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. "He" is the current owner of the Tail-Devourer Pathway, with it being the only Pathway under "Him" as the very idea of division was Devoured by "Him". 1 . Honorific Name Primordial Hunger; The Symbol of Devouring; An Insatiable Convergence; The Cleanser of All Things (原初的饥饿， 吞噬的象征， 永不满足的聚合， 万物的清扫者) Symbols, Authorities & Abilities "He" possesses full Authority over the Tail-Devourer and the corresponding Symbols , which include but are not limited to the following: Tail-Devourer: Authorities over Devouring , Convergence , and Hunger . And the Symbols of Devouring and Convergence . 2 Book 2, chapter 1164 The Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities "He" possesses and displays at the Above the Sequence level include: Primordium and Chaos : "He" is both the Primordial Hunger and the Chaos Gastric Juices . The Primordial Hunger would not miss any opportunities related to Chaos or Primordial qualities. 5 Among the Sefirot, "His" objectives include the City of Calamity, and the Chaos Sea with the the Uniqueness of Hanged Man and others. Among the Outer Deities, "He" preferred the Uncertain Mist the most, 6 because "He" is the Chaos Gastric Juices, while the Uncertain Mist is a part of the Son of Chaos. 7 '''Convergence ( Jùhé) : "He" symbolized the instinct of Convergence'''. 2 "He" could forcibly pull other's true bodies to "His" side. 2 Because of "His" authority over Convergence , even if "He" lacks the explicit ability to Devour and Digest , the Tail-Devourer can still influence Fate to some extent. 1 Author's WeChat post ph Since "He" acts primarily on instinct, 8 the Lord of Mysteries' symbolism of Foolishness will have little effect on "Him". However, Deceit will have an effect on "Him". "His" instinct for Convergence and desired targets can be exploited. 9 '''Devour ( Tūnshì) : "He" can Devour''' everything, including things such as black holes. 10 "His" domain is not merely eating and Devouring ; it also governs Digestion , Utilization , and Erasure . Unlike Concealment —which simply hides and can later be recovered—this power leaves nothing behind. 1 If "He" Devoured an Avatar or Marionette , "He" could absorb and erase the corresponding abilities, reducing or even temporarily nullifying their symbolic influence. 2 "He" can Devour the Ravings within "His" own mind when affected by the Inextinguishable Ravings. 3 Book 2, chapter 1167 If the Primordial Hunger Devoured certain entities, the following will happen: Chaos Primogenitor: This would cause an aggressive Convergence to occur, causing the return of the Original Creator. 11 Paragon: Since the Paragon is the Embodiment of Essence , all atoms in the cosmos would become Hungry' and would converge, triggering continuous nuclear fusion everywhere, leading to the universe's living environment becoming extremely hostile to life. 12 Pathways or Sefirot related to mind/spirit, like Visionary or Inextinguishable Ravings: "He" would develop the ability to Devour others' minds, but would not become smarter. 13 Countering Symbols, Authorities & Abilities Certain Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities of other Great Old Ones can counter some of "His" powers, which include but are not limited to the following: Calamity of Destruction: Disaster of Origin counters Devouring . When biting through the Chaos Vortex produced by the Calamity of Destruction, the Primordial Hunger cannot Devour the corresponding abilities and authorities due to the symbolism of Disaster of Origin . 14 God Almighty: Envisioning counters Devouring . When Devouring the God Almighty's Envisioned Illusions , "He" cannot Devour the corresponding abilities and authorities. 3 Appearance True Form : A dark vortex revealing bared white teeth and chaotic liquid encompassing all colors. "His" exterior no longer featured elongated black shadows with different heads, as they seemed to have been consumed by "Himself" long ago. 15 Personality Out of all the Outer Deities known, "He" is the most primitive and vulnerable to "His" desires of Convergence , having Devoured "His" rationality and only leaving the most basic sense of self-preservation. Background According to the Seven Lights, ever since the Oldest One awakened and split apart, the most powerful Outer Deities in the entire universe, including the Primordial Hunger, gathered around this tiny solar system. Some of "Them" wish to retrieve "Their" Sefirot and Beyonder Characteristics that had been ripped from "Them" and were attracted here. Some have the hope of getting neighboring Sefirot and high-level Beyonder Characteristics which "They" can accommodate. 16 The Primordial Hunger would not miss any opportunities related to chaos or primordial qualities. "His" objective appeared to be consuming the City of Calamity, ingesting but not digesting the Chaos Sea, and absorbing the Uniquenesses of the Hanged Man and others. However, Klein suspected that the Primordial Hunger might lose control over "His" convergence instinct and directly swallow the Chaos Sea. 2 Book 2, chapter 1164 The Primordial Hunger can Devour any Outer Deities, but "He" preferred to Devour the Uncertain Mist the most, 17 because "He" is the Chaos Gastric Juices, while the Uncertain Mist is a part of the Son of Chaos. 18 History "His" subordinate Angel, Ludwig Phil, was captured and sealed by the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. The organization that follows the Primordial Hunger, the School of Deliciousness, tried to reclaim Ludwig during Project Vortex. 19 The corruption on the Box of the Great Old Ones was revealed to originate from "Him". It was fed to Ludwig Phil by Lumian Lee, which allowed "Him" to advance and recover to Sequence 1 Chaos Gastric Juices. During The Apocalypse, "He" was held off by Adam for the duration of the fight and was forced to withdraw after being dealt a critical blow by Lumian Lee. title: Psychology Alchemists
summary: Detailed history, philosophy, pathways, members, and organizational information for the Psychology Alchemists..
searchText: Psychology Alchemists Lord of Mysteries · Organizations & Factions Psychology Alchemists Detailed history, philosophy, pathways, members, and organizational information for the Psychology Alchemists. ← Back to Organizations & Factions archive Psychology Alchemists Chinese 心理炼金会 General Information Description Members Status Active Type Secret Founded Newly Founded God Worshipped Ancient Sun God (Former) Founder Psychology Seminar Participants Leader Hermes Pauli Derlau Influence Pathway(s) Visionary Domain(s) Loen Kingdom, Intis Republic, Feynapotter Kingdom, Feysac Empire, Lenburg Headquarters Garden of Eden Related Group(s) Twilight Hermit Order History The original Psychology Alchemists was just a seminar for enthusiasts who all believed that the mind has limitless power and infinite wonders. Later on, this seminar obtained a treasure map and found the relics left behind by Hermes. The information he left behind shows that mind dragons have advanced far into this field and have achieved the same level of achievement as deities. Those materials laid the foundation and direction for the research of the Psychology Alchemists . The discovery of the ruins marked the establishment of the organization. The members at the beginning wanted to maintain a state of pure academic discussion, but they would always need help when encountering matters. Similarly, they lacked items and research materials. That’s why the Psychology Alchemists slowly became systematic and transformed into a real secret organization. However, compared to other secret organizations, its structure and relationships are still relatively loose. In Year 1352, after Klein became a King of Angels, he destroyed and killed The President inside their headquarter, the Garden of Eden. Klein suspected the Psychology Alchemists might appear again in the future, no longer as a shadow of the Twilight Hermit Order, but under the control of Hermes. Characteristics They believe that a person's consciousness is an island, and the subconscious is the portion of the sea beneath the island. The collective subconscious is the surrounding sea. The sky belongs to the Spirit World. Further information: Mind World Headquarters Their headquarters is at a city inside the Sea of Collective Consciousness in everyone's mind. This city is called the Garden of Eden. The city can be accessed from everywhere in human society as long as there are two people around, excluding the one who wants to enter. Members of the council can enter the city as long as they bring their persona mask with them. Notable Members Councillors There are eight members of the council at any one time. Seven of them hold a persona mask corresponding to the Seven Deadly Sins as codename, while the last one is The President overlooking everything. Every councillor is responsible for a city and the surrounding area. They do not have any councillors in the Fog Sea, the Berserk Sea, the Sonia Sea, and the Southern Continent. title: Red Priest Pathway
summary: Red Priest Pathway: The Red Priest Pathway centers on war-related abilities: fire, traps, enhanced physical ability, weakness-finding, conspiracy, and
searchText: Red Priest Pathway Calamity of Destruction · Standard Pathway Red Priest Pathway Sequence 9: Hunter → Sequence 0: Red Priest The Red Priest Pathway centers on war-related abilities: fire, traps, enhanced physical ability, weakness-finding, conspiracy, and provocation. At high Sequences it expands into weather control, steel-like flame manipulation, army coordination, conquest, and the authorities of War and Destruction; its Above the Sequence is Calamity of Destruction and its Sefirah is the City of Calamity. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Red Priest Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Hunter Enhances physical ability and grants wilderness-survival, hunting, spatial perception, explosives, and trap-setting knowledge. 8 Provoker Uses tailored provocation and humiliation to incite irrational decisions, conflict, or temporary loss of control. 7 Pyromaniac Controls and conjures flames for fireballs, armor, weapons, delayed explosions, fire spells, and spirit-body burning. 6 Conspirer Sharpens insight and senses; incites desires, engineers deception and misdirection, and travels by merging with fire. 5 Reaper Discerns vulnerabilities, infuses attacks to cull vital points, precisely splits fire spells, and accelerates through flames. 4 Iron-blooded Knight Weaponizes ordinary objects, links and shares with troops, concentrates or spreads damage, and galvanizes body and flames into steel. 3 War Bishop Boosts allies and weakens enemies through war songs, creates Fog of War, gathers army power, and invokes sacrifices. 2 Weather Warlock Controls regional weather, gathers strength across a team, weaponizes materials, and travels as fast flame or meteor. 1 Conqueror Subjugates targets, turns objects into soldiers, shares rank and abilities, gathers massed power, and commands vast temporary teams. 0 Red Priest Commands War, Conquest, Destruction, Sacrifices, and planetary-scale team power-sharing, including calamity, flame, and weakness-locking authorities. Pathway themes & abilities Its progression moves from hunting, survival, traps, and provocation into pyrokinesis, conspiracy, precision attacks against weaknesses, weaponizing, command-and-control, weather manipulation, conquest, and large-scale destruction. The pathway also has a masculine symbolism tied to the Original Creator and shares a high-sequence group with the Demoness Pathway . Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Iron-blooded Knight: Weaponizes ordinary objects, links and shares with troops, concentrates or spreads damage, and galvanizes body and flames into steel. Sequence 3 — War Bishop: Boosts allies and weakens enemies through war songs, creates Fog of War, gathers army power, and invokes sacrifices. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Weather Warlock: Controls regional weather, gathers strength across a team, weaponizes materials, and travels as fast flame or meteor. Sequence 1 — Conqueror: Subjugates targets, turns objects into soldiers, shares rank and abilities, gathers massed power, and commands vast temporary teams. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Red Priest: Commands War, Conquest, Destruction, Sacrifices, and planetary-scale team power-sharing, including calamity, flame, and weakness-locking authorities. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances The Red Priest pathway is framed as War and Destruction, and its story history becomes a dynastic power struggle as much as a supernatural one. Medici, an innate mythical creature and one of the Ancient Sun God’s eight Kings of Angels, accommodated the pathway’s Uniqueness and led the Red of War Army; Alista Tudor later killed Medici, Sauron, and Einhorn to become Red Priest, fracturing the Tudor–Trunsoest United Empire. In Circle of Inevitability , the Red Priest-dominated Iron and Blood Cross Order seeks the Blood Emperor’s legacy, while Medici manipulates it to find Vermonda Sauron in Fourth Epoch Trier Story connections Fourth Epoch succession and empire collapse: Alista’s alliance with Adam and Amon traps the three apex Red Priest angels; his ascension to Red Priest coincides with the breakup of the Tudor–Trunsoest United Empire The Red Angel’s return: Medici’s death leaves his spirit fused with those of Sauron and Einhorn. As the Red Angel Evil Spirit, he later possesses Ince Zangwill and pursues his own agenda in Book One Trier legacy plot: In Book Two, the Iron and Blood Cross Order pursues the Blood Emperor’s legacy in Fourth Epoch Trier.
