title: Rose School of Thought
summary: Detailed history, philosophy, pathways, members, and organizational information for the Rose School of Thought..
searchText: Rose School of Thought Lord of Mysteries · Organizations & Factions Rose School of Thought Detailed history, philosophy, pathways, members, and organizational information for the Rose School of Thought. ← Back to Organizations & Factions archive Rose School of Thought Chinese 玫瑰学派 General Information Description Members Status Active, split into several factions Type Secret Founded Fifth Epoch God Worshipped Mother Tree of Desire (Indulgence Faction) Chained God (Former) Primordial Moon (Primordial Moon Faction) The Fool (Temperance Faction) Leader Suah (Indulgence Faction) Reinette Tinekerr (Temperance Faction) Influence Pathway(s) Chained Patriarch Moon Chaos Primogenitor Domain(s) Southern Continent Highlands Kingdom Paz Kingdom Related Group(s) Naturism Sect Bliss Society Tree of Flesh and Blood Pirates Church of the Fool (Temperance Faction) History The Rose School of Thought 's origins can be traced back to before the Fourth Epoch, boasting a history stretching back over two millennia, all the way before the Cataclysm back to the time of Mutated King Kvastir in the Second Epoch. Early in the Fifth Epoch, after the perishing of Death, there was resistance stirring against the Balam Empire in places like the Star Highlands and Paz Valley. During this process, the Chained God appeared, and the Rose School of Thought was born. Before the invasion of the Northern Continent, the Rose School of Thought was an orthodox organization in the Southern Continent, alongside the Church of Death. It ruled the Paz Valley and Star Highlands, where the government and the church were one. The organization has always been focused on the Chained Pathway . The original belief was about temperance, until the Mother Tree of Desire corrupted the Chained God. The organization slowly transformed into believing in releasing and indulging in desires. In the beginning, the Indulgence Faction and the Temperance Faction barely tolerated each other. But later, the Indulgence Faction started claiming that the Chained God, whom both factions believe in, is actually the embodiment of the Mother Tree of Desire . After Suah was born in the year 428 of the Fifth Epoch, the belief in releasing desires and bloody sacrifices became dominant in the organization. When the invasion by the Northern Continent's countries occurred, they lost their country and went underground, becoming clandestine. On the one hand, they resisted the colonists and attempted to expel them from the Southern Continent. On the other hand, they frequently caused terrorist acts in the Northern Continent. This actually had no effect on their resistance to colonization. Instead, it incurred the hatred of the people of various countries. After Suah successfully advanced to become a true Abomination , an internal war began. The Indulgence Faction launched a surprise attack on the Temperance Faction and inflicted severe injuries. The remaining members of Temperance Faction , such as Reinette Tinekerr , Sharron and Maric , fled in a sorry state and were hunted down for a long time until they joined the Church of the Fool. The Indulgence Faction has fully transformed the Rose School of Thought to their belief towards the Mother Tree of Desire . If it weren't for The Fool's protection, the Temperance Faction members would have more or less been influenced by the Mother Tree of Desire in the past 1356-1358. Factions Indulgence Faction The Indulgence Faction believes in the Mother Tree of Desire . After the internal war broke out and the Temperance Faction was defeated and had to flee, they became the main faction of the Rose School of Thought , and transformed the rest of the organization towards Indulgence ideologies. Temperance Faction The Temperance Faction believed in Temperance of desires, and originally believed in the Chained God. They believe that "Temperance is not about perpetual suppression; it is about rationally understanding oneself and preparing for an explosive moment when it truly matters". After being defeated by the Indulgence Faction and were forced to flee away, they eventually became part the Church of the Fool. They introduce themselves as "the Temperance Faction of the Rose School of Thought under the Church of the Fool", and maintained that they are the true orthodox branch of the Rose School of Thought while viewing the Indulgence Faction as traitors who should change their organization's name. Primordial Moon Faction The Primordial Moon Faction were originally a branch of the Life School of Thought from the Moon Pathway . Later, guided by the Primordial Moon, they defected from the Life School of Thought and joined the Indulgence Faction , becoming the Primordial Moon Faction . The Primordial Moon Faction also includes other believers of the Primordial Moon—such as Klarman—who had received the blessings of the Primordial Moon, and later on received a revelation to join the Rose School of Thought . Klarman sometimes believed that the Mother Tree of Desire and the Primordial Moon were different sides of the same great existence, but other times, he felt that "They" were not only different, but there was also a deep conflict between "Them". This resulted in the Primordial Moon believers not getting enough attention when they later joined the Rose School of Thought . Apart from receiving some bestowments in the form of items, they were only placed in noncritical positions. Devil Faction According to Leonard Mitchell , he has observed some rudimentary cooperation among the Mother Tree of Desire 's organizations over the past year or two, with even some members of the Devil Families becoming involved with the Indulgence Faction . From the series of events involving Hisoka and the Dream Festival, Lumian Lee suspected that there was also a Devil Faction within the Rose School of Thought . Philosophy The Rose School of Thought was believes in the Chained God, and they believe that magic is a science and art that changes according to one's will to change things. This requires the establishment of a religious ritual system, including law and order. At the same time, they believe that their wills originated from various desires. Combined with Beyonder powers, they were able to accomplish all sorts of unimaginable things. Because of these ideas, they retained an ancient and bloody tradition of primitive sacrifice including the skinning of people and using the skulls of children as ritual objects, letting a large number of believers fervently release all sorts of desires. The Rose School of Thought has held different beliefs for ages. Their core principle revolves around the notion that willpower is born from diverse desires, capable of reshaping reality and achieving incredible feats. Yet, there's a divide in how they approach these desires. Some adhere to indulgence, embracing passionate cravings at all times, even resorting to bloody or primitive sacrificial rituals to bolster their willpower. On the other hand, the temperance faction, working from the potions' names, advocates for suppressing desires, keeping them pent up within their hearts, only unleashing them during critical moments to unleash formidable forces. Characteristics Their main sphere of influence is the Southern Continent. They are known for promoting unrestrained desires and bloody rituals. According to Mr. Poet's experience, while the organizations exhibit clear purpose, decisiveness, accurate foresight, and excellent planning at a high level, they often appear chaotic, disorderly, and even mad in specific events. This reflects the nature of the evil god itself. In simpler terms, these organizations don't cooperate or communicate well, often acting erratically and unpredictably. According to Klein's conjecture, the Rose School of Thought has about the same number of demigods as the Aurora Order: the number of Saints number around 5, and the number of Angels and Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts number around 2 to 3. title: Sealed Artifacts
summary: Browse Sealed Artifacts by grade with codes, appearances, functions, drawbacks, and status.
searchText: Sealed Artifacts Lord of Mysteries · Mysticism Sealed Artifacts Grades, abilities, drawbacks, and statuses from the artifact archive An archive of dangerous power Sealed Artifacts offer powerful effects at the cost of significant drawbacks. Browse the local records by grade without leaving the archive. Sealed Artifacts are items that offer a wide variety of powerful effects at the cost of a significant drawback. The drawbacks occur because sealed artifacts are in a state of "having lost control." They are either man-made or natural. Their powers often correspond to certain sequence abilities, such as the Blood Vessel Thief 's correspondence to the Error Pathway 's Sequence 6 Prometheus . They often have abilities of the lower sequences too, like the Hand of Horror which has abilities from sequences 7 , 6 and 5 of the Black Emperor Pathway . Although Sealed Artifacts ’ main powers and negative effects mostly adhere to the Sequence traits of the 22 pathways , just like how people have different personalities, each Sealed Artifact is unique. It might be due to fusing with an object, the environment when formed, the possible existence of a High-Level’s aura, or a curse from the original owner; all kinds of strange traits manifest as a result. No one can imagine the different permutations and list them all out. Because they can augment the user with abilities outside of their own sequence, they are very valuable and prized; sometimes sold for exorbitant prices, if at all. However, some negative effects might stack and synergize into something worse, which makes it dangerous to transport several of them. Sealed Artifacts usually come about in one of two ways: as a result of the death of an out of control Beyonder, or through craftsmanship by a Sequence 6 or higher of the Paragon Pathway . A few, like the Biological Poison Bottle , are a result of an experiment gone horribly wrong. In each case, they require a Beyonder Characteristic or the main material of a pathway potion to form; hence all sealed artifacts, if purified or destroyed, will result in the original Beyonder Characteristic or main material. The downside of the sealed artifact could be reduced depending on the sequence level of the Artisan who crafted it, or with the power of a Sequence 4 or higher of the Death Pathway , but there will always be some of downside. When a Beyonder Characteristic combines with the environment to form a Sealed Artifact , the spirituality used to influence the outside world come from the Spirit World and itself. If someone has an affinity with a Saint/Holy Artifact (Sequence 4 or above), it can reduce the negative effects by deceiving it to a certain degree. The so-called affinity is the similarity between one’s psyche and the remnant High-Sequence Beyonders psyche mark on the Sealed Artifact . Many mystical items have rather obvious side effects that can cause certain harm. Therefore, the seven orthodox Churches would seek them out and seal them. They’re called Sealed Artifacts and are distinguished using numbers as code names. title: Second Epoch
summary: A spoiler-marked guide to the Second Epoch of Lord of the Mysteries: the five eras, eight Ancient Gods, the War of the Betrayers, and humanity’s revolt.
searchText: Second Epoch World chronology · major spoilers Second Epoch The Dark Epoch—an age of Ancient Gods, rival civilizations, and humanity’s long struggle for freedom. The Second Epoch is remembered as humanity’s Dark Epoch. Dragons, Giants, Elves, Sanguines, and other Beyonder races rule the world, while humans live as subordinates or slaves. The source chronology divides the epoch into five eras and ends with humanity’s revolt in the Dawn Era. Major spoilers for Lord of the Mysteries and related lore follow. Epoch timeline The year ranges below are local to the Second Epoch and follow the simplified chronology cited by the source article. Each era name links to its corresponding row in the archive’s full world timeline. Second Epoch periods and source chronology Era Epoch years Duration Key transition Sprouting Era 0–1,268 1,268 years Chaos creatures recede as civilizations and Ancient Gods emerge. Early Era of Fire 1,268–1,730 462 years Eight Ancient Gods rule; the world remains in darkness. Dual Era 1,730–1,960 230 years The War of the Betrayers pits Giants against Elves. Era of Tranquility 1,960–2,325 365 years A relative stalemate; humans remain enslaved. Dawn Era 2,325–2,561 236 years Humanity rises; the Pathway system begins to take shape. The five rows retain reserved data-page-target filenames for future era pages. Those planning details stay separate from the visible historical dates. The eight Ancient Gods During the Early Era of Fire, eight Ancient Gods divide the remaining powers and authorities of the Creator. The source describes them as rulers of the sky, land, oceans, Spirit World, Astral World, and the various races. Each has subsidiary gods drawn from the Angel sequences. Giant King Aurmir Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt Elf King Soniathrym Sanguine Ancestor Lilith Devil Monarch Farbauti Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace Mutated King Kvastir King of Demonic Wolves Flegrea Sprouting Era Years 0–1,268 As creatures of chaos dwindle, a more recognizable age of civilizations begins. The Giant King, Elf King, Mutant King, dragons, phoenixes, demonic wolves, sea races, and demons contend for dominance while other Ancient Gods gradually emerge. The source notes that Giants, Elves, Vampires, and Humans are still understood as unified races rather than the later divisions. Early Era of Fire Years 1,268–1,730 · Age of Giants The eight Ancient Gods rule a world divided among competing racial powers. Accounts describe human-like races fighting non-human peoples, devils, and demonic wolves. Human societies become more established, but humans remain beneath the Giants, Elves, and Sanguines. The source also describes a secret struggle and betrayals among the Ancient Gods. It later clarifies that Lilith was not truly dead and secretly took Omebella’s place as Goddess of Harvest. The source explains the name “Dark Epoch” by saying the Supernova Dominator occupied the sun, while the Earth’s Barrier prevented its light from reaching the world. Dual Era Years 1,730–1,960 The First Blasphemy Slate reveals the divine pathways. The source describes humans fracturing under pressure from other races, while Giants and others increasingly regard themselves as divine rather than human. After Lilith, Kvastir, and Flegrea perish in a conspiracy, distrust between the Giants and Elves erupts into the 230-year War of the Betrayers. Dragons and demons intervene, while the forces of Aurmir and Ankewelt become the dominant powers reflected in the era’s name. Era of Tranquility Years 1,960–2,325 Giants, Elves, Dragons, Demons, and Phoenixes reach a stalemate, creating 365 years of relative peace. Enslaved humans lose much of their memory of pre-cataclysm civilization. The source describes younger Giants and Elves beginning to show more emotion during this period. Aurmir’s household works with human secret organizations in an effort against Soniathrym. The source suggests that one of those organizations may have worshipped the Ancient Sun God. Dawn Era Years 2,325–2,561 Public creation myths and City of Silver records describe humanity’s revolt as the work of the gods or of a waking Creator. The source’s account of the underlying history identifies Adam, who called himself God Almighty, as the figure later known as the Ancient Sun God. In Year 2348, he kills the Elf King and Dragon of Imagination. The Giant King and Phoenix Ancestor are severely wounded, while the Devil Monarch sacrifices much of his power to seal the Abyss. Humanity becomes favored by the Omniscient and Omnipotent God and begins studying mysticism. The Pathway system, including potion formulas and rituals, takes shape; Hermes creates the Hermes Language. The source places the Evernight Goddess, Earth Mother, and God of Combat’s Sequence 0 ascensions near the end of this epoch. ↑

searchText: Second Law Pathway Non-Standard Pathway · Monarch of Decay Second Law Pathway Outer Deity: Monarch of Decay · Boon advancement The Second Law, also called the Patient or Decay pathway, combines Decay, Time, and Disease. It spreads pathogens, corrupts people and organizations, accelerates deterioration, and makes death increasingly inevitable. The pathway runs from Sequence 9 Patient to Sequence 0 Second Law and is advanced through Boons from the Monarch of Decay . Non-standard pathway lore and Outer Deity corruption details contain major story spoilers. It spreads pathogens, corrupts people and organizations, accelerates deterioration, and makes death increasingly inevitable. The pathway runs from Sequence 9 Patient to Sequence 0 Second Law and is advanced through Boons from the Monarch of Decay . Paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Complete wiki information Full main-article information imported from the Second Law Pathway wiki article . Existing archive pathway details above are preserved. All things eventually rot. The entropy of the entire universe can only increase—irreversibly. That day, which is bound to come, is also the endpoint of the River of Time. Perhaps the universe too, will be afflicted with diseases, and will ultimately putrefy and die. Cuttlefish That Loves Diving On Cuttlefish's WeChat Post : "The Monarch of Decay Pathway" Overview The Second Law Pathway revolves around using diseases, decay, and pathogens to affect others and bring about inevitable death. It specializes in spreading pathogens and diseases, corrupting others and organizations, using certain death and sure hit attacks, and survivability, excelling at self-division and replication. At High-Sequences, "They" have authorities over Time , Senescence , Disease , Decay , and Entropy . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] This Pathway is one of the new Pathways introduced in Circle of Inevitability . It exists outside the twenty-two Standard Pathways , but is still classified into Sequence 9 to Sequence 0. [ 3 ] On Earth, the Beyonders of this Pathway do not advance through Potions, but by praying to the Outer Deity , the Monarch of Decay , who is the Above the Sequence of this Pathway, for a Boon . The corresponding Sefirah is the Monarch of Decay 's currently unnamed Sefirah . This Pathway is a mix of three different Pathways: [ 2 ] The Pathway of Decay 衰败: Shuāibài : All things eventually rot 朽: Xiǔ , whether they're matters or organisations, all will ultimately corrupt 腐化: Fǔhuà . The Pathway of Time 时光: Shíguāng : Under the merciless erosion of time 时光: Shíguāng , even the most supreme sovereign will head towards their end. When combined with decay 衰败: Shuāibài , it gives rise to Sureness/Certainty 必然: Bìrán . The Pathway of Disease 疾病: Jíbìng : whether intrinsic or infectious, it is disease 疾病: Jíbìng itself, the source of putrefaction 腐烂: Fǔlàn . Pathway Symbol The official symbol of the Second Law Pathway . [ 5 ] Corresponding Ingredients Browse the local Second Law Pathway ingredient archive → Unknown Mythical Creature Form A colossal, highly decomposed body composed of countless pathogens, often appearing swollen and blackish-blue, oozing yellowish-green pus. [ 2 ] Time Giant "They" seem composed of water-coloured time, "Their" massive forms slowing everything around "Them". [ 6 ] God of Decay "They" are hunched, ancient to the point of decrepitude, with loose, wrinkled skin blotched with decay. Aside from "Their" mountainous size, "They" appear unremarkable. [ 6 ] Neighboring and Compatible Pathways Compatible Pathways to the Second Law Pathway include, but might not be limited to, the following: Pathways under the Calamity of Destruction : Demoness Red Priest Pathways under the Eternal Darkness : Darkness Death Twilight Giant Pathways under the Circle of Inevitability : Eternal Aeon Pathways under the High-Dimensional Overseer : Sublunary Eye Pathways under the Primordial Hunger : Tail-Devourer High-level abilities The pathway’s upper abilities are inseparable from the corruption of its Outer Deity. These powers are expressed through Boons, mystical influence, and the gradual replacement of ordinary cause-and-effect with the pathway’s domain. Causes planets, ecosystems, and living beings to decay, rot to death, or transform into loyal and disgusting creatures. Destabilizes the internal balance of powerful beings and makes failure, collapse, and corruption increasingly likely. Drags a region’s time toward its conclusion, slowing surrounding events while hastening the approach of an endpoint. Uses Certain Death and Sure Hit symbolism to make fatal attacks or unavoidable decay into supernatural certainties. Corruption from Monarch of Decay The Monarch of Decay is the pathway’s Outer Deity and primary source of Boons. Corruption can appear as physical mutation, mental contamination, altered fate, environmental collapse, or the rewriting of reality, depending on the pathway’s authority. searchText: Secret Order Lord of Mysteries · Organizations & Factions Secret Order Detailed history, philosophy, pathways, members, and organizational information for the Secret Order. Image Primary image from the Lord of Mysteries Wiki ↗ ← Back to Organizations & Factions archive Secret Order Chinese 密修会 General Information Description Members Status Destroyed (Most Members Killed) Type Secret Founded Fourth Epoch God Worshipped None Founder Zaratul Family Leader Zaratul Influence Pathway(s) Fool Domain(s) Intis Republic Castle Dylan, Orville (Former) Related Group(s) Zaratul Family Bureau 8 First Appearance Novel Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 28 Donghua Episode 3 History The Secret Order is one of the most secretive organizations around. What is known is that their founder, Zaratul, botched the advancement into a Sequence 1 Beyonder and turned into a monster. Although they rarely take direct action, the organization appears to be actively searching for relics of the Antigonus Family, an Angel Family that once held control over the Fool Pathway . They previously possessed the Antigonus Family's Notebook , but it was accidentally sold by Regence. The Secret Order later dispatched members to retrieve it. Following Zaratul's escape from the Foggy Town into the real world, Lucca Brewster received some intel that there has been some reshuffling among the Secret Order in Intis. Characteristics Their goals and philosophy are unknown. The Secret Order has deep connections to the Intis Republic. They form Bureau 8 , which is a branch of the Intis Intelligence Department.

Fors Wall 's thoughts on joining the Tarot Club On Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 337 There are many powerful Secret Organizations hiding in the shadows of the world. Most, if not all, of them mainly comprise of Beyonders. This page categorizes secret organizations based on the time of their founding. In the Fifth Epoch, knowledge of the supernatural is kept from the masses, with the majority going their entire lives without meeting a single Beyonder. For many of these Beyonders, in turn, the truly powerful secret organizations are veiled in secrecy and mystery. Secret organizations are of various types. Some are remnants of the Angel Families of the Fourth Epoch, some believers of the Outer Deities or other hidden existences. Others exist with their own goals and agendas. Some of these organizations, such as the Twilight Hermit Order and the Tarot Club, wield power and authority rivalling that of the Orthodox Organizatons and the Royal Families. title: Sublunary Eye Pathway
summary: The Sublunary Eye, also called the Painter or Pixie pathway, centers on territory creation, true sight, painting, imagination, reality, and dimensional man
searchText: Sublunary Eye Pathway Non-Standard Pathway · High-Dimensional Overseer Sublunary Eye Pathway Outer Deity: High-Dimensional Overseer · Boon advancement The Sublunary Eye, also called the Painter or Pixie pathway, centers on territory creation, true sight, painting, imagination, reality, and dimensional manipulation. Its users create mystical paintings and worlds, materialize fiction, manipulate strings, and alter the dimensionality of targets. The High-Dimensional Overseer is its Great Old One and source of Boons. Non-standard pathway lore and Outer Deity corruption details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Sublunary Eye Pathway ingredient archive → Notes High-level abilities The pathway’s upper abilities are inseparable from the corruption of its Outer Deity. These powers are expressed through Boons, mystical influence, and the gradual replacement of ordinary cause-and-effect with the pathway’s domain. Freely traverses higher and lower dimensions and changes the dimensionality of other beings, countering effects such as parasitism, puppetry, and teleportation. Reduces targets into paper-like or painted forms that merge with scenery and lose ordinary freedom of movement. Creates painting-worlds with their own suns, planets, rules, and principles, then traps powerful enemies inside them. Within its paintings the Overseer can govern reality with near-total omnipotence and create painted entities capable of True God-level destruction. Corruption from High-Dimensional Overseer The High-Dimensional Overseer is the pathway’s Outer Deity and primary source of Boons. Corruption can appear as physical mutation, mental contamination, altered fate, environmental collapse, or the rewriting of reality, depending on the pathway’s authority. Known corruptive effects Freely traverses higher and lower dimensions and changes the dimensionality of other beings, countering effects such as parasitism, puppetry, and teleportation. Reduces targets into paper-like or painted forms that merge with scenery and lose ordinary freedom of movement. Creates painting-worlds with their own suns, planets, rules, and principles, then traps powerful enemies inside them. Within its paintings the Overseer can govern reality with near-total omnipotence and create painted entities capable of True God-level destruction. Advancement warning Unlike the standard pathways, Earth-side advancement is recorded as receiving a Boon through prayer to High-Dimensional Overseer . That connection is also the main route through which the Outer Deity’s will, symbols, and corruption can enter the practitioner. Major story spoilers. The corruption summary is a paraphrase of the linked source material. title: Sun Pathway
summary: Sun Pathway: The Sun Pathway combines priestly light and holy magic with self- and ally-enhancement, purification, exorcism, and hard-to-break contracts. At
searchText: Sun Pathway God Almighty · Standard Pathway Sun Pathway Sequence 9: Bard → Sequence 0: Sun The Sun Pathway combines priestly light and holy magic with self- and ally-enhancement, purification, exorcism, and hard-to-break contracts. At high sequences it develops Justice and Order, broad Light authority, and the capacity to create a holy domain or function as a Sun. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Sun Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Bard Singing imbues allies with courage, dispels fear, and modestly improves strength, spiritual recovery, agility, and speed. 8 Light Suppliant Uses Sun-domain light and fire spells, blessings, night vision, ritual knowledge, and detection of undead or evil. 7 Solar High Priest Purifies and exorcises through holy spells, including halos, holy water, oaths, light beams, fear immunity, and golden flames. 6 Notary Notarization authenticates and enforces contracts, amplifies abilities, or nullifies and disperses targeted Beyonder powers. 5 Priest of Light Commands stronger divine spells, including Light of Holiness and Purification Halo, to destroy undead and foul creatures. 4 Unshadowed Direct Purification removes degeneration, corruption, darkness, evil, ailments, and unclean influences, even from Beyonders or characteristics. 3 Justice Mentor Defines personal Justice and Order, empowering aligned actions, weakening violations, enforcing Holy Contracts, and strengthening purification domains. 2 Lightseeker Gains Sun and Light authority, becoming a miniature Sun, moving as pure light, resisting corruption, and wielding Spear of Light. 1 White Angel Commands partial Holiness, Order, Faith, and Sun authority, creating Holy Kingdoms, fervor, pure white light, and solar radiance. 0 Sun Embodies Inextinguishable Light and authorities over Light, Order, Contracts, and Holiness; wherever light exists, it can illuminate and destroy. Pathway themes & abilities Its central authorities are Light, Holiness, and Order, with Sun, Faith, and Contracts as related lesser authorities. Common expressions include bardic enhancement, fire and light spells, notarization, purification, exorcism, justice-based empowerment, holy domains, and inextinguishable light. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Unshadowed: Direct Purification removes degeneration, corruption, darkness, evil, ailments, and unclean influences, even from Beyonders or characteristics. Sequence 3 — Justice Mentor: Defines personal Justice and Order, empowering aligned actions, weakening violations, enforcing Holy Contracts, and strengthening purification domains. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Lightseeker: Gains Sun and Light authority, becoming a miniature Sun, moving as pure light, resisting corruption, and wielding Spear of Light. Sequence 1 — White Angel: Commands partial Holiness, Order, Faith, and Sun authority, creating Holy Kingdoms, fervor, pure white light, and solar radiance. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Sun: Embodies Inextinguishable Light and authorities over Light, Order, Contracts, and Holiness; wherever light exists, it can illuminate and destroy. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers: The Sun pathway is woven into the Ancient Sun God’s legacy: Aucuses, once his White Angel, joined the Rose Redemption faction before becoming the Eternal Blazing Sun after the Ancient Sun God’s fall; the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, founded in the Third Epoch, controls the pathway. In the Forsaken Land, the City of Silver kept faith in the Ancient Sun God as Creator through a 2,582-year darkness and a curse that left kin to kill their dying relatives. Derrick Berg sought the Sun pathway to free his people; later expeditions lead him and Colin Iliad to Sasrir and a fatal confrontation Story connections Major spoilers: Derrick’s desire to “become the sun” is personal as well as communal: the City of Silver’s curse forced him to kill his parents, and he sought the Sun pathway to free his people Major spoilers: In the True Creator’s temple expedition, Derrick helps expose the team’s repeated time loop; his observations and guidance from the Tarot Club help Colin’s team break it Major spoilers: At the Giant King’s Court, Colin Iliad and Derrick confront the Dark Angel evil spirit Sasrir. Colin dies restraining Sasrir and asks Derrick to open the gate toward the sunlight beyond Figures to know Aucuses / Eternal Blazing Sun Formerly the Ancient Sun God’s White Angel; later ascended as the Sun pathway’s Sequence 0 deity Derrick Berg City of Silver member and Sun-pathway Beyonder whose hope of freeing his people shapes his Tarot Club role Colin Iliad City of Silver’s chief; his final stand against Sasrir clears a path for Derrick Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. Associated figures Selected figures listed in the source material: Adam Ancient Sun God Derrick Berg Eternal Blazing Sun Orpheus Primordial God Almighty Showing 6 of 14 names listed in the source; this is not an exhaustive roster. Pathway connections The source lists these as neighboring, compatible, or otherwise connected pathways. Some do not yet have a dedicated page in this archive. title: Supernova Dominator
summary: The Supernova Dominator is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth.
searchText: Supernova Dominator Outer Deity Supernova Dominator Overview ...Without necessary resistance, the mere approach of Supernova Dominator would tear the planet apart. Madam Magician, Book 2, chapter 1090 The Supernova Dominator is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. "He" is the current owner of the Condenser. Honorific Name The Ruler of Stars; The Symbolism of Weight and Density; The Controller of Fundamental Forces; The Laws of the Boundless Cosmos (群星的主宰， 沉重和致密的象征， 基本之力的掌控者， 无垠星空的律法) Symbols, Authorities, & Abilities "He" possesses full Authority over the Condenser and the corresponding Symbols , which includes but is not limited to the following: Condenser: Authorities over Gravity (Space-Time) and Fundamental Forces , and the Symbols of Density , Weight , Gravity and Attraction . The Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities "He" possesses and displays at the Above the Sequence level include: Laws of the Cosmos : "He" controls the Order and Rules of celestial mechanics in the entire universe 13 If "He" were to obtain the Nation of Disorder, "He" would be able to complete the Order and Rules beyond the celestial mechanics. Ruler of Stars : "He" can control and summon the Stars in the entire universe. 1 "He" can summon "His" shepherded Stars through the Spirit World, creating Supernovae and catastrophic Black Holes without compromising "His" structural stability. If "His" connection with the Spirit World is cut. "He" will be forced to spend extra time converting the Stars into conceptual forms, sending them into the Astral World, and transporting them to "His" location, finally manifesting them in reality. "He" can fully control millions of stars as an upper limit. 14 Great Attractor : "He" can control the Great Attractor, gravitationally influencing the motion of galactic filaments and superclusters. 2 Author's WeChat post error_formulas, part 32 "He" can dissipate or amplify the gravity of the Great Attractor. 2 Weight and Density : "He" can use the symbols and concepts of Density , Gravity , and Attraction to influence space-time and distort dimensions. 3 The countless exploding suns composing "His" body emit an intense gravitational pull, bending and shattering objects that get too close, capable of tearing planets into fragments. 3 4 Book 2, chapter 1161 5 Book 2, chapter 1162 15 The influence of the gravitational pull that "He" and "His" creations emit is not limited to physical matter, it includes intangible matter such as Fate , thoughts, and Spirit Bodies. 16 The Protected Zones, along with the Chaos Sea that submerged them, were on the brink of collapse under "His" immense gravitational pull but ultimately managed to stabilise before being transported to a planet at the edge of the universe. 5 If "He" were in state unconnected to reality, like having "His" Fate cut by the Final Judgement from the Goddess of Fate, "He" won't be able to utilise this symbolism. 6 Book 2, chapter 1174 "His" use of the Spirit World to instantly summon "His" Grazed Stars to create Supernova explosions or terrifying Black Holes stems from "His" symbolism of Weight and Density , reinforcing related physical concepts such as stellar mass density. 17 Welding the Weight and Density symbolism allows "Him" to resist being sealed into a Sequence 1 Abomination Beyonder Characteristic by the Lord of Mysteries. 18 Supernova Dominator's Space-Time attributes can achieve a level of authority that is the same as the Twilight Giant. 19 Controller of Fundamental Forces : "He" controls the Fundamental Forces of reality. "He" can eject countless particles from the myriad explosive suns comprising "His" body. 7 Book 2, chapter 1172 Fusion : "He" can manipulate particles and cause them to draw closer, triggering repeated nuclear fusions, transforming into various elements, and creating true matter. 7 This can be used to rejoin the River of Fate after having "His" Fate tributary severed by the Goddess of Fate's Final Judgment . This matter will begin forming their own Fates , weaving together and attempting to break through the isolation, seeking to rejoin the vast, illusory mercury - coloured River of Fate. "He" can emit light bright enough to devour all darkness, blind an Angel through the Astral Barrier (as well as reveal the barrier to the real world), and make the abstract patterns of the corresponding True Deities be nearly transparent. 8 "He" can turn into a genuine sun and erupt with light that can illuminate the entire Astral World and reveal all hidden entities. 20 As a Great Old Dominator leaning toward Reality , "He" is able to survive strikes from the Eternal Darkness and Calamity of Destruction - powerful existences of Destruction capable of killing other Great Old Dominators in a short time. 21 "His" massive size is much larger than the instant symbolic influence range, making the Death symbolism of the Eternal Darkness need a certain period of time to take its effect on "Him". Essentially, this is Reality resisting and dissipating Mysticism , one of the lower manifestations of the Reality characteristics. 22 As a Great Old Dominator whose consciousness, spirit, Sefirah, Uniqueness, and Beyonder Characteristics were all still intact, and who was not in a state of post-revival dormancy but rather leaned heavily towards reality, "He" could not be completely sealed. 6 After being sealed in the Abomination Beyonder Characteristic by Lord of Mysteries Klein, the Supernova Dominator would naturally break through the seal and emerge from the Characteristic in two or three minutes. Even if Klein reinforced the seal, it would not delay "Him" much longer. 6 Supernova : "He" can create Supernovae in two different ways: "He" can directly cause several Supernovae to erupt using "His" star-cluster form. 9 Book 2, chapter 1168 This direct method is relatively more dangerous to "Himself", the Supernovae can be manipulated by certain symbolism to backfire against "Him". The Lord of Mysteries' symbol of Change can induce an Error in the Supernovae , collapsing violently toward a single point which threatened to create an unimaginably massive Black Hole with Supernova Dominator's star-cluster form, which forced "Him" to stabilise "Himself". Amassing multiple Stars in a Star Dominion would immediately result in them attracting and colliding with each other, resulting in an immense eruption of light and heat. 1 "His" Supernovae is enough to obliterate layers of Doors and overwhelm countless Kleins, giving "Him" an unobstructed connection to the Astral World, and even helping the Mother Tree of Desire eliminate several Kleins. 1 9 A supernova explosion from "Him" can immediately destroy a Star System. Afterwards, the impact will continue to spread outward until it dissipates, with the final range of influence reaching the size of a Galaxy. 10 Black Hole : "He" can create massive Black Holes formed from the Supernovae of stars, the colliding matter would rapidly collapse, emitting unimaginable gravitational force that could capture even the expelled light and heat, compressing an entire Star Dominion inward and slowing time dramatically. 1 "His" embryonic Black Hole will develop, tear apart, and devour the planet, causing the barrier to lose support and disintegrate prematurely. 11 Book 2, chapter 590 True Deities and Angels could escape, but without the barrier's protection, no one knows what would happen. Two King of Angels, Mr. Door and Amon couldn't obliterate the already developing Black Hole . Any attempts to destroy or destabilize the Black Hole as this would only make it stronger. 11 "He" could replenish the Black Hole due to its connection to "Him", preventing it from dissipation. The Goddess of Fate was unable to perceive the fates within the Black Hole's region. 1 The possibility of a Black Hole gaining sentience can’t be ruled out. 23 White Hole : "He" can reverse a Black Hole's collapse into the strongest explosion possible - creating a White Hole . This transformation takes at least 1 second to complete. 1 The creation of a White Hole would be accompanied by the eruption of burning light and an extreme explosion, strong enough to obliterate Goddess of Fate, Lord of Mysteries, and severely damage the manifested Sefirah Castle. 1 This is a fundamental symbolism, untouchable and irremovable by abilities such as the Goddess of Fate's Final Judgment . 7 Appearance True Form : "His" body is a star cluster, composed of a myriad explosive suns. 1 7 "His" form is large enough that it cannot be contained within a Solar System, "He" only reduced "Himself" to a size small enough to fit inside ours. 24 "His" true body is as large as a Star System. 10 Personality "He" wants to embody the symbol of Civilization , so "He" encourages the development of civilisation. However, "He" is still quite mad, so the civilisations under "Him" experience various disasters from time to time. 25 Background According to the Seven Lights, ever since the Oldest One awakened and split apart, the most powerful Outer Deities in the entire universe gathered around this tiny solar system. Some of "Them" wish to retrieve "Their" Sefirot and characteristics that had been ripped from "Them" and were attracted to Earth. Some of "Them" have the hope of getting neighbouring Sefirot and high-level characteristics which "They" can accommodate. 26 Supernova Dominator's goals were harder to pinpoint than the other Outer Deities. Klein speculated that "He" desired the City of Calamity to embody the symbolism of Universal Catastrophe , the Knowledge Moor to enrich "His" star systems and civilisations and the Nation of Disorder to complete the order and rules beyond celestial mechanics. Successfully accommodating the Knowledge Moor would make "Him" the symbol of Civilization . 27 Furthermore, "He" is likely interested in the Chaos Sea and the Uniquenesses of the Sun and Tyrant Pathways. 3 Book 2, chapter 1164 The Moon and Darkness Pathways are also considered a component, not the entirety, of the "Mystical Cosmos" required by the Supernova Dominator. 28 History The Supernova Dominator's birth symbolised the birth of stars. 29 In the First Epoch, during the Lost Era, the Primordial God Almighty and Celestial Worthy's strong and still-perfect-and-whole power deterred the Outer Deities, who can only settle for observing Earth from afar for now. After the death of the Primordial God Almighty, the Sun, which used to be embodied by the Primordial God Almighty, was now occupied by the Supernova Dominator, up until the end of the Early Era of Fire of the Second Epoch. But due to the Earth's Barrier, "His" light could not shine through, and thus the world was in complete darkness - Which is why the Second Epoch was called the Dark Epoch . 30 In the Fourth Epoch, "He" sent a spaceship containing an embryonic black hole inside it to Earth. The plan was for it to rapidly develop, tear apart, and devour the planet, causing the barrier to lose support and disintegrate prematurely. Due to the timely intervention of Mr. Door and Amon, this plan was thwarted. Mr. Door sealed the spaceship, while Amon devised a ritual to regularly siphon power away from the spaceship, ensuring the seal would not weaken. This transformed over the years into the Sea Prayer Ritual of Port Santa. 12 Book 2, chapter 590 During the Sea Prayer Ritual of 1358, Lumian Lee was almost killed when a heavy, dense, terrifying, and brilliant aura "looked" at him from another place connected to the black hole inside the ship, before being rescued by Madam Magician. 12 When Project Vortex commenced, the Supernova Dominator agreed to intervene fully, suppressing the barrier so that all true gods in the Astral World could not interfere with the matters inside the barrier. In exchange, the seal on the spaceship under the waters of Port Santa was to be broken. 8 Book 2, chapter 865 The Apocalypse Upon the destruction of the true and fake Astral Barriers, Supernova Dominator was the first Outer Deity outside to affect Earth, "His" body, a terrifying star cluster composed of erupting suns, violently tore the planet into fragments. 4 The Protected Zones, along with the Chaos Sea that submerged them, were on the brink of collapse under "His" immense gravitational pull but ultimately managed to stabilize before being transported to a planet at the edge of the universe. 5 Supernova Dominator, along with the Mother Tree of Desire and the Goddess of Fate, were held off by Klein, who had just advanced to a true Lord of Mysteries. "His" strength was heavily handicapped by Klein, who severed "His" connection to the Spirit World, which hampered "His" ability to summon suns and stars, forcing "Him" to rely on the Astral World instead. "He" was stalled with the combination of Doors and the symbolism of Change . Later, "He" would be sealed within an Abomination Beyonder Characteristic by Klein and effectively taken out of the fight. After breaking through "His" seal at the end of The Apocalypse, "He" was immediately affected by the combination of the Lord of Mysteries' Foolishness , and the Visionary's Hypnosis and Virtual Persona through Lumian's access of the Chaos Sea. This made "Him" believe that the Outer Deities intend to harm "Him" and that "He" is a friend of Earth's Great Old Ones - one that would help "Them" when it matters most. Klein and Lumian would later visit "Him" from time to time to maintain "His" Foolish state and Virtual Persona . 31 After The Apocalypse, since the Supernova Dominator had become an ally of Earth, there would be more of "His" followers on Earth. 32 Translations Language Name Chinese 超星主宰 Thai บดีแห่งอติดารา , เจ้าแห่งมหานวดารา References Book 2, chapter 1171. title: Sword of Courage
summary: Sword of Courage, a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact: function, downside, and status.
searchText: Sword of Courage Sealed Artifact · Grade 1 Sword of Courage Grade 1 · No code recorded Overview Sword of Courage is recorded in the archive as a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. Grade 1 artifacts sit near Saint level, roughly matching Sequence 3 to Sequence 4 Beyonders. It is described as: A dark, iron-black broadsword. Function *This sword fills its bearer with courage. It's extremely durable and sharp, capable of blocking direct attacks from demigods and significantly impacting their defences. It can also enable the user to perform Cull at the level of an Iron-blooded Knight. If the sword is coated with the target's blood or if they've been scorched by its flames, the user can throw it up to five kilometres into the sky. It will wrap itself in flames, fly toward the target and then crash down, creating a violent explosion. Downside *Excessive courage can lead to people losing their their ability to judge and analyse, leading to a swift demise. The user will need to prepare at least thirty ordinary broadswords to place around it. Otherwise, it will start attacking everyone nearby indiscriminately. Status No status is recorded in the source table. Source: the Sealed Artifacts archive , from the Lord of the Mysteries wiki . title: Tail-Devourer Pathway
summary: The Tail-Devourer is a non-standard pathway centered on analyzing and processing ingredients into dishes, drinks, and concoctions. It enhances digestion, d
searchText: Tail-Devourer Pathway Non-Standard Pathway · Primordial Hunger Tail-Devourer Pathway Outer Deity: Primordial Hunger · Boon advancement The Tail-Devourer is a non-standard pathway centered on analyzing and processing ingredients into dishes, drinks, and concoctions. It enhances digestion, deprives others of Beyonder powers, and digests or absorbs Beyonder characteristics and mystical items. Its high authorities are Devouring, Convergence, and Hunger, and Earth-side advancement comes through Boons from Primordial Hunger . Non-standard pathway lore and Outer Deity corruption details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Tail-Devourer Pathway ingredient archive → High-level abilities The pathway’s upper abilities are inseparable from the corruption of its Outer Deity. These powers are expressed through Boons, mystical influence, and the gradual replacement of ordinary cause-and-effect with the pathway’s domain. Forcibly converges targets and can pull true bodies or symbolic influences toward the Outer Deity. Devours, digests, utilizes, and erases objects, powers, Avatars, or Marionettes so completely that nothing may remain recoverable. Can consume hostile mental corruption and ravings, turning contamination itself into something that can be processed. Its hunger can spread catastrophically: devouring powerful pathways or entities may trigger universal convergence, instability, and the loss of life-supporting conditions. Corruption from Primordial Hunger The Primordial Hunger is the pathway’s Outer Deity and primary source of Boons. Corruption can appear as physical mutation, mental contamination, altered fate, environmental collapse, or the rewriting of reality, depending on the pathway’s authority. Known corruptive effects Forcibly converges targets and can pull true bodies or symbolic influences toward the Outer Deity. Devours, digests, utilizes, and erases objects, powers, Avatars, or Marionettes so completely that nothing may remain recoverable. Can consume hostile mental corruption and ravings, turning contamination itself into something that can be processed. Its hunger can spread catastrophically: devouring powerful pathways or entities may trigger universal convergence, instability, and the loss of life-supporting conditions. Advancement warning Unlike the standard pathways, Earth-side advancement is recorded as receiving a Boon through prayer to Primordial Hunger . That connection is also the main route through which the Outer Deity’s will, symbols, and corruption can enter the practitioner. Major story spoilers. The corruption summary is a paraphrase of the linked source material. Tail-Devourer Pathway Pathway type Non-standard / Boon pathway Outer Deity Primordial Hunger Known authority Tail-Devourer Advancement Boons through prayer ↑

title: Tarot Club - Achievements
summary: Achievements of the Tarot Club in Lord of the Mysteries and Circle of Inevitability. Major operations, hunts, and missions carried out by the club members.
searchText: Tarot Club - Achievements This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Tarot Club - Achievements ← Back List of Members Gatherings Achievements Rituals 1. Book One: Lord of Mysteries The achievements of the Tarot Club across Lord of the Mysteries, from the founding gathering to the end of the story. Qilangos The Hanged Man gave the offer to kill the Tyrant Pathway Beyonder Rear Admiral Qilangos in a Tarot meeting. Justice accepted the offer and hired Fors and Xio to investigate him. Later, Justice found him during a ball and prayed to The Fool . Eventually, Azik killed him, while Justice and The Hanged Man assumed it was done by one of Mr. Fool's followers. Steel Maveti The Hanged Man realized that The World was in Bayam, and offered to help. The World then invited him to the fight against Steel Maveti. This was the first time The Hanged Man and The World met in reality. The Hanged Man informed his Church and lured Maveti out, while The World and Danitz conducted the fight and killed him. They split up the bounty. Sea of Ruins The World asked The Hermit for the opportunity to board onto The Future to search for mermaids. They went through a series of adventures along with all the crews and The World advanced to Sequence 5: Marionettist. Primitive Island The Hanged Man gave The World the coordinates of an island he has once explored with Qilangos as the price of the Ocean Songster characteristic. Later, they explored the island together and discovered the painting showing the great betrayal of the three angels: White, Wind and Wisdom. The World 'sacrificed' the Tyrant Card to Mr. Fool . Cielf June The Hanged Man found the artisan Cielf June working with believers of Primordial Moon. He then invited The Hermit to capture Cielf and made him return what was The Hanged Man's and had him hand in all his artifacts. The Hermit then brought Cielf onto The Future to ensure observation and benefits. Ernes Boyar This was the first mission that involved most Tarot Club members. The Moon decided to get revenge against Viscount Ernes Boyar for giving him wrong information about the Abandoned Castle, which almost killed Judgement and The Magician. Judgement investigated and followed Ernes; The Star dragged Ernes into a dream; Justice disguised herself as a paperboy and hypnotized Ernes; The Moon was the bait. The Hanged Man gave his advice that they needed to mislead the Sanguines in some ways. Mr. Fool monitored the whole action above the Gray Fog . Amon Avatars Amon's avatar found Klein in his house, and The Star (with Pallez) came to fight as planned. After defeating Amon, The World brought Justice to Hazel's house to clear her memories about Amon and hypnotized everyone who had been parasitized by Amon to pray to Evernight Goddess afterward. Groselle's Travels The World invited The Star and Justice to explore the subconscious sea of Groselle's Travels. They discovered a non-floating city that exactly resembled the City of Miracle, Liveseyd. At the end they encountered a dangerous corruption locked away by the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt. Botis The World hired Tarot Club members to hunt Botis in order to obtain his Worms of Star (Worms of Cosmos). The Hermit and Justice hunted Botis together, while Judgement hid aside and interrupted Botis with her Justiciar pathway abilities, The Magician was only a bait and was captured by the Box of the Great Old Ones at the start of the operation. Mr. Fool , as always, monitored the action above the Gray Fog . After the operation The Star 'named' the Tarot Club for the first time. The spoils of war from Botis were divided among the participants. Shaman King Klarman The Moon, along with Rose School of Thought Temperance faction members ( Sharron , Maric , and Reinette Tinekerr ) and The World planned together to hunt down a member of the Rose School of Thought Indulgence faction from the Moon Pathway . Their choice was Shaman King Klarman. The Moon partnered with Sharron to fight, with the help of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact of the Sun Pathway , while The World and Reinette acted as bait to divert the attention of Suah. In the end, they managed to kill Klarman. Giant King's Court Klein was forced by the True Creator to meet Sasrir. Together with the Sun, Colin Iliad and Lovia, they defeated Sasir and opened the door to the outside world at the cost of the latter two's lives. 2. Book Two: Circle of Inevitability The achievements of the Tarot Club during Circle of Inevitability . Tree of Shadow The Seven of Wands, the Two of Cups, Judgement, and Magician fought and prevented the emergence of the Tree of Shadow, which was planted by the Mother Tree of Desire long ago in Trier. I Know Someone Magician hired Will Auceptin in order to give Jenna enough luck to locate I Know Someone in an asylum in Trier. The Seven of Wands and the Two of Cups fought against him, and with the help of Justice and Magician, they survived and killed him. Fourth Epoch Trier To be added. Sea Prayer Ritual To be added. Loki To be added. Project Vortex To be added. Mr. Fool's Dream To be added. Hunting Hidden Sage To be added. title: Tarot Club - Gatherings
summary: List of Tarot Club meetings in Lord of the Mysteries. Weekly gatherings at Sefirah Castle since 1349, and monthly gatherings without a convener after The Fool's slumber.
searchText: Tarot Club - Gatherings This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Tarot Club - Gatherings ← Back List of Members Gatherings Achievements Rituals 1. Overview Tarot Club meetings are mainly held on Mondays at 3 PM in Sefirah Castle , above the gray fog. From 1349 to 1352, Tarot Club meetings occur every week. But after Mr. Fool went to sleep, gatherings occur only once a month, and there is no convener. The following is a log of the depicted gatherings of the Tarot Club , organized by volume. Click a volume header to expand its meetings. 2. Volume 1: Clown onward Book One: Lord of the Mysteries. Volume 1: Clown Open volume Chapters 5-7 · June 28, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , and Alger Wilson Klein accidentally summoned Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson above the Gray Fog. Klein posed as "The Fool". Alger asks to exchange 100 milliliters of Ghost Sharks' blood with the Spectator potion formula from Audrey. The Tarot Club was established to share and sell information and Beyonder ingredients. Chapters 34-36 · July 2, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , and Alger Wilson Alger gives Audrey the Spectator potion formula. Klein tells them about the Acting Method as an advance payment and entrusts them to collect Roselle's Diary. Klein raised a suggestion through Justice to hold "the Civil Servant Unified Examination". Chapters 58-61 · July 9, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , and Alger Wilson Audrey became the Spectator. Audrey found one page, Alger found two pages of Roselle's Diary. Some information about the Antigonus Family and Blasphemy Slate from Alger. Audrey asked a hypothetical question if potions were safe for normal animal consumption. Klein asks them to hold a ritual and pray to The Fool with his honorific name. Chapters 93-94 · July 16, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , and Alger Wilson One page of Roselle's Diary from Audrey. Some information about secret organizations from Alger. After the gathering, Klein heard Derrick Berg 's prayer in Jotun. Chapters 113-114 · July 23, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , and Alger Wilson Audrey asks about the Beyonder creature. One page of Roselle's Diary. Chapter 118 · July 30, August 6, and August 13, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , and Alger Wilson 3 gatherings timeskipped. No new pages of Roselle's Diary. Audrey had gotten to know two Beyonders (Fors and Xio) and she was getting in touch with them consistently, trying to get into their circle of acquaintances. Audrey wasn't the innocent and romantic maiden from before. She kept her guard up and never mentioned the names and traits of the two Beyonders. But she revealed her gradual digestion of her potion. Alger had returned to land and was dealing with some matters. He would begin looking for more pages of Roselle's Diary as soon as he had more free time. Chapters 143-146 · August 20, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , and New Major Arcana: Derrick Berg The Sun Derrick first joins the gathering. Two pages of Roselle's Diary from Audrey. Derrick asks to exchange the Telepathist potion formula with the Bard potion formula. Some information about the Aurora Order from Alger. Alger asks to look for the whereabouts of Qilangos. Chapters 157-159 · August 27, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , and Derrick Berg Derrick has become a Bard. He gives Audrey the formula of the Telepathist. One page of Roselle's Diary from Audrey. Some news and information about Qilangos from Alger. Chapters 178-180 · September 3, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , and Derrick Berg Audrey relays Fors and Xio's progress tracking Qilangos. Mr. Fool gives the Tarot Club members permission to recite "His" name in a ritual in order to pass information along to "Him". Audrey requests the complete pituitary gland of a Rainbow Salamander. Alger offers to help on the premise that Qilangos is found and mentions primitive islands. Derrick reveals that the City of Silver still believes in "the Lord that created everything" despite being abandoned, then describes some of the city's history and rituals. Klein later modifies the Sun's ritual into one for sacrifices and bestowment. Alger realizes that the Sun hails from the Forsaken Land of the Gods. The September 10th gathering did not happen because of Justice Audrey's and Hanged Man Alger's withdrawal from the gathering. This was due to the aftermath of Qilangos' failed assassination attempt on Pallas Negan. Audrey in particular had to withdraw due to her father hiring Beyonders overtly and covertly to protect her. The remainder, The Sun Derrick, were then notified that the gathering for that time was cancelled. Volume 2: Faceless Open volume Chapters 216-220 · September 17, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , and Derrick Berg Nineteen pages of Roselle's Diary from Alger as payment for Qilangos. Today six pages are submitted. Mr. Fool shares some free general knowledge from Roselle's Diary. "He" explains the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Indestructibility and the Law of Similar Sequence Beyonder Characteristics Conservation. In exchange for a three-way deal of promised information on the Secret Order (Derrick chooses to cash in a promised favor), Mr. Fool explains the exchangeability of pathways at higher sequences. Mr. Fool introduces "His" modified bestowment ritual. This allows Alger to give Audrey her requested Rainbow Salamander pituitary gland. Audrey recommends Fors and Xio for the Tarot Club. Klein gives her permission to discreetly spread "His" name to them. Chapters 235-238 · September 24, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , and Derrick Berg Audrey has become a Telepathist. Six pages of Roselle's Diary from Alger as payment for Qilangos (12/19 pages given). Alger reveals the Secret Order's connection to the Intis Republic. Mr. Fool commissions the assassination of the Intisian Ambassador, Bakerland Jean Madan. Audrey accepts the commission in exchange for the Psychiatrist potion formula and ingredients. Alger also accepts the mission. Klein provides the Light Supplicant formula to Audrey, who gives it to Derrick in exchange for information about dragons. Chapters 264-267 · October 1, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , and New Major Arcana: Gehrman Sparrow The World Gehrman Sparrow, Klein's marionette created using the All-Black Eye , joins the gathering. Mr. Fool requests Audrey to have Xio and Fors investigate Lanevus. Six pages of Roselle's Diary from Alger as payment for Qilangos (18/19 pages given). Through Roselle's Diary, the existence of Sequence 0 is revealed. Klein as Mr. World requests ingredients for the Magician potion formula. Derrick offers to obtain Mist Treant materials in exchange for a suitable combat weapon. Klein as Mr. World requests information on all the abject nobles in the Loen Kingdom. Audrey agrees in exchange for information regarding other Beyonder pathways. He tells her about the Demoness Pathway . Klein as Mr. World requests information on the Sauron Family's High-Sequence Beyonders. Klein as Mr. Fool "agrees" to answer the question "in exchange" for a Sequence 7 formula. Chapters 289-293 · October 8, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , and Gehrman Sparrow In the aftermath of the Death of Lanevus, Klein describes East Borough's terrible conditions, urging Audrey to take action. One page of Roselle's Diary from Alger, the final payment for Qilangos' assassination. "The taste of a Demoness ain't bad." Alger mentions an upcoming pirate gathering attended by even Pirate Kings and Pirate Admirals. Klein offers an incomplete Sequence 4 Unshadowed formula to Alger in exchange for Dark Patterned Black Panther Spinal Fluid and Spring of the Elves Marrow Crystals. Alger refuses. Klein makes the same request and instead offers high-level secrets in exchange. Alger accepts and learns about Sequence 0. Ailment Maiden Tracy has replaced Qilangos as Vice Admiral. Alger describes the situation of the current Pirate Kings and Admirals. Audrey describes the serial murders in Backlund. Derrick makes the connection to a Devil's advancement ritual. An expedition by the City of Silver has uncovered the True Creator's Temple. Mr. Fool reveals that the "Fallen Creator" is in control of the Shepherd pathway ( Hanged Man Pathway ). Chapters 310-314 · October 15, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, and New Major Arcana: Fors Wall The Magician Fors Wall joins the gathering. No new pages of Roselle's Diary. Klein inquires about the Devil and Guardian Sequences. Derrick offers knowledge in exchange for information about the True Creator. Fors asks about the Apothecary and Trickmaster formulas. Klein sells the Apothecary formula to her. Fors pays Audrey 200 pounds to learn about the Acting Method. In exchange for information about the seven orthodox deities, Derrick shares the creation myth of the City of Silver and describes the ancient gods, including the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea. He also describes the Chained Pathway . Chapters 341-342 · October 22, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, and Fors Wall Audrey requested a private conversation with Mr. Fool. During their conversation, she disclosed the encounter between herself and the Psychology Alchemists. Two pages from Roselle's Diary from Audrey. However, Klein had previously seen these pages at the Roselle Memorial Exhibition. Alger recounted his investigative mission concerning the disappearance of native tribes and slaves in the Southern Continent over the past two to three years. In preparation for his exploration of the True Creator's Temple, led by Lovia Tiffany, a believer in the True Creator, Derrick sought advice. Alger advised him to leave the mission, suggesting he could do so by pushing himself to the brink of losing control. Chapters 358-360 · October 29, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, and Fors Wall Derrick faked losing control and was put in the spire. Within the confines of the spire, he met Uddel, a former team captain who was imprisoned in the spire for 42 years. He mentioned Amon to Derrick. Three pages of Roselle's Diary from Audrey. Alger urged everyone's attention to focus on an individual named "Baelen," who had a connection to the disappearance of the colonial slaves. Chapters 390-395 · November 5, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, and Fors Wall Three pages of Roselle's Diary from Alger. In exchange for the diary pages, Alger learns that Mr. Fool possesses one of the Cards of Blasphemy: the card of the Black Emperor Pathway . Derrick recounted his encounter with a mutating Uddel, who attempted to break through the seal. Mr. Fool discovered Amon parasitizing on Derrick's soul and sent his angel to purify him. Derrick borrowed the All-Black Eye from Mr. World. Fors inquired about families associated with the Apprentice Pathway, leading to an exchange involving a chapter from Sights in the Spirit World. Audrey informed them about the incident involving The Hero Bandit. Audrey instructed Fors in the understanding of the Law of Indestructibility and Conservation. Chapters 439-442 · December 20, 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, and Fors Wall Three pages of Roselle's Diary from Audrey. Audrey promises ten more pages as payment for being told about the Twilight Hermit Order's existence. Fors also promises ten pages for the help she's received. Alger and Klein as Mr. World complete a transaction involving Deep-Sea Naga hair and the sale of a Werewolf Beyonder characteristic. Audrey inquires about supplementary ingredients of the Psychiatrist potion. At Alger's request, Audrey shares the details of Duke Pallas Negan's assassination. Mr. Fool hints at the existence of the Twilight Hermit Order. Fors asks for advice on how to digest a second Apprentice potion. Once again, Derrick has been put on an expedition to the True Creator's Temple, led by Colin Iliad this time. Alger advises him to go. At Alger's request, Audrey describes Backlund's political situation in the fallout of the duke's assassination. Chapters 460-464 · December 1349 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, and Fors Wall Upon entering the gathering, Derrick regains his memories of previous "loops" of his expedition to the True Creator's Temple. He becomes aware that he is trapped in a cycle of fate. Looking for advice, Derrick describes his situation and uses the gray fog to display images of his expedition. This includes a mural depicting the Fallen Creator resisting "six evil gods" (the current orthodox gods except for the God of Steam and Machinery). This prompts Klein as Mr. World to display an image of the six god statues he found in a Fourth Epoch ruin. Mr. Fool name-drops Rose Redemption. Three pages of Roselle's Diary from Audrey. According to Zaratul: "A miracle is to be resurrected from the dead!" Audrey purchases a pair of Mirror Dragon Eyes from Fors for 1,000 pounds. Fors, Alger, and Derrick engage in a three-way deal involving a Spirit Eater stomach pouch, 300 pounds, and the Solar High Priest potion formula. Derrick promises to put together a list of the City of Silver's resources to provide further repayment. Klein as Mr. World warns of a major event brewing in Backlund. Mr. Fool says a name: Edessak Augustus. Volume 3: Traveler Open volume Chapters 483-489 · January 1350 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, Fors Wall , and New Major Arcana: Emlyn White The Moon Emlyn White joins the gathering. Three pages of Roselle's Diary from Fors. Tarot Club learns about the Angel of Fate from Derrick. Audrey asks about the names of the other Kings of Angels. Mr. Fool replies with "You will come into contact with it in the future." Alger buys a Dragon-Eyed Sea Condor from Fors for 2,000 pounds. Audrey buys a fruit of a Tree of Elders for 600-700 pounds and the blood of a Mirror Dragon from Emlyn for 100 pounds. She pays an additional hundred pounds for labor costs. Klein as Mr. World commissions Alger to sell a Faceless characteristic to an Artisan for less than 3,500 pounds. Audrey pre-orders the mystical item produced by the Artisan. Audrey asks Mr. Fool for the truth behind the Great Smog of Backlund. Mr. Fool replies that it has not been discovered yet. Klein as Mr. World sells the information about Baelen to Alger for 100 pounds. Audrey reports about the origins of the Psychology Alchemists. Mr. Fool reveals that Hermes was a member of the Twilight Hermit Order. Derrick asks Mr. Fool about hand gestures. Audrey follows up and asks if the Tarot Club should design one. Alger rejects the notion due to the risks, but instead suggests that there should be temporary gestures to identify Tarot Club members. Chapters 514-516 · January 10, 1350 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, Fors Wall , and Emlyn White Six pages of Roselle's Diary from Audrey and Fors.
