Fors tells Emlyn that he might become the archbishop of the church or the sole Sanguine representative of the Church of the Earth Mother, to which Leonard explains that Earth Mother will soon have the title of 'Lady of Crimson'. Mr. World tells the others that the focus of the gathering now might switch to exchanging information and engaging in secret cooperation because most of the members have become demigods and their progress in advancement will surely lengthen. Mr. Fool tells everyone that they may now exchange higher level items including the Sea God's identity, level, and strength. Alger asks Mr. Fool what price he needs to pay to exchange these items, to which Mr. Fool answers: "The missions I shall give you, as well as frequent praying and the sincere making of wishes." Mr. Fool gives Alger his current mission of cooperating with the Sea God believers and helping the people from the Forsaken Land of the Gods settle down. Mr. Fool hints on Xio that she could exchange Imperative Mage potion formula and Beyonder characteristic. Audrey receives sincere advice from Alger when she expresses her current feeling of helplessness due to the world situation. Mr. World reminds everyone that the apocalypse will arrive in about a decade and even the deities may perish. The members of the gathering realize that The World has become an angel. Chapters 1320-1323 · February 25, 1352 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha Fors has become Secrets Sorcerer. Emlyn asks if there was something special about the Planter and Moon pathways that resulted in the internal system of the Church of the Earth Mother. Mr. Fool hints on how some of the 22 Beyonder pathways originated from the original Creator and the Cosmos. Emlyn consults the others as to why the angel level sequence names of the Moon and Planter pathway have certain gender inclinations, to which Audrey hints on the fact that the Witch potion turns the person into a 'witch'. Leonard shares the matters regarding Merlin Hermes and his actions of rebuilding Constant City and performing miracles, to which Mr. World replies that "He'd" be leaving Midseashire soon. This revelation made the others realize that Mr. World was Merlin Hermes. Alger and Cattleya realized "He" was 'acting' to digest "His" potion. Mr. World inquires what the others know about Barros Hopkins to covertly hint on Audrey to bring up the discussion about her experience with the Psychology Alchemists' higher-ups. Audrey shares her experience of being sent to investigate the mind dragon she once encountered two years ago by a secret organization. Emlyn, with his experience in such matters, replies that this should be a test to observe her. Audrey rejected this as she assumes that they already knew she was problematic and she asks for advice on her subsequent actions, to which Alger suggests to stall for time. Audrey asks Mr. Fool if Adam has become Sequence 0, to which Mr. Fool replies "Only with the apocalypse approaching did 'He' finally take that step." Derrick asks how the City of Silver could earn gold pounds and resources. He receives advice on forming mercenary teams, having residents join the industries in Bayam and/or applying for civil jobs within Rorsted Archipelago, and investing in different industries using their liquid funds. Derrick shares that they have built the temple and cathedral meant for Mr. Fool including a Holy Bible, Order of Mass, and prayer details. Alger reminds them to be respectful of Mr. Fool's Oracle and be friendly towards the other churches to avoid conflict. Cattleya inquires about the Sequence 3 Beyonder characteristic of the Mystery Pryer pathway, to which Mr. World suggests she ask Queen Mystic directly, implying that "She" has already advanced and might have an additional spare Clairvoyant Beyonder characteristic. Mr. World commissions a long-term mission to Cattleya to collect information regarding the Hidden Sage's sudden coming back to life, to which the latter agrees. Chapter 1335 · 1352 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha Klein was undergoing his ritual for Attendant of Mysteries. A gathering was held in Klein's POV: "I sit at the far end of the mottled table and hear Miss Judgment describe the Utopia incident. After she finishes, I look around and hoarsely say, "This is a ritual." Unsurprisingly, I see Miss Judgment's gaze freeze. I can sense Mr. Hanged Man and Miss Justice looking over with a hint of speculation in their eyes. At this moment, I can almost guess what they're thinking. They definitely suspect that this is The World Gehrman Sparrow's Sequence 1 ritual. And they are already long aware from the talks in the Tarot Gatherings that the existence of a Sequence 0 true god makes it impossible for a Sequence 1 to exist. Regarding this matter, I have already prepared an explanation. It is to let them think about the ancient sun god and "His" eight Kings of Angels. Unfortunately, no one raises any questions. They may have already made the connection to the Kings of Angels, or perhaps they believe that the ritual involving Utopia is mainly to help Mr. Fool awaken further. ... I lean back in my chair and listen to The Moon Emlyn describe his dream. After Father Utravsky's appraisal, this dream has been confirmed to have not originated from the Earth Mother. This inevitably makes people cast their looks of suspicion at The Moon, towards a state prior to being corrupted by the Mother Goddess of Depravity ... I'm nearly amused by my own thoughts. As an experienced Seer, a master at deciphering dreams, I'm not held back by modesty. I frankly reveal what I know: "The three possibilities are that this dreamscape is trying to bait you into exploring and pursuing something. To a certain extent, it can interfere with your fate. Secondly, this dreamscape hopes that you can interpret it deeply and understand it. Then, through this, corrupt you in an indiscernible manner. Thirdly, you are too worried about the matter of becoming a Beauty Goddess, so you dreamed of that remarkably terrifying scene. "The third possibility doesn't need elaborating on. The action needed for the first two possibilities are the same: don't think about it, don't investigate. There's no need to leave Backlund." With that said, I see Emlyn nod without any hesitation. I know it's his way of handling things. ... Bansy? Verdu wants to go to Bansy? I sit at the bottom end of the long, mottled table and look at The Hanged Man who has reported to Mr. Fool. I have some doubts about the development of the matter. Verdu, who's engrossed in mysticism and is trying to save Mr. Door, does have certain reasons to search Bansy Harbor. Furthermore, he has stayed in Bayam for almost half a year, so it's very normal for him to come into contact with information about Bansy... The main problem is that The Hanged Man's previous surveillance didn't provide any corresponding signs, making Verdu's actions seem a little out of place... The importance placed on this matter has to be raised... I nod inwardly and hear Mr. Fool instruct, "Continue monitoring." - Lord of Mysteries, Chapter 1335 Volume 8: Fool Open volume Chapters 1388-1390 · 1352 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha A sudden gathering without prior notice. Klein has become Fool and half-Lord of the Mysteries. The members were surprised, alarmed, and saddened to see that Mr. World was missing from his seat. Mr. Fool explains that this was a last-minute gathering. Mr. Fool explains that "He" will be entering a state of slumbering, that this involves a war that's at the level of 'Above the Sequences' and involves the forthcoming of The Apocalypse. The members were enlightened about the term 'Above the Sequences.' Mr. Fool reveals that "His" Blessed, The World, has entered a deep slumber. Mr. Fool issues a long-term commission to all the members to aid in "His" awakening; the reward is the convenience they have enjoyed in the past, responses they receive, and corresponding help given to them in the future. To spread "His" name more widely without clashing with the Orthodox Churches. To spread the news that The World is "His" Blessed, and record it in the Church's Holy Bible. To remember one sentence: The awakening of The World spells The Fool's return. Mr. Fool explains that after "He" begins "His" slumber, "He" could still respond to their prayers in a certain way, but not every time. Mr. Fool issues each member a mission: To Cattleya , to gather all the information regarding the Hidden Sage suddenly coming to life; if she wishes, she could further investigate the present state of the Hidden Sage. The reward is a wish. To Derrick, to protect the New City of Silver and New Moon City and protect the Rorsted Archipelago and, with this foundation, think about how to expand the Church and spread the faith. The reward is to become "His" Blessed. To Fors, to protect the Abraham Family well to prevent them from suffering the temptation of the cosmos, as well as gather more information regarding the Fourth Epoch and figure out Mr. Door's condition at that time. Uncover some of the latent problems of the Abraham Family. And, if she's willing, she can write down biographies and stories of The World's different identities using different aliases. The reward is that when she can have a chance of becoming a Planeswalker and have to head to the cosmos, she will receive "His" blessings. To Emlyn, to gather blessings, auras, and items given by the Primordial Moon to 'Her' believers in the Rose School of Thought. Apart from participating in the besieging of the Rose School of Thought's mission, to form a pharmaceutical company and perform research on how to mass-produce the medicine with magical effects; its main goal was to spread The Fool's name. The reward will be a wish. To Xio, to rely on the official factions to investigate the whereabouts of the three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics and the Uniqueness of the Red Priest pathway . And, if there's a chance, find a clue to confirm the Primordial Demoness's present condition. The reward has been bestowed through holding a ritual and becoming a Sequence 4 Imperative Mage. To Leonard, to share the stories of The World with songs and poetry, and try his best to raise his own level to prepare for the apocalypse. The reward is a wish. To Audrey, to assist Xio and investigate the whereabouts of the Red Priest Pathway 's Uniqueness and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics, confirming the present state of the Primordial Demoness. The other is to work hard to raise her level, as this could create more opportunities to awaken The World. The reward has been bestowed in the form of Dream Weaver Beyonder Characteristic, corresponding ingredients, and potion formula. To Alger, "You will know what your mission is in time to come." Mr. Fool reminds Cattleya to watch over her subordinates who are Beyonders of the Earth and Moon pathways. Audrey notices that Mr. Fool's humanity seems to have become richer just as "He" is about to enter a deep sleep. Mr. Fool reminds Xio to be careful of Bansy. Mr. Fool says to Leonard to not do too much in promoting "His" name, as he is an official Beyonder of the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Mr. Fool tells Alger that he could use the Sea God Scepter , but all the prayers of the Sea God believers will be transferred to Derrick, pointing directly at "Him". Mr. Fool explains that after the gathering, on the first Monday afternoon of every month, they can still gather here, but there will be no convener. If they need to do a private, mini discussion, pray in advance and wait for a response. Mr. Fool ends the gathering, while the members experience a baffling sense of sorrow. 3. Circle of Inevitability Book Two: meetings after The Fool's partial awakening. Volume 5: Demoness Chapter 863 · 1359 Participants: Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha An emergency meeting held with Mr. Fool's permission. Leonard reveals that the Evernight Goddess reminded him through a dream to pay close attention to Harrison. Cattleya realizes the involvement of Bernadette Gustav in Project Vortex. Volume 6: Dream Weaver Chapter 1034 · 1359 Participants: Gehrman Sparrow, Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , and New Major Arcana: Sharron as well as New Major Arcana: Lumian Lee This meeting was conducted after The Fool achieved an initial state of awakening from The Fool's Dream using the identity of Gehrman Sparrow. Temperance Sharron joins the gathering. The Chariot Lumian Lee joins the gathering. Volume 7: Second Law Chapters 1039-1040 · 1359 Participants: Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , Sharron , and Lumian Lee A small meeting conducted to unify the Major Arcana's understanding of Gehrman Sparrow. Chapters 1072-1074 · Spring 1359 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Fors Wall , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Sharron , and Lumian Lee A gathering to divide the spoils of war among the Tarot Club members who participated in Hunting the Hidden Sage. Mr. Fool informs the gathering of the rewards that will go to their allies in the battle. The Uniqueness of the Hidden Sage will go to the God of Steam and Machinery. The Knowledge Emperor Beyonder characteristics containing Sequence 9 to Sequence 1 will go to Bernadette, which is also a reward for her assistance in The Fool's Dream. The Church of the Evernight Goddess will receive the Destined Madness Grade 0 Sealed Artifact and the Beyonder characteristics of Seids, who was corrupted by this Sealed Artifact. Cattleya receives a Sage Beyonder characteristic as a reward for fulfilling her commission from the Fool. Lumian receives the Weather Warlock potion formula and the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Post-Apocalyptic Scripture . Fors receives the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Solomon's Mask . Mr. Fool considers the death of the Hidden Sage his reward. Alger receives Merumu's Spellbook . Audrey receives a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact formed by a Manipulator Beyonder characteristic. Sharron receives Eye of Omniscience . Leonard receives Creator's Hammer , planning to use it to create a self-playing piano. Several Hermit Pathway Beyonder characteristics are to be given to the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society who assisted. The remaining Mid- and Low-Sequence Beyonder characteristics and mystical items obtained are split between Seven of Cups, Two of Cups, and the Church of the Fool. Lumian asks why the Hidden Sage came to life because of the Great Mother . Mr. Fool says only that the problem lies in the West Continent. Chapters 1087-1092 · 1359 Participants: Klein Moretti , Fors Wall , and Lumian Lee A mini-gathering, owing to only a few members being Angels at this point. Fors asks Mr. Fool to explain godhood. Mr. Fool explains the concepts of True Godhood, Apparent Godhood, and the Vague Conception of Godhood that many people have. Mr. Fool also explains high level concepts, including Above the Sequence, the goals of the Great Old Ones, the Original Creator, the history of the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings and God Almighty, the Sefirot, the Pillars, and the theoretical Fourth Pillar. Fors advises Lumian on being an angel, while also revealing her preparations to advance to Key of Stars. She and Lumian worry that her status as a Sequence 1 will make her a target during the Apocalypse. Volume 8: Eternal Aeon Chapter 1128 · 1359 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , and Sharron A small meeting conducted to announce to the other Major Arcana the Chariot Lumian Lee 's intention to devastate the Demoness Sect. Lumian is not present. Mr. Fool instructs Leonard and Derrick to use this battle as an opportunity for advancement to Sequence 2, either through acting or trading for a Beyonder characteristic. Mr. Fool instructs Sharron that Reinette Tinekerr is also to participate. Chapters 1142-1143 · 1360 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , Sharron , and Lumian Lee A meeting to divvy up the spoils of war from the Death of Primordial Demoness and the last meeting before The Apocalypse. While Lumian lacks many valuable artifacts to reward the other members for their participation, he promises to aid them whenever they need. The other members see this as more valuable, now that he is a dual-pathway God. Lumian promises to trade Farbauti's Abomination characteristic to Sharron for the Calamity of Crimson . He then offers to trade Calamity of Crimson to Derrick in exchange for Gift of the Land . If he can resolve its issues, he offers it to Audrey, who in turn offers to lend it to Fors, to help with her plan to relocate the Abraham family to another planet. Lumian offers Fors the chance to travel the Special Mirror Worlds he now controls, in exchange for spreading faith in him. He also shares his new honorific name. Lumian proposes his help to Cattleya and Bernadette in digesting their potions. Lumian also tells Leonard to tell Pallez Zoroast that he owes him a favor. Lumian asks Fors to borrow the Box of the Great Old Ones to resolve the issues on its third level. Xio trades Solomon's Mask to Leonard for Pillar of Severity . She also asserts that she won't be switching to the Black Emperor Pathway . Mr. Fool suggests that since the Book of Calamity task assigned to Alger cannot be completed before the Apocalypse, he instead switches to a neighboring pathway to become an angel sooner. He offers characteristics from the Sun Pathway , White Tower Pathway , or Tyrant Pathway in exchange for The Setting Sun Rooster . Alternatively, he suggests shattering and purifying the Setting Sun Rooster to obtain the characteristic for Profane Presbyter. Alger accepts the latter proposal, deciding to finally live up to his Hanged Man codename in full. Emlyn asks for suggestions on digesting his High Summoner potion. Lumian offers to allow himself to be summoned. Mr. Fool congratulates them all on the success of the operation and remarks that there is about a month left before the Apocalypse. He hopes they will all be present at the next Tarot Meeting. Chapter 1179 · 1360 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , Sharron , and New Major Arcana: Franca Roland The Empress Franca Roland 's first depicted gathering, although she joined previously. She has replaced Lumian, since he is now a God. At Mr. Fool's request, Fors, with help from the others, recounts how she and the Tarot Club, barring Audrey, Emlyn, and Leonard, visited the planet Lorbath, along with Pallez Zoroast , Hela, Reinette Tinekerr , and Aurore Lee. The natives worship Supernova Dominator , and they met the God of Steam and Machinery, who is interested in the local technology. Mr. Fool listens with a smile and doesn't interrupt. title: Tarot Club - Rituals
summary: The ritualistic magic of the Tarot Club in Lord of the Mysteries. Prayers, the sacrificial and bestowment ritual, secret deed ritual, angel embrace, and magic mirror divination.
searchText: Tarot Club - Rituals This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Tarot Club - Rituals ← Back List of Members Gatherings Achievements Rituals "The Fool that doesn't belong to this era; The Mysterious Ruler above the gray fog; The King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck." - The Fool's Honorific Name "With Mr. Fool, rituals aren't tedious and troublesome!" - The Justice on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 220 The ritual is transcribed in Hermes / Ancient Hermes / Jotun. 1. The Fool's Prayers Praying to The Fool allows direct communication with him. If Klein doesn't have time to hear the prayer immediately, he can listen to it later, because the prayers are stored in Sefirah Castle . Klein compared it to "wireless communication" and "offline messages". Outside meetings, it was the main way of communication of the Tarot Club between members, or an intelligence report to The Fool. "I pray for your attention. I pray for you to listen. .... [REPORT] " 1.1 Formal Ritual A ritual to The Fool based on a modified version of the Luck Enhancement Ritual. First, the ritual can be informal, in an environment that won't be disturbed. Put four brand new candles on an altar, placed on four corners respectively. It's best if they are candles with a sandalwood scent. Put a loaf of white bread near the candle on the top left corner, a bowl of Feynapotter noodles near the candle on the top right corner, paella by the candle on the bottom left corner, and a Desi pie by the candle on the bottom right corner. Use a silver knife to make a sealed spiritual environment. Mix moon flowers, gold mint, slumber flowers, fingered citron, and rock-rose together, then distill it. Extract it for its essential oil, then pour a drop onto each candle. The incantation used is The Fool's Honorific Name, alongside the following prayer based off Klein's first observed ritual: "I pray for your help. I pray for your loving grace. I pray for you to give me a good dream. Moon flower, a herb that belongs to the red moon, please bestow your powers to my incantation. Fingered citron, a herb that belongs to the sun, please bestow your powers to my incantation." "If you have any matters to tend to that leave you unable to attend the gathering on Mondays, conduct the ritual and inform me (The Fool). All you have to do is change the line in the incantation 'I pray for a good dream' with the reason." - The Fool Audrey Hall 's experience: Cleanse one's body before the ritual by bathing in water infused with a few drops of the ritual's essential oil. Leaving the bath with a clean and naked body, put on a robe: white for women and black for men. In the same room, conduct the ritual on an impromptu altar (table). Remember to set up a silver-knife-based sealed spiritual environment for protection, then receive The Fool's verbal answer. 1.2 Impromptu Ritual "You have to use a simple ritual and recite my (honorific) name whenever you return to the City of Silver. I will notify you in advance for future gatherings. You need not pay too much attention to it on other days, nor do you have to avoid anyone. When you receive my notification, isolate yourself within a thousand heartbeats." - The Fool to The Sun This is essentially a response to a prayer. The Fool opted to omit the other steps of the ritual, since it was a plea directed toward "Him". The Tarot Club members habitually follow this ritual version as they participate in more active events. Klein Moretti Version: pray to The Fool without the need of essential oils or burnt herbs to obtain powers. 2. The Fool's Sacrificial and Bestowment Ritual Introduced in Volume 2: Faceless . A "delivery service" ritual to The Fool, based off The Sun's initial sacrifice ritual. It was more theoretical, with advice from Azik Eggers . The ritual uses Sefirah Castle as an "air transport" point for the delivery of energies and objects to it. The sacrifice and bestowment was once inspired by anecdotes of Evernight gifting holy items to "Her" believers. Therefore, The Fool desired to let certain materials enter and leave Sefirah Castle, establishing a trade route. First of all, prepare an altar. There's no need to make it too complicated; it can be very simple and crude, using the dualism method. The only requirement is to engrave or draw "His" symbol, the hidden "Pupil-less Eye" and the mysterious symbol of the partial contorted lines, the same symbol on the back of The Fool's chair. Secondly, follow the normal sacrificial ritual procedure, but there's no need to burn any more additional herbs or apply the holy oil. There's no restriction on time, just chanting The Fool's name is enough. Remember to use ancient Hermes or Jotun to recite this piece of prayer: "Your devoted servant prays for your attention, I pray for you to take his offerings. I pray for you to open the gates to your Kingdom." After finishing the chant, combine the materials that contain spirituality with the natural power created by the incantation, and await The Fool's response for the sacrifice. To receive the object from The Fool using the dualism method, recite: "Your devoted servant prays for your attention, I pray for you to open the gates to your Kingdom. I pray for you to give me strength." The ritual creates an illusory gate above the gray fog, similar to the Door of Summoning (Door of Sacrifice and Bestowment). However, a Sequence 8 Clown's spirituality alone couldn't construct a stable channel, and he could only use Sefirah Castle to complete the sacrifice. Dualistic Ritual Method: place a candle above the drawn symbol or deity-related object. One candle was placed in the altar's middle, representing the performer making the sacrifice. Klein Moretti Version: uses Sefirah Castle as a storage facility during his adventures. Derrick Berg Version: uses a candle engraved with The Fool's secret symbol, and recites the sacrificial ritual incantation without setting up a wall of spirituality. 2.1 Preorder Business Model With Audrey Hall requesting to buy an Artisan fresh made Sealed Artifact through Alger Wilson , The Fool's Sacrificial and Bestowment Ritual was used to allow a Sealed Artifact preorder business across the Tarot Club members. 2.2 Rental Business Model With Fors Wall introducing the Leymano's Travels rental post, The Fool's Sacrificial and Bestowment Ritual was used to allow rental businesses across the Tarot Club members. Leymano's Travels : each rental basically starts at 300 pounds. Every additional day is an additional 50 pounds. And when returning it, the notebook needs to have two additional pages of Beyonder powers than when it was rented out. If there's only one blank page or no blank pages when it's rented, one just needs to fill up the full book (38 pages). Unshadowed Crucifix : until the Crucifix was broken to acquire its The Sun blood, the Grade 1 Sealed Artifact was rented at a negotiated price (later barter price once in Derrick Berg 's ownership), to help Tarot Club members expel excess Beyonder characteristics or use the Sun domain to apply to various mysticism actions. 2.3 Records of the Ritual The rows are based on the complete transaction conducted by the circle of "sacrifice" and "bestowment" for the exchange, excluding Klein's "storage space ring" moments. If the transaction is directly to The Fool, a Door of Summoning allows dual "sacrifice" and "bestowment". For potion formulas and some paper records, the powers of The Fool allow no waste of paper and clean up evidence outside Tarot Club meetings. Because of Klein's purposeful confusion, The World is recognized as only Gehrman Sparrow, and will only be referred to as such in the Records. Temporarily receive the "hand-sanitized" Box of the Great Old Ones to release Fors and other trapped Beyonders, then re-store it with The Fool. Cattleya used silver candles. The Fool → Botis Hunting Participants (Bestowment) The Hermit, The Magician, Judgement, The Star, Justice, The World Receive divided spoils of the Botis Hunting. The Fool → Gehrman Sparrow The World Deliver the Sea God Scepter to Alger Wilson . Colin Iliad's bestowment prayer: "The Fool that doesn't belong to this era. The mysterious ruler above the gray fog. The King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck. I pray to you, praying for the strength that stems from mystery, and praying for the bestowment that stems from good luck. I implore you to make these items on this altar turn into charms..." 3. The Fool's Secret Deed Ritual An "exorcism" ritual, based on the ritualistic magic Klein found in Klarman's Book of Secrets, based on the Blood Moon Sacrifice. Its first use was to deal with a clone parasite of Amon attached to Derrick Berg . The process was to use a material rich in spirituality, preferably the blood of a Beyonder, to write the honorable name of the target of the secret deed on an animal hide, and to draw the corresponding symbols and magic labels. If necessary, the specific circumstances of a given time and place also had to be taken into account. When this was done, the ritual host would set up the altar, pick up the piece of hide, and repeat the honorable name, letting their spirituality seep into the hide, gradually spreading it out, little by little, to form a hidden bond with the corresponding great being, and obtaining the corresponding spiritual experience or help. It was a ritual destined to the Primordial Moon. Klein replaced the honorable name with his own, and the symbol with the one carved behind the seat of The Fool in Sefirah Castle . Finally, he had to design the corresponding magic label according to the symbols and his mysticism knowledge. This was the most difficult step. Any mistake would cause the entire ritual to produce unpredictable developments. Lastly, he modified the layout of the original altar to make it closer to "The Fool" and to the "King of Yellow and Black". It could only give knowledge or direct effects such as purification or corruption, letting the target's mind gain a wonderful experience. It couldn't interfere with the divination or other matters done by another person. Simply put, the secret deed ritual directly affected the target's Spirit Body, Astral Projection, Body of Heart and Mind, and Ether Body. The related positive or negative states were removed. The principle of a secret deed ritual is to adjust one's state, release one's mind and body, and align oneself with the target of the prayer bit by bit. Finally, an overlapping will occur, allowing one to acquire the corresponding knowledge. And this kind of alignment and overlapping is relative. While acquiring knowledge, the performer's secrets will also be open to the target of the prayer. It can only be performed on the performer's body, and not towards an external object. 3.1 Records of the Ritual Performer Purpose Derrick Berg Exorcise a clone parasite of Amon from Derrick's body. Capim's Possessed Henchman Fabian Bypass the "order" restriction set on his mind and soul. Emlyn White Exorcise Utravsky's Mental Terror Candle applied psychological cue's remnant. 4. The Fool's Angel Embrace An "angel's blessing" ritual of The Fool, based off the artificial sleepwalking ritual, that allows The Fool greater interference than the secret deed ritual could do before. The "blessing" applies up to Sequence 1.5, and helps keep the blessed calm and safe from harmful mental influences, as well as applying a passive temporary divination-interference buff through a paper angel figure. The Fool later adds the assistance of the Sea God Scepter . 4.1 Upgrade To be added. 4.2 Records of the Ritual Performer Purpose Fors Wall Intervene with divination from Lawrence Nord Abraham. Derrick Berg Bless to survive the Psyche Analyst interrogation observed by Chief Colin. Audrey Hall Bless to survive the Psychology Alchemists official initiation at the home of her psychology teacher, Escalante. Fors Wall Intervene with divination. 5. Magic Mirror Divination A "magic mirror divination" ritual which applied The Fool as a third party to divine secrets of the unknown through the standard magic mirror divination method. The performer of the divination is completely seen by The Fool. title: Third Epoch
summary: A spoiler-marked, detailed guide to the Third Epoch of Lord of the Mysteries: The Glorious Era, the rise of God Almighty, the establishment of the Orthodox Churches, the Solomon Empire, and the events leading to the Fourth Epoch.
searchText: Third Epoch World chronology · major spoilers Third Epoch The Glorious Era—an age of unity under God Almighty, the ascension of the Orthodox Gods, and the rise of the Solomon Empire before its slow descent into ruin. The Third Epoch is known solely as the Glorious Era . Following humanity's revolt at the end of the Second Epoch, the figure known as Adam, who proclaimed himself God Almighty, unified the continent under his rule. It is during this era that the orthodox faiths are established, the Pathway system is codified into the churches, and the first great human empire reaches a height of prosperity and mysticism unseen since before the Dark Epoch. Major spoilers for Lord of the Mysteries and related lore follow. Epoch timeline The year ranges below follow the source-attributed simplified timeline used by the archive. The Third Epoch consists of a single era, the Glorious Era , spanning from the fall of the Second Epoch to the events that ignite the Fourth Epoch. Third Epoch periods and source chronology Era Epoch years BA range Duration Key transition Glorious Era 0–1,086 3,668 BA – 2,582 BA 1,086 years The rise and fall of the age of God Almighty, ending with the outbreak of the Warring Era. Each era name links to its corresponding row in the full world timeline . The reserved future-page target is kept on each row as data-page-target . Overview Dubbed the "Glorious Era", the Third Epoch is remembered as the pinnacle of human civilization in recorded history. For the first time since the First Epoch, humanity was not enslaved to the Ancient Gods of the Second Epoch. Under the unifying rule of God Almighty, the Northern and Central Continents are brought under a singular order. Mysticism flourishes, the churches become the cornerstone of both faith and governance, and the pursuit of becoming a Beyonder is systematized and sanctified across the vast majority of the human population. Despite its name, the Glorious Era is defined by a slow, insidious rot beneath its splendor. Zealotry, schisms, ambition amongst the nobility, increasing infighting between the Orthodox Churches, and the ever growing desire for godhood amongst those of high Sequence all eat away at the utopia that God Almighty had forced into existence. By the end of the epoch, that glory would collapse into total war. God Almighty and the New Order At the close of the Second Epoch's Dawn Era, the man known as Adam rose to prominence. He would come to be known as God Almighty , the Ancient Sun God returned to his full authority. Utilizing his immense power and authority over the Sun Pathway , he spearheaded humanity's final revolt, personally slaying the Elf King and Dragon of Imagination, gravely wounding the Giant King and Phoenix Ancestor, and forcing the Devil Monarch to sacrifice the vast majority of his strength to seal the Abyss. With the rule of the Ancient Gods shattered, God Almighty united humanity under his banner. He positioned himself not as a king of man, but as the sole Creator-God of the current world, the Omniscient and Omnipotent God. His reign was absolute. The notion of divine right was no longer contested, for the one that broke the yoke of the Ancient Gods now sat above all creation. Under his rule, heretical faiths were purged, the Pathways were distributed and controlled through the upcoming Orthodox order, and a new golden age was forged. God Almighty would rule for the vast majority of the Glorious Era. However, towards its latter half, his activities become more secretive. His gaze turns inwards and towards greater existences, his presence within the material world grows more distant, and his direct intervention becomes exceedingly rare. Many attribute this to his attempts to accommodate more power, to reclaim what was lost, or to ascend even further beyond his current state. Whatever the truth may be, his growing absence would prove catastrophic for the order he created. The Seven Orthodox Gods In order to solidify his rule and to create a stable order that could persist, God Almighty elevated a select few to godhood. These beings would come to be known as the Seven Orthodox Gods . Each would be entrusted with their own authority, their own Pathway, and their own flock, acting as the pillars of the new divine order whilst still ultimately falling under the dominion of God Almighty. The generally accepted seven Orthodox Gods of the Third Epoch are as follows: Goddess of Evernight Night Domain Lord of Storms Storm Domain Eternal Blazing Sun Sun Domain God of Knowledge and Wisdom Knowledge & Wisdom God of Steam and Machinery Steam & Machinery Earth Mother Earth & Harvest God of Combat War & Combat Each of these deities holds dominion over a cluster of related Pathways, granting them immense influence over their respective Churches. Whilst their faiths coexisted under the banner of God Almighty for the majority of the era, doctrine, territory, and the scramble for influence would breed tension with each passing century. Many suspect that not all seven ascended through the same means, and that the interests of each god had already begun to diverge long before the era's end. Establishment of the Orthodox Churches With the Seven Orthodox Gods ascended, God Almighty commissioned the establishment of the Orthodox Churches . These were not mere places of worship, but colossal, state-encompassing organizations. They acted as the arbiters of faith, the distributors of Beyonder resources, the enforcers of doctrine, the educators of the masses, and in many regions, the direct extensions of imperial authority. The Churches were built with extreme care around the Pathway system. Through sanctioned ritual, prayer, and the distribution of potions, they controlled the spread of mysticism throughout humanity. Becoming a Beyonder was no longer a matter of stumbling into chaos as it was in the Dark Epoch, but could be done through the Church's sanctioned paths, albeit only under their strict supervision and usually only for those deemed loyal or useful. The most prominent of these would come to dominate the continent. The Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun , the Church of the Lord of Storms , the Church of Evernight , the Church of Steam and Machinery , the Church of Knowledge and Wisdom , the Church of the Earth Mother , and the Church of the God of Combat all established cathedrals, seminaries, inquisitorial orders, and their own internal hierarchies of Beyonders. Often, a single diocese would see fierce competition between the orders of differing Churches. God Almighty's own faith remained supreme, preached as the worship of the Omniscient and Omnipotent God above all. In practice, however, the vast majority of the populace would find themselves worshipping one of the Seven Orthodox Gods as their patron far more often than they would directly worship God Almighty himself. The Solomon Empire As the Glorious Era progressed, temporal power coalesced into what would become the greatest human empire of the age: the Solomon Empire . Blessed by God Almighty and supported by nearly every Orthodox Church, the Solomon Empire unified the Northern Continent under its banner, subjugating the last holdouts of old kingdoms and bringing them into the new divine order. The Solomon Empire was the embodiment of the Glorious Era. Its cities were grand beyond compare, its cathedrals pierced the clouds, its academies pushed the boundaries of both orthodox theology and mysticism, and its armies were bolstered by countless sanctioned Beyonders from across the Churches. Trade flourished, the Hermes Language spread to every corner of the empire, and for the first time in history, humanity could rightfully call itself the ruler of the known world rather than its slave. The imperial family, staunch adherents to the faith of God Almighty, were believed to be divinely ordained to rule in his name during his absence. Emperors would oftentimes be anointed by the highest representatives of the Churches, with the implicit understanding that the throne existed to uphold God's will and to act as the sword of the divine order. For centuries, the Solomon Empire reigned as an uncontested colossus. However, as the centuries wore on, imperial authority began to wane. The Churches grew too powerful for even the Emperor to rein in, the nobility grew decadent and power hungry, and the belief in God Almighty's imminent return began to be replaced with politicking, ambition, and heretical thoughts of godhood. Whispers of the empire's "glory" began to sour into obsession, envy, and greed. Sephirot, Pathways and the Divine Order The Glorious Era is also notable for the immense progress made in understanding Beyonder pathways. Building off of the groundwork laid at the very end of the Second Epoch, the Churches, under the supervision of God Almighty and the Orthodox Gods, began to fully compile, verify and sanctify potion formulas for the vast majority of known Pathways. It was during this era that the concept of the Sephirot became more widely known amongst the upper echelons of the Churches. The twenty-two pathways were categorized and tied to the divine order, with each Orthodox God having their own domain over a set of them. The idea of climbing the Sequence ladder in service to a god became the "correct" and "holy" way of advancement, as opposed to the reckless, blasphemous and chaotic pursuit of godhood that had plagued the previous epochs. God Almighty himself was understood to stand above all Pathways. The Seven Orthodox Gods acted as his deputies, each a lord over their own portion of authority. The Churches would go to great lengths to demonize any form of Beyonder advancement that did not fall under their sanctioned routes, branding them as heresy, the work of evil gods, or a return to the chaos of the Dark Epoch. Despite this control, the thirst for power proved impossible to fully suppress. Countless secret organizations, cults worshipping the Outer Deities, hidden families attempting to usurp authority, and ambitious individuals seeking to become gods in their own right all festered beneath the gilded surface of the Glorious Era. Decline and the Road to the Fourth Epoch The decline of the Third Epoch was not brought about by a single event, but by a culmination of centuries of rot. God Almighty's increasing absence created a power vacuum at the very top of the divine order. With their master growing distant, the Seven Orthodox Gods began to act more and more in their own interests, forming alliances, betraying one another, and competing for influence over the Solomon Empire and its vast territories. The Churches, now behemoths with their own armies, lands, and legions of high-Sequence Beyonders, began to care less about serving God Almighty and more about expanding their own power. The Empire, caught in the middle, attempted to mediate and control, only to find itself increasingly powerless against the very institutions that were propping it up. Tensions finally snapped into open conflict. The peace of the Glorious Era gave way to all out war between the Orthodox Churches, their vassals, and ambitious forces within the Empire. This conflict would come to be known as the precursor to the Warring Era of the Fourth Epoch. The Solomon Empire would be torn asunder, God Almighty's divine order would be shattered beyond repair, and the continent would be plunged into a new age of endless strife. With the outbreak of war, the Glorious Era drew to a close. The age of unity was dead. The age of war had begun. ↑

title: Twilight Giant Pathway
summary: Twilight Giant Pathway: The Twilight Giant Pathway is a traditional warrior pathway combining offensive and defensive abilities: extreme strength, weapon
searchText: Twilight Giant Pathway Eternal Darkness · Standard Pathway Twilight Giant Pathway Sequence 9: Warrior → Sequence 0: Twilight Giant The Twilight Giant Pathway is a traditional warrior pathway combining offensive and defensive abilities: extreme strength, weapon mastery, supernatural resistance, Dawn-light weapons and armor, protection, and high-sequence alchemy and concealment. Its Above the Sequence is Eternal Darkness, and its corresponding Sefirah is the River of Eternal Darkness. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Twilight Giant Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Warrior Supernatural strength and agility, with mastery of weapons, armor, combat, and martial arts. 8 Pugilist Physical abilities weaken some Beyonder powers; supernatural resistance and exceptional close-quarters combat. 7 Weapon Master Uses any weapon at master level, including Beyonder weapons, while reducing their negative effects. 6 Dawn Paladin Giant-like strength, Dawn Light, conjured Dawn Armor and weapons, plus Hurricane of Light that purifies evil. 5 Guardian Creates protective walls to absorb damage for companions, gains illusion immunity, and greatly strengthens prior abilities. 4 Demon Hunter Identifies weaknesses and corruption, crafts alchemical effects, conceals intentions, and strengthens protection and Dawn powers. 3 Silver Knight Liquefies into mercury, manifests teleporting Silver Rapiers and Light Concealment, and materializes powerful Silver Armor. 2 Glory Uses simplified Twilight, Combat, and Holiness authorities; forms sealing Cages, Twilight Swords, and annihilating light storms. 1 Hand of God Channels a pledged deity's power through Proxy, briefly lends marks, and strengthens Protection with radiant Cages. 0 Twilight Giant Wields Twilight, Holiness, Combat, and Proxy; causes decay, aging, purification, devastation, protection, and time-slowing effects. Pathway themes & abilities Its core authorities are Twilight, Combat, Holiness, and Proxy, with Decay and the Passage of Time as symbols. Progression emphasizes combat mastery and physical growth before adding Dawn purification, protection, alchemy, concealment, mercurial liquefaction, aging and decay, and deity-mediated power. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Demon Hunter: Identifies weaknesses and corruption, crafts alchemical effects, conceals intentions, and strengthens protection and Dawn powers. Sequence 3 — Silver Knight: Liquefies into mercury, manifests teleporting Silver Rapiers and Light Concealment, and materializes powerful Silver Armor. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Glory: Uses simplified Twilight, Combat, and Holiness authorities; forms sealing Cages, Twilight Swords, and annihilating light storms. Sequence 1 — Hand of God: Channels a pledged deity's power through Proxy, briefly lends marks, and strengthens Protection with radiant Cages. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Twilight Giant: Wields Twilight, Holiness, Combat, and Proxy; causes decay, aging, purification, devastation, protection, and time-slowing effects. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers for Lord of Mysteries and Circle of Inevitability . The Twilight Giant pathway’s “twilight” motif carries historical weight: its Sequence 0, the God of Combat, was once Badheil, eldest son of Giant King Aurmir and Goddess of Harvest Omebella. In the Second Epoch he served Aurmir; later he joined the Rose Redemption faction whose rebellion helped bring down the Ancient Sun God. Much later, the God of Combat’s killing by Evernight and Lilith ended the 1350 World War. In the Forsaken Land, Colin Iliad led the City of Silver; he died restraining Sasrir at Giant King’s Court so Derrick could open a path to the outside sunlight Story connections Ancient succession and betrayal: Badheil inherited divine power after Aurmir fell, became the Twilight Giant Sequence 0, and joined Rose Redemption; in the Fifth Epoch his death at Evernight and Lilith’s hands concluded the 1350 World War A city enduring the darkness: The City of Silver survived 2,582 years in the Forsaken Land after the sun vanished. Its people found a route out through Giant King’s Court, then established the New City of Silver, which became a Church of the Fool holy land Colin’s final sacrifice: Chief Colin Iliad, a Twilight Giant demigod, died restraining the Dark Angel spirit Sasrir during the last investigation of Giant King’s Court. His death gave Derrick time to open the gate; Colin’s final revelations included the City’s “ Gift of the Land ” curse Figures to know Badheil God of Combat: Former God of Dawn and Aurmir’s eldest son; eventually became Sequence 0 of Twilight Giant and was killed by Evernight and Lilith Aurmir Giant King: Ruled the Kingdom of Silver and passed his power to Badheil after his fall Colin Iliad City of Silver chief: Twilight Giant Sequence 3 Silver Knight, responsible for his city’s survival and central to its exit from the Forsaken Land Evernight Goddess (Amanises) One of the two deities who killed the God of Combat; the other was Lilith, acting under the guise of the Earth Mother Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. searchText: Tyrant Pathway God Almighty · Standard Pathway Tyrant Pathway Sequence 9: Sailor → Sequence 0: Tyrant The Tyrant Pathway focuses on water and weather, combining water, wind, electricity, underwater capability, flight, disabling song, and anger-fueled power. At high Sequences it extends to sea-creature command, ocean dominion, earthquakes, light-speed travel, immense electricity, and fear or oppression. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Tyrant Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Sailor Aquatic traits provide underwater endurance, fishlike swimming, illusory scales, exceptional balance, and enhanced physical strength. 8 Folk of Rage Physical enhancement combines wrath-driven strength and speed with a stored-hit Raging Blow powered by accumulated anger. 7 Seafarer Improved ocean affinity, navigation, memory, calculation, and limited water spells support seafaring and underwater activity. 6 Wind-blessed Wind-blessed controls wind and water, glides or flies briefly, creates windblades, dives deeply, floats, and sees in darkness. 5 Ocean Songster Ocean Songster wields lightning, spiritually influential singing, stronger wind and water control, aquatic communication, oxygen extraction, and pressure resistance. 4 Cataclysmic Interrer Cataclysmic Interrer summons hurricanes, tsunamis, earthquakes, downpours, floods, lightning chains, windblade legions, and true flight. 3 Sea King Sea King commands marine life and seas, walks seabeds, raises tsunamis, creates lightning storms, and unleashes destructive water droplets. 2 Calamity Calamity gains city-destroying storms, tsunamis, and cold, plus terror-inducing sound, magnetic manipulation, electromagnetic disruption, and grief-laden singing. 1 Thunder God Thunder God becomes near-light-speed energy and commands thunder, wind, and calamities through heavenly punishment, Storm Hell, and Ocean of Lightning. 0 Tyrant Tyrant commands matter, thunder, water, wind, calamity, and intimidation, converting energy and unleashing vast electromagnetic storms and disasters. Pathway themes & abilities Its recurring domains are sea, land, and air, with abilities centered on water, wind, weather, electricity, aquatic life, and calamity. The pathway also emphasizes wrath, intimidation, and horror: users can instill or resist fear and weaponize voice, storms, and thunder. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Cataclysmic Interrer: Cataclysmic Interrer summons hurricanes, tsunamis, earthquakes, downpours, floods, lightning chains, windblade legions, and true flight. Sequence 3 — Sea King: Sea King commands marine life and seas, walks seabeds, raises tsunamis, creates lightning storms, and unleashes destructive water droplets. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Calamity: Calamity gains city-destroying storms, tsunamis, and cold, plus terror-inducing sound, magnetic manipulation, electromagnetic disruption, and grief-laden singing. Sequence 1 — Thunder God: Thunder God becomes near-light-speed energy and commands thunder, wind, and calamities through heavenly punishment, Storm Hell, and Ocean of Lightning. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Tyrant: Tyrant commands matter, thunder, water, wind, calamity, and intimidation, converting energy and unleashing vast electromagnetic storms and disasters. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers for both novels. The Tyrant’s Sequence 0 is the Lord of Storms, whose church controls this pathway. The deity was Leodero, formerly the Ancient Sun God’s Wind Angel. Leodero joined Rose Redemption, whose conspiracy eventually led to the Ancient Sun God’s death, and rose to Sequence 0 afterward. Alger Wilson ’s modern arc links the storm church to the Sea God faith in the Rorsted Archipelago: he left the storm church to become the Sea God Church’s masked pontiff, later attained Sea God status, and by the end of Circle of Inevitability had switched to the Hanged Man pathway Story connections Leodero’s succession: Wind Angel under the Ancient Sun God, member of Rose Redemption, then Lord of Storms after the Ancient Sun God’s death Alger’s church realignment: Alger left the Church of the Lord of Storms and became the masked pontiff of the Sea God Church in Rorsted; he later became its Sea God and eventually switched pathways Bayam conflict: In the 1350 World War, the Lord of Storms fought alongside the Evernight Goddess against the God of Steam and Machinery in Bayam; their side won Figures to know Leodero former Wind Angel and the Lord of Storms, Sequence 0 of Tyrant Alger Wilson former Church of the Lord of Storms operative and Tarot Club’s Hanged Man; later Sea God Church pontiff and Sea God Ancient Sun God Leodero’s former master; his death is tied to Rose Redemption’s conspiracy Major story spoilers. title: Uncertain Mist
summary: The Uncertain Mist is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth.
searchText: Uncertain Mist Outer Deity Uncertain Mist Overview Other Identities : Son of Chaos, Uncertain Mist The Uncertain Mist is one of the Outer Deities from the Cosmos that attempted to invade Earth. "He" is the remaining part of the Son of Chaos in the Cosmos after "He" sent "His" main consciousness down to Earth. "He" is the current owner of the Chaos Mist. Honorific Name Bridge of Light and Darkness; Interstice Between Black and White; Ever-Uncertain Mist; The Truth that Oversees All Things (光与暗的桥梁， 黑与白之间隙， 永不确定的迷雾， 监督万物的真理) Symbols, Authorities & Abilities See also: Son of Chaos TRANSLATION NOTE In the original Chinese text, 真理 (zhēnlǐ) and 真实 (zhēnshí) are distinct terms with different nuances, though both can be translated as “Truth” in English, as is done in the English WebNovel translation (School of Truth and the symbolism of Truth respectively). This note will illustrate the different meanings lost in translation. Chaos Mist's Truth (真理, zhēnlǐ): Universal Truth; It denotes a universal, objective, or philosophical truth that reflects the fundamental principles of reality, often absolute or unchanging. Sublunary Eye's Truth (真实, zhēnshí): Truth/Reality; It denotes factual existence, genuineness, or something that is not false or illusory, often concrete and verifiable. "He" possesses full Authority over the Chaos Mist and the corresponding Symbols , which include but are not limited to the following: Chaos Mist: Authorities over Deconstruction , Truth , and Chaos . The Symbols , Authorities , and Abilities "He" possesses and displays at the Above the Sequence level include: Chaos : As one of the three direct children of the Original Creator, the Son of Chaos inherently possesses the Chaos quality of the Original Creator. 5 As the Uncertain Mist possesses the Chaos Mist, "He" possesses the Chaos aspect of the Son of Chaos. As the Primordial Hunger possesses Primordium and Chaos qualities, "He" prioritized devouring the Sefirot and Great Old Ones related to those qualities the most. Among the Outer Deities, "He" preferred the Uncertain Mist the most, 6 because "He" is the Chaos Gastric Juices, while the Uncertain Mist is a part of the Son of Chaos. 7 Gray : "His" Chaos Mist is the gray between white and black, the fog between light and darkness, the bridge between Order and the Shadows of Order of the Son of Chaos. 8 Transaction : Without the Uncertain Mist present to coordinate and unify the Outer Deities into an alliance, none dared bet on receiving support if "They" stayed behind to deal with the Lord of Mysteries. 2 Book 2, chapter 1165 Without the Uncertain Mist, the Outer Deities would be disunited, each fighting for "Themselves", and would easily be driven back by Earth's Above the Sequences after The Apocalypse. 9 Overseeing : With the strengthened Overseer ability at the Great Old One level, "He" could only be harmed by existences possessing a Sefirah. 10 Appearance It occupies a solid, massive planet in the Cosmos. The planet is shrouded in layers of ever-changing white mist. 11 The size and state of the dense white mist was indescribable. 3 Book 2, chapter 884 History As one of the Original Creator's direct children, the Son of Chaos was the most affected by the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence when the Original Creator awakened in the Pre-Epoch, resulting in part of "His" Sefirah, Beyonder Characteristics, and Uniquenesses being attracted to Earth. Part of "His" torn Sefirah later self-completed into the Nation of Disorder, while "He" retained influence over "His" lost Pathways on Earth. However, "He" was able to bypass the barrier by killing "Himself" and then resurrecting through the Black Emperor ability. 12 In the First Epoch, the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings sealed the Genie, the consciousness of the Son of Chaos, in the Magic Wishing Lamp. 13 Most of "His" remaining parts were in the depths of the universe as the Outer Deity called the Uncertain Mist. 14 As of 1358, the Uncertain Mist, along with the Mother Goddess of Depravity and the Mother Tree of Desire, were the three Outer Deities can bestow godhood through Boons without much difficulty. 15 "He" is the Deity worshipped by the School of Truth, a Secret Organization founded after year 1352 of the Fifth Epoch. By 1358, the School of Truth were looking for clues to three things: the Fallen Heaven, Roselle's final mausoleum, and the Magic Wishing Lamp. 4 Book 2, chapter 713 During Project Vortex in 1359 of the Fifth Epoch, both the Uncertain Mist and the Genie inside the Magic Wishing Lamp were heavily injured by the combined efforts of Adam, Amon, Roselle Gustav and Bernadette Gustav. 3 The planet the Uncertain Mist was residing on shattered and "It" was forced to retreat into the depths of the endless, dead, and dark Cosmos. As "It" suffered a heavy blow, "It" would have to sleep for decades. For sixty years, the Uncertain Mist would not be able to come again, ensuring one less danger during The Apocalypse. 3 As the Uncertain Mist would not be able to bestow any Boons till then, no more Beyonders of the Chaos Mist Pathway would appear before The Apocalypse. During The Apocalypse, without the Uncertain Mist to coordinate and unify the Outer Deities into an alliance, none dared to bet on receiving support if "They" stayed behind to face and eliminate the Lord of Mysteries Klein Moretti. 16 As a result, once The Fool Grafted the various Sefirot away, the Outer Deities scattered according to "Their" targets. After The Apocalypse, Klein intended to fulfill his promise to return the Magic Wishing Lamp to the universe, using it to lure out the hiding Uncertain Mist and secretly influence "Him". Without the Uncertain Mist, the Outer Deities would be disunited, and would easily be driven away. 17 The Genie and the Uncertain Mist are hostile towards each other. 18 Whether the Uncertain Mist or the Genie would emerge victorious after "They" merged is unknown, both scenarios are equally plausible. 19 See Also Son of Chaos Translations Language Name English Uncertain Mist Chinese 不定之雾 Thai - References Author's WeChat post um. title: Visionary Pathway
summary: Visionary Pathway: The Visionary Pathway specializes in psychological manipulation: its Beyonders can read minds, discern emotions, hypnotize, and travel
searchText: Visionary Pathway God Almighty · Standard Pathway Visionary Pathway Sequence 9: Spectator → Sequence 0: Visionary The Visionary Pathway specializes in psychological manipulation: its Beyonders can read minds, discern emotions, hypnotize, and travel through dreams. At high Sequences, they can enter and influence the Mind World, create realistic dreams and virtual personas, affect reality through thought and imagination, and hold the authorities of Envisioning, Psyche, and Discernment, with partial authority over Dreams and Loss of Control. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Visionary Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Spectator Analyzes expressions, manners, and subconscious actions to infer a target's thoughts and connections. 8 Telepathist Reads superficial thoughts, simulates their trajectory, and deepens observation beyond visible body language. 7 Psychiatrist Uses telepathy, psychological cues, frenzy, awe, and psychoanalysis to directly affect targets. 6 Hypnotist Conceals presence psychologically and hypnotizes consciousness or subconsciousness through focused suggestions. 5 Dreamwalker Alters dreams, guides subconscious disclosure, and traverses between intelligent beings' dreams. 4 Manipulator Enters Mind Islands to implant manipulation, mental plagues, mind storms, and virtual personas. 3 Dream Weaver Weaves realistic dreams and projections that attack mental weaknesses and can induce corruption. 2 Discerner Discerns psychological vulnerabilities and causal traces, builds Dream Mazes, and strengthens dream weaving. 1 Author Envisions concepts into reality, controls coincidence, intertwines dreams with reality, and influences minds. 0 Visionary Makes imagined things materialize, brings envisioned divine kingdoms into the world, and realizes proclaimed futures. Pathway themes & abilities Its core progression moves from observation and mind reading into hypnosis, dream manipulation, subconscious control, discernment, and reality-shaping imagination. The consolidated abilities article specifically supports Body Language Analysis, Mind Reading, Telepathy, Psychological Cues, Hypnosis, Dream Traversal, Manipulation, Dream Weaving, Discernment, Envisioning, and Psyche among the pathway's signature abilities. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Manipulator: Enters Mind Islands to implant manipulation, mental plagues, mind storms, and virtual personas. Sequence 3 — Dream Weaver: Weaves realistic dreams and projections that attack mental weaknesses and can induce corruption. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Discerner: Discerns psychological vulnerabilities and causal traces, builds Dream Mazes, and strengthens dream weaving. Sequence 1 — Author: Envisions concepts into reality, controls coincidence, intertwines dreams with reality, and influences minds. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — Visionary: Makes imagined things materialize, brings envisioned divine kingdoms into the world, and realizes proclaimed futures. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers for Lord of Mysteries. Adam is not merely a high-level Visionary: born as a Sequence 1 Author with the Visionary Uniqueness, he is the Ancient Sun God’s son and the vessel in which that god’s divinity awakens. The Ancient Sun God’s humanity and death-born extremes instead form the True Creator, leaving Adam and the True Creator as divided aspects in conflict over which persona will dominate; during Klein’s apotheosis, Adam partially fuses with him and remains dominant. Adam also leads the Twilight Hermit Order, which steers political events from the shadows in pursuit of the Ancient Sun God’s return Story connections Major spoiler — the Ancient Sun God’s fall: Rose Redemption’s coup killed the Ancient Sun God; his death split the godhood that awakens in Adam from the humanity and extreme emotions that become the True Creator, and the fall left the Forsaken Land of the Gods cursed and cut off The Order’s intervention in history: The Twilight Hermit Order secretly backed George Augustus III’s bid to become Black Emperor and aggravated Loen’s political conflict with Feysac, helping precipitate the war that became a world war. Roselle Gustav had earlier belonged to the Order and gained knowledge through its gatherings Major spoiler — Klein’s apotheosis: Adam partially fused with the True Creator during Klein’s apotheosis ritual, with Adam dominant; the wiki says this temporarily elevated him to a Half Great Old One Figures to know Adam Angel of Imagination, child of the Ancient Sun God, Visionary-pathway Uniqueness bearer, and Twilight Hermit Order leader Ancient Sun God Adam’s father; his death is the source of the divided Adam/True Creator legacy True Creator the other aspect of the Ancient Sun God, later partially fused with Adam during Klein’s ritual Roselle Gustav former Twilight Hermit Order member whose membership connects the organization to the novel’s historical revelations Major story spoilers. title: Volume 1: Clown
summary: Summary and guide for Volume 1: Clown of Lord of the Mysteries. Includes overview, title meaning, and chapter synopsis.
searchText: Volume 1: Clown This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Volume 1: Clown ← Back Quote "Everyone will die, including me." , Cuttlefish That Loves Diving on Volume 1: Clown Overview Clown is the first volume of the Lord of Mysteries series written by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving. It details the story of Klein Moretti as he first arrives in the world of Lord of the Mysteries, his becoming a Beyonder and his adventures with the Nighthawks. Title Meaning The meaning of the title Clown refers both to Klein's promotion to Sequence 8 Clown, as well as his inability to withstand the vicissitudes, yet still smiling and continuing along anyway. In this volume, a clown is established to mean those who cannot do anything about their fate, yet continue to smile at it. Despite the many deaths that occur, Klein and the rest of the Nighthawks continue to confront their fates without becoming despondent, fulfilling the meaning of Clown. Synopsis Transmigration In the early morning of June 28, 1349, Klein Moretti committed suicide, leaving a note that read: "Everyone will die, including me." Zhou Mingrui, a history graduate from modern Earth, transmigrates into Klein's body through a Luck Enhancement Ritual, though the inherited memories are incomplete. Discovery of The Gray Fog Attempting to return to Earth through the luck ritual, Klein instead discovers The Gray Fog, a mysterious transcendent space. He accidentally summons two fellow Beyonders above this fog: Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson . Recognizing an opportunity, Klein assumes the mysterious persona of "Mr. Fool" and establishes the Tarot Club as a clandestine gathering for sharing information and trading Beyonder ingredients. Joining the Nighthawks Klein obtains the Antigonus Family's Notebook , which leads him to join the Blackthorn Security Company, a division of the Nighthawks, as civilian staff. He quickly becomes a Beyonder of the Fool Pathway and, through the Acting Method detailed in Roselle's Diary, advances to Sequence 8: Clown under the Church's guidance. Conspiracy and Betrayal During his time with the Nighthawks, Klein experiences a series of unnatural coincidences in rapid succession. Though suspicious, he realizes too late that Ince Zangwill, a mysterious mastermind, has orchestrated everything. Zangwill uses a True Creator's spawn to target Klein with the devastating Sealed Artifact 0-08. Death and Resurrection Klein is killed alongside Nighthawk captain Dunn Smith in the confrontation. However, he mysteriously returns from death. Seeking greater strength and advancement, Klein relocates to Backlund, where he begins his quest for revenge while continuing to strengthen himself through the Fool Pathway . ← Back Home

title: Volume 2: Faceless
summary: Summary and guide for Volume 2: Faceless of Lord of the Mysteries. Includes overview, title meaning, and chapter synopsis.
searchText: Volume 2: Faceless This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Volume 2: Faceless ← Back Quote "It was the best of times, it was the worst of times." , Charles Dickens Overview Faceless is the second volume of the Lord of Mysteries series. It details Klein Moretti 's arrival in Backlund and his new identity as Sherlock Moriarty. Title Meaning The title Faceless refers to Klein's promotion to sequence 6 Faceless, as well as the faceless people of East Backlund. It also represents Klein's changing identities and masks. Synopsis The Detective Returns Klein arrives in Backlund, the grand capital city, and establishes himself under a new identity: Sherlock Moriarty, a renowned private detective. This new persona allows him to operate in high society and investigate matters that align with his growing power and influence. Unraveling Conspiracies As Sherlock, Klein becomes entangled in various conspiracies and mysteries that plague Backlund. He navigates complex social networks and dangerous intrigue while building his detective career, all while advancing his understanding of the Fool Pathway . Sequence Advancement Through his investigations and encounters with mysterious forces, Klein makes significant progress on his spiritual path. He undergoes the trials necessary for the next sequence promotion, becoming increasingly faceless and enigmatic. ← Back Home

title: Volume 3: Traveler
summary: Summary and guide for Volume 3: Traveler of Lord of the Mysteries. Includes overview, title meaning, and chapter synopsis.
searchText: Volume 3: Traveler This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Volume 3: Traveler ← Back Quote "Every journey has its destination." , Cuttlefish That Loves Diving Overview Traveler is the third volume. Klein leaves Backlund and travels at sea under the identity of Gehrman Sparrow, meeting new friends and hunting pirates. Title Meaning The title refers to Klein's travels across the seas and his encounters with various people and creatures while maintaining his distance as a traveler. Synopsis The Wandering Detective Klein sets sail across the Sonia Sea as Gehrman Sparrow, a wandering sailor and adventurer. This new identity allows him to explore distant lands while maintaining distance from his previous entanglements. Encounters with Pirates and Mysteries During his travels, Klein becomes entangled with pirates, pirate hunters, and various mysterious forces seeking the legendary Cards of Blasphemy. His journeys expose him to dangerous powers and forbidden knowledge that test both his wit and his growing abilities. Spiritual Growth and Promotion Through his maritime adventures and encounters with powerful adversaries, Klein gains valuable experience and spiritual insights. His journey leads to significant promotions along the Fool Pathway and an expanded sphere of influence across the seas. ← Back Home

title: Volume 4: Undying
summary: Summary and guide for Volume 4: Undying of Lord of the Mysteries. Includes overview, title meaning, and chapter synopsis.
searchText: Volume 4: Undying This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Volume 4: Undying ← Back Quote Undying is a bestowment or a curse. , Cuttlefish That Loves Diving Overview Undying is the fourth volume of the Lord of Mysteries series. Title Meaning Undying refers to the theme of immortality and resurrection that permeates this volume, representing both a gift and a curse to various characters. Synopsis Rise to Godhood Klein ascends to become a demigod and returns to Backlund with newfound power and authority. His promotion marks a significant turning point in his journey, granting him abilities that far exceed his previous limitations. Secrets and Conspiracies Upon his return, Klein uncovers dark secrets about the royal family and powerful factions operating in the shadows. He discovers hidden conspiracies that threaten the very foundation of society and challenge everything he thought he understood. Confrontation and Revenge Klein confronts various powerful forces in his relentless quest for revenge and advancement. These confrontations test his newfound godly powers and force him to make difficult choices that reshape the political landscape of Backlund. ← Back Home

This knowledge fundamentally alters his understanding of his place in the cosmos. Ancient forces thought long dormant awaken, and multiple pathways to divinity collide in spectacular confrontation. Convergence of Powers As the strongest powers in existence clash, Klein must navigate through a labyrinth of deception, betrayal, and revelation. The fate of the world hangs in the balance as he fights to protect those he cares about while pursuing his ultimate goals. ← Back Home

searchText: Volume 8: Fool This page includes spoilers from across the novels. ↑ Volume 8: Fool ← Back Quote The Fool walks the path of the extraordinary. , Cuttlefish That Loves Diving Overview Fool is the eighth and final volume of the Lord of Mysteries series. Title Meaning The Fool represents Klein's journey from an ordinary person to an extraordinary being, coming full circle with the card that started it all. Synopsis The Ultimate Confrontation In this concluding volume, Klein faces his ultimate confrontation with the forces that have shaped his destiny. All the mysteries and questions that have haunted him throughout his journey finally reach their resolution. Full Circle The Fool's journey comes full circle as Klein returns to the beginning, but transformed by all he has experienced. The story of the Fool completes its narrative arc in a climactic and unforgettable finale. The End of Mysteries The mysteries of the world reveal their deepest truths, and the Lord of Mysteries' dominion reaches its ultimate expression. The conclusion of the Fool's story marks the end of an era and the beginning of a new world. ← Back Home
