title: Wheel of Fortune Pathway
summary: Wheel of Fortune Pathway: The Wheel of Fortune Pathway, also called the Fate Pathway, represents the possibility of fate and Chaos. Its Above the Sequence
searchText: Wheel of Fortune Pathway Key of Light · Standard Pathway Wheel of Fortune Pathway Sequence 9: Monster → Sequence 0: Wheel of Fortune The Wheel of Fortune Pathway, also called the Fate Pathway, represents the possibility of fate and Chaos. Its Above the Sequence and Sefirah are both the Key of Light, and its Beyonders can travel freely in the River of Fate. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local Wheel of Fortune Pathway ingredient archive → Sequence progression Sequence titles are retained from the archive; key ability notes are concise paraphrases of the linked source material. Seq. Name Key abilities 9 Monster Exceptional spiritual perception detects otherwise unseen things, sometimes glimpses the future, and warns of danger. 8 Robot Enhances physical and mental control, calculation, divination, anti-divination, and danger perception. 7 Lucky One Passively attracts fluctuating lucky events, though the user cannot reliably depend on this luck. 6 Calamity Priest Attracts calamities passively or actively, uses foresight and luck, and projects a disorienting Psyche Storm. 5 Winner Uses foresight, curses enemies with misfortune, accumulates luck, and produces a drowsiness-inducing Psyche Storm. 4 Misfortune Mage Creates misfortune fields, grants luck through blessings, senses fate changes, and strengthens life-threatening misfortune curses. 3 Chaoswalker Discerns or seals disordered fate, cleanses spirits, and gains partial authority over Disorder. 2 Soothsayer Uses fate connections through dreams or objects, prophesies outcomes, reveals fate, and bestows fortune or misfortune. 1 Snake of Mercury Controls Cycle and Reboot, trapping targets in fate loops, restoring saved states, and embodying the Snake of Mercury. 0 Wheel of Fortune Embodies Fate, controls Probability, Cycle, Disorder, and Light Cone World, and manipulates luck, prophecy, and outcomes. Pathway themes & abilities Its central authorities are Fate, Probability, Cycle, and Disorder, supported by Good Luck, Bad Luck, Foresight, Save, and Select. The progression moves from danger-sensing and divination to deliberate calamity, blessings, misfortune fields, prophecy, fate connections, reincarnation, and rebooting. Rather than winning through raw force, the pathway changes the conditions around an event until the desired outcome becomes the most likely—or the only surviving—possibility. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities These are the defining capabilities that separate the upper pathway from its lower-Sequence foundations. Details contain major spoilers. Misfortune Mage The saint-level pathway user can create misfortune fields, strengthen life-threatening curses, sense changes in fate, and counterbalance bad luck with blessings that push probability toward survival. Chaoswalker and Soothsayer These levels read and redirect disordered fate. They can cleanse spiritual contamination, trace fate through dreams or objects, reveal possible outcomes, and bestow either fortune or misfortune on a target. Snake of Mercury and Wheel of Fortune At the angelic and divine peak, Cycle and Reboot can trap events in loops, restore a saved state, or force a new run through fate. Sequence 0 embodies Fate and controls Probability, Cycle, Disorder, and the Light Cone World. Paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers for Lord of the Mysteries. The Wheel of Fortune, also called the Monster or Fate pathway, is associated with the Key of Light and with fate, probability, and cycles. In the Fourth Epoch, after Ouroboros hunted the God of Luck, Will Auceptin rose as an Angel; later, anticipating Ouroboros’s attack, Will restarted as Will Ceres and became an ally who repeatedly aided Klein. Ouroboros had been the Ancient Sun God’s Angel of Fate and joined Rose Redemption; after the Sun God’s fall, Ouroboros led the group and followed the True Creator Story connections Will and Klein: Klein’s dream communication with Will begins after he acquires Will’s folded paper crane; Will later helps him with the Die of Probability and other situations Will versus Ouroboros: Ouroboros’s predicted attack forces Will to restart as a child, keeping their long-running conflict personal as well as supernatural Ouroboros and Klein: In Calderón City, Ouroboros investigates after the True Creator’s attention is drawn and tries to stop Klein with a Reboot Figures to know Will Auceptin / Will Ceres Wheel of Fortune Beyonder, President of the Life School of Thought, and Klein’s ally; his restart as Will Ceres sets up his conflict with Ouroboros Ouroboros Angel of Fate and one of the Ancient Sun God’s Kings of Angels; later a leader of Rose Redemption aligned with the True Creator Ancient Sun God Ouroboros’s former lord; Ouroboros’s past affiliation with Rose Redemption is tied to the Sun God’s fall Major story spoilers. Lore is paraphrased;. searchText: White Tower Pathway God Almighty · Standard Pathway White Tower Pathway Sequence 9: Reader → Sequence 0: White Tower The White Tower Pathway, also called the Reader Pathway, represents the search for knowledge and combines scientific with mysticism knowledge. Its high-sequence Beyonders can see possible futures, analyze and use fundamental principles of reality, and reveal information about people; its Above the Sequence is God Almighty and its Sefirah is the Chaos Sea. Pathway progression and late-sequence details contain major story spoilers. Browse the local White Tower Pathway ingredient archive → Overview The White Tower Pathway, also called the Reader Pathway, represents the search for knowledge and combines scientific with mysticism knowledge. Its high-sequence Beyonders can see possible futures, analyze and use fundamental principles of reality, and reveal information about people; its Above the Sequence is God Almighty and its Sefirah is the Chaos Sea. Paraphrased from the Fandom pathway article .. Complete wiki information Full main-article information imported from the White Tower Pathway wiki article . Existing archive pathway details above are preserved. We basically came to a consensus and believe that the Reader pathway represents the ‘omniscient’ part of ‘omnipotent and omniscient.’ Roselle's Diary On Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 715 Overview The White Tower Pathway represents the search for knowledge. In contrast to Hermit Pathway and Paragon Pathway , this pathway includes both scientific and mysticism knowledge. Beyonders of this pathway have a good memory and the ability to imitate others' powers by analysis. They are also skilled in ritual magic . At High-Sequences, they can see the future, directly observe, analyze and use the fundamental laws of reality, and reveal all information about a person, hidden or otherwise. The Above the Sequence of the White Tower Pathway is the God Almighty , and the corresponding Sefirah is the Chaos Sea . The Tower is commonly interpreted as meaning danger, crisis, destruction, and liberation. It is associated with sudden unforeseen change. [ 4 ] According to the author , in the Cthulhu genre 's world view, Knowledge equals Disaster and Danger . The higher one looks, the darker it becomes. It is filled with the aura of insanity, destruction, inauspiciousness, and disaster. Hidden within the gaps of its ancient volumes are pools of brass eyes that ooze black liquid, capable of contracting and extending at will. Atop the towering, illusory structure formed by the stacked bookshelves rests an Omniscient Eye , brimming with an aura of madness. Like a lighthouse beam, it can illuminate and perceive all things of the past and future. Name Key abilities 9 Reader Enhanced memory, comprehension, and learning support Reading and the use of Ritualistic Magic. 8 Student of Ratiocination Improved observation and logical reasoning; becomes expert in Ritualistic Magic. 7 Detective Masters reasoning, gains weapon proficiency and agility, and can reconstruct events through Beyonder analysis. 6 Polymath Analyzes encountered powers to identify strengths and weaknesses, then may imitate them with variable success. 5 Mysticism Magister Masters Mystic Arts, invents spells from analyzed principles, and develops flexible healing, defense, offense, or support effects. 4 Prophet Uses Prophecy to view likely futures and can learn or create non-dangerous Astral World Mystic Arts. 3 Cognizer Cognizes Principles and the essence of things, exposing secrets and leveraging reality’s underlying rules. 2 Wisdom Angel Foresees situational shifts to make correct choices, while enhancing Learning, Analysis, and prior abilities. 1 Omniscient Eye Sees information about targets across past, present, and future, and can temporarily manipulate limited Astral World concepts. 0 White Tower Has Omniscience over knowledge; can imitate abilities at original or greater power, and partially wield Principles, Creation, Calamity, Wisdom, Learning, and Analysis. Pathway themes & abilities The pathway centers on memory, learning, observation, reasoning, ritual magic, analysis, imitation, spell creation, prophecy, cognition, wisdom, and omniscience. Its progression moves from acquiring and reasoning about knowledge to reconstructing events, analyzing and imitating powers, creating mystic arts, prophesying, cognizing principles, and wielding broad knowledge-related authorities. Sequence-specific highlights are shown in the progression table above. High-sequence abilities The upper Sequences change the pathway from a specialist discipline into a domain of angelic and divine authority. The highlights below summarize the progression from Sequence 4 upward; details contain major spoilers. Sequences 4–3 Sequence 4 — Prophet: Uses Prophecy to view likely futures and can learn or create non-dangerous Astral World Mystic Arts. Sequence 3 — Cognizer: Cognizes Principles and the essence of things, exposing secrets and leveraging reality’s underlying rules. Sequences 2–1 Sequence 2 — Wisdom Angel: Foresees situational shifts to make correct choices, while enhancing Learning, Analysis, and prior abilities. Sequence 1 — Omniscient Eye: Sees information about targets across past, present, and future, and can temporarily manipulate limited Astral World concepts. Sequence 0 Sequence 0 — White Tower: Has Omniscience over knowledge; can imitate abilities at original or greater power, and partially wield Principles, Creation, Calamity, Wisdom, Learning, and Analysis. Sequence highlights are paraphrased from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki pathway article . Novel lore & story appearances Major spoilers for Book I and Book II. The White Tower’s symbolism links knowledge with danger: its tarot correspondence is The Tower, and its imagery centers on books and brass eyes. In the Third Epoch, the Ancient Sun God’s Wisdom Angel, Herabergen, betrayed him and consumed his remains alongside other angelic kings; Herabergen thereby became the Sequence 0 God of Knowledge and Wisdom, the White Tower deity. After the Ancient Sun God’s death, his divinity awakened in Adam, whose Twilight Hermit Order worked from the shadows toward his resurrection Story connections Betrayal and succession: Herabergen rose from Dragon of Wisdom to Wisdom Angel, then joined other angels in consuming the Ancient Sun God’s remains and became the White Tower’s Sequence 0 deity The failed contingency: The Ancient Sun God planned to use Adam’s Visionary authority and the Hanged Man’s Grazing to control the White Tower, Sun, and Tyrant Uniquenesses and characteristics; the betrayal at his death disrupted this intended arrangement A hidden resurrection project: Adam leads the Twilight Hermit Order, which manipulates events from the shadows toward the Ancient Sun God’s resurrection. Adam and the True Creator are divided remnants of that god and struggle over which persona will dominate Figures to know Herabergen / God of Knowledge and Wisdom Former Wisdom Angel and the White Tower Sequence 0 deity Ancient Sun God Third-Epoch ruler whose death and planned return shape the White Tower’s history Adam Ancient Sun God’s child; the god’s divinity awakened in him, and he leads the Twilight Hermit Order. Adam’s pathway origin is Visionary, not White Tower True Creator The Ancient Sun God’s extreme emotions, in conflict with Adam over their eventual fusion and dominant persona Major story spoilers. searchText: Divine Kingdoms Terminology · Divine Kingdoms Divine Kingdoms 神国 · Shén guó · Summoned realms that embody a True God's power and concept Definition Divine Kingdoms (神国, Shén guó ) are summoned areas that embody the power and concept of the True God that created it. Within their Divine Kingdoms, their strength increases and their enemies are suppressed. Some Angels are capable of creating their own version of Divine Kingdoms, however, their Divine Kingdoms are incomplete. Only a Sequence 0 True God can create a complete Divine Kingdom . The size of a True God's Divine Kingdom can cover a star. 1 Sefirot like the Sefirah Castle come with their own inherent Divine Kingdom. 2 Types of Divine Kingdoms Divine Kingdoms are divided into two categories. 3 Rules-based Divine Kingdoms : they could be forcibly created, however once the Divine Kingdom's rules are fixed, its owner would similarly be restricted to a certain extent. They have to bear the corresponding responsibility for the benefits obtained. 4 These include but are not limited to the following: Realm of Mysteries , the Fool 's complete Divine Kingdom. Within it, every door was Reassembled with different items. If one forcefully broke through them, they would trigger unknown effects, making it hard for others to break through with brute force. 4 However, the corresponding Deity will definitely be in one of the rooms, not somewhere else. The Error 's Divine Kingdom, an Erroneous environment. 3 5 It can be constructed to allow creating Errors while not directly affecting the target. The Door 's Divine Kingdom, a self-defined Alternate World . 3 6 The Visionary 's Divine Kingdom, unique according to their own imagination and thus possesses a variety of different purposes and abilities. 7 Direct Divine Kingdoms : involving ruling a certain region or realm, then turning it into one's own Divine Kingdom. These include but are not limited to the following: The Red Priest 's Divine Kingdom, his Divine Kingdom is formed through completely Conquering a land, battlefield, or special area. This is a deeper conceptualization of Conquest . The Demoness 's Divine Kingdom, her Divine Kingdom is tied to the Mirror World. The Hanged Man 's Divine Kingdom, the entire Shadow World , or something similar to the Shadow World that has been created by them. 8 The Darkness 's Divine Kingdom, they can turn Concealed Worlds into their Divine Kingdom. 9 List of General Divine Kingdom Names Sequence 0 Divine Kingdom Sequence 0: Fool Realm of Mysteries Guǐmì zhī jìng 诡秘之境 Sequence 0: Tyrant Dreadful Heaven Kǒngjù tiāntáng 恐惧天堂 Sole Obedience to the Storms Wéi fúcóng fēngbào 唯服从风暴 Chasm of Storms Fēngbào zhī yuān 风暴之渊 Sequence 0: White Tower Tower of Omniscience Quánzhī zhī tǎ 全知之塔 Tower of Madness Fēngkuáng zhī tǎ 疯狂之塔 Sequence 0: Twilight Giant Land of Twilight Huánghūn zhī dì 黄昏之地 Sequence 0: Hermit The World in the Eyes Yǎnzhōng shìjiè 眼中世界 Digital Heaven Shùzì tiāntáng 数字天堂 Land of Fairy Tales Tónghuà zhī dì 童话之地 Sequence 0: Paragon Mechanical Heaven Jīxiè tiāntáng 机械天堂 Civilization's Cemetery Wénmíng mù yuán 文明墓园 Land of Perfection Wánměi zhī dì 完美之地 Sequence 0: Wheel of Fortune Light Cone World Guāng zhuī shìjiè 光锥世界 Sequence 0: Mother Bountiful Earth Fēngráo lètǔ 丰饶乐土 Sequence 0: Abyss Abyss Shēnyuān 深渊 Abyssal Sea of the Mind/Heart Xīnlíng yuān hǎi 心灵渊海 Different names and characteristics depending on the Sequence 0. title: Ancient Sun God
summary: The Ancient Sun God, real name Grisha Adam, is the human Survivor from the Pre-Epoch who woke up from the Chaos Sea in Chernobyl at the beginning of the Second Epoch.
searchText: Ancient Sun God Ancient God Ancient Sun God Overview Other Identities : Ancient Sun God, Adam, True Creator, Sasrir Let there be light! Ancient Sun God, Book 1, chapter 1033 The Ancient Sun God, real name Grisha Adam , is the human Survivor from the Pre-Epoch who woke up from the Chaos Sea in Chernobyl at the beginning of the Second Epoch. "He" became the human savior who killed the Ancient Gods and led humans to dominate the world in the Third Epoch. "He" was a Quasi-God Almighty, 15 and was extremely close to being a Great Old One. 1 Book 1, chapter 1357 "He" had accommodated all required Uniquenesses and Sequence 1 Characteristics of all 5 pathways, and was almost equivalent to the owner of the Chaos Sea through Sasrir and the First Blasphemy Slate. "He" also possessed the the Uniqueness of Error. 2 "He" had eight Kings of Angels following "Him": the Dark Angel Sasrir, the Angel of Fate Ouroboros, the Red Angel Medici, the Wind Angel Leodero, the Wisdom Angel Herabergen, the White Angel Aucuses, as well as "His" two sons, the Angel of Time Amon and the Angel of Imagination Adam. Honorific Name The Lord that Created Everything; The Omnipotent and Omniscient; The Source of Everything Great; The Beginning and The End; The God of Gods; Ruler of the vast Astral World (创造一切的主， 全知全能者， 一切伟大的根源， 开始，也是结束， 众神之神， 浩瀚星界的支配者) Symbol The symbol of the Ancient Sun God is the grayish-white crosses and a sculpture of God bearing the cross. 17 Appearance Pre-Epoch His original body had blonde hair and blue eyes. 3 Archive:Cuttlefish's WeChat Comments and Answers He belonged to the relatively tall category, about 190 cm or 6.23 feet. 4 Archive:Cuttlefish's WeChat Comments and Answers After waking up from the Chaos Sea in Second Epoch A figure walked out-a man. He wore a black clergyman robe and had a silver crucifix hung on his chest. This man's hair wasn't long and was mainly raven-black in color. There was a faint hint of blond at the roots of his hair. His eyes were pure gold in color, and his skin was rather white. He had a deep outline and pronounced eye sockets. He looked quite similar to the people of the Northern Continent. Book 1, chapter 1033 This figure was dressed in a simple white robe. It was difficult to see his face clearly, and it was impossible to tell his age. One could only vaguely tell that he was a man. A bright halo hung at the back of his head like a miniature sun. Beneath his feet was an illusory clock that was divided into twelve segments. Each segment represented a different symbol of time. Behind him, there was a shadow that looked like a curtain. Eyes seemed to be looking out from the shadow. Book 1, chapter 1343 "His" appearance (eye color and hair color) changed due to influences from Beyonder characteristics. 5 History Pre-Epoch Modern Earth He was a naturally talented researcher 6 Archive:Discord International AMA with the author 4 5 working at a research institute in Chernobyl. His nationality was a bit sensitive. 18 While working in a research facility, "He" and other colleagues were researching the disappearance of oil. When the apocalypse began, the facility "He" worked at was one of the first sites that encountered supernatural phenomena due to its proximity to the Chaos Sea. After falling inside the Chaos Sea, "He" was put into an unconscious or sealed state. 7 Book 1, chapter 1222 Second Epoch In this era, the world was ruled by eight Ancient Gods. Humans were subordinates or even slaves of Giants, Elves, and Sanguines. 19 The Ancient Sun God became a deity based on the Sun, collecting the Uniquenesses and the minimum required Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics of the corresponding pathways 20 from fighting the Ancient Gods. Early Era of Fire The Ancient Sun God awakened in Chernobyl before the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith's death at the end of the Early Era of Fire. 8 Author's WeChat post red_priest, part 90 When "He" woke up, "He" said "Let there be light" and so the light appeared. 21 "He" emerged as a True God, 22 with the Uniquenesses and three Sequence 1 Characteristics of both the Sun and Hanged Man. 23 "He" also possessed the First Blasphemy Slate, the control over the Chaos Sea, and the the Uniqueness of Error. 2 Book 1, chapter 1369 According to Sasrir, soon after "He" walked out of the Chaos Sea, "He" sensed that the Primordial God Almighty was awakening inside "His" body, so "He" created another self hoping to control of the Chaos Sea and isolate it from continuously corrupting "His" main body. "He" separated part of "His" personality and merged with the "Degeneration" authority and the Hanged Man Beyonder characteristics to create Sasrir—a King of Angels with two Sequence 1 characteristics. However, the Primordial God Almighty continued to wake up despite all the efforts. 24 After awakening, the Ancient Sun God started cooperating with the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith and the Goddess of Misfortune Amanises. 8 Since right after emerging, "His" strength was insufficient to defeat two Ancient Gods, "He" didn't attack directly from the start 25 and instead stayed hidden for hundreds of years by relying on Amanises' Concealment authority, and on "His" own Shadow authority from the Hanged Man that inherently has some Concealment properties. 26 At the end of the Early Era of Fire, the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea, and Mutated King Kvastir perished together in a conspiracy 9 Author's WeChat post history that was part of the Ancient Sun God's plan. 27 Although "He" did not directly act in the killing of the Flegrea, "He" did exert influence. 28 In the chaos, Amanises retrieved the the Uniqueness of Darkness and a Knight of Misfortune characteristic from Flegrea 29 and disappeared afterwards. 10 Book 1, chapter 1066 The the Uniqueness of Moon from Lilith was stolen and eventually passed into "Her" hands. 30 Later, Amanises used the the Uniqueness of Moon to satisfy the Darkness, 31 Since the Darkness for the Sequence 0 potion would normally require the Cosmos that was outside of the Astral Barrier, the Ancient Sun God helped provide this. 32 In truth, Lilith didn't fully perish. At some point, the Evernight Goddess collaborated with the Ancient Sun God to help Lilith pretend to be Omebella using "Her" Authority over Concealment , while the Ancient Sun God used "His" the Uniqueness of Error to help Lilith steal the fate of the Giant Queen. 33 After switching to Omebella's identity, Lilith did not immediately advance to Mother until Badheil lived up to "Her" expectations and became the God of Combat 34 to satisfy the Mother. The reason "She" didn't just consume the Beyonder Characteristics directly was because the Ancient Sun God persuaded "Her" to wait for the ritual. 35 After the Sanguines civilization was destroyed, the Moon City followed the Ancient Sun God. "He" ordered the residents of the Moon City to guard the barrier fog that sealed the Western Continent. 36 Dual Era The Ancient Sun God manipulated the First Blasphemy Slate to emerge, revealing the paths of the divine. However, only part of its content was leaked; the remaining formulas remained unknown. 37 With the appearance of the First Blasphemy Slate, humans fractured under the instigation of dragons, mutants, and demons. Giants and others saw themselves as divine creatures, no longer human. The giants and elves split accusing each other of betrayal regarding Lilith's death and waging the 230-year "War of the Betrayers", with dragons and demons intervening three times. 9 Era of Tranquility Aurmir sought cooperation with some secret human organizations in an effort led by "His" son Badheil and "His" wife Omebella to deal with Soniathrym. 10 This secret organization most likely worshipped the Ancient Sun God. Dawn Era No, 'He' isn't the Sun God. 'He' is our Lord, the father of all things, the great source of everything. 'He' wasn't battling the Elf King, but taking back the authority which belonged to him. Snowman, Book 1, chapter 698 The Ancient Sun God emerged, proclaiming "Himself" as " God Almighty " and fought against the rest of the Ancient Gods and took "Their" power. "His" first recorded battle was slaying the Elf King Soniathrym and the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt in the year 2348 of the Second Epoch. Subsequently, the Giant King Aurmir and the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace were severely wounded—one passing power to the next generation, the other fragmenting across the Southern Continent. The Devil Monarch Farbauti was also wounded, sacrificing most demons and "His" own power to seal the Abyss, retreating to evade the radiance of The Omnipotent and Omniscient . 9 The Ancient Sun God made another attempt to fight against the awakening of the Primordial God Almighty in "Him", by having children to decrease "His" Beyonder characteristics. 11 Book 1, chapter 1261 Adam was born in this era and inherited "His" the Uniqueness of Visionary. As The Omnipotent and Omniscient , "He" Created a the Uniqueness of Visionary that bordered between reality and illusory to maintain "His" state. 12 Book 1, chapter 1346 Later, the Earth Mother helped the Ancient Sun God catalyze the activation of the the Uniqueness of Error using "Her" Mother Authority, leading to Amon's birth at the beginning of the Third Epoch. 38 As an activated Uniqueness, Amon would normally be far stronger than any Kings of Angels, but the Ancient Sun God placed restrictions on "Him". 39 40 Third Epoch Glorious Era After the death of all Ancient Gods, the Ancient Sun God became the absolute ruler of the world. There were eight Kings of Angels under "Him": Dark Angel Sasrir, Angel of Imagination Adam, Angel of Time Amon, Wisdom Angel Herabergen, Wind Angel Leodero, White Angel Aucuses, Angel of Fate Ouroboros, War Angel Medici. Starting from this era, humans walked out of the shadow of other races and became the dominant race of the land. After gaining initial control of the Omnipotence and Omniscience authority, the Ancient Sun God began to deduce the methods and pathways to become different Great Old Ones, and finally found the suitable formulas and figured out the different symbols. Unfortunately, at that time, the Primordial God Almighty had also awoken inside "Him". 13 Book 1, chapter 1347 In the Third Epoch, the three True Gods—the Evernight Goddess, the God of Combat, and the Earth Mother—gradually stepped onto the world's stage. These three formed alliances with each other, going against The Omniscient and Omnipotent . Since the power gap between "Them" and The Omniscient and Omnipotent was still relatively large, the three of "Them" nearly perished on multiple occasions. However, just as The Omniscient and Omnipotent and "His" faction were about to win completely, "He" began to have problems with the revival of the Primordial God Almighty inside "Himself". 9 The reason why "He" pursued the three gods despite previous collaborations such as helping Lilith hide "Her" identity was because of the issue with "His" state. 41 In the late Third Epoch, the Ancient Sun God wanted to create a weakened Celestial Worthy to counter the Primordial God Almighty. "He" didn't choose Amon because, as an activated Uniqueness, Amon was extremely similar to the Celestial Worthy and might lead to "His" revival. After Bethel Abraham was born, "He" advanced quickly on the Door due to the Ancient Sun God's favor. 42 The Ancient Sun God also tolerated Solomon, but didn't actively support "Him". 43 Cataclysm Era The Original Plan The Ancient Sun God tacitly allowed Sasrir, "His" other persona, to create the Rose Redemption, with the goal of assassinating "Himself" to prevent the revival of the Primordial God Almighty before resurrecting later. Sasrir convened the other Kings of Angels under the Ancient Sun God (except Adam and Amon), and invited various other deities and Kings of Angels with the Evernight Goddess. 44 11 Book 1, chapter 1261 "His" original plan at the end of the Third Epoch was: during the fight between "Him" and "His" corrupted side consciousness, "He" would be assassinated. Following this, "He" would immediately revive in the Giant King's Court where Sasrir's body was. "He" would first take back the Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics of the Hanged Man and become Hanged Man. Using the First Blasphemy Slate placed beside the body, "He" would gain preliminary control over the Chaos Sea and use this foundation to allow Angel of Imagination Adam to awaken and return to "His" main body to form a support. With such a system, the Ancient Sun God would use the Hanged Man's Grazing ability and a Visionary's Virtual Persona to control the Uniquenesses and Sequence 1 characteristics of the Sun, White Tower, and Tyrant. This would allow "Him" to become infinitely close to a Great Old One while maintaining a minimum level of stability. "He" didn't directly accommodate the Chaos Sea and the other three pathways' Uniquenesses and Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics because "He" didn't want to advance to become a Great Old One, a Pillar, in that era. That would inevitably lead to the resurrection of the Primordial God Almighty, causing "Him" to lose "Himself". "He" would control the situation and materials and then finish the last few steps to advance to God Almighty when The Apocalypse approached. 45 The Feast of Betrayal The Kings betrayed that existence. Blood, anger, foulness, and shadows began to flow across this land, triggering a huge calamity. Gehrman Sparrow to Nim, Book 1, chapter 1213 Sasrir fell asleep inside the Giant King's Court and "His" consciousness returned to the Ancient Sun God's body. In the meantime, "He" was besieged by the Rose Redemption and died at the Sea of Ruins. However, the Wind Angel, White Angel, and Wisdom Angel betrayed the plan and feasted on "His" remains to become the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom respectively. 11 The Ancient Sun God was unable to foresee the betrayal of the three Kings of Angels because of interference from the Primordial God Almighty. 46 Because of the betrayal, "He" could only rushed to fuse with "His" extreme emotions before dying, and be reborn within the corpse. "He" then took away the Beyonder Characteristics of the Hanged Man and the Uniqueness of Hanged Man to form the True Creator. Meanwhile, Sasrir's body was left in the Giant King's Court and turned into an Evil Spirit due to the lingering obsession "He" had, as well as Chaos Sea's powers which were brought about by the First Blasphemy Slate. 11 12 "His" godhood awakened in Adam. 47 The Aftermaths When the Ancient Sun God perished, "He" used a portion of "His" body and will to create the Second Blasphemy Slate, to bring light for The Apocalypse by ending the chaotic battle between the deities due to anger, emotions, and other reasons, initiating the era of working towards becoming Great Old Ones. 13 The fall of the Ancient Sun God created the Sea of Ruins and separated the Eastern Continent, now known as the Forsaken Land of the Gods, from the the world. Since then it entered into a state of permanent darkness, punctuated only by the brief lightning flashes that happen every few seconds. Because the Eastern Continent was the most prosperous at the time, one of the reasons for the destruction of the Eastern Continent was that the Primordial God Almighty wanted to reduce the number of anchors of the Ancient Sun God. 48 At "His" death, the Ancient Sun God was able to sense Klein's divination about "Him" in the Fifth Epoch, and was able to exert influence back to him and Sefirah Castle. 49 After "His" death, the invasion of reality by the Outer Deities deepened, which is one of the factors influencing the history of the Fourth Epoch. 14 Book 1, chapter 1348 Fifth Epoch The books and legends of the Ancient Sun God have been missing for two to three thousand years, and the Churches of the Seven Gods' bibles are copied from "Him." 50 Resurrection Since both the True Creator and Adam were part of the Ancient Sun God, "They" would need to fuse to become complete. "They" had been fighting over who should be the dominant persona ever since "They" both awakened. 14 After Amon's Apotheosis Ritual, the Visionary Adam arrived at the Forsaken Land of the Gods with the Second Blasphemy Slate to start fusing with the True Creator. 1 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, Adam had partially fused with the True Creator, with Adam as the dominant persona. 51 As of Book 2, Adam and the True Creator have fully fused, with Adam becoming the current True Creator, 52 and is now referred to as True Creator Adam or Grisha Adam . Trivia Readers asked the author what era "He" lived in before (Because the Chernobyl explosion happened in 1986, so they guessed "He" lived in this era), but the author did not answer this question 3 and in another question he said "His" background could not be revealed for the time being. 6 Readers also asked about "His" real name and the author said it was related to the future script. 6 Regarding "His" real name, the reader asked the author if it was because the Ukrainian name was difficult to write and because it wasn't important so he didn't write it, or because "He" was polluted by the Chaos Sea and forgot "His" real name, the author said it was the first case. 54 "His" real name was later revealed to be Grisha Adam . 9 Chinese readers call "Him" "远太" ( Yuǎn Tài ) from "远古太阳神" ( Yuǎngǔ Tàiyáng Shén , Ancient Sun God), or "白造" ( Bái Zào ) from "白银城造物主" ( Báiyín Chéng Zàowùzhǔ , Silver City Creator). title: Adam
summary: Adam, also known as the Angel of Imagination, was one of the Kings of Angels from the Third Epoch and a child of the Ancient Sun God.
searchText: Adam True God Adam Overview Other Identities : Ancient Sun God, Adam, True Creator, Sasrir Can you accept such an outcome? Adam, Book 1, chapter 1149 Adam, also known as the Angel of Imagination , was one of the Kings of Angels from the Third Epoch and a child of the Ancient Sun God. "He" was born as a Sequence 1 Author with the Uniqueness of the Visionary Pathway. When "He" first appeared in Book 1, "He" had already accommodated two sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics and the Uniqueness of the Visionary Pathway. 1 Book 1, chapter 1346 Honorific Name The Lord that Created Everything; The Omnipotent and Omniscient God; The Lord who Reigns Behind the Curtain of Shadows; The Ruler of the Mind World; The Degenerate Nature of all Living Things (创造一切的主， 全知全能的神， 阴影帷幕后的主宰， 心灵世界的支配者， 所有生灵的堕落自性) Appearance "He" usually appears with a simple white cloak, golden hair and beard, and wears a silver cross on "His" neck, just like any ordinary priest. "He" is often described as having pure and innocent eyes like a child. Background The Ancient Sun God once said that "He" would be the savior of all life in the distant future. 8 "He" is the leader of the Twilight Hermit Order, a secret organization that works from the shadows to revive the Ancient Sun God. However, it is suspected the actual goal is to let Adam complete the advancement ritual of Sequence 0 Visionary. Divinity and Humanity The True Creator is the embodiment of the extreme emotions from the Ancient Sun God's death and inherited "His" humanity which drove "Him" into madness. 9 4 Book 1, chapter 1348 Meanwhile, the Ancient Sun God's divinity awoke inside Adam who has then been actively seeking for "His" complete revival 1 while still disguising under the identity of Adam—the Child of the Creator—and continuing to influence the world. 1 Since both the True Creator and Adam are a part of the Ancient Sun God, "They" will need to fuse to become complete. "They" have been fighting over who should be the dominant persona ever since "They" both awakened. 4 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, Adam had partially fused with the True Creator with Adam as the dominant persona. "He" temporarily raised "Himself" to the level of a Half Great Old One to interfere with the ritual. This process was actually rather difficult and risky, and would make "Their" progress a lot slower in the future. 10 Grisha Adam As of Book 2, Adam and the True Creator have fully fused, with Adam becoming the current True Creator. 2 Book 2, chapter 868 "He" is known as True Creator Adam , 3 or Grisha Adam . 5 Main article: Adam/History Trivia "His" name is translated as "Angel of Imagination", in Chinese it is "空想天使", "天使" is "Angel" and "空想" is "imagination", but the word "空想" is also used in " 空想 家" (Visionary). References Book 1, chapter 1346. Book 2, chapter 868. Book 1, chapter 1348. Book 2, chapter 231. Book 2, chapter 735. Book 1, chapter 1063. Book 1, chapter 1260. Book 1, chapter 1381. title: Antigonus
summary: Antigonus is the youngest son of the Demonic Wolf Flegrea and is the brother of Mother of the Sky,
searchText: Antigonus Angel Antigonus Overview Hornacis… Flegrea… Hornacis… Flegrea… Hornacis… Flegrea… Antigonus' raving, Book 1, chapter 32 Antigonus is the youngest son of the Demonic Wolf Flegrea and is the brother of Mother of the Sky, "He" was a Subsidiary God of the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea in the Second Epoch. "He" was a King of Angels of the Fool Pathway known as The Half-Fool in the Fourth Epoch. 1 Book 1, chapter 1104 Appearance Original Form An eight-legged Demonic Wolf with the transparent worms twisted among its thick black short hairs. Human Form "His" appearance incorporates characteristics of both one of old-age and youthfulness with hair that is half white and half black. "He" had a pair of dark black eyes, decent facial features, and a thick, black tuft of fur on "His" cheeks. "He" has maintained this appearance throughout the Fourth Epoch. 5 Background Antigonus was the youngest son of Flegrea, a born mythical creature with the powers of a Miracle Invoker. “He” feared "His" bloodthirsty father the most and despised the crude methods employed by "His" brothers and sisters when dealing with their prey. “He” believed that prey should be hoisted up for slow, refined enjoyment to match their status. "He" hated the God of Wishes and found the God of the Dead gloomy and disgusting. However "He" had a good impression of the Goddess of Misfortune who had a gentle personality and met "His" beauty standards as both a demonic wolf and a human, while some of "His" older sisters and brothers wanted to usurp "Her" position. 2 Book 1, chapter 1374 After the death of "His" father, "He" and Mother of the Sky, "His" sister, crossed the sea from the Eastern Continent and came to the Northern Continent, "They" established a concealed kingdom, the Nation of the Evernight, in the uninhabited Hornacis Mountain Range. The two siblings laid low, merely gathering believers and citizens for "Their" kingdom. "He" also created a City of Dead, Foggy Town alongside the nation, where "Their" dead believers were turned into "His" marionettes for an Attendant of Mysteries. According to "Him", this was the best and most peaceful period in "His" life; "His" sister and "He" also gained humanity thanks to "Their" believers. After the Cataclysm, "He" finally rose to Sequence 1 and turned "Himself" into a human. Taking Antigonus as "His" surname, "He" left the Hornacis Mountain and returned to the world outside "Their" concealed kingdom. 2 The advancement further awakened the "will" of the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings inside "Him", making "Him" losing "His" consciousness and memory at times. Despite "His" family's apparent high standing in the Solomon Empire, at some point "He" made a secret transaction with Alista Tudor 6 and eventually went over to the Blood Emperor's side after the fall of the Black Emperor. It was after the First Solomon Empire that "He" received the help of Adam and Amon—who also supported the Blood Emperor—to carry out the Fool to accommodate the the Uniqueness of Fool. 3 Book 1, chapter 1358 7 “They" captured a demigod from the Solomon Empire and got Adam to do a deeper level hypnotism act and a transplant of the corresponding memory, making him believe that he was Antigonus. Then, with Amon working with Antigonus, "He" stole Antigonus’s identity and fate while Antigonus used the "Tampering" authority to combine the identity and fate with the experimental subject. The demigod from the Solomon Empire began living in the state of Antigonus, and after some time, he took the initiative to accommodate the Uniqueness of Fool and undoubtedly lost control. At this moment, the real Antigonus removed the "Tampering", allowing "His" identity and fate to return into Amon’s hands. Amon ended the theft and returned them to the original owner. This created two different fates of Antigonus existing at the same time: Antigonus failed to accommodate the Uniqueness and lost control, and Antigonus was perfectly well with no problem. Therefore, fate has been fooled to a certain extent, and Antigonus successfully became The Half-Fool . However, the accommodation also worsened the "will" of the Celestial Worthy inside "Him". During the War of the Four Emperors, "He" with some assistance from Bethel Abraham, confronted the ancestor of the Zaratul family, an Attendant of Mysteries Angel, killed "Him", and obtained "His" Beyonder characteristics. 1 Antigonus failed to suppress the spiritual "will" of the Celestial Worthy and "Their" psyches were stitched together, "He" could use this identity to influence Sefirah Castle. The Evernight Goddess took advantage of this connection to "Attendant of Mysteries" the destination of the last set of Sequence 9 to 1 characteristics of the Fool Pathway that was supposed to accompany Klein's transmigration, to the Forsaken Land of the Gods. 3 "He" was sealed inside a palace at the peak of the Hornacis Mountain Range, the Nation of the Evernight, that was connected to Foggy Town by the Evernight Goddess during the Church of the Evernight Goddess's attack on the Nation of the Evernight in the Fourth Epoch. Inside the town, every time the moon shone on it, "He" would let out all "His" marionettes and let them act like they were just ordinary residents living their daily lives. However, should "He" find outsiders, "He" would instinctively turn them into "His" marionettes. History Lord of Mysteries During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, "He" lost the the Uniqueness of Fool and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic to Klein and was finally able to regain "His" senses. "He" was last seen waking up from "His" deep slumber in the ancient palace on Hornacis Mountain peak. 8 Circle of Inevitability "He" was captured and imprisoned by the Church of the Evernight Goddess, however, after the Evernight Goddess provided a revelation and promised "Him" one thing, "He" began working for them. "His" dream image in The Fool's Dream is An Xiaotian, an actor. When the Tarot Club decided to cast An Xiaotian as Gehrman Sparrow for the film "The Great Pirate 3", they contacted the real Antigonus to make sure there would be no latent problems. According to "Him", "He" could sense The Fool's Dream, but did not enter it nor did "He" want to. 4 Book 2, chapter 971 Trivia As a result of Antigonus once being in a state of madness and mentally closer to the Celestial Worthy, "His" marionette, Panatiya became in the possession of both "Himself" and the Celestial Worthy. 9 "His" dream image in The Fool's Dream, An Xiaotian, is an orphan raised by "His" older sister. "He" dropped out after high school and entered the entertainment industry. "His" sister fell seriously ill and is currently in a vegetative state. To maintain hope for "His" sister's awakening, "He" worked hard to become a big star and earned quite a bit of money. On the day of the shoot for the film "The Great Pirate 3", An Xiaotian had a very serious car accident and also became a vegetable. 4 Translations Language Name Chinese 安提哥努斯 Thai แอนทิโกนัส References Book 1, chapter 1104. title: Alista Tudor
summary: Alista Tudor, the Blood Emperor, was the ancestor of the Tudor Family.
searchText: Alista Tudor True God Alista Tudor Overview The tall-as-a-mountain Blood Emperor who wore a red cape with ‘His’ eyes being abnormally crazy, containing almost zero reasoning. Azik Eggers's Letter, Book 1, chapter 502 Alista Tudor, the Blood Emperor , was the ancestor of the Tudor Family. "He" was born after the Third Epoch, and before the first Solomon Empire. 6 "He" ruled the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire alongside the Night Emperor, and later ruled the Tudor Empire after the fracture of the United Empire. Appearance Normal Appearance: "He" appeared to be around 30 years old. "He" was draped in a deep red ceremonial robe and wore an iron-black crown. "He" had long hair with a faint flickering red glow ("His" hair used to be brown, but underwent a change as "He" switched to Red Priest pathway). His facial features were sharp, as if carved by a knife. His lips gave off an unyielding and unwavering impression. He also had a very prominent nose as well as a pair of blue eyes filled to the brim with insanity and cruelty ("His" eyes would turn iron-black when he used Red Priest abilities). 7 Death Mark: A figure which seemed to be engulfed in an intense inferno, with almost colorless flames covering its entire body. It felt as if the figure was abnormally huge, like a mountain peak. Within the nearly intangible flames, the figure revealed long, blood-colored hair. Its sculpted face was marred by decay and pus, and its bones gleamed with a metallic luster. Its iron-black eyes seemed rusted, emitting a sinister blood-red glow. Yellowish “magma” dripped from the figure’s body, quickly extinguished by the pale-white spring water. 1 Book 2, chapter 353 Initial fusion with the Mirrored Original Creator: A figure drapped in rust-colored long hair, wearing full-body white iron, with rigid and hollow iron-black eyes, and a high-bridged nose, seemingly cast from the same mold as Blood Emperor Alista Tudor, only with many opposite details in color. 2 Book 2, chapter 1108 History Fourth Epoch Alista Tudor was among the various people who saw the Second Blasphemy Slate 8 and later served as a high-ranking noble in the Solomon Empire, ranked beneath Zoroast, Abraham, Zaratul and on par with Augustus, Castiya. 9 Together with Trunsoest who was also a Sequence 2 Beyonder of the Black Emperor Pathway, "He" received the support of the six Orthodox deities to remove the Black Emperor. "He" and Trunsoest then both became Prince of Abolition of the Black Emperor pathway and co-ruled the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire. During "His" rule as the consul of the United Empire, Alista Tudor secretly built the mausoleums across present-day Loen - unbeknownst to the churches 10 - as part of the apotheosis ritual to become Sequence 0: Black Emperor, 11 with Bethel Abraham's assistance. 12 13 However, "His" advancement plan was thwarted by the return of a revived Solomon; meanwhile, Trunsoest was endorsed by the Six Deities to switch to Justiciar Pathway. 14 With the aid from Adam, Amon, 15 and the nobles' combined efforts 3 Book 2, chapter 433, "He" entrapped and killed all 3 Sequence 1 Angels of the Red Priest Pathway: the Red Angel Medici, Sauron, and Einhorn 16 in the underground structure in present-day Backlund 17 18 to become Sequence 0: Red Priest, turning half-mad as the cost of switching to a non-neighbouring pathway. 19 The event of killing Medici, Sauron, and Einhorn was part of the war meant for "His" Apotheosis Ritual. There were also subsequent events. 20 21 22 As the Blood Emperor , "He" founded the Tudor Empire, with the Amon Family, Abraham Family, 23 Jacob Family, Antigonus Family, and Tamara Family as "His" chief supporters, 24 25 and participated in the War of the Four Emperors. At one point, Azik Eggers met "Him" in person and lost consciousness from the half-crazed Blood Emperor's glance. During the 500 year period after founding the Tudor Empire and the War of the Four Emperors, Tudor and Cheek consummated within the Special Mirror World created by Bethel Abraham. This action also further awakened the Primordial God Almighty in "Them". This was because, in the First Epoch, The Primordial God Almighty, who accommodated the City of Calamity, hid one part of "His" resurrection arrangement around the City of Calamity and the two pathways of Demoness and Red Priest: When the Demoness combines with the Red Priest, "He" will become the Trinity, in the City of Calamity, within the Demoness and the Red Priest, simultaneously resurrecting, ultimately forming a whole, returning in the mirror. But "He" perished too early, and "His" arrangements were not as expected. The City of Calamity was sealed in the Western Continent by the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, preventing "Him" from quickly becoming the Trinity; in addition, there was also another change on the City of Calamity's side. "His" consciousness revived in the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor, but without the City of Calamity's resonance and linkage, that consciousness grew very slowly, and was suppressed and controlled by the two. "Their" union also gave birth to Krismona and Judith. Moreover, the place the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor consummated was not the ordinary mirror world, but the Special Mirror World created by Bethel Abraham, who had accommodated the Door Uniqueness and all three Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics. The Oldest One's body of both male and female, plus the power of the two direct Pillars belonging to the Oldest One, gave birth to the Mirrored Original Creator, but "His" consciousness was very weak, like all newborn infants. This gave the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor a chance to merge with the Mirrored Original Creator, with "Them" each bearing the feminine and masculine side respectively, and then use this to control the City of Calamity. But the other Deities found out, and the War of the Four Emperor started, causing "Their" failure. In the last moment, Tudor wanted to forcibly complete the merger, using this to pull all other Sefirot from the Western Continent, dragging the entire world to die, waiting for the Creator's symbolic manifestation in death. However, the Primordial Demoness deemed "His" final decision too crazy and decided to kill "Him" at the moment then resurrect "Him" later; she temporarily cooperated with Salinger in hunting "Him" down, dealing "Him" the critical blow and then Salinger completed "His" life culling. 4 Book 2, chapter 1107 26 "His" Fall in Fourth Epoch Trier caused the capital to sink underground. 5 Book 2, chapter 356 After "His" demise, the Red Priest Uniqueness fell into Salinger's hands; the Sauron Family and Einhorn Family also reclaimed their Beyonder Characteristics. 3 The mirrored Alista Tudor still existed in the Mirror World on the Blue Avenger, the masculine aspect of the Mirrored Original Creator initially fused with "Him" was safeguarded by the Primordial Demoness, "His" corpse remained in the Fourth Epoch Trier, and "His" remnant soul lingered in the River of Eternal Darkness after being sent there by Salinger. Alongside the Beyonder characteristics stored in the Blue Avenger's treasury, these were all part of his resurrection plans; however, the Primordial Demoness deliberately cursed the destiny of "His" descendants, save "Her" own child, to necessitate "His" reliance on "Her" later. 27 Fifth Epoch Lord of Mysteries Pound Family gained the title of viscount after their contribution to Loen in the Battle of the Violated Oath, owning Unit 8 in Williams Street situated above the underground ruins of the Hall of Consul of Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire and Blood Emperor's Red Priest ascension site, where the Evil Spirit Sauron-Einhorn-Medici had remained sealed. Pound Family fell into decline, and Rafter Pound sold Unit 8 in Williams Street to Millet Carter, who hired Sherlock Moriarty to investigate the underground structure beneath his new house. Sherlock and Sharron later encountered the Evil Spirit Sauron-Einhorn-Medici who tried to persuade them to help with his release and advised them to keep Rafter Pound alive, revealing that Rafter Pound was a descendant of Tudor Family and the Blood Emperor had left quite a number of good things which require the blood of "His" descendants to access them. The mausoleums that "He" had left in Loen were repurposed by George Augustus III in his Apotheosis Ritual. Circle of Inevitability Lumian Lee encountered the Blood Emperor's remnant spirit in the Samaritan Women's Spring of Underground Trier. 1 Under "His" commands, other evil spirits of various pathways attempted to drag Lumian into the spring, which almost succeeded until a strange pale-while hand emerged from the depths of the spring and persisted in dragging "Him" back. Before "He" completely disappeared into the spring, "His" madness materialized and "He" shot out the aura from "His" eyes at Lumian, which merged with the corroded mark left by the Blood Earth Ore on Lumian's right hand. 28 When Fors Wall explained the nature of the mysterious mark on Lumian's right hand, she cited hearsay similar to what Evil Spirit Sauron-Einhorn-Medici had stated, that only the ones with Tudor Family's bloodline could unlock numerous hidden treasures the Blood Emperor had left behind in the 4th Epoch Trier. Fors also mentioned another hearsay that the Blood Emperor had nearly entombed all the deities who participated in the war alongside "Him". 5 Lumian eventually learned from the Armored Shadow, who originated from the Western Continent, that: The Blood Son of Heaven disrupted the netherworld, and the Underworld Daoist sacrificed himself to enter the river. Armored Shadow's response in Chinese, Book 2, chapter 373 From Franca's translation, Lumian theorized that the Blood Emperor's remnant spirit was able to traverse Franca's homeland, the Samaritan Women's Spring, and even Fourth Epoch Trier via the distributary of a mysterious river from Franca's homeland which had infiltrated their world during the War of the Four Emperors; then a local High-Sequence Beyonder from the domains of Death and the Underworld chose to immerse himself in the river in order to harness its power fully and seal away the Blood Emperor's remnant spirit that had brought chaos to the Underworld over there. Finally exploring the Blue Avenger, Lumian encountered a Historical Projection of Alista Tudor in a scene seemingly belonging to the Tudor Empire era. Alista Tudor's Projection compelled Lumian to approach "Him", which was actually a cover-up for an antique full-length mirror that contained the mirrored Alista Tudor, and Lumian's reflection onto the mirror initiated a possession from the mirrored Alista Tudor, but the Underworld Daoist's mark brought him a brief moment of clarity, enough to roll away from the mirror and escape the full relfection, thusly evading the full possession. Violent pounding against the mirror from inside followed, which came to a halt after a while. Lumian concluded that the Projection had been triggered by a resonance between "His" residual aura within Lumian and the mirror or what hidden inside that mirror, which must be the Blood Emperor's resurrection setup. 29 When Lumian used the Blood Emperor ritual contract to search for the remaining Weather Warlock characteristic in the ruins of Bansy, at the bottom of the well where the Malevolent Dragon was sealed, he unwittingly entered a mirror world that contained a silver full-length mirror connected to the mirror on the Blue Avenger, and thusly encountered the mirrored Alista Tudor. The battle was initially dominated by the mirrored Alista Tudor, and when it was about to reach climax, a dark shadow, later revealed to be the Primordial Demoness, infiltrated this mirror world and dissuaded the mirrored Alista Tudor from finishing the battle. Both the mirror inside this mirror world and the mirror on the Blue Avenger were shattered during this battle; following the battle, a deep purple, hurricane-like light surged from the Blue Avenger and rapidly headed eastward, which was a living Weather Warlock characteristic in the form of a purple-flamed giant bird that Alista Tudor had extracted to provide for Lumian's advancement. After gaining the acknowledgement from the living characteristic and its submission as the bird's challenge served as a hidden ritual condition to make up for the foundation missing from switching pathways, Lumian prayed to Mr. Fool to shatter the characteristic and cleanse it of Alista Tudor's imprint. 30 It was theorized by Fors Wall that Julie had saved Lumian during the fight in Morora because Cheek wanted him to serve as the basis for Tudor to revive. This was later proven correct on The Day of Many Disasters, when Lumian Lee was forced to fuse with the Mirrored Original Creator's masculine side (the Alista Tudor in white armor) and feminine side (the Primordial Demoness in black bone dress), along with the mirrored Alista Tudor (black armor) and a split-off personality from the Primordial Demoness (white bone dress), a Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristic of Conqueror and one of Apocalypse. The Primordial God Almighty's consciousness also almost revived on him, manifesting as a chaos face, before ultimately being stopped by The Fool's and Amon's interference. From then on, Lumian Lee gained the symbolism of both masculine and feminine aspects of the Mirrored Original Creator. 31 After The Apocalypse, Alista Tudor now existed as a personality inside Lumian Lee's Dream, as the priest overseeing a Trier-styled cathedral. 32 Trivia Alista Tudor handled the workplace relationships among his subordinates with force. This was why the Abraham, Tamara, Antigonus, Jacob, and Amon families were able to coexist. 33 Via Bethel Abraham, Antigonus, and Amon, he could use the Kings-of-Angel-level abilities of the Lord of Mysteries pathways. 34 According to Albus Medici, Alista Tudor left behind so many problems because he was the symbol of calamity. 35 The presence of Alista Tudor's soul allowed Lumian Lee to satisfy the requirements of the Red Priest ritual during the latter's ascension as a Dual-Pathway True Gods. 36 When it comes to utilizing the powers from the Sefirot during the War of the Four Emperors, regarding Trunsoest who already accommodated the Uniqueness of the Justiciar pathway, Alista Tudor and Cheek who completed the initial merger with the masculine and feminine aspects of the Mirrored Original Creator, Alista Tudor and Cheek were more or less equal, better than Trunsoest, but there was no qualitative difference. However, when Alista Tudor went mad in the end, it was no longer the case; he would outdo others. 37 It was no exaggeration that he was capable of burying other gods involved in the war, even to the point of reviving the Original Creator. 38 To use the Chaos Sea's five Pathways at the level of Sequence 0, Alista Tudor must use the Mirrored Original Creator. However, before "His" fall, the Mirrored Original Creator was not yet fully controlled by "Him". 39 Alista Tudor utilized a bit of Mirrored Original Creator's special symbolisms and the City of Calamity's corruption in himself to summon powers from the Sefirot in the Western Continent. 40 References Book 2, chapter 353. title: Salinger
summary: Salinger or Death was a Sequence 0 God of the Death Pathway.
searchText: Salinger True God Salinger Overview Death went mad, but also became stronger! Even deities can go mad? What a horrifying sentence! Roselle's Diary, Book 1, chapter 217 Salinger or Death was a Sequence 0 God of the Death Pathway. "He" was a Subsidiary God of the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea and later the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, known as the God of the Dead in the Second Epoch. "He" then founded and controlled the Balam Empire and was known as the Underworld Emperor . "He" later used the River of Eternal Darkness distributary to fuse with the Red Priest Pathway Uniqueness to create a brand new Great Old One path. This led to "Him" becoming a Half Great Old One, although "He" went mad as a result. 5 1 Salinger perished at the end of the Pale Era of the Fourth Epoch, at the hands of the Seven Orthodox Gods. Honorific Name The Essence of Death; Lord of the Dead; Final Home to all Living-beings (死亡的本质， 亡者的君主， 所有生灵最后的归宿) Symbol "His" symbol is the Inverted Mausoleum. Appearance In the Rose Redemption Mural: A middle-aged man with facial features resembling the natives of the Southern Continent. 2 Personality Antigonus found Salinger to be gloomy and solitary, exuding a rotting and disgusting aura. 7 Because "He" was originally a Subsidiary God with mixed characteristics (Death Sequence 2 + Darkness Sequence 2), 8 even after expelling the characteristic, there would still be severe aftereffects. 9 "His" mental state was never particularly good. 10 History Second Epoch In the Second Epoch, "He" was known as the God of the Dead Salinger and was a Subsidiary God of the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea, but after Flegrea's death, "He" turned to the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace. 11 "He" was initially a mix of Death Death Consul and Darkness Servant of Concealment. 12 When Gregrace perished, "She" turned into fragments scattered across the Southern Continent. 13 When Salinger acquired the Pale Emperor characteristic, it had already changed hands twice, roughly around the year 24xx, which was over a hundred years before the end of the Second Epoch. 14 15 Third Epoch In the Third Epoch, "He" joined Rose Redemption as a Kings of Angels of the Subsidiary Gods faction under the Evernight Goddess, which eventually caused Ancient Sun God's death. 2 Book 1, chapter 1117 16 Fourth Epoch During the beginning of the Fourth Epoch, "He" advanced to Sequence 0 and became known as Death . At that time, all deities had "Their" own countries in poorer places and acknowledged the first Solomon Empire and the Black Emperor Solomon's rule over the Northern Continent in order to fight against opposing factions. Death had a conflict with the Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat. For the sake of balance, the Black Emperor also didn't attack the Southern Continent, and allowed Death to unite the plains and the ancient forest to build the Balam Empire. 17 "He", along with the Black Emperor Solomon, Night Emperor Trunsoest, and Blood Emperor Tudor, participated in the War of the Four Emperors. In Tudor's last moment, "He" wanted to forcibly complete the merger with the Mirrored Original Creator, using this to pull all other Sefirot from the Western Continent, dragging the entire world to die, waiting for the Creator's symbolic manifestation in death. The Primordial Demoness decided to let "Him" die for a while, and then resurrect "Him" later. "She" dealt Tudor the critical blow, while Death completed "His" life's culling, sending "His" soul into the River of Eternal Darkness. 3 Book 2, chapter 1107 After the War of the Four Emperors, Death was said to have benefited the most from the war, gaining the the Uniqueness of Red Priest. During the Conflicts of the Seven Gods, Death relied on a distributary of the River of Eternal Darkness to forcibly accommodate the the Uniqueness of Red Priest to create a brand new Great Old One path. This has the influence of the True Creator, as well as the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings who had once accommodated the River of Eternal Darkness which included the Death Pathway. 18 After over a century of "digestion", 4 Book 1, chapter 217 "He" went mad, but also became a lot stronger, even stronger than the War of the Four Emperors era's True Creator. "He" wasn't able to resist the desire for converging with the Twilight and Evernight pathways, 1 and then wanting to devour a certain few gods from among the Seven Gods. 4 1 Book 1, chapter 1369 In the middle of this era, the Primordial Demoness approached Death for an alliance. "She" wanted to manipulate the half-mad Death to collect the Blood Emperor's corpse in Fourth Epoch Trier, merge it with "Himself", and manipulate "Him" to touch the Special Mirror Worlds to resurrect the Blood Emperor. 19 However, Death's forced accommodation of the the Uniqueness of Red Priest caused an aberration in the Mirrored Original Creator, producing a certain self-awareness, which negatively affected "Her" state. 3 The reason for the Celestial Worthy's influence which eventually led to this aberration was to prevent the Primordial Demoness' plan regarding the Mirrored Original Creator. This is because if there were no mutation, and "She" continued down the path, succeeding would make "Her" the Mirrored Original Creator; failing would still birth the Mirrored Original Creator. With the aberration, now both sides have formed a certain balance until The Apocalypse, leading to new changes. 20 Some time after Death went mad, "He" interacted with the Underworld Daoist, who guarded the River of Eternal Darkness and the Blood Emperor's afterimage. For some reason, "He" agreed to Naboredisleys request for help, causing "His" Abomination corpse to slumber in a special dream. Therefore, be it the Underworld Daoist or Naboredisley's corpse, even if they only had their instincts left, they would still treat the Eggers Family's bloodline specially. 21 In the Pale Era, Death and the Primordial Demoness joined forces to wreak havoc and create a catastrophe on the Northern Continent. 4 The Seven Gods were defeated and retreated at every turn, until "They" eventually joined hands again. After a carefully schemed war with cataclysmic consequences, Death fell, the ocean between the Northern Continent and Southern Continent was widened by one fold, becoming the Berserk Sea that's perpetually engulfed by turbulent waves and storms, separating the North and South. 22 Fifth Epoch Resurrection Plan The Eggers Family are the descendants of Death , including Azik Eggers, the son of Death . Before "He" perished, Death left a piece of "His" soul in Azik in order to resurrect in the future. Numinous Episcopate had also been trying to revive Death by creating an Artificial Death from the the Uniqueness of Death. However, the Evernight Goddess eventually retrieved the the Uniqueness of Death. 23 When Roselle created the Pale Death mask, "He" sensed that Death might not have completely perished, and might have left behind hidden means of revival involving the River of Eternal Darkness. 24 It was later revealed that "His" death imprint was left wandering around the River. If another being accommodated the the Uniqueness of Death, and if Death couldn't use that opportunity to revive in "Their" body, "His" imprint would sink into the water of the River of Eternal Darkness and would further melt away. 25 Translations Language Name English Death God of the Dead Salinger Chinese 死神 亡灵之神 萨林格尔 Thai เทพแห่งความตาย เทพแห่งวิญญาณที่ดับสูญ ซาลินเกอร์ References Book 1, chapter 1369. title: Farbauti
summary: The Devil Monarch Farbauti is a Survivor from the Modern Era and one of the Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch.
searchText: Farbauti True God Farbauti Overview Other Identities : Farbauti, Naboredisley ‘He’ was originally the only surviving Ancient God, the Devil Monarch, Farbauti. Now, heh. Amon to Klein Moretti, Book 1, chapter 1152 The Devil Monarch Farbauti is a Survivor from the Modern Era and one of the Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch. "He" was originally an Ancient God of the Abyss and the Wheel of Fortune, and later a True God of the Abyss. 1 Author's WeChat post ancient_gods, part 27 In addition, "He" has a Sequence 1 Abomination Beyonder characteristic that was later given to Naboredisley, "His" other identity. 2 Book 2, chapter 697 "He" was the only surviving Ancient God from the Second Epoch in "Their" original form. In later epochs, "He" was known as the Dark Side of the Universe and resided in the Abyss. 8 "He" was worshiped by the Blood Sanctify Sect and Devil Families. Later on, "He" was corrupted alongside the Chained God Tolzna by the Mother Tree of Desire. "He" restored lucidness during the Fifth Epoch before The Apocalypse. 3 Honorific Name As a Sequence 0, Farbauti possesses an unknown Honorific Name. Pathway Composition as an Ancient God "His" Pathway composition is as follows: 9 Abyss: Uniqueness + 3 Sequence 1. Wheel of Fortune: Uniqueness. Chained: 1 Sequence 1. According to Madam Magician, "He" was born with a Sequence 1 Abomination Beyonder characteristic from a neighboring pathway, making "His" state one of the best among the eight Ancient Gods. "He" had also become the only Ancient God alive in "Their" original form. In fact, if Farbauti were to gather the ingredients of the Abyss Pathway as a Sequence 1 Abomination and complete the deity-ascension ritual to advance, "He" would be equivalent to a True God now—a stronger True God. "He" wouldn't be an Ancient God described by words like madness, cruelty, violence, and bloodlust. However, as the Devil Monarch, even if "He" had done so, "He" would inevitably exhibit the characteristics of the Abyss, experiencing strong influence from this pathway. Therefore, Farbauti is also one of the two or three most unhinged Ancient Gods. This doesn't contradict "His" better state. Later, "He" sacrificed the the Uniqueness of Wheel of Fortune to escape from the Ancient Sun God in the Second Epoch. 5 Author's WeChat post ancient_gods, part 31 Afterwards, because "His" remaining characteristics were only the neighboring Abyss and Abomination, even without an Apotheosis Ritual, "He" would be considered a crazy True God. 1 At some point, "He" gave the Sequence 1 Abomination Beyonder characteristic to Naboredisley, "His" other identity. 2 History According to the Myth of Creation, "He" and the rest of the devils were formed from the stomach, intestines, and the other evil parts of the body of the Original Creator. 10 The Blood Sanctify Sect worship "Him" as the Dark Side of The Universe , they believe believe that "He" is the ruler of the Abyss and that "He" is the devastator of the world who would corrupt and degenerate the real world's entire universe. 11 In truth, "He" was a remnant of the Pre-Epoch, a survivor after the Original Creator woke up. When "He" recovered fragments of thought and memory, "He" was already a great devil. Those fragments were soon drowned out by madness and blood lust, only returning near the end of the First Epoch. 6 Book 2, chapter 1125 "He" became one of the eight Ancient Gods of the Second Epoch afterwards. 7 Book 1, chapter 313 Among the Ancient Gods, the Devil Monarch Farbauti and the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea were independent beings who wanted to subvert all order and corrupt all living beings. 12 According to records of the City of Silver, "He", along with the other Ancient Gods all lost "Their" godhood after the Ancient Sun God reclaimed "His" authorities from the Ancient Gods. 7 However, the truth is that during the Dawn Era in the Second Epoch, "He" was gravely wounded by the Ancient Sun God. By using the majority of the demon race and "His" own power (including the the Uniqueness of Wheel of Fortune 5 ) as sacrificial tribute, "He" converted the Islands of Beginning into the Abyss, sealing it away from the outside world, and using this method to evade the radiance of The Omniscient and Omnipotent. 13 Only the Forsaken Land of the Gods still remembers the Dark Side of the Universe. The rest of the world has already forgotten "His" name and only knows the Dark Side of the Universe as the evil god of the Abyss Pathway. At some point in the Fourth Epoch, "He" was corrupted by the Mother Tree of Desire since "His" pathway originally belonged to "Her". 14 15 For some reason, the Underworld Daoist agreed to "His" request for help, causing the Naboredisley's corpse that contained the Abomination characteristic to slumber in a special dream, while being sealed by Death's mask, thus free from the harrassment of the Mother Tree of Desire. 16 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, Amon placed the first Blasphemy Slate into the Fog Sea, near the Abyss' entrance. This, combined with the enhanced seal brought about by the corresponding authority of Door and half of the Lord of the Astral World's control towards the world barrier prevents the Outer Deities from being able to have "Their" powers penetrate inside for a short period. Without the influence of the Outer Deities, the Dark Side of the Universe and the Chained God did not wish to interfere in the battle of gods. "They" would rather seize this opportunity to escape "Their" restraints. 17 As per the content of the book "A Summary of Rumors and Hearsay Before the Cataclysm" in the New City of Silver's library, the name Devil Monarch Farbauti was mentioned: After the Devil Monarch Farbauti led the Devils back to the Abyss, occasional rumors persisted of Demons enticing humans. “The Demons operated under the following names: “Beelbubli, Almos, Samael, Lilatan, and Naboredisley. “A high-ranking Demon Hunter speculated that these names conceal the aliases of Devil Monarch Farbauti… Book 2, chapter 631 The alias of the Devil Monarch Farbauti is Naboredisley. The Abomination form chose to sleep and be a corpse in the dream tomb of Tizamo Town. This will allow "His" corpse to enjoy peace and tranquility, safe from the Mother Tree of Desire's harassment. "He" chose to continue in this dead state until after The Apocalypse. 2 Book 2, chapter 697 In The Day of Many Disasters, because the Primordial God Almighty nearly resurrected, the Devil Monarch Farbauti experienced the revival of the malicious consciousness and frenzied spirit of the Primordial God Almighty within "Him", because the Primordial God Almighty had once accommodated the Tenebrous World in the past. To a certain extent, it balanced the corruption of the Mother Tree of Desire, allowing "Him" to regain a semblance of peace. However, since the revival of the Primordial God Almighty was short-lived, with "His" consciousness retreating to the Chaos Sea. "He" left only "His" malicious spirit, preventing a true balance. Farbauti remained unable to fully escape the control of the Mother Tree of Desire. However, "His" condition had relatively improved—"He" no longer relied on Lilith's aid. 6 Naboredisley and Lumian Lee had agreed to collaborate. The plan was that, when Lumian next performed a deep secret deed and projected his spirit and consciousness into the City of Calamity, he would take Farbauti's mental imprint with him. This will help Farbauti establish a preliminary connection with the Tenebrous World. This is possible because the Primordial God Almighty had once accommodated both the City of Calamity and the Tenebrous World, so the two Sefirot had mutually corrupted each other. Through the Tenebrous World's corruption within the City of Calamity, Farbauti can establish an initial connection. This would also benefit Lumian since Farbauti's mental imprint, fused with the Tenebrous World's corruption, would mitigate related risks when Lumian accommodate the City of Calamity, reducing potential dangers to some extent. If this plan succeeds, Naboredisley's sealed Abomination avatar will die, and Lumian may claim its resulting Beyonder characteristic as his own. 6 Before The Apocalypse, when Lumian projected his spirit and consciousness into the City of Calamity, Farbauti directly infiltrated his mind and spirit, and neutralized the Tenebrous World's corruption within the City of Calamity. 3 Book 2, chapter 1152 When the fight against the Outer Deities first started, the Master of the Shadow Cottage met Farbauti in the Tenebrous World. Both beings were unwilling to accept the fate of being devoured by the Great Old Dominators and decided to cooperate. 18 "They" fused together with the Tenebrous World to form a quasi-Father of Devils, the Pitch-Black Fiend. 4 Main article: Pitch-Black Fiend Subsidiary Gods Goddess of Succubi Demon of the Hidden Void Archdemon Shadow Demon King Demon of Slaughter See also Naboredisley Pitch-Black Fiend Trivia Fárbauti is the father of Loki, and is a jötunn in Norse mythology. "He" was an Australian. 19 Translations Language Name English Farbauti Devil Monarch Dark Side of the Universe Chinese 法布提 恶魔君王 宇宙暗面 Thai ฟาร์โบติ ราชาอสุรกาย กาฬพักตร์แห่งจักรวาล References Author's WeChat post ancient_gods, part 27.
