title: Ankewelt
summary: The Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt is one of the eight Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch.
searchText: Ankewelt Ancient God Ankewelt Overview Other Identities : Ariehogg, Alzuhod Regarding the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt, there was a legend that whatever he imagined would manifest. The kingdom he imagined would definitely descend upon the material world. The future it declares would definitely play out and become reality. Derrick Berg, Book 1, chapter 238 The Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt is one of the eight Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch. "He" was an Ancient God of the Visionary, and the White Tower. "He" also had authorities over the Paragon. Appearance In the sea, an even bigger grayish-white dragon spanning a thousand meters long rose up. One of “His” vertical pupils was pale gold and the other was bright red color. There was a third eye on the dragon’s forehead. It seemed to be hiding a thick shadow. Book 1, chapter 1343 "His" appearance was influenced by Chaos Sea corruption. 2 Pathway Composition as an Ancient God "His" Pathway composition is as follows: 3 Visionary: Uniqueness + 2 Sequence 1 + 1 Sequence 1 (Envisioned). White Tower: Uniqueness + 1 Sequence 1. Paragon: 1 Sequence 1 (Later separated) + 1 Sequence 2 Hermit: Unknown 4 "He" was initially called an Ancient God because "He" had Sequence 1 characteristics from other Pathways aside from the adjacent Visionary and White Tower. Later on, "He" gradually gave birth to children to expel the Sequence 1 characteristics from other pathways — killing all except the child that became the Dragon of Nightmare. "His" state then could be defined as a True God; however, because "He" still appeared quite mad on the surface, everyone else considered "Him" an Ancient God, as others couldn't see the detailed composition of "His" characteristics. 1 Author's WeChat post ancient_gods, part 9 "He" expelled 1 Paragon Sequence 1 through giving birth to children. 5 "His" Sequence 2 Paragon characteristic has Sefirah contamination. "He" could have expelled it, but to resist the malignant aspects related to the Sefirah, "He" needed some corruption from the Paragon side to help. 6 History According to the Myth of Creation, the dragons were formed from the brain of the Original Creator. 7 "He" was born in the mid First Epoch. 8 In the elves' chronicle, during the Early Era of Fire of the Second Epoch, the non-humans races fought against the quasi-humans races, devils and demonic wolves. This corresponds to the records of the City of Silver. "He", the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, and the Mutated King Kvastir were on one side, fighting together against the Giant King Aurmir, the Elf King Soniathrym, the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, the Devil Monarch Farbauti, and the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea. 9 According to records of the City of Silver, "He", along with the other Ancient Gods, all lost "Their" godhood after the Ancient Sun God awakened and reclaimed "His" authorities. Only the Forsaken Land of the Gods still remembered the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt . The rest of the world has already forgotten "His" existence; recently, the god of the Visionary Pathway had been replaced by the Visionary Adam. Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt had conjured a floating city with massive temple pillars supporting a towering palace complex. The name of the city was Liveseyd, meaning the City of Miracles. It disappeared and became a myth. However, Klein, Audrey, and Leonard found its traces in the Groselle's Travels. Resurrection Plan The specialty of Visionary Pathway allowed Ankewelt to be able to create Alzuhod with "His" Sequence 1 Author Beyonder characteristic and one of "His" identity or a certain lifeform that’s ‘ Envisioned .’ However, Ankewelt had been corrupted and had characteristics of other pathways, putting "Him" in a poor condition, unable to separate the 2nd sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic without losing control. Nonetheless, through certain methods, Alzuhod would become Ankewelt . 10 Alzuhod Ankewelt planned the meeting of the Quill of Alzuhod and Groselle's Travels in the real world. The meeting would awaken the Quill, i.e. a Sequence 1 Author Beyonder Characteristic. Then combined with the negative personality sealed behind the bronze door in the Liveseyd in Groselle's Travels, Ankewelt would be able to use the power of Chaos Sea and become one of the strongest King of Angels. Such a foundation would have given "Him" a chance to compete with Adam for the position of and completely revive, but if "He" resurrected using only the Quill of Alzuhod and tried to manipulate things using "His" negative personality, "He" would be in a very dangerous situation because there is a deep connection between the negative personality and Chaos Sea. Thus, the negative personality is a bit stronger than "Him," there would be all kinds of issues. 11 This plan failed because of Adam's interference. title: Lilith
summary: Lilith was once an Ancient Goddess of the Moon Pathway, known as the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, and was believed to have perished during the Second Epoch.
searchText: Lilith True God Lilith Overview Some things must be done. Some hopes must be fought for. Lilith, Book 2, chapter 1121 Lilith was once an Ancient Goddess of the Moon Pathway, known as the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith , and was believed to have perished during the Second Epoch. Honorific Name After World War The Source of Life; The Mother of All Things; The Propagation of the Fertile Land; The Symbol of the Crimson Moon and Reproduction; The Destination and the Starting Point of Everything (生命的源泉， 万物的母亲， 托起丰饶的大地， 红月和繁衍的象征， 一切的归宿、一切的起点) Before World War The Source of Life; The Mother of All Things; The Ultimate Destination; The Propagation of the Fertile Land; The Symbol of Fertility and Reproduction (生命的源泉， 万物的母亲， 最终的归宿， 托起丰饶的大地， 生育和繁衍的象征) Sacred Emblem Sacred Emblem is the symbol of the Gods which worshiped and glorified by people in the Fifth Epoch. The symbol of the Earth Mother is the Sacred Emblem of Life. Its represented by a baby surrounded by the symbols of wheat, flowers, and spring water. 3 Book 1, chapter 261 This Sacred Emblem is used by "Her" Church as its symbol. Appearance Sanguine Ancestor Lilith was the most beautiful deity when "She" was one of the Ancient Gods. Back then, "She" was the most beautiful woman, the most beautiful creature, and the most beautiful deity in the entire world and universe. Book 2, chapter 1150 However, although regarded as the Embodiment of Beauty, "She" also had a disgusting and ferocious side. "For instance, 'She' would manifest into a mountain range of flesh. On top of it grew all kinds of reproductive organs as they spewed out thick black fog while constantly producing all sorts of strange creatures. All powerhouses who approached 'Her' would be overwhelmed by the desire to mate and reproduce, becoming a walking organ." Book 1, chapter 514 Earth Mother In Third Epoch: Sitting on the table side with Tolzna, Salinger, and Badheil, is a supple, beautiful, and dignified lady. 4 Book 1, chapter 1117 Discovered in the Giant King's Court in the Rose Redemption mural. In Fourth Epoch: "She" appears as a plump and beautiful lady, with ears of wheat growing from "Her" feet, and "She" is surrounded by spring water. "Her" dress seems to flutter, and embedded in it, there are different herbs and flowers, as well as the depiction of different animals. "She" appears tall and sacred. In "Her" arms is an adorable infant in swaddling clothes. 3 The Earth Mother statue hugged a baby. 16 Discovered in the Tudor-Trunsoest Underground Ruins. In Fifth Epoch: A figure twined by deep green vines and adorned with various herbs and flowers appeared. "She" was as huge as a mountain and had a voluptuous figure. "Her" dress fluttered as "She" carried an illusory baby. 17 During the 1350 World War. "She" had a voluptuous and graceful figure, radiating maternal warmth. 5 "She" had dark brown hair. 18 After The Day of Many Disasters . Twisted Version: A supple and beautiful woman. "Her" chest bulged, propping "Her" clothes up. In "Her" arms was face-rotting baby, and at "Her" feet were black ears of wheat, spring water squirming with flesh, herbs dripping with pus, and wildly-mating animals. 6 Book 1, chapter 455 Discovered in the Forsaken Land of the Gods in the True Creator's Temple mural. Pathway Composition as an Ancient God "Her" Pathway composition is as follows: 19 Moon: Uniqueness + 1 Sequence 1. Mother: 1 Sequence 1. Demoness: Uniqueness (Controlled) + 1 Sequence 1. In addition, "She" also accommodated a Sequence 2 characteristic of the Demoness, later known as Lilith's Hair and was preserved for a long time without being used after "Her" death. 7 Author's WeChat post fate_formulas, part 54 Even though "She" didn't have support from all 3 Sequence 1 Beauty Goddess, the reason why "She" didn't retrieve the Beauty Goddess characteristics is because "She" was afraid of deepening the Mother Goddess of Depravity's influence. Furthermore, after replacing Omebella, "She" didn't want to expose the identity of Lilith. And giving the characteristics to the Sanguines was equivalent to keeping them under "Her" control. 20 Among the Ancient Gods, "She" had relatively less madness because of several reasons: Beyonders of the Mother and Moon Pathways didn't need to worry about the awakening of the Original Creator in their bodies because their Beyonder Characteristics didn't directly come from "Him", but from the Mother Goddess of Depravity. 8 Book 1, chapter 1353 Back in the Second Epoch, the Astral Barrier was still sufficiently sturdy, separating the Mother Goddess of Depravity from Earth, making it difficult for "Her" to exert too much of an influence on the situation inside. 8 Even though the Demoness Pathway doesn't neighbor the Mother and Moon Pathways, the Original Creator's feminine aspect and the universe' feminine aspect are, to some extent, equivalent, leading to convergence without causing excessive madness. 7 The will and spirit of the Malevolent Dragon—the Original Creator's persona presiding over the Demoness Pathway—had already been shattered by the Primordial God Almighty. 7 History Pre-Epoch Lilith (Former Name Unknown) was a human who survived the Earth Cataclysm 2 because of luck. 21 She was most likely of European descent. 22 She was born as a woman. 23 Second Epoch "She" was one of the eight Ancient Gods in the Second Epoch, the Sanguines Ancestor Lilith . The Sanguines regard the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith as their ancestor and God. One of "Her" symbols is a pair of huge bat wings that covered half of the crimson moon. 9 Book 1, chapter 1166 During the Early Era of Fire, the quasi-humans races fought against the non-humans races, devils and demonic wolves. The Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, the Giant King Aurmir, and the Elf King Soniathrym were on one side, fighting against the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt, the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, the Mutated King Kvastir on the other side, while the Devil Monarch Farbauti and the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea were independent beings who wanted to subvert all order and corrupt all living beings. 24 At some point after the Ancient Sun God woke up, "He" started cooperating with the Goddess of Misfortune Amanises and the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith. 25 At the end of the Early Era of Fire, the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea, and Mutated King Kvastir perished together in a conspiracy 10 Author's WeChat post history that was part of the Ancient Sun God's plan. 26 However, "She" didn't completely perish. When "She" self-detonated, "She" also dragged "Her" Mirror Person along to achieve the ultimate goal of trading "Herself" for the other two Ancient Gods. 27 After Lilith's fall, the the Uniqueness of Moon was stolen and eventually passed into the hands of the Evernight Goddess. The Beauty Goddess Characteristic was retrieved by the Sanguines and became a sacred object. At that time, the First Blasphemy Slate was not yet known to the world, and the Sanguines did not dare let their Sanguine Dukes ascend recklessly. Auernia also did not dare to risk it. 11 Author's WeChat post beauty_goddess By having the Evernight Goddess help "Her" safeguard the the Uniqueness of Moon, Lilith could better resist the Mother Goddess of Depravity's influence to some extent. 28 Afterwards, the Evernight Goddess used the the Uniqueness of Moon to satisfy the Darkness. 29 Later, the Evernight Goddess collaborated with the Ancient Sun God to help Lilith pretend to be Omebella using "Her" Authority over Concealment , while the Ancient Sun God used "His" Authority of the Error Pathway to help Lilith steal the fate of the Giant Queen. 30 After switching to Omebella's identity, Lilith did not immediately advance to Mother until Badheil lived up to "Her" expectations and became the God of Combat to satisfy the Mother. 31 The reason "She" didn't just consume the Beyonder Characteristics directly was because the Ancient Sun God persuaded "Her" to wait for the ritual. 32 At some point, "She" helped the Ancient Sun God catalyze the activation of the the Uniqueness of Error using "Her" Mother Authority, leading to Amon's birth at the beginning of the Third Epoch. 33 Only the Forsaken Land of the Gods still remembers about the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith . "She" controlled the crimson moon and could make the Blood Moon appear any time "She" wanted. 9 Third Epoch According to the Orthodox Churches' myth, the Earth Mother appeared in the Third Epoch and helped humanity through the Cataclysm, along with the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, the Evernight Goddess, and the God of Combat. 34 The true history is that, during the Third Epoch, the three True Gods - Evernight Goddess, God of Combat, and Earth Mother - gradually stepped onto the world's stage. These three formed alliances with each other, going against "The Omniscient and Omnipotent". Since the power gap between "Them" and "The Omniscient and Omnipotent" was still relatively large, the three of "Them" nearly perished on multiple occasions. However, just as "The Omniscient and Omnipotent" and "His" faction were about to win completely, "He" began to have problems with the revival of the Primordial God Almighty inside "Himself". 10 Later, the Earth Mother joined Rose Redemption as a member of the Subsidiary Gods faction under the Evernight Goddess, which eventually caused Ancient Sun God's death. 4 Fourth Epoch Due to the fall of the Ancient Sun God, Sequence 0 became critically important, and correspondingly, the status of Kings of Angels was elevated. With the spread of potion formulas from the Second Blasphemy Slate, Auernia used Lilith's Beauty Goddess Characteristic to concoct a potion, completed the ritual, and became a Sequence 1 King of Angels with 2 Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics. As a result, "Her" condition greatly improved. 11 After the Warring Era which lasted 112 years, Solomon became the Black Emperor with the help of the True Creator. By this time, all deities had "Their" own countries in poorer places, and acknowledged the Black Emperor's rule over the Northern Continent in order to fight against the opposing factions, preventing "Them" from forming a stable alliance to fight against the True Creator. At this time, the Earth Mother's attitude was vague and unclear, but "She" was more inclined towards the God of Combat. 35 Later on, the Six Gods reached a common agreement to fight against the True Creator's faction, which led to the fall of the Black Emperor and the first Solomon Empire. Afterwards, the Six Gods supported the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire that ruled the Northern Continent. When the Black Emperor was about to resurrect, the Six Gods chose Trunsoest over Alista Tudor to ascend to Justiciar, becoming the Night Emperor. With the help of Amon and Adam, Alista Tudor became the Red Priest, becoming the Blood Emperor. The Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire fractured. During the War of the Four Emperors, Auernia fell. Lilith, fearing the exposure of "Her" identity and latent corruption, chose to seize Auernia's original Beauty Goddess Characteristic. Meanwhile, the Beauty Goddess Characteristic reclaimed by the Sanguines—bearing Lilith's spiritual imprint and remnants of Auernia's consciousness—once again became the Sealed Artifact Shadow of the Beauty Goddess, which was later stolen by the Rose School of Thought and used to fabricate the public identity of the Primordial Moon. 11 At some point, "She" helped the Devil Monarch Farbauti partitioned "His" Naboredisley's soul and established a cycle of rebirth, growth, aging, death, and rebirth again to resist corruption from the main body on Hanth Island. 36 37 This was done to prevent further influence from the Mother Tree of Desire. 38 During the Conflicts of the Seven Gods - the period of over 100 years after the War of the Four Emperors - the Seven Gods fractured and supported different Angel Families of the Trunsoest Empire to form "Their" own country. 39 The Earth Mother and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom supported the Castiya Family to establish the Feynapotter Kingdom. 10 The Eternal Blazing Sun allied with the God of Combat (Feysac Empire and Intis Kingdom); the Lord of Storms allied with the Evernight Goddess and the God of Craftsmanship (Loen Kingdom); the Earth Mother allied with the God of Knowledge and Wisdom (former Feynapotter Kingdom). They began to fight one another for the next 167 years. 10 In the Pale Era, when Death went mad and caused havoc on the Northern Continent with the Primordial Demoness 40 , the Seven Gods were defeated and retreated at every turn. Eventually, "They" finally took the time to sit down once again and decided to join hands again. After a carefully schemed war with cataclysmic consequences, Death fell, and the Primordial Demoness was severely wounded. 41 All Seven Gods were also heavily injured. More and more cracks started appearing on the Earth's Astral Barrier, forcing the Seven Gods to move their Divine Kingdoms to the Astral World to mend the cracks. 42 Now, the Seven Gods were unable to leave, and could only send avatars to descend onto reality. 10 Fifth Epoch The Earth Mother's old Divine Kingdom on Earth later became the headquarters of the Church of the Earth Mother. 43 After the Battle of the Violated Oath, the Earth Mother became the only religion of Feynapotter. The Earth Mother likes the giants, and even amongst "Her" Blessed, they are Feysacians. 44 "She" decided to bet on Klein early on by showing a revelation to Nibbs Odora depicting The Apocalypse and mentioning The Fool and the corresponding Honorific Name. 12 Book 1, chapter 1371 45 This eventually led to Emlyn White praying to The Fool and joining the Tarot Club. The Ancestor told me that the apocalypse is near and that we must prepare for it, and you, Emlyn White, are one of the key elements in the Ancestor's revelation. Nibbs Odora, Book 1, chapter 458 George III's Apotheosis Ritual All Seven Gods wanted to have a Black Emperor, but they were not unanimous in "Their" candidate. As such, when George III managed to obtain the opportunity to become one through his preparations, the Seven Gods had no choice but to give "Their" tacit agreement. 13 Book 1, chapter 1087 However, eventually George III's Apotheosis Ritual failed and "He" died on the spot. 1350 World War - Evernight Goddess and Lilith The Earth Mother initially appeared to be on the side of the God of Combat and led Feynapotter to invade Lenburg. 13 Near the end of the war, "She" and the God of Combat confronted the Evernight Goddess in Backlund. 46 "She" killed the God of Combat by stabbing "Him" in the back and received the Uniqueness of Moon from the Evernight Goddess. 1 12 "She" and the Church of the Earth Mother gained an advantage in Loen due to the retreat of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery. 47 Amon's Apotheosis Ritual "She", along with the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Evernight Goddess, the Lord of Storms, the God of Steam and Machinery, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom held off the Mother Goddess of Depravity when Mr. Door returned back to Earth because of Amon's and Medici's plan. 48 49 Klein's Apotheosis Ritual During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, "She" was on Klein's side. "She" and the God of Steam and Machinery held off the Primordial Demoness and the Hidden Sage respectively, as well as preventing a portion of Amon's avatars from disrupting Klein's advancement to the Fool. Because of "Her" and the God of Steam and Machinery's influences, all Angels could not see what was happening in the Astral World. 50 The Day of Many Disasters The Apocalypse Subsidiary Gods Goddess of Beauty Auernia God of the Full Moon Olmer Goddess of Life Alternate World Queen Trivia When Klein received the information about Lilith's Ring from Emlyn, he lampooned that using the ability Door of Summoning might one day summon the ancient goddess Lilith herself. 53 Later this actually happened, and Lilith manifested as a silver moon to help Emlyn. 54 The crimson moon hanging in the sky, partially obscured by a pair of bat wings, was said in Sanguine legends to be one of the symbols of Lilith. 55 Related Mythical Items Lilith's Ring Translations Language Name English Lilith Sanguine Ancestor Earth Mother Chinese 莉莉丝 血族始祖 大地母神 Thai ลิลิธ ต้นตระกูลผีดูดเลือด เทพมารดรแห่งแผ่นดิน References Book 1, chapter 1266. title: Eternal Blazing Sun
summary: The Eternal Blazing Sun is the Sequence 0 God of the Sun and the deity worshipped by the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun. The Intis Republic follows this faith.
searchText: Eternal Blazing Sun True God Eternal Blazing Sun Overview Because He is the proud Sun. Book 2, chapter 492 The Eternal Blazing Sun is the Sequence 0 God of the Sun and the deity worshipped by the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun. The Intis Republic follows this faith. Honorific Name Eternal Blazing Sun; Inextinguishable Light; Embodiment of Order; God of Contracts; Guardian of Businesses (永恒烈阳， 不灭之光， 秩序化身， 契约之神， 商业守护者) The Eternal Blazing Sun also has the title: " Father of all Life ( Suǒyǒu shēnglíng de fùqīn) " but it's just something used by "His" Church when proselytizing. It's beyond "Him" in mysticism. 3 This title is used to point to the Primordial God Almighty to use the power of the Chaos Sea. 1 Book 2, chapter 1115 Sacred Emblem Eternal Blazing Sun' Sacred Emblem is an abstract sun made of gold and surrounded by lines. 4 5 A Sacred Emblem is the symbol of the Gods worshiped and glorified by people in the 5th Epoch. Appearance In Third Epoch: He was a handsome, radiant, and energetic young man. He wore a pure white robe and had short golden hair. His appearance would bring a ray of light that would make the surrounding abnormally bright. In Fourth Epoch: He looked like a young man in a pure white robe, holding a book of deeds in one hand and a golden sphere that resembled the sun in the other. He was handsome and spirited. Twisted Version: A young man wearing a pure white robe. His face was painted with a pure gold color, and there were tentacles in the form of light growing out of his skin. In his hands was a putrid-green book and a spear formed of light, and his chest and back were inverted. Twisted version was discovered in Forsaken Land of the Gods in the True Creator's Temple. History Lord of Mysteries According to orthodox legend, the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom were formed from the spirit of the Original Creator. The three of them helped humanity through the Cataclysm during the Third Epoch along with the Evernight Goddess, the Earth Mother, and the God of Combat. 6 In truth, "He" was once known as the White Angel Aucuses , one of the eight Kings of Angels who served under the Ancient Sun God during the Third Epoch. "He" was a loyal follower of the Ancient Sun God, brave, honest, having been that way from the time when "He" were weak till "He" became strong. 7 "He" was not born as an Innate Mythical Creature, and only ascended to Angelhood later on. 8 Later, Aucuses aligned himself with the Rose Redemption and became part of the faction led by Dark Angel Sasrir. This allegiance played a key role in the downfall of the Ancient Sun God. 9 After "His" death, Aucuses capitalized on the chaos of the divine war and leveraged the power of the Evernight Goddess, ascending to Sequence 0 of the Sun. 10 In the Fourth Epoch, all deities have "Their" own countries in poorer places and acknowledged the first Solomon Empire and the Black Emperor's rule over the Northern Continent in order to fight against the opposing factions. At this time, the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom had conflicts with each other due to "Their" neighboring pathways. Later on, "He" reached a common agreement with the other five Orthodox Gods, which led to the fall of the Black Emperor and the first Solomon Empire. Afterwards, the Six Gods supported the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire that ruled the Northern Continent. When the Black Emperor was about to resurrect, the Six Gods helped Trunsoest to switch to Justiciar of the Justiciar, becoming the Night Emperor. After the War of the Four Emperors, the Seven Gods (including the God of Craftsmanship who ascended during the war) fractured and supported different Angel Families of the Trunsoest Empire to form their own country. 11 The Eternal Blazing Sun supported the Sauron Family to create the Intis Kingdom, and allied with the Feysac Empire under the God of Combat. The Seven Gods then began fighting each other for the 167 years of the Conflicts of the Seven Gods. 12 Later on, in the Pale Era, when Death went mad and caused havoc on the Northern Continent with the Primordial Demoness, 13 the Seven Gods joined force and caused the destruction of Death and a fatal blow to the Primordial Demoness. When the barrier around the Earth cracked at the end of the Fourth Epoch, the Seven Gods moved "Their" Divine Kingdoms into the Astral World to mend the cracks. 14 "His" old Divine Kingdom on Earth later became the headquarters of the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun. 15 In the Fifth Epoch, "His" believers are mainly in the Intis Republic. Klein once divined about the origins of the Mutated Sun Sacred Emblem, which contained the divine blood of the Eternal Blazing Sun. When Klein looked directly at "Him" due to the divination, he suffered extreme repercussions, which were eventually neutralized by the Sefirah Castle but he learned a few things thanks to that. One of them was the mention of a White Angel , which was the name of the Eternal Blazing Sun when he served the Ancient Sun God. The other is the fact "He" is extremely hostile towards Lord of Storms and God of Knowledge and Wisdom. It was revealed later, it's because "They" are Gods of the same group. Klein also learned the Sequences, Bard, Light Supplicant, Priest of Light potion formulas of the Sun, part of the Sequence 4, Unshadowed potion formula, and how to make a Flaring Sun Charm, a relatively high level charm in the domain of the Sun. 16 All Seven Gods wanted to have a Black Emperor, but they were not unanimous in their candidate. As such, when George Augustus III managed to obtain the opportunity to become one through his preparations, the Seven Gods had no choice but to give their tacit agreement. 17 However, eventually George III's advancement ritual failed and he died on the spot. In the 1350 World War, "He" stood on the God of Combat's side and fought against the God of Knowledge and Wisdom in Lenburg. 18 They lost the war. "He", along with the Evernight Goddess, the Earth Mother, the God of Steam and Machinery, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom held off the Mother Goddess of Depravity when Mr. Door returned back to Earth because of Amon's and Medici's plan. 19 20 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, "He" was on Klein's side. "He", the Lord of Storms and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom fought against Adam. 21 Circle of Inevitability "He" and Medici carried out a big conspiracy with the short-term goal of eradicating all the most formidable Evil God's bestowed in Trier and the long-term goal of helping Medici become a Great Old One. "He" didn't repent or return to the Original Lord's side, nor did "He" submit to the Mother Goddess of Depravity who reigned above the gods. Instead, "He" chose the path of enduring pressure and facing the worst possible outcome to support a new Great Old One. This decision may have seemed nearly the worst, yet "He" embraced it wholeheartedly. 22 Long ago, since the Third Epoch, 23 fragments of the Primordial God Almighty's consciousness began reviving within "Him". For a time, "He" would even occasionally lose control of "Himself". After an extensive period, "He" finally managed to suppress "His" alienated self and achieve a fragile balance, which allowed "Him" to partially harness the power of the Chaos Sea . However, "He" had to tread carefully and limit the frequency of use. Otherwise, the corruption and alienation would deepen, and the balance would collapse. 1 In The Day of Many Disasters in late 1359 of the Fifth Epoch, after the birth of Omebella, which caused the Primordial God Almighty's consciousness to be significantly strengthened within "Him", "He" was killed by the Evernight Goddess to prevent the Primordial God Almighty's resurrection inside "Him" at his request, because "His" pride made "Him" prefer dying as a god rather than losing "Himself" and lingering in torment. 1 Translations Language Name English Eternal Blazing Sun White Angel Aucuses Chinese 永恒烈阳 纯白天使 奥赛库斯 Thai สุริยเทพนิรันดร์ เทวทูตสีขาว ออเซคุส References Book 2, chapter 1115. title: Evernight Goddess
summary: The Evernight Goddess is the Goddess of the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
searchText: Evernight Goddess True God Evernight Goddess Overview The era that was buried in the past is a memory shared between us, and also the critical period in which our humanity was born, sprouted, and nourished. Even if I’ve had a long life, it remains my fondest memories. Evernight Goddess, Book 1, chapter 1370 The Evernight Goddess is the Goddess of the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Although it is widely believed that as the Lady of Crimson, the Evernight Goddess' symbol is The Moon, Mr. Door has said that the Tarot Card that better represents "Her" is The Star. 5 "She" was the first god Klein became familiar with by joining the Nighthawks. Honorific Name After The Apocalypse Eternal Darkness; Singularity of All; Space-Time-in-One (永恒之暗， 万物奇点， 时空归一者) After World War The Evernight Goddess stands higher than the cosmos and more eternal than eternity; The Mother of Concealment; The Empress of Misfortune and Horror; Mistress of Repose and Silence (比星空更崇高 比永恒更久远的黑夜女神， 隐秘之母， 厄难与恐惧的女皇， 安眠和寂静的领主) Note: After the 1350 World War, " Lady of Crimson " was removed from "Her" title, since "She" gave up the authority of the moon. 2 Book 1, chapter 1277 Before World War The Evernight Goddess stands higher than the cosmos and more eternal than eternity; The Lady of Crimson; The Mother of Concealment; The Empress of Misfortune and Horror; Mistress of Repose and Silence (比星空更崇高 比永恒更久远的黑夜女神， 绯红之主， 隐秘之母， 厄难与恐惧的女皇， 安眠和寂静的领主) Sacred Emblem Sacred Emblems are the symbols of the Gods which are worshipped and glorified by the people in the Fifth Epoch. The symbol of the Evernight Goddess is the Dark Sacred Emblem. Its base was black, with a crimson half-moon surrounded by radiant light points. After the World War, "Her" symbol changed from the crimson moon to that of stars. 2 Appearance As an orthodox god, "She" doesn't have an actual figure for people to worship. However, "Her" appearance is shown in the ruins of the Fourth Epoch. In Fourth Epoch: The Evernight Goddess is an extremely beautiful lady with a hazy face. "She" wears a layered black classical dress that isn't overly complex. A circle of radiating rays is at the bottom of "Her" head. On this lady’s dress, there are sparkling specks of radiance. They are pieces of bright and resplendent gems. At first glance, it feels as though you are seeing the night and the stars. There is a circular shape under the Evernight Goddess’ head that resembles a full moon. 7 1350 World War: "She" wears a layered black dress with countless sparkling specks of radiance like the stars. "Her" ribs and waist each stretch out two arms. Among the six hands, two of them hold a black scythe, two of them hold a crimson "moon", one is empty, and one holds a golden bird-shaped accessory (that was taken from Azik). 8 Twisted Version (True Creator's Temple, in the Forsaken Land of the Gods): A woman wearing a black, classical dress. "Her" clothes were layered but not complicated, and it was embedded with a starry sheen. "Her" body was relatively ethereal, with signs of rippling outward. "Her" face was blurry, as though "She" was wearing a mask without any facial features. The darkness around "Her" surged as one strange eye after another faintly became discernible. title: Aurmir
summary: The Giant King Aurmir is one of the Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch.
searchText: Aurmir Ancient God Aurmir Overview "His" reputation is exactly the opposite of "His" physical build. Queen of Calamity Cohinem on Aurmir's betrayal of Lilith, Book 1, chapter 1066 The Giant King Aurmir is one of the Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch. "He" was an Ancient God of the Twilight Giant and the Red Priest. "He" also had authorities over the Error. Before dying, Aurmir managed to pass on "His" status as the God of the Twilight Giant Pathway to "His" eldest son Badheil, who later became the God of Combat. Appearance "He" is one-eyed, but it's a right eye. This is the sense of wrongness brought by the Error, 1 Author's WeChat post error_formulas, part 6 since "His" eye contains a Worm of Time Beyonder Characteristic. 7 ;Wraith/Residual Will/Evil Spirit Its skin was grayish-blue, and it wore silver-gray armor that seemed to be stained with blood. Its face was glowing like the setting sun, as though it was a manifestation of its eyes. Just its existence alone had caused the surrounding trees and the void to bend, making everything around it to begin waning uncontrollably. 8 Pathway Composition as an Ancient God "His" Pathway composition is as follows: 2 Author's WeChat post ancient_gods Twilight Giant: Uniqueness + 3 Sequence 1. Red Priest: Uniqueness. Error: 1 Sequence 1. In addition, "He" also had other excess characteristics. Omebella helped "Him" expel many excess characteristics through procreation, and "He" gained a certain amount of sanity through this. 3 Book 2, chapter 890 However, "His" Worm of Time Beyonder Characteristic could not be expelled and was only separated at "His" death due to the overlap between the Error and Twilight Giant's authority over Time , 9 10 causing the Beyonder Characteristics to be deeply fused. Later, the Ancient Sun God, using the Uniqueness of Error, took it from the God of Combat. 11 History First Epoch According to the Myth of Creation, "He" and the rest of the Giants were formed from the heart of the Original Creator. 12 "His" true origins can be traced back to the First Epoch. At that time, "He" was guarding "His" parents corpses despite being a purely mad demigod-level monster. 13 In the Waning Forest, a place only Giant King can enter, buried inside it are "His" parents, who are also the origins of giants. 14 The exploratory team of the City of Silver explored the tomb and found the remains of two human skeletons. One was less than 1.9 meters tall, while the other was less than 1.8 meters tall. It was speculated that "His" origin was in fact human. 15 Omebella's heart was touched by this, "She" then helped "Him" extract "His" excess Beyonder Characteristics through procreation and "He" gained a certain amount of sanity through this. 3 The noble Queen used Her maternal nature to help the great King calm His emotions… Giant King’s Court’s words of praise for the Giant Queen Omebella, Book 2, chapter 890 The death of Zedus and the birth of the Ancient God Aurmir marked the end of the First Epoch. The birth of the very first Ancient God is very significant: It was the very first will of a creature that isn't the will of the Original Creator that became a god in the truest of sense. This also marked the exact moment of when the Original Creator's Astral Barrier began deteriorating. Its countdown to dissipation has begun. Second Epoch Sprouting Era The Giant King Aurmir became one of the eight Ancient Gods that ruled over the entire world. The Giants used to rule over the City of Silver, so the City of Silver now controls the Warrior Pathway. 16 According to the records left by Sanguines, the City of Silver believed in "His" wife, Omebella, rather than "Him". 17 Early Era of Fire In the Elves' chronicle, during the Early Era of Fire, the quasi-humans races led by the Giant King Aurmir, the Elf King Soniathrym, and the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, fought against the non-human races led by Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt, the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace, and the Mutated King Kvastir. The Devil Monarch Farbauti and the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea were not on any side, wanting to destroy and corrupt everything. 18 At the end, Lilith, Kvastir, and Flegrea perished at the same time due to a conspiracy. 4 Author's WeChat post history Dual Era The Giants and Elves completely split in this era, each denouncing the other as traitors and sparked a 230-year-long war, later referred to as the "War of Betrayers" by history. 4 From Siatas' memories, the Elf King Soniathrym believed that Aurmir betrayed Lilith and caused "Her" death. 5 During this time, the Giants under Aurmir and the Dragons under Ankewelt were the dominant race, hence the name of "Dual Era". 5 Book 1, chapter 1066 Using the Proxy Authority of the Twilight Giant, Aurmir was able to slightly use the River of Eternal Darkness, which is the reason why "He" could contend with Ankewelt. 6 Author's WeChat post giant_abilities Era of Tranquility Giants, elves, dragons, demons, and phoenixes reached a stalemate, leading to a period of relative peace. Newborn Elves and Giants began to have more emotions and feelings. 4 From Siatas' memories, Soniathrym went to Giant King's Court to give Aurmir a lesson. 5 It was said that the Giants cooperated with some secret cult that came out of the human race to deal with Soniathrym. This matter was led by Aurmir's wife Omebella and son Badheil. 5 Dawn Era According to records of the City of Silver, Aurmir, along with the other Ancient Gods, all perished after the Ancient Sun God emerged and reclaimed the authorities from "Them". However, the true history is that the Giant King Aurmir didn't perish on the spot at the hands of the Ancient Sun God. "He" used both the Twilight Giant's Proxy and the Red Priest's Sacrifice 19 in a final attack against the Ancient Sun God, and managed to escape and pass on "His" power to "His" eldest son Badheil—the later God of Combat—before dying. 20 6 Legacy Unlike most of Ancient Gods, the Giant King Aurmir was not forgotten. In various legends and myths, "He" is remembered as a great existence on par with the deities. Even now, there were still some places that worshiped "Him". The most famous and most expensive grape wine in the Intis Republic was named after Aurmir. It was said that the Giant King particularly fancied those grape wine which was like blood. 21 It is later revealed, the wine is made and named after the provincial capital Aurmir, named after the Giant King . Aurmir stood as the provincial capital of Champagne Province, renowned as the foremost hub of wine production in the Northern Continent. 22 The residence of the royal family of the Feysac Empire is attributed to the Giant King , named the "Aurmir Palace." 23 Subsidiary Gods God of Dawn Badheil Goddess of Harvest Omebella God of Glory Bladel 3 Unnamed Children of Harvest Related Places Giant King's Court Aurmir Palace Trivia In the Fifth Epoch, "His" phantom/ Evil Spirit protected the graves of "His" parents. "He" was killed by the City of Silver Research Team of Derrick Berg, Colin Iliad, Lovia Tiffany,Joshua, Chaim, and Antioch. During the battle, "He" perceived the light from the Unshadowed Crucifix as a natural enemy. 24 "His" right eye served as an alternative to a Worm of Time Beyonder Characteristic. 25 "He" was one-eyed like all true Giants but "He" possessed a "right eye". title: God of Combat
summary: The God of Combat, is a Sequence 0 God of the Twilight Giant Pathway and the God of the Church of the God of Combat.
searchText: God of Combat True God God of Combat Overview The God of Combat, is a Sequence 0 God of the Twilight Giant Pathway and the God of the Church of the God of Combat. "He" was a Subsidiary God, the God of Dawn , of the Giant King Aurmir and Aurmir's eldest son with the Goddess of Harvest Omebella. "He" succeeded "His" father Aurmir's God position until death. Later, at the end of the 1350 World War, Year 1352 of the Fifth Epoch, "He" was killed by the Evernight Goddess and Lilith, who pretended to be Earth Mother Omebella. Honorific Name Symbol of Power and Glory; The Great Knight God; Master of War; Patron of Guns; Twilight of All Things (力量与荣耀的象征， 伟大的骑士之神， 战争主宰， 枪炮的庇护者， 万物的黄昏) Note: The "Master of War" was trying to claim more domains, but war itself belongs to the Red Priest Pathway. 3 Sacred Emblem Sacred Emblem is the symbol of the Gods which worshiped and glorified by people in the Fifth Epoch. The Sacred Emblem of the God of Combat is the combination of the symbol for dusk and a sword-shaped symbol. This Sacred Emblem is used by "His" Church as its symbol. 4 Appearance In Third Epoch: Sitting on the table side with Tolzna, Salinger, and Omebella, is a giant covered in silver armor. The figure was seven to eight meters tall. "He" was wearing silver full-body armor, and "His" eyes were glowing like the light of dawn. "He" holds a long sword in "His" hand. 1 Book 1, chapter 1117 Discovered in the Giant King's Court in the Rose Redemption mural. In Fourth Epoch: "He" appears as a warrior sitting on a throne high above, holding a sword in front of "Him". "His" face is hidden behind "His" helmet’s visor and "His" entire body is covered with an indescribable sense of decay. 5 The tall and royal God of Combat statue. 6 Discovered in the Tudor-Trunsoest Underground Ruins. In Fifth Epoch: A gigantic mountain-like figure walked out. “His” limbs were abnormally long, and “He” wore tattered silver armor. “His” face was covered by a helmet’s visor, only revealing a blob of orange light. “He” held an exaggerated sword in “His” hand, causing the tip to naturally hang down. 7 During the 1350 World War. Twisted Version: A giant warrior in tattered armor. "He" held a long sword and was sitting on a throne with bleak dusk as its backdrop. 8 Discovered in the Forsaken Land of the Gods in the True Creator's Temple mural. History According to the orthodox churches' legends, the God of Combat appeared in the Third Epoch and helped humanity through the Cataclysm, along with Eternal Blazing Sun, Lord of Storms, God of Knowledge and Wisdom, Evernight Goddess, and Earth Mother. 9 Second Epoch In fact, "He" was the God of Dawn Badheil in the Second Epoch. "He" was the Subsidiary God of the Giant King Aurmir and Aurmir's eldest son with the Goddess of Harvest Omebella. After the fall of the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, the Demonic Wolf Flegrea, and Mutated King Kvastir, Badheil and "His" mother were sent by Aurmir to cooperate with some secret cult that came out of the human race to deal with Elf King Soniathrym and Queen of Calamity Cohinem. 10 Eventually, "His" father fell but managed to pass on "His" power to "Him." 11 Third Epoch Sometime during the early Third Epoch, "He" completed the apotheosis ritual and became Sequence 0 of the Twilight Giant Pathway. 12 Afterwards, as the God of Combat Badheil , "He" joined Rose Redemption as a member of the Subsidiary Gods faction under the Evernight Goddess, which eventually caused Ancient Sun God's death. This assassination battle became known as the Cataclysm. 1 Fourth Epoch In the Fourth Epoch, all deities have "Their" own countries in poorer places and acknowledged the first Solomon Empire and Black Emperor Solomon's domination over the Northern Continent in order to fight against the opposing factions. At this time, the God of Combat had a rivalry conflict with the Evernight Goddess and Death due to "Their" Eternal Darkness group adjacent pathways. 13 Later, "He" reached a common agreement with the other 5 Orthodox Gods, which led to the fall of Solomon and the Solomon Empire. Afterward, the 6 Orthodox Gods supported the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire that ruled the Northern Continent. "They" used the rise of the United Empire to establish the Six Orthodox Churches, with the God of Combat establishing the Church of the God of Combat. When the Black Emperor was about to resurrect, the 6 Gods helped Trunsoest ascend to Justiciar, becoming the Night Emperor and established the Trunsoest Empire. As a consequence, Blood Emperor Alista Tudor forcefully swapped from the Black Emperor Pathway to the Red Priest Pathway to become a half-mad Red Priest, leading to the War of the Four Emperors. Later on, in the Pale Era, when Death went mad and caused havoc on the Northern Continent with Primordial Demoness, 14 the now 7 Orthodox Gods (including the God of Craftsmanship) joined forces and caused the destruction of Death and a fatal blow to the Primordial Demoness. 15 At the end of the Fourth Epoch, the 7 Gods fractured and supported different Angel families of the Trunsoest Empire to form their own country. 16 The God of Combat supported the Einhorn Family to create the Feysac Kingdom, later-to-be Feysac Empire. When the Astral Barrier around the Earth cracked at the end of the Fourth Epoch, "He" and the other Orthodox Gods moved "Their" divine kingdoms into the Astral World to mend the cracks. 17 Fifth Epoch In the Fifth Epoch, "His" believers mainly concentrate in the Feysac Empire, where the headquarters of the Church of the God of Combat is located and the only religion in Feysac. All 7 Orthodox Deities wanted to have a Black Emperor, but "They" were not unanimous in "Their" candidate. As such, when George III managed to obtain the opportunity to become one through his preparations by the year 1350, the 7 Deities had no choice but to give "Their" tacit agreement. 18 However, eventually George III's Apotheosis Ritual failed and he died on the spot. Divine War's Conclusion In response to Evernight Goddess's acquisition of the the Uniqueness of Death in the summer of 1350, the God of Combat initiated the 1350 World War by having Feysac invade Loen. "He" wanted to shake "Her" anchors before engaging in a battle of Gods. 19 Near the end of the war in 1352, "He" confronted the Evernight Goddess in Backlund with the Earth Mother. Li—li—th? God of Combat, Book 1, chapter 1266 However, the Earth Mother, who turned out to be Lilith in disguise, inserted a wooden staff on "His" heart from the back and drained "Him" of "His" life, before the Evernight Goddess finished "Him" off. When "He" died, some of "His" body parts scattered as sunset lights landed on the battlefield and caused countless soldiers to die; some crushed the mountains and created a lake that made all living creatures age; some fused with some creatures and turned them into crazy and powerful monsters, and some enveloped the Great Twilight Hall outside St. Millom. "His" death marked the end of the 1350 World War. 2 Book 1, chapter 1266 The Evernight Goddess successfully obtained from "Him" the the Uniqueness of Twilight Giant, the Twilight Sword . The Twilight That Lingers Larrion, the former Chief Shepherd of the Church of the God of Combat, believed that the God of Combat will return and resurrect in "His" body. 20 The Rise of Warrior Beyonders The death of the God of Combat had caused many Beyonder monsters and abnormalities related to the Twilight Giant Pathway to appear in the past five to six years. 2 This also makes it easier for Beyonders of the Twilight Giant Pathway to find materials (potion formulas and characteristics) and advance, especially for the mid-to-low Sequences. 21 22 23 The Pride Armor is one of the artifact born from "His" lost Beyonder characteristics. 24 "His" partially collapsed divine kingdom also allowed many mystical items and Beyonder Characteristics, including those of neighboring pathways, to fall from the Astral World into reality, onto the earth and into the ocean. 25 Trivia Because of "His" intense aversion and hatred before "His" demise, the God of Combat's scattered Beyonder characteristics after "His" death, like the Pride Armor, are hostile to related things of the Darkness and Mother Pathways. 26 Translations Language Name English God of Combat God of Dawn Badheil Chinese 战神 晨曦之神 巴德海尔 Thai เทพสงคราม เทพแห่งรุ่งอรุณ บัลด์ไฮเออร์ References Book 1, chapter 1117. title: God of Knowledge and Wisdom
summary: The God of Knowledge and Wisdom is the Sequence 0 True God of the White Tower and the God of the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. After the Battle of Violated Oath Lenbur
searchText: God of Knowledge and Wisdom True God God of Knowledge and Wisdom Overview If you truly grasp the allure of knowledge and understand the joy of learning, even a long life will not be plagued by emptiness or torment. Knowledge embraces everything. Knowledge is everything... God of Knowledge and Wisdom, Book 2, chapter 1128 The God of Knowledge and Wisdom is the Sequence 0 True God of the White Tower and the God of the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. After the Battle of Violated Oath Lenburg, Masin, and Segar believe in "Him". Honorific Name The Tower of Knowledge, The Embodiment of Reason, The God of Wisdom, The Scholar that Cognizes Everything (知识之塔， 理性化身， 智慧之神， 洞悉万物的学者。) Sacred Emblem Sacred Emblem is the symbol of the Gods which worshiped and glorified by people in the Fifth Epoch. The Sacred Emblem of Knowledge and Wisdom is an omniscient eye on an open book. 1 "He" has the title of being omniscient and omnipotent. 4 Appearance In Fourth Epoch: He appears as a hooded elder holding a book with an omniscient gaze, with only his mouth, wrinkles, and long white beard exposed. 1 Book 1, chapter 261 Twisted Version: An old man wearing a hood that revealed his mouth, wrinkles, and a white beard. The old man held an open book, and on top of it was an eye that was the symbol of omniscience. At first glance, this old man looked the most normal, but the smile on his face was indescribably evil. Twisted version was discovered in Forsaken Land of the Gods in the True Creator's Temple. 5 History Lord of Mysteries According to orthodox legend, the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom were formed from the spirit of the Original Creator. The three of them helped humanity through the Cataclysm during the Third Epoch along with the Evernight Goddess, the Earth Mother, and the God of Combat. 6 However, "He" is, in fact, the Dragon of Wisdom Herabergen , a Subsidiary God of Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt in the Second Epoch. 7 "He" was born as an Innate Mythical Creature. 8 After the Ankewelt's death, "He" turned to the Ancient Sun God and became the Wisdom Angel , one of the eight Kings of Angels in the Third Epoch. Later, "He" joined Rose Redemption as a member of the Kings of Angels faction under the Dark Angel Sasrir, which eventually caused the Ancient Sun God's death. 9 "He" then betrayed the Ancient Sun God and consumed "His" body along with the Lord of Storms and the Eternal Blazing Sun. Then, "He" became the now-known God of Knowledge and Wisdom, the Sequence 0 of the White Tower. In the Fourth Epoch, all deities have "Their" own countries in poorer places and acknowledged the first Solomon Empire and the Black Emperor's rule over the Northern Continent in order to fight against the opposing factions. At this time, the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom had conflicts with each other due to "Their" neighboring pathways. Later on, "He" reached a common agreement with the other five Orthodox Gods, which led to the fall of the Black Emperor and the first Solomon Empire. Afterwards, the Six Gods supported the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire that ruled the Northern Continent. When the Black Emperor was about to resurrect, the Six Gods helped Trunsoest to switch to Justiciar of the Justiciar, becoming the Night Emperor. After the War of the Four Emperors, the Seven Gods (including the God of Craftsmanship who ascended during the war) fractured and supported different Angel Families of the Trunsoest Empire to form their own country. 10 The God of Knowledge and Wisdom and the Earth Mother supported the Castiya Family to create the Feynapotter Kingdom. The Seven Gods then began fighting each other for the 167 years of the Conflicts of the Seven Gods. 11 Later on, in the Pale Era, when Death went mad and caused havoc on the Northern Continent with the Primordial Demoness, 12 the Seven Gods joined force and caused the destruction of Death and a fatal blow to the Primordial Demoness. When the barrier around the Earth cracked at the end of the Fourth Epoch, the Seven Gods moved "Their" Divine Kingdoms into the Astral World to mend the cracks. 13 "His" old Divine Kingdom on Earth later became the headquarters of the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom - now known as the Holy Temple of Knowledge , Lenburg. 14 In the Fifth Epoch, "He" supported the Feynapotter Kingdom until the Battle of Violated Oath. After the war, Lenburg, Masin, and Segar were separated from Feynapotter and only believed in the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. According to Lucca Brewster, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom had mentioned the prophecy in "His" holy bible: The Apocalypse will happen in the year 1368 in the Fifth Epoch, and there will be a savior. 15 God mentioned in ‘His’ holy bible that the apocalypse will happen in the year 1368 in the Fifth Epoch. Of course, God also said that there will be a savior. Lucca Brewster to Gehrman and Audrey, Book 1, chapter 1099 Through "His" arrangement, Klein received the key to the Giant King's Court, where Sasrir was asleep, via Edwina Edwards. All Seven Gods wanted to have a Black Emperor, but "They" were not unanimous in "Their" candidate. As such, when George III managed to obtain the opportunity to become one through his preparations, the Seven Gods had no choice but to give "Their" tacit agreement. 16 However, eventually George III's Apotheosis Ritual failed and "He" died on the spot. In the 1350 World War, "He" stood on the Evernight Goddess' side and fought against the Eternal Blazing Sun in Lenburg. 17 "They" won the war. "He", along with the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Evernight Goddess, the Earth Mother, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Steam and Machinery held off the Mother Goddess of Depravity when Mr. Door returned back to Earth because of Amon's and Medici's plan. 18 19 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, "He" was on Klein's side. "He", the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the Lord of Storms fought against Adam. 20 Circle of Inevitability After the events following the opening of Fourth Epoch Trier in 1358 of the Fifth Epoch, Lumian Lee received top-secret information on Sealed Artifact 0-01 from Ludwig, who was connected to the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. 21 According to Madam Magician, this was a sign that the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom was willing to support his bid for the Red Priest position, competing against the Red Angel Medici. 22 During The Apocalypse, "He" abandoned "His" main body and chose self-destruction, merging with Grisha Adam to help "Him" battle the Primordial God Almighty's will. In the short term, Herabergen's residual consciousness would help Grisha Adam resist the Primordial God Almighty , forming a fragile new balance. In the long term, however, integrating the the Uniqueness of White Tower at that moment would enhance the Primordial God Almighty's will and spirit, accelerating "His" recovery—significantly disadvantaging Grisha Adam in "Their" struggle. 2 Afterwards, "His" avatar was shown to be sighing within the Protected Zones. 2 Translations Language Name English God of Knowledge and Wisdom Wisdom Angel Herabergen Chinese 知识与智慧之神 智天使 赫拉伯根 Thai เทพแห่งความรู้และความเฉลียวฉลาด เทวทูตแห่งความรู้ เฮราเบอร์เกน References Book 1, chapter 261. title: Lord of Storms
summary: The Lord of Storms, is the Sequence 0 God of the Tyrant Pathway and God of the Church of the Lord of Storms.
searchText: Lord of Storms True God Lord of Storms Overview The Storm will not destroy itself! Nor will it surrender! Lord of Storms, Book 2, chapter 1158 The Lord of Storms, is the Sequence 0 God of the Tyrant Pathway and God of the Church of the Lord of Storms. "He" is one of the two official religions in the Loen Kingdom. The royal family of Loen, Augustus Family, worships the Lord of Storms. Sailors on the sea, including pirates, mostly worship "Him", even in countries that worship another deity. 3 Honorific Name King of the Skies; Emperor of the Seas; Lord of the Calamity; God of the Storms (空之王， 海之皇， 天灾君主， 风暴之神) Sacred Emblem The Storm Sacred Emblem is a symbol of gales and stormy waves. 1 Book 1, chapter 261 Appearance In Fourth Epoch : He looks like a dignified middle-aged man in black armor, standing over churning waves, surrounded by stormy winds, with lightning flashing behind him and a trident in his hand. 1 Twisted Version: A trident-wielding monster with an octopus-like head, wide eyes, and a body wrapped in lightning. The feathers of countless birds formed his cloak, and the darkness turned into waves that supported the bottom of his feet. 5 Twisted version was discovered in Forsaken Land of the Gods in the True Creator's Temple. History Lord of Mysteries According to orthodox legend, the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom were formed from the spirit of the Original Creator. The three of them helped humanity through the Cataclysm during the Third Epoch along with the Evernight Goddess, the Earth Mother, and the God of Combat. 6 "He" is, in fact, the former Wind Angel Leodero, one of the eight Kings of Angels under the Ancient Sun God in the Third Epoch, having followed "Him" from a weak stage until he slowly empowered himself. 7 "He" was not born as an Innate Mythical Creature, and only ascended to Angelhood later on. 8 Later, "He" joined Rose Redemption which eventually caused Ancient Sun God's death. 9 "He" benefited from "His" death and became sequence 0 of the Tyrant Pathway. In the Fourth Epoch, all deities have "Their" own countries in poorer places and acknowledged the first Solomon Empire and the Black Emperor's rule over the Northern Continent in order to fight against the opposing factions. At this time, the Lord of Storms had a conflict with the Eternal Blazing Sun and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom due to their neighboring pathways. 10 Later on, he reached a common agreement with the other 5 Orthodox Gods, which led to the fall of the Black Emperor and the first Solomon Empire. Afterwards, the 6 Orthodox Gods supported the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire that ruled the Northern Continent. When the Black Emperor was about to resurrect, the 6 Gods helped Trunsoest to switch to Sequence 0 of the Justiciar Pathway, becoming the Night Emperor. In the War of the Four Emperors, "He" and the Evernight Goddess banished Bethel Abraham. 11 Later on, in the Pale Era, when Death went mad and caused havoc on the Northern Continent with the Primordial Demoness, 12 the 7 Gods (including the God of Craftsmanship) joined force and caused the destruction of Death and a fatal blow to the Primordial Demoness. At the end of the 4th epoch, the 7 Gods fractured and supported different angel families of the Trunsoest Empire to form their own country. 13 The Lord of Storms supported the Augustus Family to establish the Loen Kingdom, along with the Evernight Goddess and the God of Craftsmanship. When the barrier around the Earth cracked at the end of the 4th epoch, "He" and the other Orthodox Gods moved "Their" divine kingdoms into the Astral World to mend the cracks. 14 "His" old divine kingdom on Earth - the Chasm of Storms on Pasu island - later became the holy altar and the headquarters of the Church of Storms. 15 In the Fifth Epoch, "His" believers are mainly in the Loen Kingdom. All 7 Deities wanted to have a Black Emperor, but "They" were not unanimous in "Their" candidate. As such, when George III managed to obtain the opportunity to become one through his preparations, the 7 Deities had no choice but to give "Their" tacit agreement. 16 However, in the critical moment of George III's Apotheosis Ritual, alerted by Klein's faint summoning of Sefirah Castle in the real world, the Lord of Storms sent down a storm to attack one of the nine Mausoleums. 17 Eventually George III's advancement ritual failed and he died on the spot. When Amon set up a trap for Pallez Zoroast, "He" sent lightning down to stop Amon but was too late to prevent "His" escape. 18 In the 1350 World War, "He" stood on the Evernight Goddess' side and fought against the God of Steam and Machinery in Bayam. 19 "They" won the war. "He", along with the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Evernight Goddess, the Earth Mother, the God of Steam and Machinery, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom held off the Mother Goddess of Depravity when Mr. Door returned back to Earth because of Amon's and Medici's plan. 20 21 After Klein successfully escaped from Adam's Corpse Cathedral, he alerted the Lord of Storms by chanting his name. As a result, the Lord of Storms smote down the Corpse Cathedral and the rest of Utopia with a storm of lightning strikes. 22 23 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, "He" was on Klein's side. "He", the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom fought against Adam. 24 Circle of Inevitability At the end of The Fool's Dream, "He", alongside the Eternal Blazing Sun, attacked the Mushu Hospital , submerging it in a dazzling and intense ocean of thunder. 25 During The Apocalypse, "He" did not choose self-destruct like the God of Knowledge and Wisdom in order to help Grisha Adam's battle the Primordial God Almighty's will. By proclaiming 'The Storm will not destroy itself! and 'Nor will it surrender!', "He" transformed into layers of entangled, ball lightning. "He" shot down from the Astral World at near-light speed, straight toward the Crimson Moon and the Colossal Figure, illuminating the entire world. The mass of entangled lightning approached the blood-red moon and the colossal figure at near-light speed. It tore through the void but quickly froze beside the crimson full moon. Each strand of its light was tainted scarlet, gaining new life as they detached and scattered. The terrifying lightning mass rapidly disintegrated, thus killing "Him" in the process. The remaining lightning erupted with a deafening roar, which make the natural light of the crimson moon shattered and dissipated, revealing a breach. 2 Book 2, chapter 1158 Afterwards, The Fool Grafted the Lord of Storms' Beyonder Characteristics and the Tyrant Uniqueness to Grisha Adam. 2 Trivia Klein once laughed to himself, thinking he wouldn’t be struck down by lightning for offending the God of Steam and Machinery, as that fell under the authority of the Lord of Storms. 26 He had a similar reaction when studying the sacred book of the Evernight Goddess in an attempt to draw closer to her Church. 27 Ironically, his marionette was later struck by the Lord of Storms while he was requesting the Sealed Artifact 0-32. 28 In the Forsaken Land of the Gods, remnants of the Lord of Storms’ divine power persist. Uttering His true name, Leodero , in a language that stirs the natural forces, will summon lightning. 29 Klein called upon this power several times in critical moments. 30 31 Kotar even imitated Klein’s actions after witnessing the effect firsthand. 32 Translations Language Name English Lord of Storms Wind Angel Leodero Chinese 风暴之主 风天使 列奥德罗 Thai เจ้าแห่งพายุ เทวทูตสายลม ลีโอเดอโร References Book 1, chapter 261. title: Gregrace
summary: The Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace is one of the Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch.
searchText: Gregrace Ancient God Gregrace Overview It's said that even among those mad ancient gods, the Phoenix Ancestor, Gregrace, was particularly fond of stirring things up, much like the Blood Emperor Alista Tudor of the Fourth Epoch. Maric, Book 2, chapter 771 The Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace is one of the Ancient Gods from the Second Epoch. "She" was an Ancient God of the Death and the Door. Appearance "She" was a giant bird whose body was covered with feathers woven by pale flames and mysterious patterns. "Her" eyes look like they are made of bronze with layers of illusory doors hidden inside. 1 Book 1, chapter 1368 Pathway Composition as an Ancient God "Her" Pathway composition is as follows: 3 Death: Uniqueness + 3 Sequence 1. Door: Uniqueness+ 1 Sequence 1. History According to the Myth of Creation, the phoenixes were formed from the hair of the Original Creator. 4 Even though "She" is known as the Phoenix Ancestor , it's actually more because "She" controlled the souls of similar ethnicity, instead of through reproduction like the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith. 5 According to Azik Eggers, the Underworld was created by the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace and exists in the Spirit World. 6 Amon revealed that Gregrace also had possessed partial authority over the Door. 7 It is suspected that the Door authority was the reason why "She" was able to conjure the Underworld. Even though "She" seized the authorities of Death without the Death, "She" was driven by instinct to fulfil this ritual afterwards since this is the authority's inherent desire. 8 "Her" Divine Kingdom was the City of Dead , which was renamed Calderón City by an angel of the Abraham Family. Ever since "She" opened up the Underworld, "Her" divine kingdom was moved there. The City of the Dead gradually became the holy grounds of "Her" descendants and believers, but none of its citizens ever came out again. "She" also left the clues about the River of Eternal Darkness in "Her" divine kingdom Calderón City. 9 In the elves' chronicle, during the Early Era of Fire of the Second Epoch, the non-human races fought against the quasi-human races, devils and demonic wolves. This corresponds to the records of the City of Silver. "She", the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt, and the Mutated King Kvastir were on one side, fighting together against the Giant King Aurmir, the Elf King Soniathrym, the Sanguine Ancestor Lilith, the Devil Monarch Farbauti, and the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea. 10 According to records of the City of Silver, "She", along with the other Ancient Gods all lost "Their" godhood after the Ancient Sun God emerged and reclaimed "His" authorities from "Them". The truth is that Gregrace was heavily injured by the Ancient Sun God, and "Her" city was uprooted and thrown deep into the Spirit World. 11 Severely wounded, "She" went into hiding as pieces, scattered across the entirety of the Southern Continent. 2 Book 2, chapter 900 12 Only the Forsaken Land of the Gods still remembers the Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace. The rest of the world has already forgotten "Her" existence, as the god of the Death had been replaced by the Death Salinger. After "Her" death, Salinger placed the body of the Phoenix Ancestor in the depths of the Underworld. "He" apparently thought it would be a waste to destroy the body of this Ancient God and believed it could serve a more important purpose, such as helping "Him" better and more completely control the Underworld or enabling "Him", as Death, to possess stronger power. "He" also claimed that the body of the Phoenix Ancestor held some secrets. 2 It is later revealed that "Her" death imprint has sunk into the water of the River of Eternal Darkness. 1 After the reigning Death was dead, one of the reasons for the original anomaly in the Underworld was the reanimation of the Phoenix Ancestor . It destroyed Death's palace, killed all of Death's Blessed present, and turned the depth of the Underworld into a Pale-White Nation. For a long time after the Underworld anomaly, the body of the Phoenix Ancestor still roamed the Pale-White Nation, keeping the high-ranked beings of the Death domain at bay. It has only fallen asleep in recent years. Aside from "Her" corpse, there is an egg below the belly of the Phoenix Ancestor , 13 allegedly currently incubating Omebella. 2 This is because at some point before discovering the tributary of the River of Eternal Darkness, Gregrace had been contaminated by the Brood Hive. 14 15 Subsidiary Gods God of the Dead Salinger God of Souls Shadow of Death Goddess of Reincarnation God of Destruction Related Places Underworld Calderón City References Book 1, chapter 1368.
