title: Primordial Demoness
summary: The Mirror People believe that the Chaos Demoness they revere deep within the Mirror World is the true Primordial Demoness.4 Franca speculated that the White Primordial Demoness Fi
searchText: Primordial Demoness True God Primordial Demoness Overview Primordial really is a twisted fellow. Letting a pure woman take the path of a Demoness would be so much better; however, generation after generation, you pass the damage down. And for what? Isn't the main goal merely to seek revenge on fate? Sauron-Einhorn-Medici, Book 1, chapter 1111 Cheek , the Primordial Demoness, is the Sequence 0 God of the Demoness Pathway. According to the Demoness Sect, the Primordial Demoness is the true inheritor of the Original Creator. "She" was born out of Chaos and was the earliest to be born from the Creator's body. "She" is also the ultimate Ender that ends everything. 3 The Mirror People believe that the Chaos Demoness they revere deep within the Mirror World is the true Primordial Demoness. 4 Franca speculated that the White Primordial Demoness Figurine depicts the Primordial Demoness, while the Black Primordial Demoness Figurine depicts "Her" mirror self. 5 "She" was formerly a male. Honorific Name Public The Source of All Catastrophes; The Symbol of Destruction and the Apocalypse; The Demoness who controls Chaos (所有灾难的源头， 毁灭与末日的象征， 执掌混沌的魔女) The last two lines of "Her" Honorific Name are hidden from most existences. 1 Book 2, chapter 454 Complete Appearance Without a doubt, the Primordial Demoness is the most charming woman in this world. Every living being who sees Her will inevitably be fascinated by Her, including me, my brothers and sisters, and even the undead in the Underworld. Even our father was inevitably attracted to some degree. Azik Eggers, Book 2, chapter 900 The Primordial Demoness is an extremely beautiful woman, with charm at the level of concepts and authorities. 7 All living beings and all things would be infatuated and entranced by "Her" slightest expression, perpetually in ecstasy. 2 Book 2, chapter 1105 "She" wears a dress seemingly made of white bones, "Her" black hair like venomous giant serpents - long, thick, and slick, with snake heads at the tips or rolling black and white eyes. "She" has pure, delicate, and beautiful white hands, they were not yet perfect, but they could evoke the most primitive and intense desires of anyone who saw them, instantly propelling them to heavenly pleasure from which they could never escape, just by being seen. 2 "Her" true Mirror Self is a handsome man with a blood stained face. 8 Background According to Mr. Door, Cheek and the Artisan witnessed the second Blasphemy Slate with "Him". 9 "Her" Apocalypse involved participating in the first fall of Black Emperor Solomon in the Fourth Epoch. 10 Because the Demoness requires enduring the corruption of the Chaos Sea, "She" became corrupted by the Primordial God Almighty, though "His" influence was manageable at this time. 11 In the period of peace between Solomon's revival and the War of the Four Emperors, Cheek and Tudor created the Special Mirror World with the help of Bethel Abraham, and had two children - the twins Krismona and Judith. This further awakened the Primordial God Almighty in "Them". This was because, in the First Epoch, the Primordial God Almighty, who accommodated the City of Calamity, hid one part of "His" resurrection arrangements around the City of Calamity and the two pathways of Demoness and Red Priest: When the Demoness combines with the Red Priest, "He" will become the Trinity, in the City of Calamity, within the Demoness and the Red Priest, simultaneously resurrecting, ultimately forming a whole, returning in the mirror. But "He" perished too early, and "His" arrangements were not as expected. The City of Calamity was sealed in the Western Continent by the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, preventing "Him" from quickly becoming the Trinity; in addition, there was also another change on the City of Calamity's side. "His" consciousness revived in the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor, but without the City of Calamity's resonance and linkage, that consciousness grew very slowly, and was suppressed and controlled by the two. Moreover, the place the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor consummated was not the ordinary mirror world, but the Special Mirror World created by Bethel Abraham, who had accommodated the Door Uniqueness and all three Key of Stars Beyonder Characteristics. The Oldest One's body of both male and female, plus the power of the two direct Pillars belonging to the Oldest One, gave birth to the Mirrored Original Creator, but "His" consciousness was very weak, like all newborn infants. This gave the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor a chance to merge with the Mirrored Original Creator, with "Them" each bearing the feminine and masculine side respectively, and then use this to control the City of Calamity. But the other Deities found out, and the War of the Four Emperors began, causing "Their" failure. In the last moment, Tudor wanted to forcibly complete the merger, using this to pull all other Sefirot from the Western Continent, dragging the entire world to die, waiting for the Creator's symbolic manifestation in death. But Cheek disagreed because "They" had not yet become the Mirrored Original Creator, so "She" decided to let "Him" die for a while, and then resurrect "Him" later. "She" dealt Tudor the critical blow, while Salinger completed "His" life's culling, sending "His" soul into the River of Eternal Darkness. However, the initial progress made still resulted in the birth of an Alista Tudor in white armor, with only a tiny bit of self-awareness. 12 There was a gap of over a 100 years between the end of the War of the Four Emperors and the beginning of the Pale Disaster. The Primordial Demoness' arrival to the Southern Continent was somewhere in the middle of this period. She declared to Death "Her" intention to avenge the Blood Emperor, to make all Seven Gods of the Northern Continent perish, and to bring the Blood Emperor's deity corpse back to the surface from Underground Trier. 13 When Salinger accommodated the the Uniqueness of Red Priest, the Mirrored Original Creator underwent a mutation: it produced a certain self-awareness and ego. "She" was exactly like the Primordial Demoness, just in a black bone dress instead of a white one. To suppress "Her" and to continue merging, the Primordial Demoness let the consciousness of the Primordial God Almighty in "Her" further revive, seeking a certain balance. Since then, "She" had had to suppress the Primordial God Almighty's consciousness while fighting against the black version of "Herself. Later on, the Primordial Demoness and Death joined forces to wreak havoc and create the Pale Disaster on the Northern Continent. 14 In the end, the Seven Gods joined forces and defeated "Them", killing Death and causing the Primordial Demoness to suffer severe damage. 15 After the Pale-White War, the Primordial Demoness fell into slumber, occasionally waking. All sect affairs are handled by high-ranking Demonesses titled by color. 16 "She" had only managed to descend near the start of Book 1. History Lord of Mysteries "She" tried to descend using Trissy as a vessel, which didn't succeed because her ring was destroyed by the Angel of Concealment. Later, Trissy used the historical projection of this ring to destroy one of the mausoleums George III built for "His" advancement ritual to Black Emperor, causing "Him" to fail "His" advancement at the cost of her life. It was revealed the Primordial Demoness had warned the Demoness Sect that Trissy had a strong self-destructive tendency, but they were not able to find her because Evernight was hiding her. 17 "She" sided with Amon during Klein's Apotheosis Ritual. "She" appeared not long after Amon's main body was concealed by the Evernight Goddess, "She" was interfered with by Lilith. 18 To be more precise, what "She" and the Hidden Sage really wanted was to immediately produce a Lord of Mysteries that doesn't have animosity towards "Them" to open the seal of the Western Continent and allow them access to the Sefirot there. "They" initially chose Amon because Klein was weaker than "Him" and was also hostile towards "Them". Later on, when the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings was on the verge of resurrecting, "They" didn't make any attempt to stop it because it would similarly achieve "Their" goal. This was because the pathways that "They" were in didn't belong to the three pathways that were controlled by the Lord of Mysteries, and "They" didn't have any feuds or conflicts of interest with "Him". 19 20 Circle of Inevitability She descended in the underground mausoleum of Morora through Julie, who was in possession of one of Cheek's Rings. 21 She spared Lumian Lee, who was nearby, and instead threw him out of the special Mirror World there. 22 Madam Magician speculated that if this wasn't one of Adam's arrangements, it meant the Primordial Demoness also hoped for a Beyonder who harbored hope for Alista Tudor's resurrection and was closer to the top powers of the two Calamity Pathways than Her to grow up according to the method currently considered closest to the correct answer, in order to achieve a goal that was very important and crucial to Her. 23 This was later proven correct on The Day of Many Disasters, when Lumian Lee was forced to fuse with the Mirrored Original Creator's masculine side (the Alista Tudor in white armor) and feminine side (the Primordial Demoness in black bone dress), along with the mirrored Alista Tudor (black armor) and a split-off personality from the Primordial Demoness (white bone dress), and one Conqueror and Apocalypse Beyonder Characteristics. The Primordial God Almighty's consciousness also almost revived in him, manifesting as a chaotic face, before ultimately being stopped by The Fool's and Amon's interference. From then on, Lumian Lee gained the symbolism of both the masculine and feminine aspects of the Mirrored Original Creator. 24 Cheek perished at the hands of Lumian and company in the Death of Primordial Demoness. 25 Following The Apocalypse and Lumian's ascension to Calamity of Destruction, "She" now exists as a personality inside his dream, being the mayor of his dream city. Related Mythical Items Cheek's Rings Trivia According to the Second Blasphemy Slate, both Primordial Demoness and Chaos Demoness are alternate names of Demoness. 26 These names predated Cheek's deification, and referred both to the feminine aspect of a Demoness as an extension of the Primordial God Almighty, and to the Demoness' authority over the return of all things to Chaos and the Primordial state. 27 "She" had a true love before becoming a God (see Demoness), which hadn't been revealed. title: True Creator
summary: The True Creator is the Sequence 0 God of the Hanged Man Pathway.
searchText: True Creator True God True Creator Overview Other Identities : Ancient Sun God, Adam, True Creator, Sasrir I am more inclined to call him, the Fallen Creator. The Fool, Book 1, chapter 93 The True Creator is the Sequence 0 God of the Hanged Man Pathway. "He" is considered to be evil. "He" claims to be the inheritor of the Almighty Creator (Ancient Sun God) who was worshiped during the Second Epoch and Third Epoch. Honorific Names True Creator The Lord that Created Everything; The Lord who Reigns Behind the Curtain of Shadows; The Degenerate Nature of all Living Things (创造一切的主， 阴影帷幕后的主宰， 所有生灵的堕落自性) After Fusion Appearance The True Creator has appeared in many forms in the Fifth Epoch, including "The Hanged Giant", "Eyes behind the Shadow Veil". 11 "His" true form was an indistinct figure hanging upside down on a huge cross at the top of a mountain peak in the depths of the Forsaken Land of the Gods. 12 During the fusion process with Adam, "He" appeared as a shadow-like curtain/screen on the surface of the huge cross. 13 4 Book 1, chapter 1381 14 "He" has black pupils. 15 Claims It is believed by "His" worshipers that the True Creator inherited the core of the Original Creator. The temple of the True Creator showed paintings claiming that when the Cataclysm in the Third Epoch took place, the Orthodox Gods came from the Abyss while the True Creator endured all the sins and saved the world. 16 17 His believer from Aurora Order also claims that every human being had divine qualities, and as long as they persevered and made it through the countless trials, they would be able to accumulate enough divine qualities to become Angels. Other Gods are merely powerful Angels. The True Creator's followers believe that there exists a holy residence where the True Creator once lived. They seem to know the direction as the little boy Jack successfully entered the Forsaken Land of the Gods and into the True Creator's Temple. Background The Twilight Hermit Order strongly despise the True Creator. Hermes said it's because "His" authority is closest to making "Him" "omnipotent". All Orthodox Churches are also against the True Creator. 18 It is later revealed that the True Creator is in fact, the result of the Ancient Sun God's resurrection after "He" was killed by the Rose Redemption. After the three traitors feasted on the Ancient Sun God's remains, "He" was only able to rush to retrieve Sasrir's personality, the Hanged Man Pathway Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics, and the authority of Degeneration from "His" dead corpse; it combined with the extreme emotions "He" felt when "He" fell, thus being reborn in the corpse and forming the True Creator. 5 Book 1, chapter 1261 1 Book 1, chapter 1346 Adam and True Creator The True Creator is the embodiment of the extreme emotions from the Ancient Sun God's death and inherited "His" humanity which drove "Him" into madness. 19 6 Book 1, chapter 1348 Meanwhile Ancient Sun God's divinity awoke inside Adam who has then been actively seeking for "His" complete revival. 20 Since both the True Creator and Adam are a part of the Ancient Sun God, "They" will need to fuse to become complete. "They" have been fighting over who should be the dominant persona ever since "They" both awakened. 6 Book 1, chapter 1348 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, Adam had partially fused with the True Creator with Adam as the dominant persona. Adam temporarily raised "Himself" to the level of a Half Great Old One to interfere with the ritual. This process was actually rather difficult and risky, and would make "Their" progress a lot slower in the future. 4 As of Book 2, Adam and the True Creator have fully fused, with Adam becoming the current True Creator. 2 Book 2, chapter 868 History The Rose Redemption was said to directly cause the True Creator's birth. After the Rose Redemption killed the Ancient Sun God, "He" was born from the corpse of the Ancient Sun God and extreme emotion "He" felt when "He" died. According to Sasrir, "He" was forced to reborn as the True Creator due to the betrayal of the Wind Angel, Wisdom Angel, and White Angel, and could only take the Hanged Man Pathway characteristics and authority of degeneration. 5 Since then, the rest of Rose Redemption, led by Ouroboros and Medici, has been following the True Creator. In early Fourth Epoch, taking advantage of the schism between the Six Gods, the Solomon Family, led by the Black Emperor Solomon, cooperated with the True Creator and established the Solomon Empire that ruled over the Northern Continent. 7 Author's WeChat post history The True Creator was an officially worshipped deity of the Solomon Empire, the Church of the True Creator . 21 At this time, all deities had their own countries in poorer places and acknowledged the First Solomon Empire and the Black Emperor's rule over the Northern Continent to fight against opposing factions. This made "Them" unable to cooperate in a stable fashion and thus, couldn't form an alliance to fight the Black Emperor and the True Creator. 22 Later on, the Six Gods (Evernight Goddess, God of Combat, Earth Mother, Eternal Blazing Sun, Lord of Storms, God of Knowledge and Wisdom) reached an agreement, which led to the fall of the Black Emperor and the first Solomon Empire. Afterward, the Six Gods supported the Tudor-Trunsoest United Empire that ruled the Northern Continent. Some time in the Second Solomon Empire period, the True Creator and the Underworld Emperor had cooperation. 23 "They" and the other gods had certain mingled alliances and balances of power between "Them", leading to a 500-year stalemate between the four empires before it was broken in the War of the Four Emperors. 8 Since the True Creator was a negative personality born from the corpse and spirit of the Ancient Sun God, who was deeply influenced by the Chaos Sea, "He" had a rather sizable level of Sefirah authority over the Chaos Sea before the War of the Four Emperors. Therefore, "His" combat strength somewhat exceeded that of a normal Sequence 0, 8 and "He" could use all five Pathways at the God level. 24 After "He" was severely wounded and sealed by the Seven Gods into the Forsaken Land of the Gods during the War of the Four Emperors, 9 Book 1, chapter 210 "He" could no longer do so. 25 During the Conflicts of the Seven Gods—the period of over 100 years after the War of the Four Emperors—Death relied on a distributary of the River of Eternal Darkness to forcibly accommodate the the Uniqueness of Red Priest to create a brand new Great Old One path. This has the influence of the True Creator, as well as the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings who had once accommodated the River of Eternal Darkness which included the Death Pathway. 26 Eventually, "He" went mad and caused the Pale Disaster together with the Primordial Demoness. In the Fifth Epoch, many secret organizations that worship the True Creator emerged, such as Aurora Order and Iron and Blood Cross Order, which is linked to Rose Redemption. Based on the wall paintings in the True Creator's Temple, Ouroboros has led members of Rose Redemption into the Forsaken Land of the Gods, probably as a pilgrimage. Volume 1: Clown Main article: True Creator's Spawn (Event) The True Creator was part of a plot to launch "His" spawn on the world. With the help of Lanevus and Ince Zangwill, "He" impregnated Megose with "His" spawn, which eventually caused the deaths of Klein Moretti and Dunn Smith. 9 Though stymied, for the time being, "He" would bide "His" time and try to descend again later. Volume 2: Faceless Main article: Death of Lanevus In Backlund, the True Creator was once again involved in a plot to descend through using Lanevus as "His" vessel. Unfortunately, Klein found out about "His" plot in time, alerted the Nighthawks, and managed to stop it before "His" descent. 27 Main article: Battle at the Underground Ruin Later, in a secret ritual at the end of the volume carried out by Mr. A, Klein once again chanced upon it while fleeing from Ince Zangwill. Fueled by the resentment and despair of Lower East Backlund, the ritual by that point had already started. Klein once again stopped "His" descent by throwing the Master Key at it and letting the curse of Mr. Door stop the ritual. The True Creator failed to descend onto the world once again. 3 Volume 3: Traveler Due to "His" corruption, when Klein let out All Black Eye into the real world for some time, it alerted "His" follower to its whereabouts. This almost let Klein meet directly with Saint of Secret, Botis. However, it was foiled by Die of Probability when it manipulated Botis' luck. Main article: Chaos on Bayam Mountain Later, Klein used "His" corruption that was stolen by Tinder in the battle at the mountain of Bayam and it directly invited Botis, who later took Tinder away. Volume 4: Undying The True Creator has put "His" attention on Klein. When Klein used Creeping Hunger to sang praise and "His" Honorific Name in the battle against Spirit World Plunderer, "He" directly sent out Ouroboros to deal with Klein. Unfortunately, it failed. Volume 6: Lightseeker After Klein was trapped in Forsaken Land of the Gods, "He" felt Klein's arrival and told "His" follower to track him down. "He" got Angel of Holy Words Steph to do it, which led him and Klein to meet at the Ancient Nois City. 28 Later, "He" found out one of "His" followers, Saint of Secrets Botis died at the hand of Tarot Club in Backlund and punished Kisma, Saint Tenebrous for it. After Klein unveiled "His" connection with Sefirah Castle in Forsaken Land of the Gods, "He" arrived at the battlefield and planted a corruptive seed in Klein's body that forced him to open the door that leads to Sasrir's resting place and meet Sasrir. 29 Mysteries. Go to the Giant King's Court and meet Sasrir. True Creator to Klein Moretti, Book 1, chapter 1247 Later during the battle with Sasrir's Evil Spirits, Klein stole the connection of Sasrir and First Blasphemy Slate. The seed that was planted in Klein's body then took over the connection. 30 Unfortunately, before the connection was fully formed, Amon came in and stole the Slate by attracting it with something "He" stole before and ran away with it. The seed then turned into a human shadow and pursued Amon. 31 Volume 7: The Hanged Man "He" once again sealed off the Forsaken Land of the Gods. 32 After failing to keep Klein in "His" Corpse Cathedral, Adam went in the depths of the Forsaken Land of the Gods, at the top of a mountain peak where a huge cross of the was erected with the True Creator hanging upside down on it. 33 Volume 8: Fool Adam arrived in the Forsaken Land of the Gods to confront the True Creator so "They" could fuse and "He" could be whole again. Adam used Arrodes to trigger the Chaos Sea then "He" used the Second Blasphemy Slate to form a connection with the triggered area of the Chaos Sea. "He" then stepped forward into the shadow curtain to confront the True Creator. 34 During Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, it was revealed that Adam started to fuse with the True Creator with Adam as the dominant persona. Adam temporarily raised "Himself" to the level of a Half Great Old One to interfere with the ritual. This process was actually rather difficult and risky, and would make "Their" progress a lot slower in the future. title: Amon
summary: Amon, the Angel of Time, God of Deceit, former King of Angels and Dual-Pathway True God of Error and Door.
searchText: Amon Former King of Angels · Former True God Amon Angel of Time · God of Deceit · The Blasphemer Overview Amon, also known as the Angel of Time, was one of the Kings of Angels from the Third Epoch and a child of the Ancient Sun God . He was born as a Sequence 1 Worm of Time with the Uniqueness of Error. 1 According to the doctrines from the Third Epoch, the Ancient Sun God once referred to Amon as the God of Trickery, the God of Mischief, and the light at the dawn of the apocalypse. 2 In fall of 1352, he advanced to a Sequence 0 Error by replacing Mr. Door in his Apotheosis Ritual. 3 Shortly after, he accommodated the Uniqueness of Door as well as a Key of Stars Beyonder characteristic and ascended to become a Dual-Pathway True God. After he was defeated by Klein , he revived in his avatar, which was guarded by Adam . He then left for the Cosmos, seeking the meaning of humanity. 4 In Circle of Inevitability , he secretly followed Termiboros from the Cosmos back into this world, then replaced Termiboros in 1358 and switched to Sequence 1 Angel of Redemption of the Eternal Aeon Pathway by the time of the 1359 Project Vortex. 5 By rank suppression and a surprise ambush during the 1360 Death of Primordial Demoness, he successfully parasitised Zaratul, who had converted to the Great Mother, through his Historical Projection. He then assisted Lumian Lee in the fight against the Primordial Demoness. Don't ask us why we're taking such risks. Life often requires some excitement, joy, and anticipation. Amon's Letter, Book 1, chapter 1006. Honorific Name Current The Shadow Wandering through Fate, The Past God of Deceit, The Destined Messiah. This is his honorific name as an Angel of Redemption. 6 As a King of Angels The Clock-Hand that Tampers with Time, The Shadow that Roams across Fate, The Embodiment of Deceit and Trickery. This is his honorific name as an Error Pathway King of Angels. 7 Appearance He is described as looking like a young man with black eyes and curly black hair. He has a broad forehead and a thin face. Usually, he wears a crystal monocle, which hangs over his right eye, and a black pointed hat. Personality You truly are powerful, cunning, and terrifying, truly worthy of the title of 'God of Deceit.' The Fool Klein, Book 1, chapter 1386. As a pleasure seeker, he had no common ethics and just pursued stimulation and cheerfulness. He saw anything as his toys or playmates. He teased others just for fun. After all, in the eyes of a natural Mythical Creature like him, human beings weren't different from ants. They were all just toys. He is good at deceit and prefers using fraud rather than straight-up violence to achieve his goal. His words can be very persuasive, and he often misleads others with rhetoric. To him, there's something more important than life. To you, apart from yourself, there's nothing worth caring about. When the matter develops to a point where one's life is put on the line, it would imply your loss. Born as a Mythical Creature, your lack of normal anchors is also a problem. This makes you know what courage and sacrifice are, but it's hard for you to understand. Adam to Amon, Book 1, chapter 1387. However, Amon first and foremost values his own life. His deceitful, fraudulent, and somewhat reckless attitude is simply a cover. This was exploited by Klein, leading to Amon's defeat. Circle of Inevitability As a born Mythical Creature, Amon is highly influenced by Beyonder characteristics, so as he became an Angel of Redemption, he has a redemptive nature. 8 Trivia Amon called Adam "my zealous brother". 9 Amon was categorized by the author as a "Uniqueness who became sentient", which is similar to the Hidden Sage. 10 Amon couldn't decrypt the fourth line of Klein's honorific name, "Protector of Backlund magic and drama performers." He was amused when he got the answer from Klein's mind. He said that it was very interesting, then asked Klein if he wanted to become his Blessed. In response, however, Klein simply asked Amon to kill him. 11 He can use some of the Abyss' characteristics to go anywhere. 12 Under his auspices, "the Amons" would adopt internal decisions by democratic voting. 13 Each avatar of Amon has its own consciousness, each thinking they are Amon. In this situation, even though the main body has been snatched away, the remaining Amons will still choose a "big brother", or not choose at all. 14 When Amon learned that Klein had put on a monocle on the left eye and pretended to be him to frighten Medici, he thought it was very interesting, and said that he would pretend to be Klein the next time he met Medici and do the same in front of him. 15 Every avatar of Amon is obsessed with monocles. When he was a seagull, his right eye had a black circle of feathers. 16 When he was an ant, he could only wiggle his right antenna. Medici was responsible for holding him when he was an infant and burned his hair for some reason. 17 According to the author's interview, the first half of the Ancient Sun God's prophecy, "The Angel of Time is the light at the dawn of the apocalypse", refers to when Amon stopped an Outer Deity descending through Mr. Door, and the other half may appear in the second book. 18 According to the author's interview, Amon finds out his brother is his father approximately at the start of Volume 7. 19 According to the author's reply to some WeChat questions, a raven is one of the forms that Amon likes to appear as, which is also one of his symbols in mysticism. 20 Amon once explained that he doesn't need to build an idol since all of his believers are himself; however, back in the Ancient Sun God's reign, he had other believers aside from his avatars, who used either a clock with the title "Angel of Time" or a crow covered in mysterious patterns with the title "God of Mischief", or both, to refer to Amon. 21 In Book 2, Amon changed his symbolic form to an owl, mocking Pallez, who couldn't even decipher this as a Cryptologist. 22 In the side story In Modern Day , he is a monocle-wearing driver Zhou Mingrui called from a ride-sharing app. 23 According to the author, the Amon in this side story is the real Amon, because Klein is accommodating Amon's Uniqueness to become a Half-Lord of Mysteries. 24 References Book 1, chapter 1006. title: Artificial Death
summary: Artificial Death: the activated Uniqueness of the Death Pathway, created by the Numinous Episcopate to revive Death.
searchText: Artificial Death Pretender God · Activated Uniqueness Artificial Death A sentient Uniqueness raised by the Numinous Episcopate Overview The Artificial Death was an attempted plan during the Fifth Epoch to turn the Uniqueness of the Death Pathway into a sentient being. The Numinous Episcopate's Artificial Death faction started it after their God, Death , perished at the hands of the Seven Orthodox Gods at the end of the Fourth Epoch. It is made from the Uniqueness of Death along with half of Azik Eggers 's soul. It was originally a resurrection plan left by Death. 1 The Artificial Death is an activated Uniqueness combined with two types of Sefirot corruption brought by Death. 2 It has no Sequence 1 characteristic attached. 3 Appearance It was a massive feathered serpent that seemed to occupy an entire island. It had huge, dark green scales that were nearly black. Amidst the gaps were feathers covered in yellow oily stains. On every feather, thin illusory black tubes extended outwards. The exaggerated feathered serpent was both illusory and real, its actual form hardly describable. It seemed to be a combination of things incomprehensible to humans. Its eye sockets burned with pale white flames. Its face was that of a human, and it looked like another Azik Eggers. 4 History Origins The original goal of the project was to revive Death. The present upper echelons of the Numinous Episcopate had gained inspiration from the Hidden Sage's sudden coming to life and turning anthropomorphic. 5 They used a series of sacrificial rituals and the transformation of their own High-Sequence Beyonders across hundreds of years to influence Death's remains via backward propagation, causing the Uniqueness of Death to generate some form of sentience. 6 Though they failed in reviving Death, the Numinous Episcopate managed to create an artificial god. It also gained certain innate abilities, as it began influencing any High-Sequence Death Beyonders who failed their advancements, like the former chief of the City of Silver, Hawick. However, it was still unable to reply to prayers and rituals. 7 Destruction Azik Eggers and Klein explored Death's treasure trove at the Berserk Sea where the Artificial Death is, resulting in the attempted fusion of both halves of Azik Eggers' soul and starting Death's revival. The Evernight Goddess prevented the resurrection of Death by appearing at the last minute and taking the Uniqueness of the Death Pathway. 8 Consequences Because the Evernight Goddess obtained the Uniqueness, the God of Combat and his allies started the 1350 World War to prevent her progression. See also Artificial Death Product's White Feathers, the physical remains the project left behind. References Book 1, chapter 915. Author's WeChat post red_priest , part 6. title: Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings
summary: The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, the original Lord of Mysteries and former owner of Sefirah Castle.
searchText: Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings Great Old One · Former Pillar Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings Lord of Mysteries · Dominator of the Spirit World Overview The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings was the original Great Old One, Lord of Mysteries, who was most active on Earth from the Pre-Epoch to the middle of the First Epoch, and the former owner of Sefirah Castle. He is also referred to as "The great ruler above the Spirit World" by the Seven Lights. 1 The Transmigrators, Penglai, and the sealing of Sefirot inside the Western Continent were parts of the Celestial Worthy's resurrection plans. Honorific Name General honorific name Lord of Mysteries, King of Space-Time, Beacon of Destiny, Embodiment of Sefirah Castle, Dominator of the Spirit World. 2 In the Western Continent The Immortal Lord of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, the Sky Lord of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, the Exalted Thearch of Heaven and Earth for Blessings, the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings. 3 Appearance He is only seen consisting of a cape and a mask. 4 Personality As the original Lord of Mysteries and an innate Great Old One, he embodied the godhood instincts and concepts of the Fool, Error, and Door Pathways, which include, but are not limited to, trickery, deceit and bizarreness. According to the Genie, he was very cunning and shameless. 5 According to Klein, he was a true Great Old One, looking down on the universe from high above and treating most of the living beings as insects. This would make him distance himself from reality. 6 Great Existences like him would still have the most basic self-awareness of a living being's core and various instincts: selfishness, greed, survival, indifference, only caring about oneself, only doing things beneficial to oneself, not influenced or constrained by group morals, group interactions, or group perceptions. 7 They can experience anger and violence, and can exhibit extreme and maddening tendencies and emotions. 8 During the fusion process with Klein Moretti for several years, the Celestial Worthy had been living as an ordinary human inside The Fool's Dream. Inevitably, he had picked up some humanity. For example, he felt despair when realizing his defeat. 9 History Pre-Epoch In a time more ancient than the Modern Era of the Pre-Epoch, the sleeping Original Creator had naturally split into multiple personas. They were also in a state of slumber, but they began to use the authority and Beyonder Characteristics they controlled to influence the world, making many preparations for the true dissociation which would occur when the Original Creator's body awakened. Among the multiple personas, the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings were the most powerful and active on Earth. 10 He was active on Earth at least as early as the Qin or Han Dynasty of the Pre-Epoch, based on the fact that his honorific name and a corresponding ritual to enter Sefirah Castle was recorded in a book named Quintessential Divination and Arcane Arts of the Qin and Han Dynasty , which was eventually obtained by Klein Moretti in the Modern Era. 11 His holy temple was in current day Penglai. 12 In the Modern Era, he seized the spirit bodies of various people and hung them as cocoons in Sefirah Castle as part of his preparation. First Epoch Lost Era After the Original Creator awakened and split apart, the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy leveraged their long-prepared ancient schemes across the times of the Old Earth to gradually gain advantages in their fight against the Sefirot. The two Pillars eventually defeated the other Sefirot (excluding the Brood Hive and the Key of Light) and shattered their wills, making those wills take a very long time to recover and awaken again. 13 During this time, the Son of Chaos was able to bypass the Astral Barrier by killing himself and then resurrecting through the Black Emperor ability. 14 However, he encountered the Celestial Worthy and was controlled by him until the end of this era. 15 What remained of him in the Cosmos became known as the Outer Deity Uncertain Mist, with some consciousness. After the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy absorbed their first additional Sefirah, they exceeded the limit of the Pillar, the highest level of stability one can achieve. This made their inclination to converge more intense, making it impossible for them to control themselves, and they began taking actions against each other. 16 The devouring of their first additional Sefirot marked the end of the Lost Era. 17 The Celestial Worthy accommodated the Nation of Disorder and the River of Eternal Darkness. 18 Era of Destruction Both the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy made various arrangements, some to ensure their own revival, and some to prevent the other's revival. 19 At the start of this era, the Son of Chaos was sealed inside the Magic Wishing Lamp by the Celestial Worthy, and became the Genie. 20 After the Celestial Worthy completed the creation of the Magic Wishing Lamp, he and the Primordial God Almighty engaged in full-scale war, extinguishing the sun and plunging the world into darkness. 21 No one, not even the Seven Lights of the Spirit World, knows the exact situation of the battle between the Celestial Worthy and the Primordial God Almighty. After the battle, both Pillars perished. 22 The Primordial God Almighty's corpse formed the First Blasphemy Slate in the Chaos Sea, and beside it was the Uniqueness of Error, which was intentionally used by the Celestial Worthy to stop the Primordial God Almighty's first resurrection within the Ancient Sun God. 23 The Celestial Worthy sealed all Sefirot on Earth apart from Sefirah Castle and the Chaos Sea to the Western Continent, to be guarded by Penglai. 24 This was a part of his resurrection plan: by sealing the Sefirot, the Gods of other pathways would have to help someone reach either Lord of Mysteries or God Almighty (to either remove or break the Western Continent's seal respectively) before they could obtain the Sefirot themselves to become a Great Old One. Then, he would have a high chance to awaken inside the new Lord of Mysteries. 25 Penglai held one of the backup plans of the Celestial Worthy for his resurrection. Since there was no way for the Celestial Worthy to guarantee that the people of Penglai would believe in him for generations and not betray him, his only option was to scatter and tamper with the characteristics and items. 26 Those from Penglai can utilize a bit of Sefirah Castle. 27 As another plan for his resurrection, he arranged for Sefirah Castle to release certain people in the cocoons when certain requirements were met. The original plan was for the released person to directly be accompanied with a "curtain" containing a set of Sequence 9 to 1 Beyonder Characteristics of the Fool Pathway stored inside Sefirah Castle. Since these characteristics had not undergone generations of Beyonders and Beyonder creatures to dilute and wear off the Celestial Worthy's will, if a Transmigrator was born with them in the Fourth Epoch or earlier, they would be taken over by the Celestial Worthy the moment they became an Attendant of Mysteries. However, something unknown had happened to the Celestial Worthy, causing many of the prior arrangements to be out of control. Sefirah Castle could only experience a certain change in the late Fifth Epoch, after two consecutive failures. 28 After the birth of a Transmigrator, they were guaranteed to quickly make a connection with one of the three pathways under Sefirah Castle. 29 If they eventually choose one of these three pathways, they would be able to enter and establish a connection with Sefirah Castle. 30 As the owner of Sefirah Castle, starting from Sequence 2, the corruption and contamination from the Celestial Worthy they suffer would be higher than others. 31 Before their deaths, the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy's strong and still perfect and whole power deterred the Outer Deities, who could only settle for observing Earth from afar for the time being. 32 Second Epoch Sefirah Castle released the first transmigrator, Amanises. She was a Subsidiary God under the Annihilation Demonic Wolf Flegrea, who held the authority of the Fool Pathway. 33 Third Epoch In the late Third Epoch, the Ancient Sun God wanted to create a weakened Celestial Worthy to counter the Primordial God Almighty. He didn't choose Amon because, as an activated Uniqueness, Amon was extremely similar to the Celestial Worthy and might lead to his revival. After Bethel Abraham was born, he advanced quickly on the Door Pathway due to the Ancient Sun God's favor. 34 Fourth Epoch In the Fourth Epoch, the will of the Celestial Worthy was still strong, so it was not suitable for the three Mysteries pathways to become Sequence 0. 35 As a result, both Amon and Bethel only wished to make all sorts of preparations, hoping to make the attempt when The Apocalypse was approaching. 36 The reason the three Uniqueness under Sefirah Castle (Amon, Bethel, and Antigonus) converged at the Tudor Empire was because of guidance from spirituality. In particular, the reason why Bethel joined the Tudor Empire was because of the passive instinct of the Celestial Worthy to prevent the resurrection of the Primordial God Almighty. 37 This was because the Primordial God Almighty had once accommodated the City of Calamity, and his consciousness had slowly revived in the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor. 38 As an attempt to create a Calamity of Destruction, the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor consummated inside the Special Mirror World created by Bethel Abraham, who was partially under the influence of the Celestial Worthy's godhood. The Oldest One's body of both male and female, plus the power of the two direct Pillars belonging to the Oldest One, gave birth to the consciousness of the Mirrored Original Creator. 39 During the War of the Four Emperors, after Solomon's fall, Trunsoest attempted to accommodate the Uniqueness of Black Emperor. This was one of the reasons that caused his issues, because the Celestial Worthy had once accommodated the Nation of Disorder, which includes the Black Emperor Pathway. Trunsoest's and Auernia's falls later on was partially related to this. 40 After Antigonus lost control, his self-awareness was no longer able to suppress the Celestial Worthy's will in him. The two psyches got stitched together, revealing a most primitive, most instinctual, and also most bloody and crazy side. Since the Celestial Worthy is the former owner of Sefirah Castle, the present Antigonus can indirectly influence Sefirah Castle by using this identity very naturally. After Antigonus was sealed by the Evernight Goddess, she could use the Uniqueness of Fool inside Antigonus to indirectly affect Sefirah Castle in certain matters, such as tampering with the Beyonder characteristic that accompanied a transmigrator away to prevent the instant awakening of the Celestial Worthy in them. 41 During the Conflicts of the Seven Gods, Death relied on a distributary of the River of Eternal Darkness to forcibly accommodate the Uniqueness of Red Priest to create a brand new Great Old One path. This has the influence of the True Creator, as well as the Celestial Worthy who had once accommodated the River of Eternal Darkness which included the Death Pathway. 42 His forced accommodation of the Uniqueness of Red Priest caused an aberration in the Mirrored Original Creator, producing a certain self-awareness, which negatively affected her state. 43 The reason for the Celestial Worthy's influence which eventually led to this aberration was to prevent the Primordial Demoness' plan regarding the Mirrored Original Creator. This is because if there were no mutation, and she continued down the path, succeeding would make her the Mirrored Original Creator; failing would still birth the Mirrored Original Creator. With the aberration, now both sides have formed a certain balance until The Apocalypse, leading to new changes. 44 Fifth Epoch In 1143, Sefirah Castle released the second Transmigrator, Roselle Gustav . He transmigrated in Intis which had the Secret Order, and quickly got to know Zaratul, an angel of the Fool Pathway. 45 In 1349, Sefirah Castle released the third Transmigrator, Klein Moretti . He was instantly involved in the case brought about by the Antigonus Family's Notebook, and also quickly had the opportunity to choose the Seer potion. 46 In Klein's Apotheosis Ritual, when the Celestial Worthy was about to resurrect inside Klein's main body, all of the Gods present tacitly cooperated together to stop his awakening. 47 His awakening was interrupted by Klein's avatar's control over Sefirah Castle, Amon's gifting of stolen "eternal slumber", 0-05's use of Trunsoest Brass Book, Adam's prophecy powers and the Evernight Goddess' use of River of Eternal Darkness water. Ultimately, he, along with Klein's main body, was killed by the Evernight Goddess, before Klein resurrected using the power of miracles. In The Fool's Gambit, Klein was pushed by Amon to the point where he had to release the will of the Celestial Worthy inside him to prevent Amon from winning. Even though he managed to achieve victory against Amon in the end, he had to enter a deep sleep afterwards to fight and fuse with the remaining will of the Celestial Worthy. The people inside the cocoons in Sefirah Castle, the Transmigrators, were released by Klein before his sleep. From then, the Celestial Worthy and Klein had been contending against each other within The Fool's Dream. By 1358, the Celestial Worthy chose some of the released transmigrators in the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society to use, such as Loki, to complete the resurrection within Klein. After The Fool's Dream, Klein started the process of accommodating Sefirah Castle and fusing with the will of the Celestial Worthy. After The Day of Many Disasters, the Celestial Worthy was agitated by the terror of the Original Creator and the hatred of the Primordial God Almighty borne towards him, and chose to compromise and cede the contest to Klein Moretti. By June 25, 1360, Klein Moretti completed his confrontation and fusion with the Celestial Worthy, and finished accommodating Sefirah Castle. Over a month later, during The Apocalypse, he returned to the Astral World to merge with Gehrman Sparrow and retrieve the Uniqueness of Error and Door and Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics to become the Lord of Mysteries. 48 Trivia The term Celestial Worthy (天尊, Heavenly Venerable, Tiānzūn) is a title primarily used in Taoism to refer to the highest gods in the Taoist pantheon, most prominently, the Three Pure Ones. When asked if the Lord of Mysteries is inspired by the following, the author answered with "All of them": 49 The Jester in Yellow, a Chinese SCP. Nyarlathotep, an Outer God in the Cthulhu Mythos. As the "God of a Thousand Forms" who delights in deception, Nyarlathotep corresponds to the Faceless and Swindler. The Gods of Pegāna, which served as a prototype and influence to the Cthulhu Mythos. The attendant "Time" corresponds to Nyarlathotep, which corresponds to the Worm of Time. Yog-Sothoth, an Outer God in the Cthulhu Mythos. Azathoth, an Outer God in the Cthulhu Mythos, who corresponds to the Fool's authority. The Celestial Worthy doesn't have any children. 50 The Celestial Worthy never modified any of his three pathways like Amon did with the Error Pathway. 51 References Book 1, chapter 1271. title: Primordial God Almighty
summary: The Primordial God Almighty, former God Almighty, Lord of the Astral World, and former owner of the Chaos Sea.
searchText: Primordial God Almighty Great Old One · Former Pillar Primordial God Almighty Lord of the Astral World · Father of All Living Beings Overview The Primordial God Almighty is the former Great Old One, God Almighty, who was most active on Earth from the Pre-Epoch to the middle of the First Epoch, and the former owner of the Chaos Sea. He is the Lord of the Astral World. 1 Not to be confused with the God Almighty, the honorific used for the God of the Abrahamic faiths. Honorific Name God Almighty, Creator, Maker, the Omnipotent and Omniscient, Lord of the Astral World. 2 Appearance The Primordial God Almighty's full appearance has never been shown, but his consciousness inside other beings has manifested in the forms below. Eternal Blazing Sun : a colossal luminous humanoid figure surrounded by chaos. 3 Lumian Lee : a vortex-like face with no eyes, nose, or mouth, no bones, composed entirely of a chaotic liquid embodying every color. 4 Malevolent Dragon : a head that was a swirling amalgamation of liquid, encompassing all colors and possibilities. At its facial features (eyes, nose, ears, and mouth), holes had been drilled, one or two in each location. 5 History Pre-Epoch In a time more ancient than the Modern Era of the Pre-Epoch, the sleeping Original Creator had naturally split into multiple personas. They were also in a state of slumber, but they began to use the authority and Beyonder Characteristics they controlled to influence the world, making many preparations for the true dissociation which would occur when the Original Creator's body awakened. Among the multiple personas, the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings were the most powerful and active on Earth. 6 During this time, the Primordial God Almighty's holy temple was in the West. 7 In this era, there was a myth: the God Almighty of Heaven created a divine child. Several Angels, led by an Archangel, rebelled. They were defeated, cast into the Abyss, creating Hell, and turning them to devils. This myth might never have actually occurred; instead, it represented a tendency, a connection between Heaven and the Abyss. 8 Research of the appearance of oil in a dried-up oil field. Why would they need to build a research facility in such an unimaginable place for such matters? God, what did they discover deep in the oil field. This is some amazing material. What exactly happened? The doctor turned into a puddle of black oil in front of me. More and more people have turned into oil. This research facility has been sealed from the outside. No one can leave. No one can leave. Mad, they've all gone mad. We're still normal, but our food is almost running out. I seem to be hearing things. There seems to be sounds coming from underground. It's summoning me. "He" is summoning me. Note from a researcher in Chernobyl, Book 1, chapter 1222. The underground corruption from the Chaos Sea (and thus, the Primordial God Almighty) had always been influencing the human world in an unobvious manner. It can intermittently bring about certain mysterious events. Since oil itself is a product derived from the Chaos Sea's corrosion of underground regions, 9 when the Chernobyl research facility probed deeper into the dried-up oil field and discovered some strange material, the Original Creator fully awakened, turning people into oil and causing them to go mad, summoning them to the underground. 10 As a researcher from Chernobyl, the Ancient Sun God fell into the Chaos Sea, and would only awaken in the Second Epoch. First Epoch Lost Era After the Original Creator awakened and split apart, the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy leveraged their long-prepared ancient schemes across the times of the Old Earth to gradually gain advantages in their fight against the Sefirot. The two Pillars eventually defeated the other Sefirot (excluding the Brood Hive and the Key of Light) and shattered their wills, making those wills take a very long time to recover and awaken again. 11 After the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy absorbed their first additional Sefirah, they exceeded the limit of the Pillar, the highest level of stability one can achieve. This made their inclination to converge more intense, making it impossible for them to control themselves, and they began taking actions against each other. 12 The devouring of their first additional Sefirot marked the end of the Lost Era. 13 The Primordial God Almighty first accommodated the City of Calamity because of a mystical connection, an instinctive tendency that had long existed. Beyond his deep desire for it, even though he was unaware of the setup and contingency plans left by the Original Creator to stabilize existence through the Mirrored Original Creator, 14 he likely foresaw the dangers. Thus, he intervened personally by inserting his own consciousness into the City of Calamity as a Chaotic Head to act as a barrier to prevent yin and yang from fully merging and forming the Mirrored Original Creator. 15 Afterwards, he accommodated the Tenebrous World because, already under the convergence instinct, he prioritized the association between Heaven and the Abyss, which was also consistent with the mystical similarity between the degenerate nature of the Hanged Man and the Abyss Pathways. 16 Era of Destruction Some time in the mid-First Epoch, foreseeing parts of the future, the Primordial God Almighty and the Brood Hive gave birth to the twins Omebella and Zedus. 17 Both the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy made various arrangements, some to ensure their own revival, and some to prevent the other's revival. 18 The Primordial God Almighty also had undisclosed backup plans related to the Western Continent. 19 After the Celestial Worthy completed the creation of the Magic Wishing Lamp, he and the Primordial God Almighty engaged in full-scale war, extinguishing the sun and plunging the world into darkness. 20 No one, not even the Seven Lights of the Spirit World, knows the exact situation of the battle between the Celestial Worthy and the Primordial God Almighty. After the battle, both Pillars perished. The Primordial God Almighty's corpse formed the First Blasphemy Slate in the Chaos Sea, and beside it was the Uniqueness of Error, 21 which was intentionally used by the Celestial Worthy to stop the Primordial God Almighty's first resurrection within the Ancient Sun God. 22 The Celestial Worthy sealed all Sefirot apart from Sefirah Castle and the Chaos Sea to the Western Continent. 23 Before their deaths, the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy's strong and still perfect and whole power deterred the Outer Deities, who could only settle for observing Earth from afar for the time being. During this era, the Primordial God Almighty served as the sun. After his death, the world was cast into darkness until the ascension of the Ancient Sun God. 24 At some point in the First Epoch or Second Epoch, Edefana was polluted by the Chaos Sea, then influenced and driven by the godhood of the Primordial God Almighty. This was the reason why he was able to survive to the Fifth Epoch. 25 Second Epoch According to Sasrir, not long after the Ancient Sun God walked out of the Chaos Sea in the Second Epoch, he sensed that the Primordial God Almighty was awakening inside his body. Therefore, he deliberately split a portion of his persona, fusing the Uniqueness of the Hanged Man and its authorities of Degeneration with the Hanged Man Pathway's Beyonder Characteristic, creating Sasrir to control the Chaos Sea and to isolate it from his true body to prevent any contamination and corruption. Later, he made another attempt to fight against the awakening of the Primordial God Almighty in him, by having children to decrease his Beyonder Characteristics, leading to the birth of Adam and Amon. 26 But in the end, the Primordial God Almighty still awoke in his body. Third Epoch Just as the Ancient Sun God and his faction were about to win against the Evernight Goddess, God of Combat, and Earth Mother completely, he began to have problems with the revival of the Primordial God Almighty inside himself. This was why he convened the various Kings of Angels and Subsidiary Gods with the Evernight Goddess to establish the Rose Redemption to assassinate himself, so that after reviving and escaping the Primordial God Almighty, he would truly gain control of the Chaos Sea and the corresponding five pathways. Ultimately, the Ancient Sun God was successfully killed, but his revival plan failed because of the betrayal of the three Kings of Angels. 27 The Ancient Sun God was unable to foresee the betrayal of the three Kings of Angels because of interference from the Primordial God Almighty. 28 Because the Eastern Continent was the most prosperous at the time, one of the reasons for the destruction of the Eastern Continent was that the Primordial God Almighty wanted to reduce the number of anchors of the Ancient Sun God. 29 Fourth Epoch In the First Epoch, the Primordial God Almighty left another revival plan in the two pathways of Calamity. When the Chaos Demoness combined with the Red Priest, he would become the Trinity, in the City of Calamity and within the Chaos Demoness and the Red Priest, simultaneously resurrecting, ultimately forming a whole, returning in the mirror. But he perished too early, and his arrangements were not as expected, despite the union of the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor in the Fourth Epoch. The City of Calamity was sealed in the Western Continent by the Celestial Worthy, preventing him from quickly becoming the Trinity. In addition, there was also another change on the City of Calamity's side. His consciousness revived in the Primordial Demoness and Alista Tudor, but without the City of Calamity's resonance and linkage, that consciousness grew very slowly, and was suppressed and controlled by the two. With the combination of the initial feminine and masculine sides of the Original Creator symbolized by the Chaos Demoness and the Red Priest, the consciousness of the Primordial God Almighty, and the Special Mirror World created by Bethel Abraham who was influenced by the godhood of the Celestial Worthy, the development of things deviated from the Primordial God Almighty's arrangement, and led to the consciousness of the Mirrored Original Creator to be born, though his consciousness was very weak, like all newborn infants. 30 Fifth Epoch The Fool's Dream In The Fool's Dream, the five figures of "Peng Deng", "Grisha", "Nie Zhen", "the boss of Aurora Company", and "Zhang Yujia" corresponded to (not in order) the five identities: the Ancient Sun God, the True Creator, Adam, the Primordial God Almighty, and Sasrir. 31 "Peng Deng" and "Grisha" (Peng Deng's roommate) symbolized Adam and the Primordial God Almighty, but their specific positions are not fixed. They can swap at any time, symbolizing fusion and confrontation. "Nie Zhen" (Peng Deng's girlfriend) symbolized Sasrir, representing the part that split off from the Ancient Sun God. Adam's rib is his Eve. "The boss of Aurora Company" symbolized the True Creator. The True Creator and Adam had already achieved consciousness fusion, so they don't need to share rent anymore. They can act under different identities through The Fool's cognition, but their thoughts are interconnected. "Zhang Yujia" (Zhou Mingrui's and Peng Deng's childhood friend, who once sent Zhou Mingrui a postcard with an image of the Corpse Cathedral) symbolized the Ancient Sun God. The Corpse Cathedral itself belonged to him. Zhang Yujia wandered outside the dream city, symbolizing that the Ancient Sun God had already left this stage. Now his successors and the Primordial God Almighty were confronting each other. The Primordial God Almighty was one of the people who least wanted the Celestial Worthy to resurrect. As Peng Deng, he was the previous renter of the Magic Mirror Arrodes from the Star Dream Provisions Store since the birth of that magic mirror was related to him, 32 presumably to set up the trap regarding the Mirrored Original Creator to the Celestial Worthy later on. He did various actions to help Lumian's team to oppose the Celestial Worthy. He appeared as Grisha and specifically arranged to guide Lumian to discover the corresponding psychological trauma of Klein in the underground area of Mushu Hospital. Later on, he appeared as Peng Deng when talking with Anthony and gave him the hint that he was not only Zhou Mingrui's childhood friend, but also the Celestial Worthy's childhood friend. 33 As a top-tier Dreamweaver, the Primordial God Almighty also helped Medici, who already had a corresponding manifestation in the dream city, to come into the Dream. 34 The Day of Many Disasters After The Hostel incident, 35 the Primordial God Almighty made a contract with the Mother Goddess of Depravity: he would help her bypass the barrier and reclaim the Brood Hive and the corresponding Uniquenesses and Beyonder Characteristics, and she would help him revive. In addition, the Mother Goddess of Depravity also entered a contract with the Mother Tree of Desire, witnessed by the Primordial God Almighty, where the Mother Tree of Desire would sacrifice the Tree of Shadow to help the Mother Goddess of Depravity descend on Earth in The Day of Many Disasters. In return, the Mother Goddess of Depravity would need to give assistance to the Mother Tree of Desire later. 36 During The Day of Many Disasters, the Primordial God Almighty had two chances to resurrect. The first chance was when Lumian was forced to fuse with a split-off self from the Primordial Demoness, the mirrored Alista Tudor, both the masculine and feminine aspect of the Mirrored Original Creator, and an Apocalypse and Conqueror characteristic. The balance was lost with Jenna's advancement to Demoness of Unaging, which attracted the feminine Mirrored Original Creator away from Lumian, before it was regained with the addition of the Mother's powers 37 via Omebella's bloodline and Zedus's vitalized soul fragments inside Lumian. After the balance was regained, Lumian's body became the resurrection cornerstone for the Primordial God Almighty, who manifested as a Chaotic Vortex Face. The Primordial Demoness was also forced to retreat to resist against the Primordial God Almighty's reviving consciousness. The Chaotic Vortex Face was eventually sealed by The Fool using the dark-golden mask taken from Loki. 38 The second chance happened during Omebella's birth. Since the Primordial God Almighty was Omebella's father, her birth strengthened the symbolism of the Father on the Eternal Blazing Sun, causing him to lose control of the fragile balance. This attempt was thwarted when the Eternal Blazing Sun voluntarily chose death at the hands of the Evernight Goddess. During the event, Naboredisley also experienced the revival of the malicious consciousness and frenzied spirit of the Primordial God Almighty because he had accommodated the Tenebrous World in the First Epoch. However, the revival of the Primordial God Almighty was short-lived, with his consciousness retreating to the Chaos Sea, leaving only his malicious spirit behind, preventing a true balance to be reached with the Mother Tree of Desire's corruption, though it did improve Naboredisley's state. 39 The Primordial God Almighty retracted his powers and influence over Edefana to focus on his two resurrection opportunities, causing Edefana to age and eventually die. 40 Come, my child. Merge with me. You are out of time. The apocalypse is nigh. Your only choice is to risk merging with me, then contend for dominance on equal footing. Primordial God Almighty to Grisha Adam, Book 2, chapter 1115. Lastly, the Primordial God Almighty successfully persuaded Grisha Adam to enter the Chaos Sea and merge with him, as the Mother Goddess of Depravity would soon descend onto Earth through the strengthened symbolism of Omebella's birth, and time was running out. 41 This gave Grisha Adam enough strength to cooperate with The Fool to create the Protected Zones to save Earth from the initial impact of the Mother Goddess of Depravity's descent on Earth. 42 Before The Apocalypse In the next one year when the Mother Goddess of Depravity was chasing and accommodating the Brood Hive within the gray fog sealing the Western Continent, Grisha Adam and the Primordial God Almighty were locked in a fierce struggle, with the Primordial God Almighty gaining the upper hand. When Lumian went to meet with Grisha Adam, he removed the dark-golden mask originated from the Celestial Worthy, which gave the Primordial God Almighty a choice. If he diverted his focus to influence Lumian's head and face to resurrect there, symbolically, it would mean abandoning the contest with Grisha Adam, causing him to gain back the advantage. If he refused to retreat or give up, the revival of Lumian's head and face would stagnate, yet their unique qualities will remain intact, allowing Lumian to make use of their powers. The Primordial God Almighty chose not to revive on Lumian. 43 The Apocalypse When The Apocalypse began, Grisha Adam merged with the Uniquenesses and Beyonder Characteristics from the Lord of Storms and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom to temporarily achieve a fragile balance using their remnant psyche. 44 This gave him the strength of a Quasi-God Almighty and allowed him to hold off the Primordial Hunger for the duration of the battle. However, during the battle, Grisha Adam was first affected by the Inextinguishable Ravings, 45 and then the Mother Goddess of Depravity's New Life, 46 which strengthened the consciousness of the Primordial God Almighty and made his resurrection imminent, even when put into a slumber by the Eternal Darkness. 47 Towards the end of the battle, Klein proposed a temporary truce to the Mother Goddess of Depravity. He modified the contract drafted by the Primordial God Almighty, which was originally exceptionally tight and without exploitable Loopholes, into producing one: "The time limit is until the conclusion of this event". As the Mother Goddess of Depravity hadn't yet reclaimed the Uniqueness of Mother and Moon, nor achieved all her objectives, the current event wasn't considered over, allowing her to retreat and return back at a later time. 48 After the battle finished, Grisha Adam accepted his death at the hands of Lumian Lee to stop the awakening of the Primordial God Almighty. After the Primordial God Almighty was killed, he hadn't tried to resurrect within Lumian, as adding anything else to Lumian's body would render even the most powerful and genuine Angel of Redemption unable to redeem the situation. After the Primordial God Almighty's near resurrection in The Apocalypse, his consciousness had significantly strengthened. Without hundreds or thousands of years to wear it down, none of the God Almighty's five pathways are suitable for birthing a corresponding Sequence 0. 49 Trivia It is strongly implied that the Primordial God Almighty corresponds to the God of the Abrahamic faiths. The term God Almighty (上帝, Supreme Thearch, Shàngdì) in Chinese refers to the absolute god of the universe. It is commonly used as a non-religious translation for the Abrahamic God. With regards to the Chaos Sea, in biblical literature, the sea frequently symbolizes chaos and disorder. In Genesis 1:2, the sea is depicted as a primordial abyss over which the Spirit of God hovers. This imagery underscores the sea as a symbol of the chaotic forces that God orders and subdues. The novel mentioned the Pre-Epoch myth of the God Almighty of Heaven creating a divine child, who, as an Archangel, led several Angels in rebellion before being defeated and cast into the Abyss, creating Hell and turning them to devils. This myth likely refers to the story of Lucifer. The author confirmed that the Primordial God Almighty accommodating the City of Calamity corresponds to the God of War and Storm, the Lord of Armies YHWH in Canaanite mythology. 50 References Book 1, chapter 1260. title: Roselle Gustav
summary: Roselle Gustav, also known as Huang Tao: Intis emperor, transmigrator, pathway progression, history, and sayings.
searchText: Roselle Gustav Character profile · Transmigrator · Emperor Roselle Gustav Huang Tao · Emperor Caesar · Son of Steam · Black Emperor Modern-era transmigrator Emperor of Intis Paragon → Hermit → Black Emperor Roselle’s Diary Roselle Gustav , born Huang Tao, is a modern-era transmigrator who arrived in the Lord of the Mysteries world in 1143. A statesman, explorer, inventor, and author of the famous Roselle’s Diary, he reshaped the Fifth Epoch before becoming the Black Emperor. His notes later helped Klein Moretti choose the Seer Pathway. 3 Major spoilers for Lord of Mysteries and Circle of Inevitability . “I was an emperor for many years, stood at the pinnacle of human power. I faced True Gods, fought Angels, had followers willing to die for me. I brought the light of civilization to that era. […] What regrets could I possibly have in this life?” Appearance Roselle has long chestnut hair, blue eyes, a high nose bridge, thin lips, and two neat little mustaches. The source profile describes him as quite good-looking. Personality He is bold and uninhibited, open-minded in his relationships, fiercely individualistic, and politically astute. In his youth, he was dramatic and ambitious, viewing himself as the protagonist of his era. His adventurous streak led him into dangerous places, including Primitive Island in the Fog Sea and the Abyss. In later years, corruption took hold and his personality and behavior grew increasingly extreme. His diary also reveals his regret at not choosing the Apprentice, Seer, or Marauder Pathway; those reflections influenced Klein’s choice of the Seer Pathway instead of Old Neil’s Mystery Pryer Pathway. 3 Legacy and roles Roselle introduced proverbs, literature, and technological advances to his era. As consul and later emperor of Intis, he helped overturn the old kingdom and established the Intis Empire. His safer sea route to the Southern Continent accelerated colonization there, a process also described as an invasion by the Northern Continent. In Circle of Inevitability , a Mirror Roselle is revealed in the Mirror World as the leader of the Mirror People. 4 Titles and aliases Huang Tao Emperor Roselle Emperor Caesar Son of Steam Black Emperor The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse Roselle’s four personal subordinates were Grimm, William, Poli, and Edwards. He called them the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, or the Knights of the Apocalypse. 6 7 Trivia Nast believed that “no one is more suitable than ‘Him’ to be the Black Emperor.” 5 Before transmigrating, Huang Tao’s profession was oriented toward marketing. 8 Klein once complained that Roselle’s handwriting was even uglier than his own. 9 In the side story In Modern Day , Roselle is the CEO of the Intis Group and the superior of Huang Tao and Zhou Mingrui. He became a father at 18 and is intensely protective of his daughter, resenting other men who get close to her. He is also described as treating pretty girls kindly. 10 In that side story, Roselle writes his diary in cursive script. 11 Names and translations Language Names English Roselle Gustav; Huang Tao Chinese 罗塞尔·古斯塔夫; 黄涛 Thai โรเซลล์ กุสตาฟ; หวงเทา See also Roselle’s Diary , its chronological order , Roselle’s Inventions , and Roselle’s Sayings Paragon Pathway , Hermit Pathway , and Black Emperor Pathway Sources and references Roselle Gustav , citing Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 884.
