This article adapts and reorganizes material from the Lord of the Mysteries Wiki’s Roselle Gustav article , which is available under CC BY-SA. The portrait is sourced from the same Fandom character page; see its caption for credit. History and major events This expanded chronology combines Roselle’s character history, Intis’s political record, and the diary chronology. Where the sources do not give a precise year, the event is marked undated. 14 15 13 11 October 1125 · Birth Roselle Gustav is born in Trier, in the Intis Kingdom. Before transmigration, he was Huang Tao, a modern-era man from China. February 1143 · Transmigration and first pathway Huang Tao arrives in this world as Roselle Gustav. The Church of Craftsmanship gives him two pathway options, and he chooses Savant, the Paragon route. He learns the Acting Method from Zaratul and begins applying modern scientific knowledge to a world entering an industrial age. 14 Early Fifth Epoch · Inventor and industrial catalyst Roselle “invents” the steam engine, improves sailboats, and introduces other technologies remembered from his previous life. His inventions help start Intis’s Industrial Revolution and win him recognition from the Church of Craftsmanship. In response to his influence, the Church receives a sacred commandment to rename its deity the God of Steam and Machinery—the first public message from a deity in the Fifth Epoch. 14 17 Undated · Marriage and exploration Roselle marries Matilda. He later finds the ship Black King and explores the Fog Sea with close companions. Their expedition reaches a primitive island tied to the Primordial Moon, where the group is unknowingly exposed to corruption that will shape Roselle’s fate. 14 May 1155 · Bernadette’s birth His daughter Bernadette is born. 1173 · Revolution and consulship With Zaratul’s help, Roselle leads a revolution against the Intis Kingdom, overthrows the Sauron monarchy, and establishes the Intis Republic. He becomes its governor—also rendered as consul—and joins the Twilight Hermit Order at an unspecified date, where he sees the Blasphemy Slate. 14 15 1173–1192 · Caesar of the Republic As Intis’s consul, Roselle reforms the penal code, encourages invention, and protects industrial expansion. He leads the Republic to victories against neighboring states and turns Lenburg, Masin, Segar, and other countries into protectorates. This combination of legal change, mechanized growth, and military reach makes Intis a major power—but his later advancement strains his relationship with the Church of Steam and Machinery. Roselle suspects the deity is trying to control him by making his son Bornova a devoted believer. 14 18 November 1183 · Mr. Door and the moon Roselle meets Mr. Door, who shares secrets and suggests a lunar journey. After reaching Sequence 1, Roselle goes to the moon; the trip deepens his corruption and reveals that his new world is Earth, while the approaching Apocalypse is tied to the Outer Deities. 14 End of 1192 · Emperor Caesar Roselle converts the Republic into the Intis Empire and declares himself Emperor Caesar, or Caesar the Great. The source identifies this as likely part of the Black Emperor Sequence 0 ritual. His imperial title crowns his rise, but also makes the emperor’s apotheosis and the political order around it targets of competing church and aristocratic interests. 14 15 1194 · Southern Continent route Roselle discovers a safer sea route to the Southern Continent. The route accelerates colonization by Northern Continent powers and is also described as an invasion; Intis and Loen compete for territory there. 15 29 December 1197 · Last diary entry Roselle records that his mausoleums are complete and warns a future transmigrator to choose a pathway carefully. He is preparing to advance to Sequence 0: Black Emperor. 13 1198 · Assassination and the end of his reign After reaching Sequence 0, Roselle arranges an assassination involving the Churches of the Eternal Blazing Sun and Steam and Machinery, along with former Intis royal and noble interests. The plan is meant to remove the characteristics of his former Paragon and Hermit pathways so he can resurrect with only the Black Emperor characteristics. The character article also names the Sauron family among the forces involved. Roselle then realizes that resurrection could give an Outer Deity a route through the Astral Barrier, halts his return, and seals himself on the primitive island. His daughter Bernadette eventually finds him, but he sends her away to protect her from corruption. The emperor’s death ends the regime; Intis later returns to a republican system. 14 15 2 1352 · Incomplete return Roselle returns as Sequence 0: Black Emperor, but in an incomplete state. 2 1359 · Project Vortex The Mother Goddess of Depravity reclaims her corruption from Roselle, but he is then corrupted by the Uncertain Mist. He helps Adam attack the Uncertain Mist and perishes. The source says he may resurrect after a hundred years: corruption from the Uncertain Mist, the Nation of Disorder, and the Chaos Sea could reach a basic balance that allows him to retain humanity and clarity. 2 Historical details are paraphrased from the Roselle Gustav/History , Intis Republic , and diary chronology pages. Pathway and Sequence progression Roselle’s documented route crosses three pathways. The source profile gives his Paragon range and named high-sequence forms, but not an exhaustive list of every potion or advancement date, so the sequence below stays at the level supported by that account. 01 Early pathway Paragon Pathway Roselle begins as a Beyonder on the Savant/Paragon route and advances through Sequences 9 to 2. 13 02 Sequence 1 Hermit Pathway He switches to the neighboring pathway and reaches Sequence 1: Knowledge Emperor. 2 03 Sequence 0 Black Emperor Pathway He changes to the non-neighboring Black Emperor Pathway, reaches Sequence 0, and sheds the Beyonder characteristics from his former pathways. 2 Condition after the progression 1197–1198 Failed apotheosis attempt He attempts the Black Emperor advancement, then is assassinated. 1352 Sequence 0 return He returns as an incomplete Black Emperor. 1359 onward Corruption and possible resurrection After perishing in the conflict with the Uncertain Mist, the source describes a possible return once several corruptions reach a basic balance. Current profile classification Sequence 0: Black Emperor Former pathways: Paragon, Sequences 9–2; Hermit, Sequence 1. See the Pathway Directory for related sequence ladders. Powers and Abilities Roselle’s documented route was Paragon Sequence 9–2, Hermit Sequence 1, then Black Emperor Sequence 0. The Paragon and Black Emperor entries below summarize powers associated with those pathway Sequences; they describe the pathway’s abilities, not a claim that every listed power is separately shown in Roselle’s own scenes. 2 18 20 Paragon Pathway · Sequences 9–2 Sequence 9 Savant Gains broad scientific, mechanical, and mystical knowledge, with exceptional recall, learning, and comprehension. Sequence 8 Archaeologist Builds physical resilience, practical survival and historical expertise, and a limited grasp of ritual magic and the taboos of ruins. Sequence 7 Appraiser Quickly identifies the powers and dangers of most Beyonder items, helping him use them with fewer risks. Sequence 6 Artisan Manufactures Beyonder items and mechanical artifacts, reshaping characteristics through crafting and assembly. Sequence 5 Astronomer Draws power from astronomical phenomena and constellations, including starlight curses and gravity-altering effects. Sequence 4 Alchemist Creates temporary dolls and objects infused with souls; enhanced manufacturing supports complex devices and mechanical bodies. Sequence 3 Arcane Scholar Extracts information from surroundings, manipulates the environment, and can disintegrate structures or transform into knowledge. Sequence 2 Knowledge Magister Analyzes essences, learns with extraordinary speed, creates imagined wonders, and alters physical principles through knowledge. Sequence titles and ability summaries follow the Paragon Pathway and Paragon abilities articles. Hermit Pathway · Sequence 1 Knowledge Emperor As a Knowledge Emperor, Roselle could use information gathered in the Spirit World to influence the Seven Lights. The pathway’s defining authority lets knowledge take on tangible power. He demonstrates this by turning the potion formulas of the 22 pathways into the Cards of Blasphemy: their effects can evoke a High Sequence aura, cause pathway Beyonders to converge, and resist divination and prophecy. The source notes that Mother Goddess of Depravity corruption contributes to the cards’ unusual anti-divination strength. 19 Black Emperor Pathway · Sequence 0 Black Emperor · Shadow of Order At Sequence 0, Roselle’s route centers on the authority of Autocrat: exploiting loopholes in Order or distorting its intent so that rules serve him. The pathway’s core abilities include Bribery, Disorder, Distortion, Bestowment, Magnify, Exploit, Majesty, and Resurrection. A Black Emperor can return from death while his mausoleum and order remain intact; Roselle’s own attempted resurrection was halted when he recognized the danger his corruption posed to the world. 20 14 Final known advancement Sequence 0: Black Emperor · returned incomplete, missing characteristics and Uniqueness Selected quotes 8 excerpts Many sayings attributed to Roselle echo ideas from the modern world; the source wiki cautions that their authenticity is not guaranteed. 12 “I was an emperor for many years, stood at the pinnacle of human power. I faced True Gods, fought Angels, had followers willing to die for me. I brought the light of civilization to that era. […] What regrets could I possibly have in this life?” — Roselle Gustav, Circle of Inevitability , Chapter 884. 1 “The only lesson that humans can learn from history is that humans do not gain any lessons from history.” — Attributed to Emperor Roselle, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 15. 12 “One is never too old to learn.” — Attributed to Emperor Roselle, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 106. 12 “I want it all!” — Emperor Roselle’s famous saying, recalled by Audrey, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 131. 12 “Take things one step at a time...” — Attributed to Emperor Roselle, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 375. 12 From Roselle’s diary “Huang Tao!” — Diary entry, 23 February 1143, Lord of Mysteries , Chapters 359–360. 16 “The taste of a Demoness ain’t bad.” — Diary entry, Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 317. 16 “I have to work hard to save myself.” — Diary entry, Lord of Mysteries , Chapters 714–715. 16 Short diary excerpts are attributed to Roselle’s published diary entries; read their surrounding context on Roselle’s Diary . More sayings and their chapter context appear on Roselle’s Sayings . title: Son of Chaos
summary: The Son of Chaos, third child of the Original Creator, former owner of the Nation of Disorder and the Chaos Mist Pathway.
searchText: Son of Chaos Outer Deity · Great Old One Son of Chaos The Anarchy · Genie of the Magic Wishing Lamp Overview The Son of Chaos is the third child of the Original Creator, and is one of his three direct children along with the Mother Goddess of Depravity and the Mother Tree of Desire. 1 He was the original owner of the Nation of Disorder and its corresponding Pathways, the Black Emperor and Justiciar. He was also the original owner of the Chaos Mist Pathway . Then came the Son of Chaos, who established order, and with it, shadows naturally emerged. The Second Day of Genesis, Book 2, chapter 1171. Honorific Name The Anarchy, Shadow of Order, Bridge of Light and Darkness, Interstice Between Black and White, Ever-Uncertain Mist, The Truth that Oversees All Things. 2 This is the complete honorific name, formed from combining the honorific names of The Anarchy and the Uncertain Mist. Symbols, Authorities and Abilities In the original Chinese text, 律法 (lǜfǎ) and 规律 (guīlǜ) are distinct terms with different nuances, though both can be translated as "Laws". Since these terms are both distinct authorities, this page uses the same English words for the same Chinese words throughout. Laws (律法, lǜfǎ): codified, enforceable laws, rules established by authority, often carrying judicial or binding force. It aligns with legal systems, decrees, and formal structures of governance. Officially translated as "laws and decrees" and "set of laws" in some relevant chapters. 3 Principles (规律, guīlǜ): inherent patterns or natural laws, the underlying order of reality that exists independently of authority. It is closer to universal principles or the fundamental workings of the world. In other contexts this term can also denote simpler patterns or regularity, an observable consistency or recurring behavior over time. The symbolism of Laws also uses different Chinese characters, 定律 (dìnglǜ), 4 which are also the same characters used for the "Law" in the "Laws of Beyonder Characteristics" or "Second Law". Laws (定律, dìnglǜ): fixed laws or established principles, a stable, universally applicable rule that does not change. The Chinese word for the symbolism of Power (权力, Quánlì) does not denote the "raw power" sense, but rather the "power in the social and political" sense. Pathway authorities The complete Son of Chaos possesses full authority over the Justiciar, Black Emperor, and Chaos Mist Pathways and the corresponding symbols, which include but are not limited to the following: Justiciar: authorities over Order, Judgement, Balance, and Disorder. Black Emperor: authorities over Autocrat and Disorder. Chaos Mist: authorities over Deconstruction, Truth, and Chaos. Symbols at the Above the Sequence level Chaos (混沌, Hùndùn): as one of the three direct children of the Original Creator, the Son of Chaos inherently possesses the Chaos quality of the Original Creator. 5 The Chaos Mist is the manifestation of Chaos in the Son of Chaos. 6 As the Primordial Hunger possesses Primordium and Chaos qualities, he prioritized devouring the Sefirot and Great Old Ones related to those qualities the most. Among the Outer Deities, he preferred the Uncertain Mist the most, 7 because he is the Chaos Gastric Juices, while the Uncertain Mist is a part of the Son of Chaos. 8 Order (秩序, Zhìxù) and Shadow of Order (秩序阴影, Zhìxù yīnyǐng): the birth of the Son of Chaos established Order in the universe, and with it, the Shadow of Order naturally emerged. 9 Order : the symbolism established with the birth of the Son of Chaos. He can modify the bottom-layered Rules of the world to some extent, establish new non-bottom-layered Rules that stay permanent, as well as remove non-bottom-layered Rules. 10 The Justiciar possesses the corresponding core authority of Order, with subordinate authorities of Rules (规则, Guīzé), Laws (律法, Lǜ fǎ), Principles (规律, Guīlǜ), and others. Through the definition of Rules, and only at the level of the complete Son of Chaos, can he touch the Astral World, defining concepts and influencing symbols. 11 The Lord of Mysteries, Demon of Knowledge, and Son of Chaos joining force can extend the Chaos Primogenitor's cooldown by modifying the Major Month. However, they could extend it by one Major Year at most. 12 The Son of Chaos can order all dimensions (higher, lower, and the current one) to become interconnected, as though overlaid with layer upon layer of glass barriers, as shown by the Celestial Thearch in The Apocalypse. 13 If this rule was established, the High-Dimensional Overseer could no longer increase dimensions unscathed, and the Son of Chaos could still maintain influence on the battlefield even if his dimension is lowered. The death due to the backlash from Above the Sequence Rules, such as by exceeding three wishes of the Magic Wishing Lamp, will be granted even when one was isolated by the Corpse Cathedral of the Visionary. 14 After making a deal with Klein, the Genie's voice gradually turned solemn, as if he was proclaiming a clause of law (法律, Fǎlǜ). He seemed to have established a particular Rule based on this deal. There was no need to worry that Klein would go back on his word in the future, even if he were to become a Lord of Mysteries. This is a Rule that has been set. The Genie himself can't violate it afterwards. Laws (定律, Dìnglǜ): the symbolism of Laws, held by both the Son of Chaos and the Demon of Knowledge. One focuses on the law and the universe, the other on the knowledge of the law itself. 15 The complete Son of Chaos can even influence the Laws of Beyonder Characteristics such as Indestructibility, Convergence, and Separation to a certain extent, making limited, low-level, and small-scale modifications. 16 Power (权力, Quánlì): Order and Power are symbiotic, Order requires Power, and Power requires Order, thus the Son of Chaos encompasses the symbolism of Power. 17 Shadow of Order : the symbolism that naturally emerged from the Order established after the birth of the Son of Chaos. At the core of the Black Emperor is the authority of Autocrat (独裁者, Dúcáizhě) under the Shadow of Order symbolism, and the majority of the Disorder (混乱, Hùnluàn) authority. 18 Distortion (扭曲, Niǔqū): a subordinate authority of Autocrat. The Son of Chaos can unleash his powers upon the outside world and Distort all surrounding concepts, authorities, and symbolisms, as shown by the Celestial Thearch in The Apocalypse. 19 The Son of Chaos can Distort the sentence from "I can promise" to "I promise", making it impossible for someone to go back on their word. If they did, they would suffer damage at the level of a Great Old One. 20 This can be done even after he has become the Genie, losing his Sefirah, Uniqueness, and Beyonder Characteristics, reduced to mere consciousness, spirit, and status. 21 If the true Celestial Worthy made a promise to send the Magic Wishing Lamp into the Cosmos in the future, the Genie can Distort this promise to make his seal be removed automatically. This effect can only be achieved by twisting the original owner's words, not the words of someone else. This is one of the more than ten ways for the Genie to verify that someone is the true Celestial Worthy or not. The Genie could Distort the Dual-Pathway True God Amon's sentence of "I can also promise to send you back to the cosmos" and make it impossible for him to go back on his word. The Genie could argue with or twist the Dual-Pathway King of Angels Lumian's ideas. However, since he was merely the messenger for The Fool, not the decision-maker, this wouldn't affect the outcome. Resurrection : Death is a part of the most underlying and core part of the Order of Reality, thus the Black Emperor can Resurrect. In the First Epoch, by killing himself and then Resurrecting through the Black Emperor ability, the Son of Chaos was able to send his main consciousness past the Astral Barrier when it was still perfect. 22 Gray (灰色, Huīsè): the Chaos Mist of the Uncertain Mist is the Gray between white and black, the fog between light and darkness, the bridge between Order and Shadows of Order of the Son of Chaos. 23 Contracts and Transactions : he can make Contracts and facilitate Transactions that even Great Old Ones have to honor. The Genie can make Contracts that if not honored will cause even a Lord of Mysteries to perish and split. Although both the Son of Chaos and the Lord of Mysteries have means to resist the backlash and reduce the damage caused by breaching the Contract made with their own Sefirot as witnesses, it won't be without a price. They would need to consider the consequences. 24 Without the Uncertain Mist present to coordinate and unify the Outer Deities into an alliance, none dared bet on receiving support if they stayed behind to deal with the Lord of Mysteries. 25 Without the Uncertain Mist, the Outer Deities would be disunited, each fighting for themselves, and would easily be driven back by Earth's Above the Sequences after The Apocalypse. 26 Overseeing : with the strengthened Overseeing ability at the Great Old One level, the Uncertain Mist, and by extension the Son of Chaos, can only be harmed by existences possessing a Sefirah. 27 Appearance As the Genie: the wick at the spout of the Magic Wishing Lamp suddenly ignited, emitting light that looked like viscous water, spurting upwards to form a blurred and distorted pale golden figure. 28 History Genesis On the first day, the Original Creator awoke and created this world, but Reality, the Spirit World, the Astral World, and Fate were still mixed together. On the second day, the Oldest One birthed the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Reality gained a foundation, the Spirit World and Astral World were separated, and the River of Fate began to flow. Soon after, the Mother Tree of Desire was born, giving rise to life and introducing evil and desire. Then came the Son of Chaos, who established order, and with it, shadows naturally emerged. 29 First Epoch As one of the direct children of the Original Creator, the Son of Chaos was the most affected by the Law of Convergence when the Original Creator awakened in the Pre-Epoch, causing part of his Sefirah (later self-completed into the Nation of Disorder) and the two Pathways of Justiciar and Black Emperor to be separated from him and be attracted to Earth. The Son of Chaos was able to send his main consciousness past the Astral Barrier by killing himself and then resurrecting through the Black Emperor ability. 30 However, he encountered the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings and was controlled by him. 31 What remained of him in the Cosmos became known as the Outer Deity Uncertain Mist, with some consciousness. 32 At the start of the Era of Destruction, the Son of Chaos was sealed inside the Magic Wishing Lamp by the Celestial Worthy, and became the Genie. 33 Fourth Epoch In the Fourth Epoch, Trunsoest attempted to shatter the Magic Wishing Lamp, but was unsuccessful. This led to his corruption. 34 Lord of Mysteries The Magic Wishing Lamp was formerly owned by Roselle Gustav . Later, it was held by Bernadette Gustav and she made a wish for it in preparation for the upcoming fight against William Augustus I during George III's Apotheosis Ritual. Through its power, she was able to hold the power of a Sequence 1 Knowledge Emperor for a day. 35 The artifact was temporarily held by Cattleya when Bernadette left to find the remains of Roselle on a mysterious island. 36 Afterwards, she informed Mr. Fool about the lamp. When Klein looked at the Magic Wishing Lamp through Cattleya's star in Sefirah Castle, the Genie took over her star and entered in her place. In their meeting, he confirmed that Klein is not the previous owner of Sefirah Castle that sealed him. He still made his offer to Klein, his release in exchange for his assistance, confident that Klein will need it in the future. 37 When Klein was trapped in Adam's Corpse Cathedral, he made a deal with the Genie in order to escape. He promised to send the Magic Wishing Lamp into the Cosmos before the end of 1368, in exchange for two wishes. His first wish was to move the two wishes used by Bernadette under his name, so that she wouldn't die by using all three wishes. His second wish was for Utopia to give rise to a corresponding region in the spirit world, completing his Sequence 1, Attendant of Mysteries ritual. As his second wish is equivalent to his fourth wish, it was distorted, killing him and helping him escape Adam's Divine Kingdom. Klein rented the lamp from Bernadette before he went to the Hornacis Mountain Range. He made a deal with the Genie to acquire assistance during his apotheosis ritual. During the ritual, the Genie used his connection with the Trunsoest Brass Book to use it to help Klein against the assault of Amon's avatars. 38 When the Celestial Worthy was about to be revived in Klein's original body, the Genie used the Trunsoest Brass Book to prohibit his resurrection. 39 During The Fool's Gambit, when Amon invaded Sefirah Castle, the Genie continued using the Trunsoest Brass Book in Klein's fight against Amon. However, when Amon also promised the Genie to send him back to the Cosmos, Klein didn't want to take a chance and used the Fool's authority, forcing the Genie to shrink back to the Magic Wishing Lamp. 40 Circle of Inevitability The lamp appeared with Bernadette around the period before Vermonda Sauron's death at Medici's hands. The Genie suggested to save Roselle by balancing his corruption with another's. 41 In the Tarot Club's battle against Loki, The Hermit held the lamp. 42 During Project Vortex in 1359 of the Fifth Epoch, the Genie was used as a medium to gain temporary access to the Nation of Disorder. Both the Genie inside the Magic Wishing Lamp and his counterpart in the Cosmos, the Uncertain Mist, were heavily injured by the combined efforts of Adam, Amon, Roselle Gustav and Bernadette Gustav. 43 Before the Death of Primordial Demoness, Lumian Lee visited Bernadette and asked to speak with the Genie for advice regarding The Apocalypse on behalf of The Fool. The Genie gave three hints that greatly assisted them in The Apocalypse. 44 In the early stage of The Apocalypse, Mirror Roselle Gustav mentioned to Bernadette that even with the required Uniquenesses and Sequence 1 characteristic, the Nation of Disorder couldn't immediately become a Great Old One because its consciousness is not unified. The only way to instantly elevate it to the level of a Great Old One was to unseal and release the Genie; however, what he might do after escaping his seal was entirely unpredictable. 45 After The Apocalypse, Klein intended to fulfill his promise to return the Magic Wishing Lamp to the universe, using it to lure out the hiding Uncertain Mist and secretly influence him. Without the Uncertain Mist, the Outer Deities would be disunited, and would easily be driven away. 46 The Genie and the Uncertain Mist are hostile towards each other. 47 Whether the Uncertain Mist or the Genie would emerge victorious after they merged is unknown, both scenarios are equally plausible. 48 See also Nation of Disorder, Uncertain Mist, and the Magic Wishing Lamp. title: Original Creator
summary: The Original Creator, also called the Oldest One and Primordial Chaos, the existence who created the universe and everything in it.
searchText: Original Creator Above the Sequence · Source of All Original Creator Oldest One · Primordial Chaos Overview The Original Creator (最初造物主, lit. Primeval Lord Maker of All Things, Zuìchū zàowùzhǔ), also known as the Oldest One (最初, lit. The Primeval, Zuìchū) and Primordial Chaos (原初混沌, Yuánchū hùndùn), 1 is the existence who created the universe and everything in it. 2 He is the amalgamation of all concepts and symbols in the universe. He is the source of all Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder Characteristics of all Pathways. All things that shouldn't happen might happen when encountering him. He was asleep deep inside Earth until one day he woke up and created a cataclysm that almost destroyed humanity, ushering in the First Epoch. Due to his awakening and division, many Outer Deities came and cast their gaze upon Earth. Note: "Oldest One" (最初, Zuìchū) is the same Chinese word as the "Original" used in "Original Creator" (最初造物主). Everything has godhood in them. The Oldest One is still alive, alive in everyone's bodies. Roselle Gustav, Book 1, chapter 1308. Characteristics Collective of All The Original Creator is the collective of all. He is crazy, but also rational; he is confused, but also lucid. He created everything, and he destroyed everything. He loves all things, and he also hates all things. He has the most intense of all desires, yet he is indifferent and unaffected by anything. 3 He is the maker of the universe, and also its destroyer. He is both day and also night. He is the light of holiness, and also the decadent abyss. 4 He is all-inclusive, masculinity, femininity, and gender-neutral all in one. 5 He is the amalgamation of all contradicting concepts and symbolism. Primordium and Chaos He is the Primordial Chaos (原初混沌, Yuánchū hùndùn), the Chaos that the world was born from, and would eventually return to. 6 Manifestations of the Primordium and Chaos nature of the Original Creator include: The Primordial God Almighty, one of the split-off personas of the Original Creator, and the symbol of the Chaos Sea. The Original Creator's three direct children all hold aspects of Chaos: 7 The Chaos Primogenitor, Sequence 0, of the Mother Goddess of Depravity. The Chaos Mist, Sequence 0, of the Son of Chaos. The fact that the Mother Tree of Desire is also the Father of Devils, making her symbolically, inherently Chaotic. The Fourth Pillar, which represents the endpoint of destiny, the universe's destruction, and the finale of all things, the return of everything to Chaos, including the three Pillars. As the feminine aspect of the Original Creator, the Demoness, who is also named the Chaos Demoness and Primordial Demoness, holds authority over both Chaos and Primordium. 8 The Primordial Hunger possesses Primordium and Chaos qualities, so he prioritized devouring the Sefirot and Great Old Ones related to those qualities the most. Among the Sefirot, his objectives include the City of Calamity, and the Chaos Sea with the Uniqueness of Hanged Man and others. 9 Among the Outer Deities, he preferred the Uncertain Mist the most, 10 because he is the Chaos Gastric Juices, while the Uncertain Mist is a part of the Son of Chaos. 11 Chaos (混沌, Hùndùn) is the End (结束, Jiéshù), while Primordium (原初, Yuánchū) is the Beginning (开始, Kāishǐ). These two aspects are similar to some extent, and at the Original Creator's level, both the Beginning and the End merge into one. Manifestations of the inherent connection between the Beginning and the End include: 12 The destruction of the Fourth Pillar would also bring about a new world. The Demoness' Primordium authority, and the Calamity of Destruction's title as the Disaster of Origin, signifies that they, to some extent, catalyze new beginnings through destruction, such as how supernova explosions give birth to new stars. The Twilight Giant possesses both the authority of Twilight, which represents the gradual contraction and conclusion of this universe, and the authority of Dawn, which signifies the beginning of a new universe. 13 Disorder and Madness As the amalgamation of all contradicting concepts and symbolism, all his actions are random, even he himself cannot predict them. The reason Disorder (混乱, Hǔnluàn) and Madness (疯狂, Fēngkuáng) are the bottom-layer rules of this world 14 is because everything in this world (all living beings, all Beyonder Characteristics, the way events unfold, and the miraculous turns of Fate) originates from the Original Creator. Something good will inevitably carry bad aspects, and vice versa. This is the essence of the world, the fundamental symbol that governs all things. Even Great Existences on the level of the Pillars can't completely avoid it, they can only mitigate its influence. 15 Manifestations of this characteristic include: The extreme loss of control for most Beyonders is when Godhood gains absolute dominance, transforming them into a state similar to the Original Creator, completely chaotic, completely losing their sense of self. The Key of Light's symbolism of Endless Disorder (无尽的混乱, Wújìn de hǔnluàn), signifying that the essence of Fate is Disorder, which embodies Madness. 16 Convergence and Division Instincts As the amalgamation of all contradicting concepts and symbolism, the Original Creator naturally has an uncontrollable tendency to Split, and once he Splits, there will be a strong trend towards Convergence. Thus, he is very unstable because both Convergence and Division are his instincts. 17 He couldn't have repealed the Law of Convergence to prevent his own fragmentation. 18 This is the crux and origin of the Law of Convergence, 19 which applies to Beyonder Characteristics, Uniqueness, and Sefirot, and which manifests through influencing Fate itself. 20 Convergence is the instinct of all things, originating from the Original Creator's tendency to Converge. The higher the level, the stronger the instinct. If one reaches the Sefirot Accommodation Limit, just accommodating an additional Sefirah will lead to being controlled by the Convergence Instinct in an irreversible manner. They would be unable to restrain themselves from Converging until they become the embodiment of the entire universe, which is also the innate instinct of the Original Creator. Once this process begins, it can only be interrupted by their complete fall and division. Revival Scenarios Known scenarios for the Original Creator's revival include: The Mirrored Original Creator, born from the union between the Original Creator's masculine and feminine aspects, embodied by the Sefirah City of Calamity and the two Pathways of Red Priest and Demoness. This is the only revival scenario where the Original Creator can achieve a stable existence. 21 The massive aggregation of Sefirot and Beyonder Characteristics would cause the Oldest One to revive, 22 for example, the merging of the nine Sefirot on Earth. 23 The Primordial Hunger Devouring the Chaos Primogenitor would cause an aggressive Convergence to occur, causing the Original Creator to awaken. 24 There are other unmentioned Pathways in the universe that could possibly resurrect the Original Creator to a certain extent like the Red Priest and Demoness Pathways, but they have no possibility for a stable existence. 25 Exception to All Rules The Original Creator represents the ultimate, chaos, beginning and end, the unknowable and undiscussable. No existence can surpass this level, and this level can only have one being. He is the Exception, the Inconceivable, the Incomprehensible, the Indescribable. All things that shouldn't happen might happen when encountering him: unknowable, undiscussable, unnameable. 26 For example: Normally, things like Uniquenesses and Sefirot cannot be divided, copied, or destroyed. Only one situation can cause them to be torn apart: encountering the Original Creator. And it was this single instance of Sefirot being torn apart that led the Great Old Dominators to discover that torn Sefirot could self-complete. The Mother Goddess of Depravity, as The Indestructible, would never perish, unless she encountered the Original Creator who could make the impossible happen, or the Fourth Pillar symbolizing the end to everything was born, or she overextended the Chaos Primogenitor's unique symbolism as the nascent Original Creator of the next universe. 27 The Original Creator naturally can do everything that his other counterparts can, at the highest level. Indestructible Spiritual Imprint The Original Creator created the entire world, created all things, created all Outer Deities, and finally split into six Sefirot, sixteen Uniquenesses, and countless Beyonder Characteristics. From this perspective, all things possess Godhood. 28 The spiritual imprint of the Original Creator resides within all Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder Characteristics. Even though his Will would gradually weaken over time unless a true resurrection occurred, his Spirit remained indestructible and would always seek to reawaken. The higher up in sequence, the closer one is to the Original Creator. The more one learns about him, the more likely he will awaken inside oneself. 29 High-ranked Beyonders would carry in their subconscious the mental imprints or past shadows of the Great Old Ones presiding over their Pathway, and potentially even glimpses of the Original Creator. 30 Compared to the Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder Characteristics directly derived from him, the Tenebrous World, Brood Hive, and Nation of Disorder are much less affected in this regard. This is because they originated from the Mother Tree of Desire, Mother Goddess of Depravity, and Son of Chaos respectively rather than being a product split off from the Original Creator. 31 Similarly, the Outer Deities born from the union between the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity are much less impacted in this regard, since they are neither his split-off personas nor his three direct descendants. With this intermediary layer, the spiritual imprint of the Original Creator within their Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder Characteristics was relatively weak. Normal humans also carried Godhood and were subject to the erosion and influence of the Sea of Collective Subconscious, inheriting the most profound cognition and impressions of ancient humanity. Disorder, Madness, and Primal Instincts lurked deep within their subconscious. The closer it is to The Apocalypse, the easier it is for Beyonders to advance due to the weakening will of the Original Creator. Characteristics of the Created Universe The form of the created universe depends on the Original Creator's thought. 32 If the universe is destroyed and the Original Creator revives to recreate the world, whether the three Pillars will change or not depends on the Original Creator. This is because the Original Creator has the ability to change things, and the Astral World, Spirit World, and Reality are not necessarily divided or exist in this way by default. 33 The Oldest One's power is only related to the Oldest One himself, and not directly related to the Sefirot. In this universe, he himself became the Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder Characteristics. This is the reason why, when the universe reaches its end and the Fourth Pillar brings about the destruction and restart of the entire universe (even Great Old Ones would perish and the universe would return to Chaos), the Chaos Primogenitor as the next Original Creator can recreate the universe. Sefirot, Uniquenesses, Beyonder Characteristics Beyonder Characteristics are the cornerstone composing the Original Creator. In the next universe, they will still exist, so his tendency to converge and diverge due to the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence would still remain. 34 However, he can freely permutate, combine and modify Beyonder Characteristics, for example, mixing two Pathways into a single pathway, Uniqueness, or even creating a pathway of completely brand new symbolism or domain. 35 History Genesis On the first day, the Original Creator awoke and created this world, but Reality, the Spirit World, the Astral World, and Fate were still mixed together. 36 On the second day, the Oldest One birthed the Mother Goddess of Depravity. Reality gained a foundation, the Spirit World and Astral World were separated, and the River of Fate began to flow. Soon after, the Mother Tree of Desire was born, giving rise to life and introducing evil and desire. Then came the Son of Chaos, who established order, and with it, shadows naturally emerged. On the third day, the Oldest One and the Mother Goddess united, and the Mother of All Things gave birth to a firstborn daughter, the Goddess of Fate. From then on, the fates of all things began to intertwine, no longer in absolute chaos but instead forming relative patterns and foreseeable futures. After the Goddess of Fate, the other Outer Deities were born one after another from the union between the Original Creator and the Mother Goddess of Depravity, 37 with the Circle of Inevitability as their eldest son. 38 The Original Creator's Awakening When the stars are right, Chaos will rise from underground, and the Great Oldest One will awaken. Book 1, chapter 1167. In a time more ancient than the Modern Era of the Pre-Epoch, the sleeping Oldest One had naturally split into multiple personas. They were also in a state of slumber, but they began to use the authority and Beyonder Characteristics they controlled to influence the world, making many preparations for the true dissociation which would occur when the Original Creator awakened. Among the multiple personas, the Primordial God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings were the most powerful and active Great Old Ones on Earth. Besides Earth, there are no other Great Old Ones in the universe that originated from a split-off personality of the Original Creator. 39 The Myth of Creation according to the Orthodox churches' holy scriptures is as follows: The Creator awoke from Chaos and shattered the darkness, creating the first ray of light. He then fused himself completely into the universe and made up all of existence. His body became the land and stars. One of his eyes became the sun, while the other became the crimson moon. Some of his blood rushed into the seas and rivers, nourishing and nurturing lives. His lungs turned into the elves; His heart turned into the giants; His liver turned into the treants; His brain turned into the dragons; His kidneys turned into the feather serpents; His hair turned into the phoenixes; His ears turned into the demonic wolves; His mouth and teeth turned into the mutants, and His remaining bodily fluids turned into the sea monsters, of which the essence was Naga. His stomach, His small and large intestines, and the evil parts of His body turned into devils, evil spirits and various kinds of unknown maleficent existences. His spirit became the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of the Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom. His wisdom gave birth to humanity. That was the first Epoch, the Chaos Epoch. Book 1, chapter 18. The Myth hints at the true story: the Original Creator woke up from the underground during the 21st century of the Pre-Epoch, then his body shattered into six Sefirot and Beyonder Characteristics of sixteen Standard Pathways. The three direct descendants of the Original Creator were the Outer Deities most affected by this event, having part of their Sefirot and Pathways broken off and attracted to Earth due to the Law of Convergence. When there were twenty-two Pathways and nine Sefirot, a balance was reached, and the attraction stopped. 40 Astral Barrier The Astral Barrier is the barrier around the planet, formed after the Original Creator awakened at the end of the Pre-Epoch. Sefirot The Ancient Gods believed that the Original Creator left nine legacies behind, which were derived from some part of his body. They might be kingdoms, cities, rivers, oceans, keys, etc. The nine Sefirot correspond to nine Above the Sequence groups and twenty-two Standard Pathways. The nine Sefirot are Sefirah Castle, Chaos Sea, River of Eternal Darkness, Brood Hive, Knowledge Moor, Tenebrous World, Key of Light, City of Calamity and Nation of Disorder. 41 Among the Sefirot, the Brood Hive, Tenebrous World, and Nation of Disorder, and their corresponding Pathways, actually originated from the Original Creator's three direct descendants. The other six Sefirot and sixteen Standard Pathways originated from the Original Creator and were split off when he woke up, with different personas controlling different Sefirot, Uniquenesses, and Beyonder Characteristics. 42 Mirrored Original Creator The Mirrored Original Creator refers to the existence born from the union between the Original Creator's masculine and feminine aspects, embodied by the Sefirah City of Calamity and the two Pathways of Red Priest and Demoness. It was originally a resurrection plan of the Original Creator to achieve a stable existence. 43 Chaos Primogenitor The Chaos Primogenitor is the Original Sin of the universe. Although merely Sequence 0, it carries significant symbolism that represents the nascent Original Creator of the next universe. Nurturing it is one of the Mother Goddess of Depravity's two most vital symbols and a key reason she remains a Pillar even after the Brood Hive's separation. Even as a Mother, she cannot overly wield its symbolic powers without risking instability or further complications. 44 See also Mirrored Original Creator, Primordial God Almighty , Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings , Sefirot, and Outer Deities. title: Lord of the Mysteries Fan Wiki
summary: A comprehensive fan wiki for Lord of the Mysteries by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving. Explore characters, pathways, volumes, quotes, and lore from the novel.
searchText: Lord of the Mysteries Fan Wiki ↑ Lord of the Mysteries Fan Wiki "You can address me as… The Fool ." — Klein Moretti on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 6 Klein Moretti is the main protagonist of Lord of Mysteries . He owns the Sefirah Castle and holds authority over the Fool , Error , and Door . He is the mysterious leader of the Tarot Club and, from 1352, the God of the Church of the Fool . 1. What Is LOTM? Lord of Mysteries is a western fantasy (xuanhuan) web novel written by the Chinese author Cuttlefish That Loves Diving and published on QiDian. At the end of April 2020, the novel finished its eighth and final volume. The web novel was officially translated by CKTalon and published on Webnovel. In April of 2021, Webnovel renamed the title from "Lord of the Mysteries" to "Lord of Mysteries". 2. Awards and Recognitions Ever since its release, the series has achieved wide critical acclaim. In 2020, the series earned the honor of being one of the first 100 Chinese Web Novels to enter into the "Web Novel Category" Collection of the National Library of China. On September 16, 2021, "The Lord of Mysteries" was included in the "China Internet Literature Influence List: Overseas Influence List" by The Chinese Writers Association, along with 《Dragon Prince Yuan》 , 《Tales of Demons and Gods》 , and 《The Legendary Mechanic》 . On September 5, 2022, it was winning Best Special award of "Top Ten Annual National IP Selection in 2021" for Fantasy Creative category. As a phenomenon-level fantasy web novel which leads the new trend of "phenomenal" web novel creation. On July 11, 2023, "The Lord of Mysteries" was selected for the second "Tianma Literature Award" sponsored by the Shanghai Writers Association and the Publicity Department of the CPC Shanghai Hongkou District Committee, under the guidance of the China Writers Association Internet Literature Center and with the support of the Shanghai Press and Publication Bureau. title: Aurore Lee
summary: Aurore Lee, Lumian Lee's foster sister, transmigrator, writer, and Sequence 7 Warlock of the Hermit Pathway.
searchText: Aurore Lee Character profile Aurore Lee Hermit Pathway · Sequence 7: Warlock Aurore Lee is a transmigrator, writer, and foster sister of Lumian Lee in Circle of Inevitability . She is a member of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, where she uses the codename “Muggle.” This article contains major spoilers for Circle of Inevitability, including events in Cordu. Background Aurore came from modern China and awoke in the body of Roche Louise Sanson. She later settled in Cordu Village and took in Lumian, a homeless boy. She writes novels and works as a columnist for Novel Weekly . Pathway Aurore is a Sequence 7 Warlock of the Hermit Pathway . The body she transmigrated into had previously advanced along the Eternal Aeon Pathway. These are distinct histories and should not be read as one sequence progression. See the archive’s Pathways reference for pathway summaries. Cordu Aurore’s story in Book Two is tied to the events that destroyed Cordu Village. A conflict between her and the Roche Louise Sanson persona grew after a soul-summoning spell brought Roche’s memories and personality to the surface. During the ritual in Cordu, Aurore regained control long enough to push Lumian away from the altar, but the ritual still killed her and the villagers present. Later, soul fragments of Aurore and the other villagers were sealed inside Lumian by the Fool. The story leaves Aurore’s ultimate fate unresolved in the source material summarized here. Related profile: Lumian Lee . Source notes This page is an original summary based on the Aurore Lee article on the Lord of the Mysteries Fandom wiki, licensed under CC BY-SA. The summary is adapted and shared under the same license. Related archive pages: Hermit Pathway , Eternal Aeon Pathway , and Lumian Lee . title: Gehrman Sparrow
summary: Gehrman Sparrow, the adventurer and pirate bounty hunter identity assumed by Klein Moretti.
searchText: Gehrman Sparrow Identity profile Gehrman Sparrow Klein Moretti’s adventurer identity · The World Gehrman Sparrow is an identity assumed by Klein Moretti after he leaves Backlund. Under this name, Klein presents himself as a cold, dangerous adventurer and pirate bounty hunter. “The World” is his Tarot Club title. This page contains major spoilers for Lord of Mysteries. Purpose of the identity Klein uses the Gehrman Sparrow identity while traveling through the seas and seeking mermaids for his advancement ritual. Maintaining the role also helps him digest the Faceless potion. The identity becomes widely known through his work as an adventurer and bounty hunter. People associated with Gehrman Blazing Danitz, his companion during part of the sea journey. Reinette Tinekerr , his messenger. Klein Moretti , the person behind the identity. For the full character record, see Klein Moretti’s profile . For his Tarot Club role, see Tarot Club Members . Story role Gehrman is one of several public identities Klein uses to move through the world. Compared with his earlier detective identity, Gehrman is deliberately severe and confrontational. The performance supports Klein’s work at sea while concealing his connection to the Tarot Club’s mysterious leader. As “The World,” Klein speaks to the other Tarot Club members through this persona. The identity is referenced again in Circle of Inevitability .
